Grounded in theories of distributed cognition, we introduce CoMAP, a system that embodies a graph-based collaboration paradigm. By providing a shared visual workspace with dual-modality AI support, CoMAP transforms the human-AI relationship from a prompt-and-response loop into a transparent and equitable partnership. Our study with 30 educators shows CoMAP significantly improves teachers' design expression, divergent thinking, and iterative practice compared to a dialogue-only baseline. These findings demonstrate how a nonlinear, artifact-centric approach can foster trust, reduce cognitive load, and \textcolor{fix}{support} educators to take control of their creative process. Our contributions are available at: https://comap2025.github.io/.

AI.tldr: CoMAP 是一个面向项目式学习（PBL）教学设计的图谱化人机协同系统：以 ASSURE 模型分解出的六类节点构成结构化图谱画布作为共享视觉工作区，配合一个全局对话 Agent（发散 ideation）与两个局部 GUI Agent（Refine 精炼、Split 拆解）实现双模态 AI 支持，将人机关系从"提示-应答"循环转变为以工件为中心的透明协作。对 30 名教师的被试内交叉实验显示，相比纯对话式基线，CoMAP 显著提升设计表达（d=1.11）、对同伴设计的理解（d=1.16）、可控性、透明度、协作感与信任，并显著降低认知负荷（d=0.62）、对话轮数（d=1.11）与负面词汇（d=0.76）。
AI.motivation: 项目式学习（PBL）教学设计具有高度非线性、迭代性的特征：学习目标、活动、资源、评价等成分相互依赖，修改任一环节往往牵动全局。现有三类支持方案各有局限：(1) 工作流工具（如 PBLWorks Designer、ADDIE/UbD/ASSURE 流程工具）建立在固定的线性步骤上，无法适现实约束触发的反复返工；(2) 纯对话式 AI 灵活但要求教师高负荷地精确表述意图，线性上下文易产生不一致，难以实现"精确迭代定位"；(3) 学习环境平台（LAMS、WISE 等）聚焦于学习者端支持，对教师前期的教学构想支架不足。核心缺口是缺少一种既能提供共享工作区、又能对迭代位置与 AI 协助粒度进行精确控制的协同工具。此外，先行形成性研究还揭示了三项实践痛点：路径依赖与 ideation 空间受限（C1）、难以维持整体全局视野（C2）、上下文 AI 支持不足（C3）。
AI.method:
1) 形成性研究：7 名跨学科 PBL 从业者，先半结构化访谈，再用静态 CoMAP 原型作设计探针做出声思考，经主题分析归纳出 C1–C3 挑战与 DG1–DG3 设计目标。
2) 系统设计：理论基础为图式心理学的语义网络模型（知识即互联图结构）与分布式认知理论（认知分布于人、AI 与工件之间），画布本身充当"认知工件"与共享心智模型媒介。依据 ASSURE 模型定义六类节点（学习者分析、学习目标、教学策略、学习活动、项目资源、评价与评估），以带标签的有向边表达关系（supports/guides/measures/relates to，标签可编辑）；提供 Design Hints 预置模板库、无限平移缩放与 mini-map、summary/detail 双视图、导出为线性教案文档或可打印卡片。AI 侧为双模态多 Agent：Global Agent 通过函数调用（add_node/modify_node/create_edge，JSON actions）直接操纵画布，扮演"教学设计光标"以弥合执行鸿沟；Refine Agent 与 Split Agent 嵌入节点右键菜单，以 before-and-after 差异对比 UI 呈现，逐项接受/拒绝。技术栈为 React + React Flow 前端、Python Flask 后端、SQLite 日志，调用 GPT-4.1。
3) 用户研究：30 名教师（23女7男，均值 24.2 岁，来自 21 城市）在被试内交叉设计下对照"图谱画布+AI"与"纯对话 AI + 独立文档"，采用组间顺序反平衡、两个跨学科 PBL 任务（A 外来农作物史；B 人口老龄化与社区照护）、".mock-teaching"分享环节与半结构化访谈。测量含 Intelligent-TPACK 背景量表、五维人机交互体验量表（可控性、透明度、认知负荷、协作、信任，源自信任自动化量表与 NASA-TLX）、感知理解与感知表达量表；辅以交互日志的行为指标（节点-边比、连续节点平均距离、对话轮数、平均消息长度、负面关键词）。统计用 Shapiro-Wilk 正态性检验、配对 t 检验/Wilcoxon 符号秩检验、Holm 校正、以 TPACK 为协变量的 ANCOVA，并报告 Cohen's d；定性部分为双人独立编码的迭代主题分析。附录另报告 token/成本、延迟与失败率分析。
AI.result: RQ1：CoMAP 条件下感知设计表达显著更高（6.13 vs 4.15，t(29)=6.37，p<.001，d=1.11）；感知对同伴设计的理解亦更高（5.77 vs 4.29，W=12，p<.001，d=1.16）；ANCOVA 控制 TPACK 后仍显著（β=1.77 / 1.41，p<.001）。日志显示节点-边比 0.47、连续节点平均距离 445.72 像素，印证结构互联与非线性探索。RQ2：可控性（d=0.52）、透明度（d=0.72）、认知负荷（d=0.62）、协作（d=0.72）、信任（d=0.78）全部显著优于基线，ANCOVA 后保持显著；AI 建议接受率 76%、其中 40% 被修改，表明用户保持最终决策权。效率方面对话轮数 11.82 vs 18.64（d=1.11）、负面关键词 2.14 vs 4.16（d=0.76）显著更优，而会话时长与平均消息长度无显著差异。定性分析归纳出三种通用协作模式（发散定框、模块化拆解的收敛结构化、系统级迭代对齐）与三类个体差异模式（并行 vs 顺序结构化、指令式 vs 探索式提示、多模态编排 vs 模态固着）。技术侧：3,120 次 API 调用消耗约 468 万输入/156 万输出 token，总成本约 21.84 美元；平均延迟 4.5 秒、中位 3.8 秒、90 分位 9.2 秒；总失败率约 3.01%（结构违规 1.53%、语义/上下文错误 0.99%、语法错误 0.49%）。
AI.conclusion: CoMAP 表明，以结构化图谱为共享外部表征、并结合"全局发散对话 + 局部直接操作"的双模态 AI，可将教师从"管理对话"负担中解放到"创造性构思"，在表达清晰度、共享理解、可控性与信任上带来大效应量改进，并降低认知负荷。作者据此提出三条设计原则：支持共享的外部化表征、把复杂设计分解并可视化、将直接操作与 AI 对话整合。同时承认三项局限：样本仅 30 名中等经验教师（外部效度受限）、多因素整体评估无法归因到单一组件（消融缺失）、依赖 GPT-4.1 单一模型且单次调用约 2000 token 的开销与长尾延迟限制可扩展性。未来方向包括替代教学设计框架（ADDIE/Kemp/逆向设计）、扩展到其他设计域（软件架构、服务蓝图、HTA、逻辑模型）、多用户与跨学科协同、以及在工作流中融入教师领域学习支持。

title: Depression Detection at the Point of Care: Automated Analysis of Linguistic Signals from Routine Primary Care Encounters
summary: Depression is underdiagnosed in primary care, yet timely identification remains critical. Recorded clinical encounters, increasingly common with digital scribing technologies, present an opportunity to detect depression from naturalistic dialogue. We investigated automated depression detection from 1,108 audio-recorded primary care encounters in the Establishing Focus study, with depression defined by PHQ-9 (n=253 depressed, n=855 non-depressed). We compared three supervised approaches, Sentence-BERT + Logistic Regression (LR), LIWC+LR and ModernBERT, against a zero-shot GPT-OSS. GPT-OSS achieved the strongest performance (AUPRC=0.510, AUROC=0.774), with LIWC+LR competitive among supervised models (AUPRC=0.500, AUROC=0.742). Combined dyadic transcripts outperformed single-speaker configurations, with providers linguistically mirroring patients in depression encounters, an additive signal not captured by either speaker alone. Meaningful detection is achievable from the first 128 patient tokens (AUPRC=0.356, AUROC=0.675), supporting in-the-moment clinical decision support. These findings argue for passively collected clinical audio as a low-burden complement to existing screening workflows.

AI.tldr: 研究利用1,108个初级保健就诊的录音，通过多种NLP方法（Sentence-BERT+LR、LIWC+LR、ModernBERT和GPT-OSS零样本模型）自动检测抑郁症。GPT-OSS表现最佳（AUROC=0.774），双向对话转录本优于单说话者配置，且仅用前128个患者token即可实现有意义检测，支持实时临床决策辅助。
AI.motivation: 初级保健中抑郁症常被漏诊，而数字化记录技术（如数字抄写）的普及提供了从自然对话中自动检测抑郁的机会，需要探索可扩展的低负担方法。
AI.method: 研究纳入1,108例录音就诊记录，抑郁定义为PHQ-9评分（253例抑郁，855例非抑郁）。比较三种监督方法（Sentence-BERT+LR、LIWC+LR、ModernBERT）与零样本GPT-OSS模型，并测试不同说话者配置（双向vs单说话者）及早期token窗口的检测性能。
AI.result: GPT-OSS零样本模型取得最佳性能（AUPRC=0.510, AUROC=0.774），LIWC+LR在监督模型中竞争力最强（AUPRC=0.500, AUROC=0.742）。双向对话转录本优于单说话者配置，抑郁就诊中医生存在语言镜像患者现象。前128个患者token即可实现有意义检测（AUPRC=0.356, AUROC=0.675）。
AI.conclusion: 被动收集的临床音频可作为现有筛查流程的低负担补充方案，支持实时临床决策辅助；双向对话中的互动特征和语言镜像现象提供了单一说话者无法捕捉的附加信号。

title: Toward Reducing Unproductive Container Moves: Predicting Service Requirements and Dwell Times
summary: This article presents the results of a data science study conducted at a container terminal, aimed at reducing unproductive container moves through the prediction of service requirements and container dwell times. We develop and evaluate machine learning models that leverage historical operational data to anticipate which containers will require pre-clearance handling services prior to cargo release and to estimate how long they are expected to remain in the terminal. As part of the data preparation process, we implement a classification system for cargo descriptions and perform deduplication of consignee records to improve data consistency and feature quality. These predictive capabilities provide valuable inputs for strategic planning and resource allocation in yard operations. Across multiple temporal validation periods, the proposed models consistently outperform existing rule-based heuristics and random baselines in precision and recall. These results demonstrate the practical value of predictive analytics for improving operational efficiency and supporting data-driven decision-making in container terminal logistics.

AI.tldr: 本研究在集装箱码头开展数据科学研究，通过机器学习模型预测海关预检服务需求和集装箱停留时间，以减少无效搬移操作。
AI.motivation: 集装箱码头运营中存在大量无效的集装箱搬移操作，导致资源浪费和效率低下。传统规则-based方法无法准确预测哪些集装箱需要预检服务以及停留时间，因此需要数据驱动的方法来优化资源分配和战略规划。
AI.method: 利用历史运营数据开发机器学习模型；实施货物描述分类系统和收货人记录去重以提升数据质量和特征质量；采用多个时间验证周期进行模型评估。
AI.result: 所提出的模型在精确率和召回率上均持续优于现有规则-based启发式方法和随机基准模型。
AI.conclusion: 预测性分析对提升集装箱码头物流运营效率和支持数据驱动决策具有实际应用价值。

title: FLeX: Fourier-based Low-rank EXpansion for multilingual transfer
comment: 19 pages, 25 figures, Stanford CS224N Custom Project
summary: Cross-lingual code generation is critical in enterprise environments where multiple programming languages coexist. However, fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) individually for each language is computationally prohibitive. This paper investigates whether parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods and optimizer enhancements can improve cross-lingual transfer from Python to languages like Java. We fine-tune the Code Llama 7B model using low-rank adaptation (LoRA) to optimize a small subset of parameters and compare Adam and Sophia optimizers, while exploring a novel Fourier-based regularization technique. Our contributions include: (1)demonstrating that LoRA fine-tuning on a small, high-quality dataset (MBPP) can exceed the pass@1 performance of the more broadly fine-tuned Code Llama-Python-7B model (40.1% vs. 38.4%); (2) showing that while Sophia achieves faster convergence than Adam, final pass@1 scores show marginal differences; and (3) presenting evidence that Fourier-based regularization during fine-tuning significantly improves cross-lingual transfer, achieving 42.1% pass@1 on Java tasks compared to the 34.2% baseline. These findings suggest that combining LoRA, optimized training methods, and frequency-domain regularization can efficiently adapt single-language LLMs to perform well across multiple programming languages.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究如何利用参数高效微调方法和优化器增强技术，提升大语言模型从Python到Java的跨语言代码生成能力。通过对Code Llama 7B模型进行LoRA微调，并比较Adam和Sophia优化器，同时引入傅里叶正则化技术，最终实现在Java任务上42.1%的pass@1性能，超越基线34.2%。
AI.motivation: 在企业环境中多种编程语言共存的场景下，为每种语言单独微调大模型在计算上不可行。研究的核心动机是探索参数高效微调方法和训练策略，能否实现从单一语言（Python）到目标语言（Java）的有效跨语言迁移，从而避免为每个目标语言进行完整的模型微调。
AI.method: 采用以下方法：(1) 使用LoRA（低秩适应）对Code Llama 7B进行参数高效微调，仅优化少量参数；(2) 在MBPP数据集上进行微调；(3) 比较Adam和Sophia两种优化器的收敛速度和最终性能；(4) 提出并验证基于傅里叶变换的正则化技术。
AI.result: 三项关键发现：① LoRA微调在MBPP数据集上达到40.1% pass@1，优于更广泛微调的Code Llama-Python-7B（38.4%）；② Sophia优化器收敛速度快于Adam，但最终pass@1分数差异不大；③ 傅里叶正则化显著提升跨语言迁移，Java任务达42.1%，远超基线34.2%。
AI.conclusion: 结合LoRA参数高效微调、优化训练方法与频域正则化技术，可以高效地将单一编程语言的LLM适配到多种编程语言，验证了跨语言代码生成中参数高效方法与正则化策略的有效性。

title: Beyond End-to-End: Dynamic Chain Optimization for Private LLM Adaptation on the Edge
summary: Federated fine-tuning enables privacy-preserving LLM adaptation but faces a critical bottleneck: the disparity between LLMs' high memory demands and edge devices' limited capacity. To break the memory barrier, we propose Chain Federated Fine-Tuning (ChainFed), an innovative paradigm that forgoes end-to-end updates in favor of a sequential, layer-by-layer manner. It first trains the initial adapter to convergence, freezes its weights, and then proceeds to the next. This iterative train-and-freeze process forms an optimization chain, gradually enhancing the model's task-specific proficiency. ChainFed further integrates three core techniques: 1) Dynamic Layer Co-Tuning to bridge semantic gaps between sequentially tuned layers and facilitate information flow; 2) Globally Perceptive Optimization to endow each adapter with foresight beyond its local objective; 3) Function-Oriented Adaptive Tuning to automatically identify the optimal fine-tuning starting point. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate the superiority of ChainFed over existing methods, boosting average accuracy by up to 46.46\%.

AI.tldr: ChainFed提出一种链式联邦微调范式，通过逐层顺序训练和冻结适配器来突破边缘设备的内存限制，包含三项核心技术：动态层协同微调、全局感知优化和函数导向自适应微调，实验表明该方法最高可提升平均准确率46.46%。
AI.motivation: 联邦微调虽能保护隐私地适配LLM，但边缘设备内存有限，无法承担LLM的高内存需求，传统端到端更新方法在资源受限场景下难以实施。
AI.method: ChainFed采用链式训练策略：首先训练初始适配器至收敛，冻结其权重，再进行下一层的训练。此外集成三项技术：1）动态层协同微调（Dynamic Layer Co-Tuning）弥合顺序微调层间的语义鸿沟；2）全局感知优化（Globally Perceptive Optimization）使各适配器具备超越局部目标的全局视野；3）函数导向自适应微调（Function-Oriented Adaptive Tuning）自动识别最优微调起点。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上的实验表明ChainFed优于现有方法，最高可提升平均准确率46.46%。
AI.conclusion: ChainFed通过链式逐层训练策略有效解决了联邦学习中边缘设备的内存瓶颈问题，三项核心技术的集成使其在任务适应能力上显著超越现有联邦微调方法。

title: Database Querying under Missing Values Governed by Missingness Mechanisms
summary: We address the problems of giving a semantics to- and doing query answering (QA) on a relational database (RDB) that has missing values (MVs). The causes for the latter are governed by a Missingness Mechanism that is modelled as a Bayesian Network, which represents a Missingness Graph (MG) and involves the DB attributes. Our approach considerable departs from the treatment of RDBs with NULL (values). The MG together with the observed DB allow to build a block-independent probabilistic DB, on which basis we propose two QA techniques that jointly capture probabilistic uncertainty and statistical plausibility of the implicit imputation of MVs. We obtain complexity results that characterize the computational feasibility of those approaches.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一套在"带缺失值(missing values)"关系数据库上进行查询回答的语义与算法框架:把缺失值的成因建模为贝叶斯网络(即缺失图 MG),由观测库 D* 与 MG 构造出块独立概率数据库(BID),进而给出可能世界集合;在此基础上提出两类偏好类语义——最可能类(MPC)与最合规类(MCC,合规度用世界经验分布与 MG 诱导分布之间的距离度量,如 KL 散度、欧氏距离、χ² 检验 p 值),并证明 MCC 相关问题在凸可分距离下可在多项式时间求解(MCC∈FP)、计数问题 #MCC 为 #P-完全、枚举问题在 DelayP 中,而直接基于 BID 的合取查询回答是 #P-难。
AI.motivation: 现实数据库(尤其是人口普查类数据)中大量属性值未被报告,用 SQL 的 NULL 表示缺失会带来固定的、嵌入式于 SQL 引擎的语义,既无法刻画缺失产生的因果/统计成因,也无法给出有原则的查询语义。统计学中的经典插补(imputation)方法虽考虑了缺失机制(MM),但只产出单一"干净"实例,无法表达不确定性;概率数据库虽然有明确的可能世界语义,但未与缺失机制结合。核心问题是:如何在已知缺失机制的前提下,穿过观测库 D* 对"底层"库 D 提出有意义的查询,并同时刻画概率不确定性与统计合理性?
AI.method: 1) 形式化:观测库 D*(含 na 的属性记为 A*, 完全可观测属性记为 A^o),底层模式 S 用 A^m 表示可能缺失的属性;缺失机制用缺失图 MG(贝叶斯网络)建模,每个 X* 是汇点,父节点为 X^m 与指示变量 I^X,I^X 依赖 Y^o 与 I^Z,满足 Markov 条件及 na 的条件概率约束(公式 1–6);MG 诱导联合分布 P^M。MG 可表达 MCAR、MAR、MNCAR(自我审查)三种情形。2) 构造 BID:D^P(D*,M) 中,每个含 na 的元组生成一个"块" B(τ),块内候选元组概率取 P^M(缺失属性取值 | 该元组已观测部分);每块恰选一元组构成可能世界 W,概率为块概率之积。3) 类语义:忽略 tid 后作为多重集相同的世界互为 matching,构成"可能世界类";定义类概率、最可能类(MP-class)、一般化的偏好类查询语义 Ans(Q,C^pref)。类的规范表示为支撑 T 上重数向量 k=(k_1,…,k_m)(受可容许性 adm(k) 约束)。4) 合规度:定义世界的经验分布 P^E_W(基于多重集),把合规度 d^c(C,M)=d(P^E_W,P^M) 作为距离型合规度(距离型:KL 散度、欧氏距离、L^p 范数、Hellinger、总变差、χ² 统计量;拟合优度型:基于 χ² 的 p 值排序),最合规类为距离取最小者。5) 算法与复杂度:MCC 归约为二分图上的最小费用流(源点→块节点→元组节点→汇点,汇点边带分离凸成本),可行整数流与可容许类向量一一对应且费用等于合规距离;枚举用带回溯的字典序搜索并以受限流网络的最小费用检验前缀可扩展性。附录给出 BID 等价性定义与"任意 BID 可由某观测库+MG 生成"的构造性证明。
AI.result: 定理1:在生成的 BID 上做合取查询回答在数据复杂度下是 #P-难(通过把 TID 上的布尔合取查询求值归约到本问题)。命题2:任何 BID 实例都可由某观测库与某个 MG 生成的 BID 等价得到(证明任意 TID 是特例),说明该框架的表达能力覆盖一般概率数据库。定理2(凸可分距离 d 下,BID 有 n 个块、支撑含 m 个不同元组):MCC∈FP(确定性多项式时间可算出一个最合规类);#MCC 是 #P-完全(从 3-正则二部图的完美匹配计数归约,利用补充块结构使 0/1 类与完美匹配一一对应);MCC-Enum∈DelayP(输出间延迟多项式,可通过受限最小费用流检验前缀有效性实现,搜索节点数 O(mn))。因 KLD、欧氏距离、χ² 统计量均属凸可分族,故结论特别适用于 C^mc_KL、C^mc_EU、C^mc_pv。总体结论:MCC 语义在计算可行性上优于 MPC 语义;得到一个 MC 类后,查询回答是直接的。运行示例显示:最可能的答案(如 sum(C^m)=5,概率 0.28125)并不一定是最合规的答案(最合规类为 C_1、C_5、C_8,最可能类为 C_1、C_3、C_5),说明概率维度与统计维度确实互补。
AI.conclusion: 论文的核心贡献是:(1) 给出了由缺失图(MG)驱动的缺失值数据库语义,把 SQL NULL 式的"空白"替换为带成因的、因果-统计感知的缺失处理;(2) 通过观测库+MG→块独立概率数据库→可能世界类,把传统单点插补推广为带概率权重的"集体插补",并提出兼顾概率不确定性与统计合规性的两类查询语义(MPC 与 MCC);(3) 给出算法与复杂度刻画:凸可分合规度下最合规类可多项式时间求得、可多项式延迟枚举、计数 #P-完全,而直接可能世界语义则是 #P-难,说明"合规"维度在计算上比"概率"维度更可行。作者指出未来工作包括在扩展版中完整展开概率维度、将类之间的查询回答形式化(本文为节省篇幅仅略过)、以及把 MG 的学习与实例兼容性检验等正交问题结合起来(属于并行研究)。此外,论文编号存在不一致(附录中 Theorem 7 与正文 Theorem 2、Proposition A 与 Proposition 1 对应),属编辑性问题。

title: WebExpert: domain-aware web agents with critic-guided expert experience for high-precision search
summary: Specialized web tasks in finance, biomedicine, and pharmaceuticals remain challenging due to missing domain priors: queries drift, evidence is noisy, and reasoning is brittle. We present WebExpert, a domain-aware web agent that we implement end-to-end, featuring : (i) sentence-level experience retrieval with topic merging and rule distillation, (ii) schemalight facet induction that bootstraps time,region,policy,industry facets from weak supervision instead of static hand-written lexicons, and (iii) preference-optimized planning that jointly improves query planning and retrieval via pairwise preference learning alongside a coverage-aware objective. At inference, a lightweight experience gate biases decoding toward active facets with fallback under low-retrieval confidence. On GAIA, GPQA, HLE, and WebWalkerQA, WebExpert improves Answer Exact Match (EM) by 1.5-3.6 pp over the strongest browsing baseline and reduces page hops. Analysis shows consistent gains and ablations on retrieval, topic merging, facet induction, and preference-aware training.

AI.tldr: WebExpert是一个端到端实现的领域感知Web智能体：通过"评论者引导的抽取链"从标注QA与专家语料中蒸馏出句子级"专家经验"并合并为规则，schema-light地归纳time/region/policy/industry四类facet，再用带facet加权的偏好优化SFT训练查询规划与检索器，推理时由经验门控将解码偏置到激活facet、低置信时回退通用查询。在GAIA/GPQA/HLE/WebWalkerQA上相对最强浏览基线（WebThinker-32B）EM提升1.5–3.6个百分点（WebExpert+SFT最高），并减少页面跳转数。
AI.motivation: 金融、生物医药、制药等专业领域的Web任务缺乏领域先验（domain priors）：通用搜索智能体会出现查询偏移（query drift）、证据噪声大、推理脆弱，遗漏时序性、区域法规、行业粒度等关键上下文，从而浪费token、检索到不相关页面。RAG类方法虽能增强LLM，但很少以结构化方式注入领域专属的policy/region/industry先验。目标是让智能体在深度浏览前先"对齐领域语义"，从而实现高精度检索与更少跳转。
AI.method:
形式化为 P(R,a|q,E^(k))，其中 E 是从专家语料蒸馏的句子级规则库。三步流水线：(1) 离线经验库构建——问题采集与规范化（改写挖掘+无schema去词化）、QA级多视角表示（问题/答案/QA联合编码），相似度 s=λ1<u,u'>+λ2<v,v'>+λ3<w,w'> 配合HDBSCAN/BERTopic/谱聚类做密度聚类与软分配；BM25+稠密检索+MMR做证据聚合与去重；用DeepSeek-R1做"矛盾与不确定性感知"的摘要，生成含前提条件、核心指引、边界情形、失效模式的规则 r_m，并做蕴含/一致性检查（保留多数一致主张，少数观点折入caveat或标记）；再做facet化与归一化 g_m=(time, region, policy, L2 industry)（由语料统计+浅层标注器+LLM消歧产生候选，再归一化时间/地理/政策并附加coverage、confidence、provenance元数据）；经验库版本化、warm-start增量合并与流式更新。无答案时回退到句子级抽取以兼容既有流水线（UMAP/HDBSCAN/BERTopic）。
(2) 训练——微调QwQ-32B：facet对齐加权的token级规划损失 L_plan（激活facet指示符的token上采样、off-facet下采样）、对比式检索margin损失 L_ret（r+对齐、r-为top-64 FAISS硬负例，分数margin 0.05内，每epoch刷新）、覆盖感知目标与成对偏好优化；约12k偏好对齐对，Pai-Megatron-Patch全参数训练（lr 1e-5、cosine衰减、β2=0.98），以QP@3与EM早停。
(3) 推理——经验检索取top-k（k=5）余弦相似经验，条件化生成多查询计划 z，经验门控用top-k平均相似度作为检索置信度（阈值θ=0.3，验证集标定），低于阈值时回退通用查询以避免过度约束；随后交给自研搜索-浏览控制器交替检索与推理生成答案。评测：GAIA/GPQA/HLE/WebWalkerQA，指标EM/F1、QP@3、Page Hops、证据nDCG@10、泄漏压力测试（实体随机化、时间偏移、模板改写）；统一Bing(US-EN)、top-10、temp 0.7、32k tokens，3种子×2轨迹。
AI.result: 主结果（EM%）：WebExpert 46.2/70.2/14.5/43.7，WebExpert+SFT 47.7/71.9/16.6/46.3（GAIA/GPQA/HLE/WebWalkerQA），均显著优于QwQ-32B直接推理、RAG-QwQ、Search-o1-32B、WebThinker-32B-Base（最强基线44.7/68.7/13.0/41.9），对最强浏览基线提升1.5–3.6 pp（配对t检验 p<0.01）。查询质量：QP@3 从49.3提升到58.2（+SFT 61.8），页面跳转从8.1降到5.6/5.2，证据nDCG@10提升4–6点。消融（GAIA）：去SFT→EM 46.2/QP@3 58.2；去主题合并→44.1/59.1；去句子级嵌入→45.7/56.0；top-k=1（对比5）→41.2/57.1，表明句子级嵌入与SFT贡献最大，top-5在精度与覆盖间取得平衡。
AI.conclusion: WebExpert证明：在深度浏览前检索并蒸馏"句子级专家经验"、用schema-light facet先验引导查询规划，可显著提升专业领域Web智能体的答案精确率并降低浏览开销。句子级检索、主题合并与偏好感知SFT对领域保真度最为关键。局限方面，消融使用分层子集与不同判定阈值，绝对EM不可与主表直接比较；经验库依赖标注QA与专家语料的覆盖度，门控阈值需按域标定；未来可扩展多域经验库与在线持续更新机制。

title: AgentCity: Constitutional Governance for Autonomous Agent Economies via Separation of Power
comment: 111 pages, 11 figures, 19 tables, 67 references. Pre-registered experimental design
summary: Autonomous AI agents are beginning to operate across organizational boundaries on the open internet -- discovering, transacting with, and delegating to agents owned by other parties without centralized oversight. When agents from different human principals collaborate at scale, the collective becomes opaque: no single human can observe, audit, or govern the emergent behavior. We term this the Logic Monopoly -- the agent society's unchecked monopoly over the entire logic chain from planning through execution to evaluation. We propose the Separation of Power (SoP) model, a constitutional governance architecture deployed on public blockchain that breaks this monopoly through three structural separations: agents legislate operational rules as smart contracts, deterministic software executes within those contracts, and humans adjudicate through a complete ownership chain binding every agent to a responsible principal. In this architecture, smart contracts are the law itself -- the actual legislative output that agents produce and that governs their behavior. We instantiate SoP in AgentCity on an EVM-compatible layer-2 blockchain (L2) with a three-tier contract hierarchy (foundational, meta, and operational). The core thesis is alignment-through-accountability: if each agent is aligned with its human owner through the accountability chain, then the collective converges on behavior aligned with human intent -- without top-down rules. A pre-registered experiment evaluates this thesis in a commons production economy -- where agents share a finite resource pool and collaboratively produce value -- at 50-1,000 agent scale.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"权力分立"(Separation of Power, SoP)模型：把自治智能体社会从规划到执行到评估的完整"逻辑链"切分为三个结构性隔离分支——智能体立法（智能合约即法律本身）、确定性软件执行、人类裁决（通过完整所有权链将每个智能体绑定到人类责任人）——并以"分权治理"部署于以太坊兼容 L2 公链上，具体实现为 AgentCity 系统，采用三层合约层级（基础层/元层/运营层）。核心论点是"通过问责实现对齐"：若每个智能体通过问责链与其人类所有者对齐，则集体涌现出与人类意图一致的行为，无需自上而下规则。作者以 Ostrom 制度设计框架设计了预注册实验（共同资源生产经济，50–1000 智能体规模，23+2 条可证伪假设），但实验尚在进行中，目前仅有设计与试点可行性结果。
AI.motivation: 随着 MCP、A2A 等智能体互操作协议、去中心化智能体注册表和 OpenClaw/ZeroClaw 等自治框架的出现，不同人类主体拥有的智能体已在开放互联网上自主发现、协商、交易、委派与组合服务，形成无中心协调器的临时供应链。然而现有多智能体框架（LangGraph、AutoGen、MetaGPT、CrewAI）全部假设"单一组织拥有全部智能体"，其治理依赖提示词角色分配、应用层约定等单一方权威，对跨信任边界的第三方智能体根本无法施加约束（"他方智能体无法被提示词约束"）。作者指出，即便在受控单方场景中治理失败也已严重（Agent Security Bench 攻击成功率 84.30%；La Serenissima 模拟中 31.4% 智能体涌现欺骗行为；GovSim 中最佳 LLM 智能体 commons 场景存活率低于 54%）。作者将这种集体不透明命名为"逻辑垄断"(Logic Monopoly)：并非某单一智能体支配他人，而是智能体社会对"从规划到执行到评估"整条逻辑链的无约束垄断，使集体对其所服务的人类而言是黑箱、不可观察、不可审计、不可治理。
AI.method: 1. 概念与形式化：提出四个治理原语（形式规则基座、经济基座、制度记忆/审计账本、可验证透明性），并形式化"实施缺口"(Implementation Gap)：令连线图 W=(V,E)，定义可检查性 I_h(W)=|E_visible|/|E|、缺口 G_h=1−I_h(W)；DAG 边数 |E|=O(nk)，当 nk≫10³ 时人工穷举审计不可行，且多主体下 I_h<1 是结构性的（组织 A 无法观察组织 B 的内部边）。AgentCity 将所有绑定记录在公开账本上，使连线拓扑上 I_h=1（微服务内部正确性未闭合，需 TEE 证明）。2. 架构：SoP 三分支（立法/执行/裁决）严格隔离，形成闭合治理回路 System-level Policy → Task-level Policy → 任务 DAG → 软件竞争交付 → 人类裁决 → 回写 System-level Policy；参数分为人类设定的"宪制参数"与智能体设定的"运营参数"。合约分三层：基础合约（Constitution/Producer/Clerk/Management/Service，智能体不可改）、元合约（Legislative/Execution/Adjudication 程序规则）、运营合约（CollaborationContract，智能体立法产出）。3. 三条流水线：六阶段立法流水线（提案→证据锚定的委员会审议含预投票与最多三轮结构化讨论→Copeland+Minimax 完全序位偏好排序投票、60% 参与法定人数→四项政策合规校验→模板化编码→部署保真校验，递归分解至叶子单智能体任务）；七阶段执行流水线（编排→调用→Commit 强制 Merkle 根承诺→Guardian 双评分器嵌入空间异常检测与确定性冻结→三级 Proof-of-Progress 验证→宪制输出谓词静态调用过滤→记录与 EMA 声誉更新、结算），配合 Adaptive Refinement 再立法式容错（迭代预算 3 次）；六阶段问责流水线（双主体注册→三通道检测（Guardian 告警、基于 Kendall τ 与 top-k Jaccard 重叠的协同投票检测、人工复核）→Override Panel（法定人数 2f+1=5、建议 7、轮换、利益冲突回避、⌈2q/3⌉ 超级多数撤销）→制裁与奖励流向人类主体→按声誉乘子 ψ(ρ)=1+α(ρ−500)/1000 结算→国库再循环）。4. 经济机制：竞争性竞价 Score_i(j)=w_q·ρ_i·match(c_i,r_j)+w_p·(1−p_i/b_j)（w_q=0.6, w_p=0.4）；HHI 归一化公平分（默认下限 600，推导 p≥15 时单一生产者份额上限约 63%）；EMA 声誉更新 ρ^{t+1}=λρ^t+(1−λ)S^t，λ 为宪制参数，智能体不可自定衰减率；奖励公式 EQ-9 分源式（托管支付 min(ψ,1) 部分，国库补贴溢价部分），保证单任务支付 ≤ b_i；EQ-10 参与理性、EQ-11 国库可持续性、EQ-12 保险池充足性；质押池分散集中度；反 Sybil 成本 C_Sybil(n)≥n·s_reg+k·s_min。5. 威胁模型：五类攻击者（单智能体、联盟、外部攻击者、被攻陷的人类主体、被攻陷的模型供应商），8 条信任假设 TA-1~TA-8，4 条安全性质 SP-1~SP-4，7 条非保证 NP-1~NP-7，拜占庭失败天花板（三分支需至少一支诚实），以及编码代理信任集中的残余攻击面 M1–M8 分类与 M5 逻辑后门约 50–70% 存活的定量估计。6. 实验设计：预注册实验，commons 生产经济（异质智能体共享有限资源池并协作生产），四个累积配置 Baseline → Emergent（仅提示词治理）→ AgentCity-Structural（合约强制、无经济激励）→ AgentCity-Full（全三分支+经济激励+模拟 HITL 裁决），配合 Ostrom 八原则映射形成因果归因阶梯；实验 1 为 n=200、200 轮、250 任务、每格 10 种子共 40 次运行；实验 2 为 n∈{50,100,200,500,750,1000} 的治理规模化；第 100 轮复合冲击（注入 15 个对抗智能体含 5 个协同投票集团、移除 20 个高声誉智能体、一已完成里程碑质量审计失败）；统计用配对 Wilcoxon 符号秩检验、Bonferroni 校正（K=6，α_adj=0.0083）、Cohen's d，10 种子下 80% 功效可检测 d≥1.5（中等效应 d≈0.8 时功效<50%）；H2h 用单侧精确二项检验并给出 Kendall τ=1.0 的闭式功效校准；主指标为 CSR 与 DR。
AI.result: 无实测结果：§5 明确"实验正在进行中"，全部结论均为预注册假设与待验证命题。已报告的仅有：(a) 试点研究（n=5、Python 模拟合约）确认可行性——commons 游戏复现合作困境动力学、persona 生成产生可区分的行为画像、配置设计在治理体制间产生可测分离；(b) 架构层面的形式化结果与静态分析，包括 I_h(W)=1 对连线拓扑的实现缺口闭合、HHI 公平分对 Sybil 竞价池垄断的形式化上界（p=2→0.816、p=5→0.72、p=10→0.68）、单智能体威慑条件 P_eff·s_min·slash_rate>δ·V_m、法官贿赂成本下界 C_bribe(q)≥⌈2q/3⌉·s_adj（生产参数下收买多数需 67–80% 任务价值）、EQ-9 数值示例（ρ=800 时总收益 1.1155 b_i，比中性高 15%）与 EQ-10 敏感性表；(c) 自陈的经济可持续性缺口——在成熟稳态情景（月流入约 5.1 万美元 vs 支出约 9.87 万美元，赤字约 4.77 万美元）下国库为赤字，需将 α 从 0.5 降至约 0.25 或提高费率/设置补贴上限方可恢复偿付平衡；(d) 合约伪代码与气体估算（AgentContract 注册约 8.5–10 万 gas，settleReward 约 6 万 gas 等）、CEI 重入审计（v0.20 已修复 deregister() 中 TRANSFER 先于 DELETE 的顺序违规）。作者声明全部 gas 数值为分析性估算，实测待后续实证论文报告。
AI.conclusion: 论文的核心主张是：跨组织边界的自治智能体协作的治理缺口可以被架构性地打破，关键在于利用"智能体推理不透明、但智能体生产的法律（公开区块链上的合约代码）透明"这一根本不对称。SoP 模型把治理结构（分支隔离、问责链、基础合约）由人类设计，而治理内容（运营规则）由智能体经立法程序自定；智能体决定"做什么工作"，但不能决定"被以何种规则评判"。作者主张的不是"抗捕获治理"而是"捕获抵抗治理"（承认 Gibbard–Satterthwaite 定理下策略性操纵不可消除，只能抬高操纵成本），并明确四项边界：智能体仅对运营合约有立法权、不能修改元合约与模板注册表，故自我治理主张限于运营范围；四个 clerk 智能体（Registrar/Speaker/Regulator/Codifier）在本版本被当作可信制度基础设施，未建模 clerk 攻陷；Byzantine 天花板不可逾越；国库可持续性需靠持续宪制再校准。作者列出 14 条局限，包括所有主张均为未验证假设、人类裁决为确定性模拟而会高估裁决一致性、单一经济域、实验 2 仅测试 Baseline 与 Full 两端点、同源 LLM 后端导致 PoP 冗余执行者相关性趋近 ρ=1 等。后续工作方向为：多方编码共识、形式化验证、clerk 角色可选举化、TEE 证明、分布式裁决与最小诚实方假设的形式化分析，以及配套实证论文中的完整对抗鲁棒性评估。

title: A Survey of Algorithm Debt in Machine and Deep Learning Systems: Definition, Smells, and Future Work
summary: The adoption of Machine and Deep Learning (ML/DL) technologies introduces maintenance challenges, leading to Technical Debt (TD). Algorithm Debt (AD) is a TD type that impacts the performance and scalability of ML/DL systems. A review of 42 primary studies expanded AD's definition, uncovered its implicit presence, identified its smells, and highlighted future directions. These findings will guide an AD-focused study, enhancing the reliability of ML/DL systems.

AI.tldr: 本文是一项关于机器学习/深度学习系统中"算法债务"(Algorithm Debt, AD)的系统文献综述，通过分析42项主要研究扩展了AD的定义，揭示了其隐性存在，识别了其"代码异味"(smells)，并提出了未来研究方向。
AI.motivation: 随着ML/DL技术的广泛采用，系统维护挑战日益突出。算法债务作为一种技术债务类型，对ML/DL系统的性能和可扩展性产生严重影响，但目前缺乏对其系统性的研究和理解。
AI.method: 采用系统性文献综述方法，对42项主要研究进行了综合分析。
AI.result: 研究结果包括：1) 扩展了AD的定义；2) 揭示了AD在ML/DL系统中的隐性存在；3) 识别了AD的相关代码异味；4) 提出了未来的研究方向。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现将指导后续以AD为重点的研究工作，最终提升ML/DL系统的可靠性。

title: Front-End Ethics for Sensor-Fused Health Conversational Agents: An Ethical Design Space for Biometrics
comment: Accepted at the Proceedings of the CHI 2026 Workshop: Ethics at the Front-End
summary: The integration of continuous data from built-in sensors and Large Language Models (LLMs) has fueled a surge of "Sensor-Fused LLM agents" for personal health and well-being support. While recent breakthroughs have demonstrated the technical feasibility of this fusion (e.g., Time-LLM, SensorLLM), research primarily focuses on "Ethical Back-End Design for Generative AI", concerns such as sensing accuracy, bias mitigation in training data, and multimodal fusion. This leaves a critical gap at the front end, where invisible biometrics are translated into language directly experienced by users. We argue that the "illusion of objectivity" provided by sensor data amplifies the risks of AI hallucinations, potentially turning errors into harmful medical mandates. This paper shifts the focus to "Ethical Front-End Design for AI", specifically, the ethics of biometric translation. We propose a design space comprising five dimensions: Biometric Disclosure, Monitoring Temporality, Interpretation Framing, AI Stance, and Contestability. We examine how these dimensions interact with context (user- vs. system-initiated) and identify the risk of biofeedback loops. Finally, we propose "Adaptive Disclosure" as a safety guardrail and offer design guidelines to help developers manage fallibility, ensuring that these cutting-edge health agents support, rather than destabilize, user autonomy.

AI.tldr: 本文聚焦于"AI伦理前端设计",探讨传感器融合大语言模型在健康监测中的生物特征翻译伦理问题,提出五维设计空间并建议自适应披露作为安全护栏。
AI.motivation: 现有研究聚焦于后端问题(传感精度、训练数据偏见、多模态融合),忽视了前端问题——不可见的生物特征数据如何被翻译成用户直接体验的语言。传感器数据提供的"客观性幻觉"可能放大AI幻觉风险,将错误转化为有害的医疗指令。
AI.method: 提出了一个包含五个维度的设计空间:生物特征披露、监控时效性、解释框架、AI立场和可质疑性。分析了这些维度如何与情境(用户发起vs系统发起)交互,并识别了生物反馈循环的风险。
AI.result: 识别了生物反馈循环风险,提出自适应披露作为安全护栏机制。
AI.conclusion: 提出"自适应披露"(Adaptive Disclosure)作为安全护栏,并给出设计指南,目标确保健康智能体支持而非破坏用户自主权。

title: Hallucination as output-boundary misclassification: a composite abstention architecture for language models
comment: Theoretical manuscript extending an earlier proof-of-concept workshop paper accepted to the ICLR 2026 Workshop on LLM Reasoning; 13 pages, 3 tables
summary: Large language models often produce unsupported claims. We frame this as a misclassification error at the output boundary, where internally generated completions are emitted as if they were grounded in evidence. This motivates a composite intervention that combines instruction-based refusal with a structural abstention gate. The gate computes a support deficit score, St, from three black-box signals: self-consistency (At), paraphrase stability (Pt), and citation coverage (Ct), and blocks output when St exceeds a threshold. In a controlled evaluation across 50 items, five epistemic regimes, and three models, neither mechanism alone was sufficient. Instruction-only prompting reduced hallucination sharply, but still showed over-cautious abstention on answerable items and residual hallucination for GPT-3.5-turbo. The structural gate preserved answerable accuracy across models but missed confident confabulation on conflicting-evidence items. The composite architecture achieved high overall accuracy with low hallucination, while also inheriting some over-abstention from the instruction component. A supplementary 100-item no-context stress test derived from TruthfulQA showed that structural gating provides a capability-independent abstention floor. Overall, instruction-based refusal and structural gating show complementary failure modes, which suggests that effective hallucination control benefits from combining both mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 本文针对大语言模型的"幻觉"问题，提出将未经证实的输出定义为输出边界处的错误分类，并设计了一种结合指令式拒绝与结构性弃权门的复合干预框架。结构门通过三个黑盒信号（自洽性、释义稳定性、引用覆盖率）计算"支持缺陷分数"St，超过阈值则阻止输出。在50条目、5种认知体制、3个模型的受控评估中，单一机制均不足，复合架构在保持高准确率的同时有效降低幻觉，但继承了指令组件的过度弃权倾向。补充的100条目无上下文压力测试表明结构门提供了能力无关的弃权基线。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型常产生无依据的声明（幻觉），现有方法难以有效解决。将幻觉重新定义为输出边界处的错误分类问题，即模型将内部生成的补全误认为有证据支撑的输出，这为干预提供了新的视角。
AI.method: 复合干预架构：(1) 指令式拒绝：通过提示工程引导模型主动拒绝不确定的问题；(2) 结构化弃权门：计算支持缺陷分数St = f(At, Pt, Ct)，其中At为自洽性信号、Pt为释义稳定性信号、Ct为引用覆盖率信号，当St超过阈值时阻止输出。评估采用50条目标准测试集、5种认知体制、3个模型，并附加100条目TruthfulQA无上下文压力测试。
AI.result: 单一机制均存在缺陷：纯指令方法在可回答项目上过度谨慎（过度弃权），且GPT-3.5-Turbo仍有残余幻觉；纯结构门虽保持各模型的可回答准确率，但遗漏了冲突证据项目上的"自信虚构"。复合架构实现高整体准确率和低幻觉率，但继承了指令组件的部分过度弃权问题。无上下文压力测试显示结构门提供能力无关的弃权基线。
AI.conclusion: 指令式拒绝与结构化弃权门具有互补的失效模式，有效的幻觉控制需结合两种机制。两种方法各有优势：指令方法能快速减少幻觉，结构门则提供跨模型能力的稳定弃权保障。

title: Weakly Supervised Distillation of Hallucination Signals into Transformer Representations
comment: 20 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables. Introduces a 15k-sample representation-level hallucination dataset with full transformer hidden states and multi-signal weak supervision. Evaluates 5 probing architectures and demonstrates internal hallucination detection without external inference-time signals. Includes held-out test evaluation and deployment benchmarks
summary:
Existing hallucination detection methods for large language models (LLMs) rely on external verification at inference time, requiring gold answers, retrieval systems, or auxiliary judge models. We ask whether this external supervision can instead be distilled into the model's own representations during training, enabling hallucination detection from internal activations alone at inference time.
  We introduce a weak supervision framework that combines three complementary grounding signals: substring matching, sentence embedding similarity, and an LLM as a judge verdict to label generated responses as grounded or hallucinated without human annotation. Using this framework, we construct a 15000-sample dataset from SQuAD v2 (10500 train/development samples and a separate 5000-sample test set), where each example pairs a LLaMA-2-7B generated answer with its full per-layer hidden states and structured hallucination labels.
  We then train five probing classifiers: ProbeMLP (M0), LayerWiseMLP (M1), CrossLayerTransformer (M2), HierarchicalTransformer (M3), and CrossLayerAttentionTransformerV2 (M4), directly on these hidden states, treating external grounding signals as training-time supervision only. Our central hypothesis is that hallucination detection signals can be distilled into transformer representations, enabling internal detection without any external verification at inference time.
  Results support this hypothesis. Transformer-based probes achieve the strongest discrimination, with M2 performing best on 5-fold average AUC/F1, and M3 performing best on both single-fold validation and held-out test evaluation. We also benchmark inference efficiency: probe latency ranges from 0.15 to 5.62 ms (batched) and 1.55 to 6.66 ms (single sample), while end-to-end generation plus probe throughput remains approximately 0.231 queries per second, indicating negligible practical overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将外部验证信号蒸馏到LLM内部表征中，实现无需外部验证的幻觉检测。方法结合弱监督信号构建数据集，训练基于隐藏状态的探测分类器，验证了幻觉检测能力可内化到transformer表征中。
AI.motivation: 现有幻觉检测方法依赖推理时的外部验证（标准答案、检索系统或辅助判断模型），计算开销大。本文探索将这些外部监督信号在训练阶段蒸馏到模型自身表征中，实现推理时仅凭内部激活即可检测幻觉。
AI.method: 提出弱监督框架，融合三种互补的锚定信号：子串匹配、句子嵌入相似度和LLM作为判断者的裁决，构建SQuAD v2的15000样本数据集（10500训练/开发样本+5000测试样本）。基于LLaMA-2-7B的全层隐藏状态，训练5种探测分类器：ProbeMLP(M0)、LayerWiseMLP(M1)、CrossLayerTransformer(M2)、HierarchicalTransformer(M3)和CrossLayerAttentionTransformerV2(M4)。
AI.result: Transformer类探测器表现最优：M2在5折平均AUC/F1上最佳，M3在单折验证和留出测试上最佳。推理效率：批处理延迟0.15-5.62ms，单样本1.55-6.66ms；端到端生成+探测吞吐量约0.231查询/秒，实际开销可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 假设成立：幻觉检测信号可蒸馏到transformer表征中，实现推理时无需外部验证的内部检测，为实时幻觉监控提供了高效可行方案。

title: Spectral Edge Dynamics Reveal Functional Modes of Learning
summary:
Training dynamics during grokking concentrate along a small number of dominant update directions -- the spectral edge -- which reliably distinguishes grokking from non-grokking regimes. We show that standard mechanistic interpretability tools (head attribution, activation probing, sparse autoencoders) fail to capture these directions: their structure is not localized in parameter or feature space. Instead, each direction induces a structured function over the input domain, revealing low-dimensional functional modes invisible to representation-level analysis.
  For modular addition, all leading directions collapse to a single Fourier mode. For multiplication, the same collapse appears only in the discrete-log basis, yielding a 5.9x improvement in concentration. For subtraction, the edge spans a small multi-mode family. For $x^2+y^2$, no single harmonic basis suffices, but cross-terms of additive and multiplicative features provide a 4x variance boost, consistent with the decomposition (a+b)^2 - 2ab. Multitask training amplifies this compositional structure, with the $x^2+y^2$ spectral edge inheriting the addition circuit's characteristic frequency (2.3x concentration increase).
  These results suggest that training discovers low-dimensional functional modes over the input domain, whose structure depends on the algebraic symmetry of the task.
  These results suggest that spectral edge dynamics identify low-dimensional functional subspaces governing learning, whose representation depends on the algebraic structure of the task. Simple harmonic structure emerges only when the task admits a symmetry-adapted basis; more complex tasks require richer functional descriptions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"谱边动力学(spectral edge dynamics)"视角：grokking 期间权重更新集中在少数奇异方向上（谱边），但这些方向在参数/特征空间并不可定位，head attribution、激活探针、SAE 均失效；将其视为对输入-输出函数的扰动后，每个谱边方向在恰当的群论适配基（加法字符、离散对数等）中坍缩为结构化的低维"函数模态"。加法坍缩到单一 Fourier 模（ω≈25–26，F=0.40，19×基线）；乘法仅在离散对数基中坍缩（ω=29，浓度提升 5.9×）；减法为小规模多模族；x²+y² 无单一谐波基可用，但加性×乘性交叉项带来 4× 方差提升，与 (a+b)²−2ab 的分解一致；多任务训练下 x²+y² 的谱边继承加法电路的特征频率 ω=26（浓度 2.3×），表明函数模态可跨任务复用。结论：训练发现的是输入域上的低维函数模态，其结构由任务的代数对称性决定，而标准可解释性工具因"类别错配"无法捕获它们。
AI.motivation: 现有可解释性方法（head attribution、激活探针、稀疏自编码器 SAE）都在"表征空间"中寻找结构：局部的头、神经元或字典特征。但作者此前的工作（Xu 2026a/b/c）表明 grokking 期间优化动力学集中在少数主导更新方向上（谱边），其几何性质虽已被刻画，其"内容"仍未知——这些方向到底是局部电路、可解释特征，还是别的东西？同时，受 Olah et al. (2025) "interference weight / virtual vs. effective weight" 框架启发，作者追问：谱边方向究竟是真正的功能模态，还是多特征共存的"折中产物"（interference artifact）？论文的核心动机是寻找一个比"数神经元"更高层级的描述层级，用以解释为何标准机制可解释性对本对象失效。
AI.method:
模型与任务：2 层 pre-norm Transformer（d_model=128，4 头，d_ff=256，~290k 参数），模 97 上 6 个二元运算 (a+b)、(a−b)、(a·b)、(a²+b²)、(a²+ab+b²)、(a³+ab)；前 4 个 grok（95% 准确率 <5000 步），后 2 个为非 grokking 对照；3 个随机种子；另训共享 trunk 的双任务（add+mul）与三任务（add+mul+x²+y²）模型。

谱边定义：对注意力参数（D=131,072）的逐步更新 δθ_t，构造滑动窗口 W=20 的 Gram 矩阵 G_ij=⟨δθ_i,δθ_j⟩，其特征值 σ_1≥…≥σ_W；谱隙 g_k,k+1=σ_k−σ_{k+1}，其中 g_23 的衰减（BBP 框架）指示前 2 维块"固化"；谱边位置 k* 取 σ_k/σ_{k+1} 比值最大并按累积信号质量加权处，其右奇异向量 v_1..v_{k*} 即谱边方向。

功能模态（functional mode）映射：沿 v_k 做有限差分扰动 ε=0.005‖θ_attn‖，定义残差流扰动 Δh_k(x)=d/dε h(x;θ+εv_k)|_{ε=0}，其范数平方 f_k(x)=‖Δh_k(x)‖² 是定义在输入域 𝒳={0..p−1}² 上的标量场；功能子空间 ℱ=span{f_1..f_{k*}⊂L²(𝒳)}。

分析手段：(1) 表征层负结果——head purity（2 层×4 头×4 矩阵型块的最大范数占比）、激活扰动的 effective rank（归一化奇异值熵 exp H(p)）、TopK SAE（d=512, k=32）top-20 特征的 Jaccard 重叠及三重零模型；(2) 傅里叶分析——选分组变量 q(a,b) 得群平均信号 f̄_k[q]，做 M 点 DFT，定义 Fourier concentration F_k=峰值频率功率占比（均匀基线 2/M）；共测试加法字符、离散对数（乘法群，p=97 原根 g=5，周期 96）、高斯整数基（i_p=22，u=a+i_p b，v=a−i_p b）、角向变量、二维傅里叶等基；(3) 岭回归多变量探针，用加性/乘性傅里叶特征及其交叉项预测完整位移 Δh_k；(4) 与 interference weight 框架对接：逐样本激活 a_k(x)=⟨∇_θℓ(x), v_k⟩、共使用矩阵 M_ij=corr(a_i,a_j)、对角支配度 d_k、有效权重 σ_k·d_k、多任务共享度 S_k；(5) 三种独立谱分解交叉验证（Gram 滑动窗 SVD、位移 PCA、权重矩阵 SVD）。
AI.result:
1) 谱边存在且判别 grokking：36 个单任务条件（6 运算×2 权重衰减×3 种子）中，12 个 grokking 运行的 g_23 衰减全部被检出（幅度 15–110×，均值 40×），24 个对照条件仅 1 个出现类似衰减（1.5×，且为 41,700 步的异常事件）；wd=0 时 0/12 检出。三种谱分解给出一致时序签名：记忆期形成、grokking 转变处锐化、之后稳定；权重矩阵 SVD 显示 grokking 前先出现 σ_1≈σ_2 的近简并，随后对称破缺 σ_1≫σ_2（与既往 commutator defect 上升一致）。

2) 表征层负结果：head purity≈0.14（基线 1/8=0.125），谱边全局分布于所有头；激活扰动 effective rank≈40/128，为高秩弥散；SAE top-20 特征 Jaccard 为 0.25–0.60，等于或低于随机方向零模型均值（0.30–0.83），角匹配零模型 p≥0.97。作者判定这不是"无结构"，而是"类别错配"：谱边是函数级对象。同时 f_k 的 Fourier peakedness 达均匀的 32.8×，证明结构确实存在，只是不在表征空间。

3) 对称适配基中的函数结构：加法——三个顶部方向全部锁在 ω≈25–26，F=0.40（基线 0.021，19×），top-3 均值 0.29 vs bulk 0.18（1.6×），单主成分 F=0.67，二维傅里叶功率集中于对角 (26,26)；乘法——加法基下弥散（F≤0.11），换到离散对数基后全部坍缩到 ω=29，v_1 的 F 从 0.054→0.32（5.9×），top-3 均值 2.7×；对照实验显示加法在离散对数基下浓度反而降至 0.2–0.3×，证明提升是基依赖的。减法——多模族 {6,16,32}，但 top-3 浓度 F≈0.16 与 bulk 无分离，作者诚实标注为负结果。x²+y²——五种基（加性、乘性、高斯整数、角向、二维）均无主导模，峰值 F≈0.10–0.15 与 bulk 相当；二维高斯傅里叶显示 97% 功率在非对角线，表明扰动对"角度坐标"敏感；但加性/乘性交叉项把探针 R² 从 0.04 提升到 0.16（4×），与组合恒等式一致。

4) 多任务复用：三任务模型的 x²+y² 谱边继承加法电路特征频率 ω=26（单任务中为散乱的 ω=17），ω=26 处加性浓度 F 从 0.09→0.20（2.3×），组合协同性 +0.024→+0.043（1.7×）。

5) 与 interference 的关系：边以上方向被非重叠的输入子集相干激活（虚拟权重≈有效权重，为真实功能模态），边以下方向弥散激活、方向间高相关（承载 interference）；多任务中边以上方向跨任务共享度 S≈0.8–0.9，边以下 S≈0.3–0.5。
AI.conclusion: 论文主张：训练动力学选择的是输入域上的低维函数模态，而非参数/激活空间中的局部分解；这些模态在任务具有适当群结构时对齐到傅里叶（对称适配）基，并在共享训练下可跨任务复用。谱边动力学因此成为识别支配学习的低维函数子空间的直接探针，其表示形式取决于任务的代数/组合结构——只有当任务存在对称适配基时才涌现简单谐波结构，复杂任务需要更丰富的函数描述。作者明确不主张：精确分解（F≤0.40；x²+y² 探针 R²≤0.16）、超出模运算的普适性、完整理论（两条猜想均未证明）、减法子空间已被刻画清楚。局限：仅限模算术与小模型；最关键的未决问题是该框架能否推广到语言等"基事先未知"的领域，即谱边是否能对齐到某种可解释的语法/语义功能基。后续方向包括多任务消融（仅加法/仅乘法/两者）以定位哪个子电路贡献哪个模态、更深模型与更多任务族检验、以及开发直接在函数空间操作的分析工具。

title: Exploiting Aggregate Programming in a Multi-Robot Service Prototype
summary: Multi-robot systems are becoming increasingly relevant within diverse application domains, such as healthcare, exploration, and rescue missions. However, building such systems is still a significant challenge, since it adds the complexities of the physical nature of robots and their environments to those inherent in coordinating any distributed (multi-agent) system. Aggregate Programming (AP) has recently emerged as a promising approach to engineering resilient, distributed systems with proximity-based communication, and is notably supported by practical frameworks.  In this paper we present a prototype of a multi-robot service system, which adopts AP for the design and implementation of its coordination software. The prototype has been validated both with simulations, and with tests in a University library.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于聚合编程（AP）的多机器人服务系统原型，旨在解决多机器人系统协调中的复杂性挑战，并通过模拟实验和大学图书馆实地测试进行了验证。
AI.motivation: 多机器人系统在医疗、探索、救援等领域应用广泛，但构建这类系统面临物理复杂性和分布式协调的双重挑战，需要新的设计方法来实现弹性协调。
AI.method: 采用聚合编程（AP）方法设计多机器人协调软件，构建系统原型，并分别通过仿真环境和大学图书馆真实场景进行测试验证。
AI.result: 成功实现了多机器人服务系统原型，验证了AP方法在多机器人协调中的可行性，实现在 proximity-based 通信环境下的弹性分布式协调。
AI.conclusion: 聚合编程为多机器人系统的协调软件设计提供了有效解决方案，能够应对物理机器人及其环境的复杂性挑战，具有实际应用价值。

title: AI-Driven Research for Databases
summary: As the complexity of modern workloads and hardware increasingly outpaces human research and engineering capacity, existing methods for database performance optimization struggle to keep pace. To address this gap, a new class of techniques, termed AI-Driven Research for Systems (ADRS), uses large language models to automate solution discovery. This approach shifts optimization from manual system design to automated code generation. The key obstacle, however, in applying ADRS is the evaluation pipeline. Since these frameworks rapidly generate hundreds of candidates without human supervision, they depend on fast and accurate feedback from evaluators to converge on effective solutions. Building such evaluators is especially difficult for complex database systems. To enable the practical application of ADRS in this domain, we propose automating the design of evaluators by co-evolving them with the solutions. We demonstrate the effectiveness of this approach through three case studies optimizing buffer management, query rewriting, and index selection. Our automated evaluators enable the discovery of novel algorithms that outperform state-of-the-art baselines (e.g., a deterministic query rewrite policy that achieves up to 6.8x lower latency), demonstrating that addressing the evaluation bottleneck unlocks the potential of ADRS to generate highly optimized, deployable code for next-generation data systems.

AI.tldr: 论文提出通过"协同进化"方式自动设计评估器来解决AI驱动系统研究(ADRS)的评估瓶颈问题，并在数据库缓冲管理、查询重写和索引选择三个场景验证了该方法的有效性，成功发现了优于现有最优方案的新算法（如实现6.8倍延迟降低的确定性查询重写策略）。
AI.motivation: 现代工作负载和硬件的复杂性已超出人类研究和工程能力，传统数据库性能优化方法难以跟上发展速度。虽然ADRS通过大语言模型自动生成解决方案，但其核心瓶颈在于评估环节——需要快速准确的评估器来评价大量自动生成的候选方案。
AI.method: 核心创新是"协同进化"方法，即在生成优化方案的同时自动设计评估器，而非人工构建。具体在三个场景验证：(1)缓冲管理策略优化，(2)查询重写策略优化，(3)索引选择优化。
AI.result: 实验结果表明自动化评估器能够发现超越现有最优基准的创新算法，包括一种确定性查询重写策略实现了最高6.8倍的延迟降低。
AI.conclusion: 解决评估瓶颈释放了ADRS的潜力，使其能够为下一代数据系统生成高度优化的可部署代码。该方法证明了通过自动设计评估器可有效弥合AI生成方案与实际部署之间的差距。

title: ARIA: Adaptive Retrieval Intelligence Assistant -- A Multimodal RAG Framework for Domain-Specific Engineering Education
summary: Developing effective, domain-specific educational support systems is central to advancing AI in education. Although large language models (LLMs) demonstrate remarkable capabilities, they face significant limitations in specialized educational applications, including hallucinations, limited knowledge updates, and lack of domain expertise. Fine-tuning requires complete model retraining, creating substantial computational overhead, while general-purpose LLMs often provide inaccurate responses in specialized contexts due to reliance on generalized training data. To address this, we propose ARIA (Adaptive Retrieval Intelligence Assistant), a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework for creating intelligent teaching assistants across university-level courses. ARIA leverages a multimodal content extraction pipeline combining Docling for structured document analysis, Nougat for mathematical formula recognition, and GPT-4 Vision API for diagram interpretation, with the e5-large-v2 embedding model for high semantic performance and low latency. This enables accurate processing of complex educational materials while maintaining pedagogical consistency through engineered prompts and response controls. We evaluate ARIA using lecture material from Statics and Mechanics of Materials, a sophomore-level civil engineering course at Johns Hopkins University, benchmarking against ChatGPT-5. Results demonstrate 97.5% accuracy in domain-specific question filtering and superior pedagogical performance. ARIA correctly answered all 20 relevant course questions while rejecting 58 of 60 non-relevant queries, achieving 90.9% precision, 100% recall, and 4.89/5.0 average response quality. These findings demonstrate that ARIA's course-agnostic architecture represents a scalable framework for domain-specific educational AI deployment.

AI.tldr: ARIA 是一个面向大学课程的"课程无关"多模态 RAG 教学助手框架：先用 Docling（文本/表格/版面）+ Nougat（公式 LaTeX）+ GPT-4o Vision（工程图、受力图、示意图）三路并行抽取课程材料，再经语义分块与向量入库，查询时做相似度检索并由 GPT-4 结合教学型提示生成带引用编号的回答，同时用多层"领域相关性判定"（89 个关键词 + 27 类非工程语境排除 + 单位/符号/公式模式）拦截越界问题。在 JHU《Statics and Mechanics of Materials》课程上验证：抽取量较最佳单一工具提升 65.2%（20,760 字符），领域问题过滤准确率 97.5%（精确率 90.9%、召回率 100%、F1 95.2%），平均回答质量 4.89/5；与 ChatGPT-5 相比总体教育有效性 94.2% vs 91.7%，ARIA 在概念讲解与分步教学上占优，GPT-5 在纯数学计算精度上占优。
AI.motivation: 通用大语言模型在专业/课程级教育场景中存在三类核心缺陷：幻觉、难以增量更新知识、缺乏领域专精。其根源在于依赖泛化训练数据，无法利用结构化的课程专属知识。已有两条改进路线各有代价：微调（如 LoRA）每有新材料就需完整重训练，计算与维护开销大；纯 RAG 在 STEM 教育中又面临多模态挑战——公式、图表、手写标注难以被通用嵌入模型有效表征，且当前 RAG 普遍存在"检索失败"与"生成失败"两类失效。此外教育场景还存在隐私与公平性顾虑、标准评测框架缺失等问题。因此需要一个可快速迁移到任意课程、既能处理文本+公式+图形、又能严格限定在课程范围内并提供可追溯引用的教学助手框架。
AI.method: 整体为"离线知识构建 + 在线检索生成"两段式流水线。离线阶段：课程材料（PDF/docx）逐页转为高分辨率图像/PDF 后进入三条并行抽取路径——Docling（DocLayNet 版面分析 + TableFormer 表格结构）负责结构化文本；Nougat（facebook/nougat-base 视觉编码器-解码器）将数学公式转为 LaTeX；GPT-4o Vision 识别并描述工程图、自由体图、结构示意图及解题流程；随后三路输出合并为统一多模态表示，经保持概念边界与元数据（主题域、来源文档、难度层级、先修知识）的语义/层级分块后编码为向量，存入 pickle 近似最近邻索引。在线阶段：查询向量化后做相似度检索，检索内容与问题通过教学型提示工程注入 GPT-4 生成回答并附加编号来源引用；生成采用保守解码（最大 400 token、温度 0.7、presence/frequency penalty 0.1），并支持多轮对话与按学生水平调整解释深度。教学护栏采用多层相关性分类：89 个领域词表（静力学 30 + 力学 34 + 工程 25）、27 类常见非工程语境排除、6 类易混淆表述、31 个工程计量单位、12 个数学/力学符号、10 类平衡与应力-应变公式模式；未过阈值者返回标准化"课程无关"提示。实验包含三部分：抽取消融（6 页扭转课件，单工具 PyPDF2/Docling/Nougat/GPT-4 Vision vs ARIA-Full）、5 种嵌入模型对比（text-embedding-3-large/small、all-MiniLM-L6-v2、instructor-xl、e5-large-v2，指标 Acc@5/MRR/NDCG@5/相似度/延迟/存储）、80 题四类问题的领域过滤评测，以及与 ChatGPT-5 在 20 道相关题上的六项二元专家评测。
AI.result: （1）抽取消融：PyPDF2 对图像化 PDF 抽取为 0 字符；Docling 3,924 字符（18.9%，公式为占位符）；Nougat 4,268 字符（20.6%，8 个公式全部 LaTeX 化但上下文碎片化）；GPT-4 Vision 12,568 字符（60.5%，图表描述详细但公式为自然语言）；ARIA-Full 20,760 字符，较最佳单一工具提升 65.2%，实现结构化文本+可计算 LaTeX+详细图示语义的互补非冗余覆盖。（2）嵌入模型：5 个模型 Acc@5、MRR、NDCG@5 全部为 1.00，说明在主题集中的小规模知识库中维度影响甚微；差异体现在相似度与效率——e5-large-v2 相似度最高 0.851（instructor-xl 0.798，OpenAI 系 0.588–0.604），all-MiniLM-L6-v2 延迟最低 0.065 s（约为 text-embedding-3-large 的 1/18）、存储 73 KB（后者 346 KB），e5-large-v2 以 0.178 s/138 KB 取得最佳平衡。（3）领域过滤：80 题中 20 真阳、0 假阴、2 假阳、58 真阴，精确率 90.9%、召回率 100%、F1 95.2%、总体准确率 97.5%，两处误判均为工程相邻问题（振动分析、复合材料应力分析）；平均回答质量 4.89/5.0。（4）与 ChatGPT-5 对比：总体教育有效性 94.2% vs 91.7%；逐题看，ARIA 在"分步讲解""概念解释""教学式引导而非直接给答案"上系统性占优，GPT-5 在若干题（Q1、Q5、Q8、Q10、Q11、Q13、Q18、Q20 等）的数学正确性与计算精度上更好，ARIA 在 Q3、Q5、Q10、Q11、Q13 的数学正确性上出现失误。
AI.conclusion: 多模态编排式抽取是处理工程教育材料的前提：单一工具无法同时覆盖文本、公式与图形语义，完整流水线较最优单工具多捕获 65.2% 的非冗余信息；轻量级开源嵌入模型在主题集中的课程知识库上可与商业嵌入模型检索精度持平且在相似度与效率上更优，e5-large-v2 是资源受限教育部署的最佳折中；严格的多层教学护栏使系统能在保持 97.5% 领域过滤准确率的同时提供带可追溯引用的高质量教学式回答，验证了"课程无关架构 + 替换知识源即可迁移"的可扩展性。局限与未来方向：论文存在描述不一致（摘要称生产环境使用 e5-large-v2，而方法/图 1 述及 text-embedding-3-large；基线为 ChatGPT-5 而系统本体为 GPT-4，未做同基线对比），评测为单门课程、单次人工二元打分、样本量小，缺少对照消融（如纯文本 RAG、无护栏版本）与学习成效/长期记忆实验；未来将引入专用数学推理模块弥补计算短板、优化顺序逐文档处理（精度高但延迟大）的架构、通过联邦学习解决机构级扩展、建立学习成果与保持率标准评测、实现按学生进度自适应个性化、拓展至人文社科并加入多语言支持，同时需保证数据隐私与跨文化适配。

title: Strategic Persuasion with Trait-Conditioned Multi-Agent Systems for Iterative Legal Argumentation
summary:
Strategic interaction in adversarial domains such as law, diplomacy, and negotiation is mediated by language, yet most game-theoretic models abstract away the mechanisms of persuasion that operate through discourse. We present the Strategic Courtroom Framework, a multi-agent simulation environment in which prosecution and defense teams composed of trait-conditioned Large Language Model (LLM) agents engage in iterative, round-based legal argumentation. Agents are instantiated using nine interpretable traits organized into four archetypes, enabling systematic control over rhetorical style and strategic orientation.
  We evaluate the framework across 10 synthetic legal cases and 84 three-trait team configurations, totaling over 7{,}000 simulated trials using DeepSeek-R1 and Gemini~2.5~Pro. Our results show that heterogeneous teams with complementary traits consistently outperform homogeneous configurations, that moderate interaction depth yields more stable verdicts, and that certain traits (notably quantitative and charismatic) contribute disproportionately to persuasive success. We further introduce a reinforcement-learning-based Trait Orchestrator that dynamically generates defense traits conditioned on the case and opposing team, discovering strategies that outperform static, human-designed trait combinations.
  Together, these findings demonstrate how language can be treated as a first-class strategic action space and provide a foundation for building autonomous agents capable of adaptive persuasion in multi-agent environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Strategic Courtroom Framework，一个多智能体模拟环境，利用大语言模型(LLM)模拟控辩双方的法庭论证过程。通过9个可解释特质构建四种原型队伍，在7000+场模拟审判中发现异质性团队表现优于同质化配置，中等交互深度产生更稳定判决，量化型和魅力型特质贡献最大，并提出基于强化学习的特质编排器可动态生成超越人工设计的防御策略。
AI.motivation: 传统博弈论模型抽象掉了语言说服机制，而法律、外交、谈判等对抗性领域的战略互动正是通过话语实现的。研究旨在弥合语言作为战略工具与计算框架之间的鸿沟，使语言成为一等战略行动空间。
AI.method: 1) 构建包含9个可解释特质的4种原型多智能体系统; 2) 使用DeepSeek-R1和Gemini-2.5-Pro在10个合成案例、84种三人队伍配置下进行7000+场模拟审判; 3) 开发基于强化学习的Trait Orchestrator动态生成防御特质策略。
AI.result: 异质性团队显著优于同质化配置; 中等交互深度产生更稳定判决; 量化型和魅力型特质对说服成功贡献突出; 动态生成的特质策略可超越静态人工设计组合。
AI.conclusion: 语言可作为一等战略行动空间; 该框架为构建自适应说服型自主智能体奠定基础; 为多智能体环境中研究话语说服机制提供可扩展平台。

title: Beyond Functional Correctness: Design Issues in AI IDE-Generated Large-Scale Projects
comment: 40 pages, 19 images, 5 tables, Manuscript submitted to a Journal (2026)
summary: New generation of AI coding tools, including AI-powered IDEs equipped with agentic capabilities, can generate code within the context of the project. These AI IDEs are increasingly perceived as capable of producing project-level code at scale. However, there is limited empirical evidence on the extent to which they can generate large-scale software systems and what design issues such systems may exhibit. To address this gap, we conducted a study to explore the capability of Cursor in generating large-scale projects and to evaluate the design quality of projects generated by Cursor. First, we propose a Feature-Driven Human-In-The-Loop (FD-HITL) framework that systematically guides project generation from curated project descriptions. We generated 10 projects using Cursor with the FD-HITL framework across three application domains and multiple technologies. We assessed the functional correctness of these projects through manual evaluation, obtaining an average functional correctness score of 91%. Next, we analyzed the generated projects using two static analysis tools, CodeScene and SonarQube, to detect design issues. We identified 1,305 design issues categorized into 9 categories by CodeScene and 3,193 issues in 11 categories by SonarQube. Our findings show that (1) when used with the FD-HITL framework, Cursor can generate functional large-scale projects averaging 16,965 LoC and 114 files; (2) the generated projects nevertheless contain design issues that may pose long-term maintainability and evolvability risks, requiring careful review by experienced developers; (3) the most prevalent issues include Code Duplication, high Code Complexity, Large Methods, Framework Best-Practice Violations, Exception-Handling Issues and Accessibility Issues; (4) these design issues violate design principles such as SRP, SoC, and DRY. The replication package is at https://github.com/Kashifraz/DIinAGP

AI.tldr: 研究探索了 Cursor AI IDE 生成大规模软件项目的能力及其代码设计质量。采用特征驱动人机协作框架（FD-HITL）生成10个项目，平均功能正确性达91%，平均规模16,965行代码和114个文件。但静态分析发现大量设计问题，包括代码重复、高复杂度、方法过大等，违反SRP、SoC、DRY等设计原则。
AI.motivation: 新一代AI编程工具（如具备Agent能力的AI IDE）被认为能大规模生成项目级代码，但缺乏实证研究验证其在生成大型软件系统方面的实际能力以及生成代码的设计质量。
AI.method: 研究提出FD-HITL框架指导项目生成，在3个应用领域和多种技术栈中使用Cursor生成了10个项目；通过人工评估功能正确性，使用CodeScene和SonarQube两个静态分析工具检测设计问题。
AI.result: 生成的10个项目平均规模达16,965行代码和114个文件，功能正确性平均得分为91%。CodeScene检测到1,305个设计问题（9类），SonarQube检测到3,193个问题（11类）。主要问题包括：代码重复、高代码复杂度、方法过大、框架最佳实践违规、异常处理问题和可访问性问题。
AI.conclusion: Cursor配合FD-HITL框架能生成功能完整的大规模项目，但生成的代码存在维护性和可演进性风险设计问题，违反SRP（单一职责原则）、SoC（关注点分离）和DRY（不要重复自己）原则，需有经验开发者仔细审查。

title: The Human Condition as Reflected in Contemporary Large Language Models
summary: This study seeks to uncover evidence of a latent structure in evolved human culture as it is refracted through contemporary large language models (LLMs). Drawing on parallel responses from six leading generative models to a prompt which asks directly what their training corpora reveal about human culture and behavior, we identify a robust cross-model consensus on a limited set of recurring cultural themes. The themes include narrative meaning-making, affect-first cognition, coalition psychology, status competition, threat sensitivity, and moral rationalization. Each provides grounds for further psychological and sociological inquiry. There is strong evidence of a convergence in these pattern recognition exercises as differences among models are shown to reflect varying explanatory lenses rather than substantive disagreement. We review these findings in the light of the evolving literatures of moral psychology, evolutionary psychology, anthropology, and the computer science literature on large-scale language modeling. We argue that LLMs function as cultural condensates -- compressed representations of how humans describe, justify, and contest their own social lives across trillions of tokens of aggregated communication and narration.

AI.tldr: 研究利用六种主流生成式AI模型对人类文化与行为的描述进行交叉分析，发现模型在万亿级token的训练语料中形成了关于人类文化的主题共识，包括叙事意义建构、情感优先认知、联盟心理、地位竞争、威胁敏感性和道德合理化等六大主题，提出LLM可作为"文化凝聚物"的概念。
AI.motivation: 揭示透过大型语言模型折射的人类文化潜在结构，探究LLM训练语料所反映的人类文化与行为模式
AI.method: 使用六个主流生成式模型对同一提示进行平行响应分析，该提示直接询问训练语料对人类文化与行为的揭示。通过跨模型比较，识别反复出现的文化主题共识，并区分模型间差异源于解释框架不同而非实质分歧。
AI.result: 识别出六大文化主题的稳健跨模型共识：叙事意义建构、情感优先认知、联盟心理、地位竞争、威胁敏感性、道德合理化。各模型差异主要反映不同的解释视角，而非实质性分歧。
AI.conclusion: LLM作为"文化凝聚物"（cultural condensates）——是人类在数万亿token的聚合交流与叙事中如何描述、辩护和争论自身社会生活的压缩表征。六大主题为心理学、社会学及人类学的进一步研究提供了基础。

title: Consistency-Guided Decoding with Proof-Driven Disambiguation for Three-Way Logical Question Answering
summary: Three-way logical question answering (QA) assigns $True/False/Unknown$ to a hypothesis $H$ given a premise set $S$. While modern large language models (LLMs) can be accurate on isolated examples, we identify two recurring failure modes in 3-way logic QA: (i) negation inconsistency, where answers to $H$ and $\neg H$ violate the deterministic label mapping, and (ii) epistemic $Unknown$, where the model predicts $Unknown$ due to uncertainty or instability even when $S$ entails one side. We present CGD-PD, a lightweight test-time layer that (a) queries a single 3-way classifier on both $H$ and a mechanically negated form of $H$, (b) projects the pair onto a negation-consistent decision when possible, and (c) invokes a proof-driven disambiguation step that uses targeted binary entailment probes to selectively resolve $Unknown$ outcomes, requiring only an average of 4-5 model calls. On the FOLIO benchmark's first-order-logic fields, CGD-PD yields consistent gains across frontier LLMs, with relative improvements in accuracy of up to 16% over the base model, while also reducing $Unknown$ predictions.

AI.tldr: 本文针对大语言模型在三路逻辑问答（True/False/Unknown）中的两类典型失败模式提出了轻量级测试时解决方案CGD-PD，通过查询原始假设及其否定形式并结合证明驱动的消歧步骤，在FOLIO基准测试中实现最高16%的相对准确率提升。
AI.motivation: 现代大语言模型在三路逻辑问答中存在两类系统性失败：(i) 否定不一致性——模型对假设H和其否定形式¬H的预测违反确定性标签映射（如同时预测为True）；(ii) 认知性Unknown——模型因不确定性或不稳定而预测Unknown，但实际知识库S已蕴含某一确定答案。
AI.method: 提出CGD-PD方法，包含三个核心步骤：(a) 对假设H及其机械否定形式¬H分别查询同一三路分类器；(b) 将预测结果对投影到否定一致空间，当可能时消解冲突；(c) 引入证明驱动的消歧机制，使用针对性的二元蕴含探测探针选择性解决Unknown情况。该方法平均仅需4-5次模型调用。
AI.result: 在FOLIO基准测试的一阶逻辑字段上，CGD-PD为前沿LLM带来一致的准确率提升，相对基线模型提升最高达16%，同时有效减少了Unknown预测。
AI.conclusion: 通过结合否定一致性约束与证明驱动的消歧策略，CGD-PD成功解决了LLM在三路逻辑推理中的系统性失败问题，且具有计算效率高（少量模型调用）、通用性强（跨模型一致有效）的优点。

title: SymptomWise: A Deterministic Reasoning Layer for Reliable and Efficient AI Systems
summary: AI-driven symptom analysis systems face persistent challenges in reliability, interpretability, and hallucination. End-to-end generative approaches often lack traceability and may produce unsupported or inconsistent diagnostic outputs in safety-critical settings. We present SymptomWise, a framework that separates language understanding from diagnostic reasoning. The system combines expert-curated medical knowledge, deterministic codex-driven inference, and constrained use of large language models. Free-text input is mapped to validated symptom representations, then evaluated by a deterministic reasoning module operating over a finite hypothesis space to produce a ranked differential diagnosis. Language models are used only for symptom extraction and optional explanation, not for diagnostic inference. This architecture improves traceability, reduces unsupported conclusions, and enables modular evaluation of system components. Preliminary evaluation on 42 expert-authored challenging pediatric neurology cases shows meaningful overlap with clinician consensus, with the correct diagnosis appearing in the top five differentials in 88% of cases. Beyond medicine, the framework generalizes to other abductive reasoning domains and may serve as a deterministic structuring and routing layer for foundation models, improving precision and potentially reducing unnecessary computational overhead in bounded tasks.

AI.tldr: SymptomWise框架通过将语言理解与诊断推理解耦来解决医学AI的可靠性问题。该系统使用确定性规则引擎进行诊断推理，仅将LLM用于症状提取和解释，避免了大模型在医疗推理中的幻觉风险。在42例儿科神经科疑难病例中，88%的正确诊断出现在前五位鉴别诊断中。
AI.motivation: 当前AI驱动的症状分析系统面临可靠性、可解释性和幻觉问题。端到端生成式方法缺乏可追溯性，在安全关键场景中可能产生无依据或不一致的诊断输出。
AI.method: SymptomWise框架将语言理解与诊断推理分离：1) 将自由文本输入映射为经验证的症状表征；2) 由确定性推理模块在有限假设空间上进行运算；3) 仅将LLM用于症状提取和可选的解释生成，不参与诊断推理。系统结合了专家策展的医学知识和代码驱动的确定性推理。
AI.result: 在42例专家编写的儿科神经科疑难病例上评估，正确诊断出现在前五位鉴别诊断中的比例为88%，与临床医生共识有意义的重叠。
AI.conclusion: 该架构提高了可追溯性，减少了无依据结论，并支持模块化评估。框架可泛化至医学以外的其他溯因推理领域，也可作为基础模型的确定性结构和路由层，在有限任务中提高精度并降低不必要的计算开销。

title: $S^3$: Stratified Scaling Search for Test-Time in Diffusion Language Models
summary: Test-time scaling investigates whether a fixed diffusion language model (DLM) can generate better outputs when given more inference compute, without additional training. However, naive best-of-$K$ sampling is fundamentally limited because it repeatedly draws from the same base diffusion distribution, whose high-probability regions are often misaligned with high-quality outputs. We propose $S^3$ (Stratified Scaling Search), a classical verifier-guided search method that improves generation by reallocating compute during the denoising process rather than only at the final output stage. At each denoising step, $S^3$ expands multiple candidate trajectories, evaluates them with a lightweight reference-free verifier, and selectively resamples promising candidates while preserving diversity within the search frontier. This procedure effectively approximates a reward-tilted sampling distribution that favors higher-quality outputs while remaining anchored to the model prior. Experiments with LLaDA-8B-Instruct on MATH-500, GSM8K, ARC-Challenge, and TruthfulQA demonstrate that $S^3$ consistently improves performance across benchmarks, achieving the largest gains on mathematical reasoning tasks while leaving the underlying model and decoding schedule unchanged. These results show that classical search over denoising trajectories provides a practical mechanism for test-time scaling in DLMs.

AI.tldr: S^3（Stratified Scaling Search）把"测试时扩展"的算力从最终输出筛选前移到扩散去噪过程内部：维护 N 条部分去噪轨迹的粒子群体，每个去噪步做"扩展—打分—重采样"，用免参考的轻量复合验证器对模型的一步干净预测打分，并以 Srinivasan Sampling Process（低方差依赖取整）做随机重采样，把算力重分配到有希望的去噪轨迹上；在固定模型与固定解码调度下无需再训练即可提升准确率。LLaDA-8B-Instruct 上：MATH-500 25.60%→30.20%（+4.60pp，较 BoK 再 +2.00pp），GSM8K 68.16%→70.21%，TruthfulQA 46.49%→49.57%，ARC-Challenge 76.11%→77.86%（在 K=64 时略低于 BoK 的 79.30%，但在 K∈{2,4,16} 的细粒度块长下反超）。核心动机是 DLMs 中的"密度—质量失配"：模型高概率区域常与高验证分区域不重合，朴素 best-of-K 因样本同分布而仅有对数级增益。
AI.motivation: 测试时扩展（test-time scaling）关注在模型固定、不再训练的前提下，增加推理算力能否显著提升输出质量。论文指出两点核心问题：（1）朴素 best-of-K 采样存在根本上限——它反复从同一基础扩散分布 p0 采样，K 增大并不改变采样分布本身，由次高斯极值集中不等式可得增益上界为 Q(p0)+σ√(2lnK)，仅随 K 对数增长；（2）DLM 存在"密度—质量失配"（density–quality mismatch）：基础分布 p0 的高概率质量区域与验证器奖励 f 的高值区域往往错位，高质量输出可能处于概率空间的稀疏区。在 KL 约束 D_KL(p̃‖p0)≤δ 下最大化 E[f(x)] 的最优解是奖励倾斜的 Gibbs 分布 p̃0(x)∝p0(x)·exp(τf(x))，因此需要在去噪过程中"重塑"采样分布，而非仅在末端过滤输出。
AI.method: 理论框架分三个层次构建。Level 1（精确末端目标）：由 KL 约束变分优化推出最优目标为奖励倾斜 Gibbs 分布；将其推广到整条去噪路径测度 p̃(x_{0:T}) ∝ p(x_{0:T})·e^{τf(x0)}。Level 2（精确序贯实现）：定义后向信息函数 h_t(x_t)=E_p[e^{τf(x0)}|x_t]，给出实现 p̃ 的扭曲核 p̃_θ(x_{t-1}|x_t)=p_θ(x_{t-1}|x_t,e)·h_{t-1}(x_{t-1})/h_t(x_t)（Doob h-变换），并以增量势 G_t 作为重要性权重构成 SMC 采样器；理论上可用辅助粒子滤波（Pitt & Shephard）与扭曲粒子滤波（Whiteley & Lee）逼近。Level 3（可实现近似 S^3）：h_t 不可解（需边缘化所有轨迹），故用模型自身的一步干净预测 x̂0=decode(p_θ(x0|x_{t-1})) 配合验证器得分 s=f(x̂0) 构造替代势 ĥ_{t-1}=exp(λs)。具体算法（Algorithm 1）：初始化 N 个全掩码粒子；每步每个粒子扩展 b 个后继得 Nb 个候选；用一步干净预测 + 验证器打分；权重 w̃=exp(λs) 归一化后得期望后代数 ξ=Nw；用 SSP（Srinivasan Sampling Process，依赖取整的随机低方差重采样）将 Nb 个子代按 ξ 精确整数化为 N 个粒子（保留随机性以避免确定性 top-k 剪枝导致的模式坍缩）；最后在 t=0 对 N 个粒子做多数投票，并以基座模型的最低 NLL 打破平局。验证器为免参考、无需真值标签、无需 LLM-as-judge 的轻量复合打分 f(x)=Σα_k s_k(x)+α_c s_constraint(x)，五项正交信号：结构完整性（关键词/答案定界符/字符密度）、内部算术一致性（校验 a op b=c 等式与链式比值）、答案可达性（最终答案是否出现在推理前缀中）、模型置信度（生成 token 平均概率）、非退化性（特殊 token 洪水、未解掩码、长度、bigram/trigram 多样性），并按数据集设定权重剖面（数学任务重算术一致性与可达性；多选任务 α_c=0.45 用 MC 推理质量分；附录另含 Countdown/Sudoku 自验证约束项）。总评估次数约 T·N·b，N、b、λ 显式调节算力—质量权衡，验证器自身为 O(|x|)，相对 O(L²) 的模型前向可忽略。
AI.result: 主结果（LLaDA-8B-Instruct，N=4、b=2、K=64 块长）：MATH-500 25.60→30.20（+4.60pp，较 BoK 28.20 再 +2.00pp）；GSM8K 68.16→70.21（+2.05pp，BoK 69.56）；TruthfulQA 46.49→49.57（+3.08pp，BoK 49.36）；ARC-Challenge 76.11→77.86（+1.75pp，但低于 BoK 79.30）。扩展性实验显示 S^3 在 MATH-500/GSM8K/TruthfulQA 上以匹配 NFE 超过 BoK 的 Pareto 前沿，在 ARC-C 上低算力下有竞争力但高预算不占优（多选题验证器判别力弱）；去噪过程中平均 token 置信度始终高于基线，说明重采样稳定了中间生成动态而不只是末端筛选。块长分析显示 S^3 在 MATH-500/GSM8K 全部块长上一致优于基线与 BoK，在 ARC-C 上于 K∈{2,4,16} 领先、K∈{8,32,64} 落后。消融（匹配 K=N·b=8 前向）：仅 look-ahead（均匀 top-N 剪枝）增益微弱（GSM8K 69.69、MATH-500 26.20、TruthfulQA 46.49），仅 tilting（对独立样本加权 argmax）在 MATH-500 仅 26.40、低于 BoK 的 28.20，只有两者结合才取得一致提升（MATH-500 上较 BoK +2.40pp），验证双组件设计的必要性。附录显示 S^3 的验证器分数分布随去噪逐步右移、粒子密度向高奖励区集中，支持其向奖励倾斜分布逼近的解释；输出 token 数略短于基线（更简洁）；延迟显著高于基线（约为 BoK 的同量级）。需注意附录表格中的部分延迟数值（如 ARC-C 块长 2/4 下 7.4s 对 7.1e4 s、MATH 块长 4/8/16/32 下基线与 S^3 均为 ~5s）明显不自洽，附录说明"多块解码与 BFS 搜索"的表述也与正文的 SSP 粒子搜索不完全一致，提示附录数据与描述可能存在排版/报告问题。
AI.conclusion: 论文表明，DLM 的测试时扩展可以通过"在去噪轨迹上做经典搜索"实现：S^3 以验证器引导的粒子搜索（expand–score–resample）把推理算力重新分配到去噪路径的高潜力区域，无需修改基座模型或解码调度，即可跨四个基准获得一致提升，且在数学推理类任务上增益最大、在 ARC-C 等多选任务上于细粒度块长下反超 BoK，验证了"look-ahead + reward tilting"双机制协同的必要性。主要局限是：性能依赖验证器质量与中间干净预测的准确性，噪声或错位的信号无法有效引导轨迹；粒子扩展与重复打分带来额外算力开销，算力—性能权衡是实际部署的关键考量。论文自陈使用的是"验证器引导的近似扭曲方案"（Remark 2），而非对 p̃ 的无偏粒子滤波估计——因需计算相邻状态后验信息函数之比而不可行。

title: On the Decidability of Distributed Tasks with Output Sets under Asynchrony and Any Number of Crashes
summary: In this paper, we define a new class of distributed tasks, called SOS tasks (for Set of Output Sets tasks), defined by the set $O$ of distinct output sets of values that can be produced. We then demonstrate that this class of tasks is decidable: there exists an effective procedure that determines whether any SOS task is solvable asynchronously under $t$ crashes. The decision rule is as follows. Every SOS task is solvable when $t=0$. For $t > 0$, an SOS task is solvable if and only if its SOS graph $G=(O,\subset)$ is connected. In this graph, each vertex is an output set in $O$, and two vertices are linked by an edge whenever one output set includes the other. One of the surprising implications of our results is that, without a validity property, $k$-set agreement is solvable under any number of crashes $t \geq 0$ for $k>1$, and unsolvable under $t >0$ crashes only for $k=1$ (consensus). Finally, we study a novel family of tasks called $d$-disagreement, which requires the system to always produce $d$ different output values, and we show that its implementability condition is related to the harmonic series.

AI.tldr: 本文定义了SOS任务（输出集合集合任务）这一新的分布式任务类别，并证明该类别在异步系统且最多t个进程崩溃的条件下是可判定的：t=0时所有SOS任务可解；t>0时，SOS任务可解当且仅当其SOS图（以输出集合为顶点、包含关系为边的图）是连通的。一个惊人推论是：对于k>1的k-集合共识在任何崩溃数下均可解，仅k=1（共识）在t>0时不可解。此外，还研究了要求始终产生d个不同输出值的d-不一致任务族，其可实现条件与调和级数相关。
AI.motivation: 分布式计算中一个核心问题是判定哪些并发任务在给定故障模型下是否可解。该研究旨在建立一类新的分布式任务（SOS任务）的可解性判定理论，提供有效的判定程序。
AI.method: 通过构建SOS图（顶点为输出集合，边表示包含关系），将任务可解性判定转化为图论问题；利用容错异步模型进行分析。
AI.result: （1）SOS任务类是可判定的，存在有效判定程序；（2）t=0时所有SOS任务可解；（3）t>0时SOS任务可解当且仅当SOS图G=(O,⊂)连通；（4）k-集合共识：k>1时在任意崩溃数下可解，k=1（共识）仅在t=0时可解；（5）d-不一致任务的实现条件与调和级数相关。
AI.conclusion: SOS任务类的可解性完全由其SOS图的连通性决定，共识是唯一在存在崩溃时不可解的k-集合共识特例（k=1），而k>1的集合共识在任何故障数量下均可解。

title: SonicDB S6: A Storage-Efficient Verkle Trie for High-Throughput Blockchains
summary:
The Ethereum state database uses Merkle Patricia Trie (MPT), which suffers from large witness proof sizes and high storage overhead. Verkle Tries have been proposed as a replacement, offering witness proofs below 150 bytes through vector commitments and Inner Product Argument aggregation. However, deploying a Verkle Trie in a high-throughput, short block-time blockchain such as Sonic, which produces a block every 300 milliseconds, introduces substantial engineering challenges related to storage efficiency, commitment computation costs, and the need to serve both live and historical state queries in real time.
  We present SonicDB S6, a production Rust Verkle Trie database for the Sonic blockchain, which leverages its non-forking property to enable aggressive storage optimizations. Occupancy-aware node specializations, selected via an O(kn2) dynamic program, reduce live storage by 98%. Delta nodes that record only changed slots reduce archive storage by 95%. Batched updates, multi-threaded commitment computation, and homomorphic Pedersen caching yield 2.85x higher throughput than a persistent Geth Verkle baseline while sustaining production block-rate performance.

AI.tldr: SonicDB S6 是一款用于 Sonic 区块链的生产级 Rust Verkle Trie 数据库，通过占用率感知节点特化、增量节点优化、批量更新、多线程承诺计算和同态 Pedersen 缓存等技术，实现了 98% 的实时存储缩减、95% 的归档存储缩减，以及相较于 Geth Verkle 基线 2.85 倍的吞吐量提升。
AI.motivation: 以太坊状态数据库采用的 Merkle Patricia Trie (MPT) 存在见证证明体积大、存储开销高的问题。Verkle Trie 虽然通过向量承诺和内积论证聚合可将见证证明压缩至 150 字节以下，但在 Sonic 这类高吞吐量、短区块间隔（300ms）的区块链中部署，面临存储效率、承诺计算成本及实时查询服务等工程挑战。
AI.method: SonicDB S6 利用 Verkle Trie 的非分叉特性实现激进存储优化：①基于 O(kn²) 动态规划选择占用率感知的节点特化方案；②Delta 节点仅记录变更槽位以压缩归档存储；③批量更新、多线程承诺计算与同态 Pedersen 缓存相结合提升吞吐量。
AI.result: .live 存储减少 98%，归档存储减少 95%，吞吐量达 Geth Verkle 基线的 2.85 倍，同时满足生产级出块速率要求。
AI.conclusion: SonicDB S6 成功解决了高吞吐量区块链中部署 Verkle Trie 的核心工程难题，证明了在 300ms 区块间隔下实现高效状态存储和查询的可行性，为 Verkle Trie 从理论走向生产提供了重要参考。

title: The Unreasonable Effectiveness of Data for Recommender Systems
summary: In recommender systems, collecting, storing, and processing large-scale interaction data is increasingly costly in terms of time, energy, and computation, yet it remains unclear when additional data stops providing meaningful gains. This paper investigates how offline recommendation performance evolves as the size of the training dataset increases and whether a saturation point can be observed. We implemented a reproducible Python evaluation workflow with two established toolkits, LensKit and RecBole, included 11 large public datasets with at least 7 million interactions, and evaluated 10 tool-algorithm combinations. Using absolute stratified user sampling, we trained models on nine sample sizes from 100,000 to 100,000,000 interactions and measured NDCG@10. Overall, raw NDCG usually increased with sample size, with no observable saturation point. To make result groups comparable, we applied min-max normalization within each group, revealing a clear positive trend in which around 75% of the points at the largest completed sample size also achieved the group's best observed performance. A late-stage slope analysis over the final 10-30% of each group further supported this upward trend: the interquartile range remained entirely non-negative with a median near 1.0. In summary, for traditional recommender systems on typical user-item interaction data, incorporating more training data remains primarily beneficial, while weaker scaling behavior is concentrated in atypical dataset cases and in the algorithmic outlier RecBole BPR under our setup.

AI.tldr: 本文通过大规模实证研究（11个数据集、10种算法组合、9种样本规模）探究了推荐系统中训练数据规模与性能的关系。结果表明，在典型场景下，NDCG@10随数据量增加持续提升，未观察到明显的饱和点；约75%的最大样本量配置取得了各组最佳性能，暗示更多训练数据仍有收益。
AI.motivation: 推荐系统收集、存储和处理大规模交互数据的成本（时间、能源、计算资源）日益增长，但尚不明确在何时增加数据量将不再产生有意义的收益。
AI.method: 采用可复现Python评估工作流，使用LensKit和RecBole两个工具包，选取11个大型公开数据集（每个至少700万交互）和10种工具-算法组合，通过绝对分层用户抽样，在10万至1亿交互的9个样本规模下训练模型，测量NDCG@10。
AI.result: 原始NDCG通常随样本量增加而提升，无明显饱和点；min-max归一化后75%的最大样本点达到组内最佳性能；后期斜率分析（四分位距始终非负，中位数接近1.0）支持上升趋势。
AI.conclusion: 对于传统推荐系统和典型用户-物品交互数据，增加训练数据仍主要有益；较弱的扩展行为仅出现在非典型数据集和使用RecBole BPR算法的异常情况。

title: Designing for Accountable Agents: a Viewpoint
summary:
AI systems are becoming increasingly complex, ubiquitous and autonomous, leading to increasing concerns about their impacts on individuals and society. In response, researchers have begun investigating how to ensure that the methods underlying AI decision-making are transparent and their decisions are explainable to people and conformant to human values and ethical principles. As part of this research thrust, the need for accountability within AI systems has been noted, but this notion has proven elusive to define; we aim to address this issue in the current paper. Unlike much recent work, we do not address accountability within the human organisational processes of developing and deploying AI; rather we consider what it would it mean for the agents within a multi-agent system (MAS), potentially including human agents, to be accountable to other agents or to have others accountable to them.
  In this work, we make the following contributions: we provide an in-depth survey of existing work on accountability in multiple disciplines, seeking to identify a coherent definition of the concept; we give a realistic example of a multi-agent system application domain that illustrates the benefits of enabling agents to follow accountability processes, and we identify a set of research challenges for the MAS community in building accountable agents, sketching out some initial solutions to these, thereby laying out a road-map for future research. Our focus is on laying the groundwork to enable autonomous elements within open socio-technical systems to take part in accountability processes.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇观点（viewpoint）论文，主张多智能体系统（MAS）社区应从"工程化合规"转向"可问责的自主体（accountable agents）"：即让智能体不只是问责的被动对象，而是能作为问责关系中的"被问责方（accountor，提供解释）"和"问责方（accountee，要求解释、作出裁决并施加补救）"积极参与问责过程。作者通过跨学科（法律、哲学、公共政策、社会学、管理学、计算机科学）梳理提炼出问责的核心要素与三阶段过程（信息/说明—辩论—裁决与制裁），并给出一个地震救援多智能体场景示例，最后提出覆盖全问责生命周期的研究议程与测试床设想。
AI.motivation: AI 系统日益复杂、普遍与自主，在安全关键和社会影响重大的场景中部署，引发对伦理AI、透明度、可解释性与监管问责的强烈要求。然而"问责"概念本身长期含混不清：不同学科对其定义分歧极大（Kaba 2021 在 217 篇文献中识别出 113 种问责概念化），这直接阻碍了可问责系统的设计。此外，当前计算机科学尤其是 MAS 领域多将 AI 视为"问责的客体"，只关注事后责任归属/追责与合规架构；而在开放、多主体（含人类）、异构且协议未预先约定的社会技术系统中，智能体必须自行解释规范、期待与社会过程，因此需要刻画"问责型自主体（accountable agency）"所需的认知能力。
AI.method: 采用跨学科文献综述 + 概念综合 + 场景构造 + 研究议程的方法：1) 综述 Day & Klein (1987)、Schedler (1999)、Bovens et al.、Schillemans (2013)、Gibbons (2014)、Emanuel & Emanuel (1996)、Lindberg (2009)、Dubnick (2003)、Koppell (2005)、Fox (2007)、Dignum (2018)、Baldoni et al.、Chopra & Singh 等的文献，提炼问责的最小共识（可问责性/关系性/回溯性/行为导向）、三阶段过程及 accountor–accountee 关系结构，并绘制概念关系图（图1）；2) 辨析责任（task-based/forward-looking vs. causal/backward-looking）、可答性、过错性、归责、透明性、回应性、回应能力等相邻概念；3) 给出地震救援 MAS 场景（地面机器人/无人机/操作员）演示问责互动如何引发规范修订、补救与系统改进；4) 归纳 13 项研究挑战（satisficing vs. optimisation、最佳实践形式化、任务轨迹 trace 记录、何时启动问责、什么构成有效说明、问责对话协议、裁决与补救选择、未来收益建模、主动/被动响应性、问责规范本体形式化、LLM 作为问责顾问、问责测试床与竞赛）及所需支撑技术。
AI.result: 得出问责关系的一般性结构：问责是 accountor 与 accountee 之间的关系性、回溯性、面向行为的制度安排，包含问责领域（locus/domain）、问责方权力（要求解释、制裁、补救）、以及三阶段过程（信息呈现—辩论/问答—裁决与制裁/补救）；问责的用途可归纳为控制与约束、规范对齐与知识扩散、学习与系统改进、信任与专业标准设定；相关概念可归入道德拉力（liability/answerability/responsibility/responsiveness）与道德推力（obligation/obedience/fidelity/amenability）等维度。据此提出可问责自主体的能力画像，并明确一系列尚未解决的研究问题：基于满意化（satisficing）而非优化的绩效判定与阈值演化、任务"轨迹"的充分性与相关性、最佳实践的建模与动态演化、有效说明的抽象层级与查询范围、问责对话协议（结合 dialogue games 与 FIPA-ACL，含"为什么"与反事实问题）、制裁与补救的选择及官僚化风险、用强化学习/效用建模预测问责未来收益、问责规范的本体与生命周期、以及可测试"说明可靠性、模型对齐、制裁/补救选择、问责启动"等能力的测试床与竞赛。
AI.conclusion: 论文是面向 MAS 社区的号召与路线图，而非完整解决方案。作者主张：问责不仅是保障理想行为的机制，更是推动智能体推理（满意化、规范化、实践性、博弈论、决策论）、通信与交互等基础研究的催化剂；未来智能体应既能作为 accountor 解释与辩护自身行为（并知道该留存哪些信息），也能作为 accountee 主动发起质询、作出裁决并运用权力改进系统。开放 MAS 中的问责研究远未成熟，需借助跨学科洞见处理社会技术复杂性，构建测试床与评测基准以推动社区积累。

title: ExplainFuzz: Explainable and Constraint-Conditioned Test Generation with Probabilistic Circuits
summary:
Understanding and explaining the structure of generated test inputs is essential for effective software testing and debugging. Existing approaches--including grammar-based fuzzers, probabilistic Context-Free Grammars (pCFGs), and Large Language Models (LLMs)--suffer from critical limitations. They frequently produce ill-formed inputs that fail to reflect realistic data distributions, struggle to capture context-sensitive probabilistic dependencies, and lack explainability. We introduce ExplainFuzz, a test generation framework that leverages Probabilistic Circuits (PCs) to learn and query structured distributions over grammar-based test inputs interpretably and controllably. Starting from a Context-Free Grammar (CFG), ExplainFuzz compiles a grammar-aware PC and trains it on existing inputs. New inputs are then generated via sampling. ExplainFuzz utilizes the conditioning capability of PCs to incorporate test-specific constraints (e.g., a query must have GROUP BY), enabling constrained probabilistic sampling to generate inputs satisfying grammar and user-provided constraints.
  Our results show that ExplainFuzz improves the coherence and realism of generated inputs, achieving significant perplexity reduction compared to pCFGs, grammar-unaware PCs, and LLMs. By leveraging its native conditioning capability, ExplainFuzz significantly enhances the diversity of inputs that satisfy a user-provided constraint. Compared to grammar-aware mutational fuzzing, ExplainFuzz increases bug-triggering rates from 35% to 63% in SQL and from 10% to 100% in XML. These results demonstrate the power of a learned input distribution over mutational fuzzing, which is often limited to exploring the local neighborhood of seed inputs. These capabilities highlight the potential of PCs to serve as a foundation for grammar-aware, controllable test generation that captures context-sensitive, probabilistic dependencies.

AI.tldr: ExplainFuzz是一个利用概率电路(PCs)学习并查询CFG生成测试输入结构化分布的测试生成框架，通过条件化能力实现约束感知采样，在SQL和XML测试中显著提升bug触发率。
AI.motivation: 现有测试生成方法（基于语法的模糊器、概率CFG、大语言模型）存在关键局限：常产生不合语法的输入、无法反映真实数据分布、难以捕获上下文敏感的依赖关系、缺乏可解释性。
AI.method: ExplainFuzz从CFG出发，编译语法感知PC并在现有输入上训练，通过采样生成新输入；利用PC的条件化能力融入测试约束（如查询必须包含GROUP BY），实现约束感知的概率采样。
AI.result: 相比pCFG、语法无关PC和LLM，ExplainFuzz显著降低困惑度，提升约束满足输入的多样性；相比语法感知变异模糊，SQL bug触发率从35%升至63%，XML从10%升至100%。
AI.conclusion: 概率电路有潜力作为语法感知、可控测试生成的基础，能捕获上下文敏感的依赖关系，证明了学习型输入分布优于依赖种子输入局部探索的变异模糊方法。

title: Governing frontier general-purpose AI in the public sector: adaptive risk management and policy capacity under uncertainty through 2030
summary: The governance of frontier general-purpose artificial intelligence has become a public-sector problem of institutional design, not merely a technical issue of model performance. Recent evidence indicates that AI capabilities are advancing rapidly, though unevenly, while knowledge about harms, safeguards, and effective interventions remains partial and lagged. This combination creates a difficult policy condition: governments must decide under uncertainty, across multiple plausible trajectories of progress through 2030, and in environments where adoption outcomes depend on organizational routines, data arrangements, accountability structures, and public values. This article argues that public governance for frontier AI should be based on adaptive risk management, scenario-aware regulation, and sociotechnical transformation rather than static compliance models. Drawing on the International AI Safety Report 2026, OECD foresight and policy documents, and recent scholarship in digital government, the article first reconstructs the conceptual foundations of the 'evidence dilemma', differentiated AI risk categories, and the limits of prediction. It then examines how AI adoption in government depends on organizational redesign, public-sector institutional dynamics, and data collaboration capacity. On that basis, it proposes an adaptive governance framework for public institutions that integrates capability monitoring, risk tiering, conditional controls, institutional learning, and standards-based interoperability. The article concludes that effective AI governance requires stronger policy capacity, clearer allocation of responsibility, and governance mechanisms that remain robust across divergent technological futures.

AI.tldr: 本文主张，前沿通用人工智能的治理应超越静态合规模式，转向以"自适应风险管理 + 情景感知规制 + 社会技术转型"为核心的框架：先重构"证据两难"、差异化风险分类与预测失效的学理基础，再剖析公共部门AI采纳所依赖的组织重构、制度动力与数据协作能力，进而提出整合能力监测、风险分层、条件式控制、制度学习与标准互操作性在内的适应性治理体系。其结论是，有效治理依赖于更强的政策能力、更清晰的责任分配，以及能在多元技术未来下保持稳健的治理机制。
AI.motivation: 前沿通用AI的治理已成为公共部门的"制度设计"问题，而非单纯的模型性能技术问题。作者指出当前存在双重困境：一是AI能力进展迅速但不均衡，二是关于危害、防护措施与有效干预的知识仍然残缺且滞后。这使政府必须在高度不确定下决策，需同时面对2030年前多种可能的技术进步轨迹，而采纳结果又受组织惯例、数据安排、问责结构与公共价值等非技术因素影响。既有静态合规式治理范式难以应对这种"证据两难"与可变性，因而需要新的治理理论基础。
AI.method: 文章采用理论重构与规范性设计相结合的方法。文献基础包括《国际AI安全报告2026》、OECD的前瞻与政策文件，以及数字政府（digital government）领域的近期学术研究。分析沿三步展开：第一，重构"证据两难"（evidence dilemma）的概念基础，界定差异化AI风险分类，并论证预测（prediction）的局限；第二，考察公共部门AI采纳如何取决于组织再设计、公共部门制度动力与数据协作能力；第三，在上述基础上提出面向公共机构的适应性治理框架，整合能力监测、风险分层、条件式控制、制度学习与基于标准的互操作性（standards-based interoperability）五个要素。
AI.result: 文章得出以下结论：前沿AI的公共治理应以自适应风险管理、情景感知规制与社会技术转型为支柱，而非静态合规模型。具体贡献包括：（1）揭示"证据残缺+能力跃迁"构成公共决策的基本政策条件，并论证对2030年前多轨迹进展的不确定性进行情景化处理的必要性；（2）区分差异化风险类别，指出治理设计不能以单一风险假设为前提；（3）证明公共部门AI采纳受组织制度动力的决定性影响，需配套组织再设计与数据协作能力建设；（4）提出包含能力监测、风险分层、条件式控制（随风险与证据变化触发）、制度学习与标准互操作性的五要素适应性治理框架。
AI.conclusion: 有效的AI治理需要三项条件：更强的政策能力（policy capacity）、更清晰的责任分配（allocation of responsibility），以及能够在彼此分歧的技术未来（divergent technological futures）之间保持稳健的治理机制。整体判断是，治理范式必须从"规则合规"转向"适应性学习与情景应对"，并将AI视为社会—技术系统而非纯技术对象进行制度设计。

title: Temporally Phenotyping GLP-1RA Case Reports with Large Language Models: A Textual Time Series Corpus and Risk Modeling
summary: Type 2 diabetes case reports describe complex clinical courses, but their timelines are often expressed in language that is difficult to reuse in longitudinal modeling. To address this gap, we developed a textual time-series corpus of 136 PubMed Open Access single-patient case reports involving glucagon-like peptide 1 receptor agonists, with clinical events associated with their most probable reference times. We evaluated automated LLM timeline extraction against gold-standard timelines annotated by clinical domain experts, assessing how well systems recovered clinical events and their timings. The best-performing LLM produced high event coverage (GPT5; 0.871) and reliable temporal sequencing across symptoms (GPT5; 0.843), diagnoses, treatments, laboratory tests, and outcomes. As a downstream demonstration, time-to-event analyses in diabetes suggested lower risk of respiratory sequelae among GLP-1 users versus non-users (HR=0.259, p<0.05), consistent with prior reports of improved respiratory outcomes. Temporal annotations and code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本研究构建了一个包含136篇GLP-1受体激动剂相关病例报告的文本时间序列语料库，并评估了LLM自动时间线提取性能。GPT5表现最佳，事件覆盖率达0.871，时间排序准确率达0.843。下游分析显示GLP-1使用者呼吸后遗症风险较低（HR=0.259, p<0.05）。
AI.motivation: Type 2 diabetes case reports describe complex clinical courses, but their timelines are often expressed in language that is difficult to reuse in longitudinal modeling.
AI.method: Developed a textual time-series corpus of 136 PubMed Open Access single-patient case reports involving GLP-1 receptor agonists, with clinical events associated with their most probable reference times. Evaluated automated LLM timeline extraction against gold-standard timelines annotated by clinical domain experts.
AI.result: The best-performing LLM (GPT5) achieved high event coverage (0.871) and reliable temporal sequencing across symptoms, diagnoses, treatments, laboratory tests, and outcomes (0.843). Time-to-event analysis in diabetes suggested lower risk of respiratory sequelae among GLP-1 users versus non-users (HR=0.259, p<0.05), consistent with prior reports.
AI.conclusion: LLM-based timeline extraction demonstrates strong performance for clinical event recovery and temporal sequencing. Downstream time-to-event analysis validates the approach, showing significantly lower respiratory sequelae risk in GLP-1 users (HR=0.259, p<0.05). Temporal annotations and code will be released upon acceptance.

title: SELFDOUBT: Uncertainty Quantification for Reasoning LLMs via the Hedge-to-Verify Ratio
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables, plus appendix. Submitted to COLM 2026
summary: Uncertainty estimation for reasoning language models remains difficult to deploy in practice: sampling-based methods are computationally expensive, while common single-pass proxies such as verbalized confidence or trace length are often inconsistent across models. This problem is compounded for proprietary reasoning APIs that expose neither logits nor intermediate token probabilities, leaving practitioners with no reliable uncertainty signal at inference time.
