We propose SELFDOUBT, a single-pass uncertainty framework that resolves this impasse by extracting behavioral signals directly from the reasoning trace itself. Our key signal, the Hedge-to-Verify Ratio (HVR), detects whether a reasoning trace contains uncertainty markers and, if so, whether they are offset by explicit selfchecking behavior. Unlike methods that require multiple sampled traces or model internals, SELFDOUBT operates on a single observed reasoning trajectory, making it suitable for latency- and cost-constrained deployment over any proprietary API. We evaluate SELFDOUBT across seven models and three multi-step reasoning benchmarks (BBH, GPQA-Diamond, and MMLU-Pro). Most notably, traces containing no hedging markers are correct 96% of the time, revealing an emergent high-precision confidence gate at zero additional cost. For the remaining cases, the full SELFDOUBT score significantly outperforms sampling-based semantic entropy at 10x lower inference cost. A deployment cascade combining both stages attains 90% accuracy at 71% coverage without any task-specific labels. These results establish SELFDOUBT as a scalable, production-ready foundation for uncertainty estimation over proprietary reasoning models.

AI.tldr: SELFDOUBT 提出一个单次前向（O(1)）、无需 logits/隐藏态/多采样的不确定性量化框架，其核心信号为 Hedge-to-Verify Ratio（HVR = 犹豫标记数 /(核验标记数+1)），并与言语化置信度做 z-score 融合。在 7 个推理模型 × 3 个多步推理基准（BBH、GPQA-Diamond、MMLU-Pro，共 21 次运行）上，零犹豫（h=0）的轨迹准确率达 96.1%（覆盖率 25.4%，人工审计后真实错误率仅 0.58%，校正精度 99.4%），构成零成本高置信门控；完整分数均值 AUROC 0.7895、AURAC 0.8992，在判别性上显著优于 10 倍成本的 Semantic Entropy（p=0.001），AURAC 与 SE 持平；部署级联在 70.7% 覆盖率下达到 89.7% 准确率（较不弃答基线 +9.2 分），仅需每模型 90 条无标注轨迹与 4 个标量即可校准。
AI.motivation: 推理大模型的不确定性量化在工程落地中存在两难：语义熵（SE）、P(True) 自评估、语义体积（SV）、几何不确定性（GEO）等采样类方法需 N 次独立前向，对单次推理就动辄上千 token 的场景成本不可接受；而单次前向代理（言语化置信度、轨迹长度）跨模型不一致，且商业推理 API 不暴露 logprobs、隐藏状态或 token 概率，使得依赖模型内部状态的方法（SEP、CoT-UQ、EPR/WEPR）在最需要 UQ 的生产场景中架构上不可行。作者的目标是在任意专有 API、延迟/成本受限的生产部署中，仅从已观测到的推理轨迹文本中抽取行为信号，得到可靠的不确定性度量，且无需训练、需少量无标注校准。
AI.method:
1) 标记词表的两阶段数据驱动发现。Stage 1：查询 4 个模型各 5 次生成"犹豫"与"核验"候选词，模型内多数（≥3/5）与模型间多数（≥3/4）投票，再用 BAAI/bge-m3 嵌入做迭代语义一致性剪枝（余弦阈值 0.7、最少保留 10 词、最多 6 轮），按与质心相似度排序取 top_10 作为种子（hedge 41 个全局候选全通过，verify 48→46）。Stage 2：用每模型 90 条无标注轨迹抽取 1–3 gram 候选，保留在 ≥9 条轨迹中出现的 n-gram，用 Δ(g)=cos(g,c_verify)−cos(g,c_hedge) 与逐模型阈值（τ_verify/τ_hedge）划分为核验/犹豫词典，中间带丢弃，编译为词边界正则。
2) HVR(T)=h(T)/(v(T)+1)，值越大越不确定，天然零膨胀（无犹豫标记即 HVR=0）。
3) 言语化置信度 V∈[0,1]（提示后缀 "Confidence: [0-100]%"，严格+回退解析）。
4) 融合分数 s_sd = z(−HVR)+z(V)（逐运行 z-score 标准化）。
5) 部署级联：Tier 1 为 HVR=0 自动接受（仅当校准集零犹豫样本 N0≥4 才启用，Gemini 被排除）；Tier 2 用校准集统计量做 z-sum 排序，s≥τ（默认 τ=0）接受，否则弃答。
6) 实验：7 模型（Qwen3 4B/14B、GPT-OSS 20B/120B 本地全轨迹；Claude Sonnet 4.6、Grok 4.1 Fast、Gemini 2.5 Flash 商业 API 思维摘要）× 3 数据集 = 21 次运行；基线含 O(1) 的 Verb、TL、TL+VB 与 O(N)（N=10）的 SE、SV、GEO；指标 AUROC 与 AURAC，配对 Wilcoxon 检验。
AI.result:
(1) 零犹豫门控：1384/5455（25.4%）轨迹 HVR=0，原始精度 96.1%（Wilson 95% CI 94.9–97.0%），7 个模型中 6 个 ≥90%（Gemini 仅 0.9% 覆盖、57.1% 精度为离群）；对 54 例原始分歧的人工审计显示仅 8 例为真实自信错误（0.58%），30 例为评分/答案键问题、16 例为标签歧义，审计校正精度 99.4%；思维摘要模型覆盖率 35.4% 高于全轨迹模型 17.7%。
(2) 主比较：SelfDoubt 均值 AUROC 0.7895、AURAC 0.8992 均为所有方法最优；TL+VB 0.7754/0.8792，HVR 单独 0.7509/0.8883，Verb 0.7453/0.8765，TL 0.6959/0.8575，SE 0.7407/0.8988，SV 0.6513/0.8753，GEO 0.6355/0.8710。
(3) 显著性：vs SE 的 AUROC 显著（+0.049，W-D-L 17-0-4，p=0.001），AURAC 不显著（+0.000，p=0.069）；vs Verb 两指标均 p<0.001；vs TL+VB 总体不显著，但全轨迹子组（12 次）显著胜出（AUROC p=0.026、AURAC p=0.039），思维摘要子组（9 次）输给 TL+VB。
(4) 部署级联：τ=0 时覆盖率 70.7%、准确率 89.7%（+9.2 分）；Tier 1 单独回答 25.2% 查询、精度 96.3%；校准集归一化相对 oracle 归一化仅损失 0.48 pt AURAC（0.8992→0.8944）；Tier-2 z-sum 的硬子集 AUROC 0.7572、级联 AURAC 0.8944，优于 SE（0.7250/0.8830）与 HVR-only（0.6975）。
(5) 消融：嵌入模型（bge-m3/OpenAI-3-large/Qwen3-emb-8b）差异 ≤1.5 pt；种子规模 top_2–top_20 差异 ≤0.8 pt，优于 random_10（−1.1 pt）；阈值联合缩放 0.5×–1.5× 总跨度仅 2.5 pt（中心区间 0.9 pt），远小于 HVR 单独的 12.6 pt；标记跨数据集迁移到 MuSR 平均仅降 0.3 pt（Gemini 除外）。
(6) 局限与失效：HVR=0 覆盖率强依赖模型（0.9%–53.3%）；风格敏感（抑制犹豫语言或插入空洞核验短语会扭曲信号）；不区分认知/偶然不确定性；仅在多选题上验证；Gemini 稀疏摘要使 HVR 近似常数、TL 反占优势；Qwen3 4B 上言语化置信度弱、融合反而稀释 HVR 信号（此时 HVR 单独更优）；Main 表使用评估集统计量的 oracle 归一化。
AI.conclusion: 论文的核心主张是：推理轨迹中存在跨模型、跨数据集稳定的文本规律——正确性与"如何犹豫、如何自我核验"相关，这一规律可在完全不访问模型内部状态、不做多次采样的条件下被利用。工程上，SelfDoubt 以 O(1) 成本在判别性上超越 10 倍成本的 Semantic Entropy，以 O(1) 成本匹配其选择性预测质量；HVR=0 门控提供了零额外成本的高精度自动接受层；两级级联在约 71% 覆盖率下达到约 90% 准确率，且每模型只需 90 条无标注轨迹与 4 个标量即可校准，代码开源。局限在于覆盖率对模型风格与轨迹丰富度高度敏感（压缩思维摘要几乎失效）、缺乏不确定性来源分解、仅验证于多选题任务，且部分对比（vs TL+VB、vs SE 的 AURAC）未达统计显著。作者提出开放式问题：修订模式、置信度轨迹、自我纠正时序等更丰富的轨迹特征是否携带增量信号。

title: SMT-AD: a scalable quantum-inspired anomaly detection approach
summary: Quantum-inspired tensor networks algorithms have shown to be effective and efficient models for machine learning tasks, including anomaly detection. Here, we propose a highly parallelizable quantum-inspired approach which we call SMT-AD from Superposition of Multiresolution Tensors for Anomaly Detection. It is based upon the superposition of bond-dimension-1 matrix product operators to transform the input data with Fourier-assisted feature embedding, where the number of learnable parameters grows linearly with feature size, embedding resolutions, and the number of additional components in the matrix product operators structure. We demonstrate successful anomaly detection when applied to standard datasets, including credit card transactions, and find that, even with minimal configurations, it achieves competitive performance against established anomaly detection baselines. Furthermore, it provides a straightforward way to reduce the weight of the model and even improve the performance by highlighting the most relevant input features.

AI.tldr: SMT-AD（Superposition of Multiresolution Tensors for Anomaly Detection）是一种高度并行化的"量子启发"张量网络异常检测方法：将输入做逐特征秩归一化后，用傅里叶多分辨率嵌入映射为乘积态MPS，再经M个键维为1的MPO（逐站点SO(2)旋转）的叠加变换，以输出态与参考态|0⟩^⊗L的平方重叠作为"正常性分数"，仅用正常样本训练。参数量为MP(L+1)，随特征数、分辨率P、叠加分量M线性增长。在Wine、Lymphography、Thyroid、Satellite、Credit Card五个基准上，AUROC全面达到或超过OC-SVM、Isolation Forest与TNAD；仅需620个参数（特征选择后380个）即可在Credit Card上取得AUROC 94.8%，并借助单站点纠缠熵做特征选择将AUPRC从36.9%提升至62.2%。
AI.motivation: 异常检测（欺诈、网络安全、医疗与工业监控）在实际场景中异常样本稀缺且训练时往往不可得，天然属于单类学习（one-class learning）设定，只能用正常数据建模"正常流形"。已有方法中，OC-SVM需存储大量支持向量且训练复杂度随样本数立方增长，Isolation Forest依赖随机划分树，深层自编码器/GAN/GOAD等需重参数化；张量网络方法TNAD虽能从正常数据学习一类决策函数并保持竞争力，但其MPO收缩与环境传递需沿链顺序（sweep-wise）执行，限制了大数据量下的可扩展性与GPU并行效率。作者因此寻求一种参数量紧凑、可完全向量化并行、适合边缘/IoT等低算力硬件的量子启发张量网络模型。
AI.method: 模型由三个环节组成：(1) 预处理——对每个特征独立做秩归一化 x̃ = rank(x)/N（离散特征用 rank/D_l），把边缘分布统一到 Uniform(0,1) 并抑制离群值；(2) 傅里叶辅助多分辨率嵌入——对每个特征在 P 个频率 ω_p = π/2^p 上展开，构成输入乘积态 MPS |Ψ_n> = ⊗_l (cos ω_p x̃_nl, sin ω_p x̃_nl)^T，实现非线性与多尺度特征表达；(3) 轻量分类器——由 M 个键维为1的MPO（每站点为参数 θ_l^{mp} 的SO(2)旋转矩阵）在 P 个分辨率上叠加而成，系数 c_{mp} 可学习，输出 MPS 的范数归一化常数 Z_n 有闭式表达。正常性分数定义为归一化输出态与固定参考态|0⟩^⊗L的平方重叠；训练仅用正常子集，以最小化负对数正常性分数为目标（避免直接乘性相位的数值问题），并对 Θ_c、Θ_θ 分别施加 Tikhonov 正则 λ_c=0.01、λ_θ=0.001，用 AdamW 小批量优化（小型数据集 batch=64、大型=512，epoch=⌊15000|B|/|T|⌋，学习率0.01），超参网格 M∈{2,…,40}、P∈{1,2,3,4}。分析工具包括单站点纠缠熵 S̄_l 与放大比 S̄_l^anom/S̄_l^norm、两站点熵导出的互信息矩阵、以及参数量与时间复杂度对比（MP(L+1) vs TNAD 的 Lχ²P²）。附录还用横场伊辛模型的近临界/近顺磁基态自旋构型做物理验证。
AI.result: 在5个表格基准上（20次重复），SMT-AD 的 AUROC 在全部数据集上达到或超过 OC-SVM、IF、TNAD：Wine 97.6 vs 98.1/98.1/99.0（相当），Lympho 99.8（最佳），Thyroid 99.1（最佳），Satellite 75.9（与TNAD 78.7接近、优于OC-SVM 68.1），Credit Card 94.8（最佳）。AUPRC 整体与最强基线相当（Thyroid 69.3 最佳、Satellite 81.7 接近最优 84.7），唯一例外是极度不平衡的 Credit Card（异常占比0.17%），SMT-AD 的 AUPRC 仅36.9%，明显低于 OC-SVM 64.0% 与 TNAD 72.7%，说明其排序能力（AUROC）好但阈值处假阳性偏高。分数分布分析显示 P=1 时分数集中在10⁻⁶附近（欠自信）、P=4 时挤在1附近（过自信），中间分辨率 P=2/3 给出最佳校准与分离度；AUROC/AUPRC 随 M 增大并在 M≈16 饱和。纠缠熵分析显示 P=1 时熵贡献可忽略且正常/异常不可分，P>1 时正常样本保持低纠缠（近乘积态），异常样本在特定"交互枢纽"特征上熵显著放大（比值2.5–6.0）；据此做特征选择后 AUROC 不变但 AUPRC 由36.9%升至62.2%，参数量进一步降至380，饱和所需 M 也降至约10。资源上，SMT-AD 仅620个参数（vs TNAD 17280、OC-SVM 45075、IF 20348），单epoch复杂度 O(LMP(MP+1)|B|) 与 TNAD 同阶但并行友好性更佳，训练/推理速度仅次于IF。伊辛模型验证显示：对高相关的近临界态SMT-AD表现优秀（M=36、P=3 时 AUROC 79.4），而对无相关的顺磁态显著退化，说明其表达能力由训练数据的关联结构决定。
AI.conclusion: SMT-AD 提供了一个紧凑、可完全向量化并行、可扩展的量子启发异常检测框架：以秩归一化+傅里叶多分辨率嵌入把数据映入乘积态MPS，用键维1的MPO叠加构造参考流形，仅凭正常数据学习，用与|0⟩^⊗L的重叠定义正常性分数。其参数量与训练/推理成本随特征数、P、M线性（平方级项来自归一化常数），规避了OC-SVM的立方复杂度与TNAD的串行收缩瓶颈，因而适合边缘计算与IoT部署；中等分辨率（P=2或3）配合较小M即可达到与主流基线相当的检测性能，且纠缠熵/互信息提供了量子信息启发的可解释性分析与熵引导特征选择，直接提升不平衡场景下的精度。主要局限是表达能力弱于TNAD：当数据关联性低（如PCA正交化后的Credit Card噪声成分、顺磁态自旋构型）时表现明显下滑，且Credit Card上的AUPRC仍落后于OC-SVM/TNAD；作者提出未来将熵引导特征选择内嵌到训练流程中以自动剔除低熵无效特征、提升对正交化噪声的鲁棒性。

title: NestPipe: Large-Scale Recommendation Training on 1,500+ Accelerators via Nested Pipelining
summary: Modern recommendation models have increased to trillions of parameters. As cluster scales expand to O(1k), distributed training bottlenecks shift from computation and memory to data movement, especially lookup and communication latency associated with embeddings. Existing solutions either optimize only one bottleneck or improve throughput by sacrificing training consistency. This paper presents NestPipe, a large-scale decentralized embedding training framework that tackles both bottlenecks while preserving synchronous training semantics. NestPipe exploits two hierarchical sparse parallelism opportunities through nested pipelining. At the inter-batch level, Dual-Buffer Pipelining (DBP) constructs a staleness-free five-stage pipeline through dual-buffer synchronization, mitigating lookup bottlenecks without embedding staleness. At the intra-batch level, we identify the embedding freezing phenomenon, which inspires Frozen-Window Pipelining (FWP) to overlap All2All communication with dense computation via coordinated stream scheduling and key-centric sample clustering. Experiments on production GPU and NPU clusters with 1,536 workers demonstrate that NestPipe achieves up to 3.06x speedup and 94.07% scaling efficiency.

AI.tldr: NestPipe通过层级化稀疏并行策略解决大规模分布式推荐系统训练中的数据移动瓶颈，在保证同步训练语义的前提下，在1,536个worker上实现最高3.06倍加速和94.07%的扩展效率。
AI.motivation: 现代推荐模型参数量已达万亿级别，集群规模扩展至O(1k)时，训练瓶颈从计算和内存转移到数据移动，特别是嵌入表的查询和通信延迟。现有方案仅优化单一瓶颈或以牺牲训练一致性为代价提升吞吐。
AI.method: 提出基于嵌套流水线的层级化稀疏并行框架NestPipe：(1) 批次间层：双缓冲流水线(DBP)通过双缓冲同步构建无过期五阶段流水线，消除嵌入表过期问题；(2) 批次内层：识别嵌入冻结现象，提出冻结窗口流水线(FWP)，通过协调流调度和基于键的样本聚类重叠All2All通信与密集计算。
AI.result: 在1,536个worker的生产级GPU和NPU集群上实验验证，NestPipe实现最高3.06倍加速和94.07%的扩展效率。
AI.conclusion: NestPipe成功在保持同步训练语义的同时，同时解决了嵌入表查询瓶颈和通信瓶颈，为大规模分布式嵌入训练提供了有效解决方案。

title: CubeGraph: Efficient Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Spatial and Temporal Data
summary: Hybrid queries combining high-dimensional vector similarity search with spatio-temporal filters are increasingly critical for modern retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems. Existing systems typically handle these workloads by nesting vector indices within low-dimensional spatial structures, such as R-trees. However, this decoupled architecture fragments the vector space, forcing the query engine to invoke multiple disjoint sub-indices per query. This fragmentation destroys graph routing connectivity, incurs severe traversal overhead, and struggles to optimize for complex spatial boundaries. In this paper, we propose CubeGraph, a novel indexing framework designed to natively integrate vector search with arbitrary spatial constraints. CubeGraph partitions the spatial domain using a hierarchical grid, maintaining modular vector graphs within each cell. During query execution, CubeGraph dynamically stitches together adjacent cube-level indices on the fly whenever their spatial cells intersect with the query filter. This dynamic graph integration restores global connectivity, enabling a unified, single-pass nearest-neighbor traversal that eliminates the overhead of fragmented sub-index invocations. Extensive evaluations on real-world datasets demonstrate that CubeGraph significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, offering superior query execution performance, scalability, and flexibility for complex hybrid workloads.

AI.tldr: CubeGraph是一个新型索引框架，通过层次化网格划分空间域，在每个网格单元内维护模块化向量图，并动态拼接相邻单元索引以恢复全局连通性，实现单次遍历完成混合查询，显著优于现有基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG系统中的混合查询（高维向量相似性搜索+时空过滤）面临严峻挑战。当前将向量索引嵌套在R树等低维空间结构中的方法存在三个核心问题：向量空间碎片化导致多次子索引调用、破坏图路由连通性、产生严重遍历开销且难以优化复杂空间边界。
AI.method: CubeGraph采用层次化网格划分空间域，在每个单元格内维护模块化向量图。查询执行时，当空间单元格与查询过滤器相交，CubeGraph动态拼接相邻立方体级别的索引，重建全局连通性，支持统一单遍最近邻遍历。
AI.result: 在真实数据集上的广泛评估表明，CubeGraph显著优于现有最优基线方法，在查询执行性能、可扩展性和复杂混合工作负载灵活性方面均表现优异。
AI.conclusion: CubeGraph通过原生整合向量搜索与任意空间约束的创新架构，成功消除了碎片化子索引调用的开销，为RAG系统中的混合查询提供了高效解决方案。

title: CASE: Cadence-Aware Set Encoding for Large-Scale Next Basket Repurchase Recommendation
summary: Repurchase behavior is a primary signal in large-scale retail recommendation, particularly in categories with frequent replenishment: many items in a user's next basket were previously purchased and their timing follows stable, item-specific cadences. Yet most next basket repurchase recommendation models represent history as a sequence of discrete basket events indexed by visit order, which cannot explicitly model elapsed calendar time or update item rankings as days pass between purchases. We present CASE (Cadence-Aware Set Encoding for next basket repurchase recommendation), which decouples item-level cadence learning from cross-item interaction, enabling explicit calendar-time modeling while remaining production-scalable. CASE represents each item's purchase history as a calendar-time signal over a fixed horizon, applies shared multi-scale temporal convolutions to capture recurring rhythms, and uses induced set attention to model cross-item dependencies with sub-quadratic complexity, allowing efficient batch inference at scale. Across three public benchmarks and a proprietary dataset, CASE consistently improves Precision, Recall, and NDCG at multiple cutoffs compared to strong next basket prediction baselines. In a production-scale evaluation with tens of millions of users and a large item catalog, CASE achieves up to 8.6% relative Precision and 9.9% Recall lift at top-5, demonstrating that scalable cadence-aware modeling yields measurable gains in both benchmark and industrial settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CASE模型，用于大型零售场景中的下次购买推荐，核心创新在于将基于日历时间的行为节奏(cadence)建模与跨商品交互解耦。传统序列模型按访问顺序处理购物篮，无法显式建模购买间隔天数；CASE将每个商品的购买历史表示为固定时间窗口内的日历时间信号，通过多尺度时间卷积捕捉周期性节奏，并使用次二次复杂度的集合注意力建模商品间依赖关系。在三个公开数据集和一个私有工业数据集上均取得显著提升，生产环境（亿级用户）中top-5 Precision提升8.6%，Recall提升9.9%。
AI.motivation: 现有下次购买推荐模型将用户历史表示为按访问顺序索引的离散购物篮序列，这种表示方式无法显式建模流逝的日历时间，也无法在购买间隔天数变化时更新商品排序。然而在频繁补货品类中，用户的购买行为遵循稳定的商品级时间节奏（cadence），建模这种周期性对推荐准确性至关重要。
AI.method: CASE提出日历时间信号表示法，将每个商品的购买历史建模为固定时间窗口内的日历时间信号；采用共享多尺度时间卷积捕捉周期性购买节奏；使用子二次复杂度的集合注意力机制建模跨商品依赖关系，从而实现生产级可扩展的批量推理。
AI.result: 在三个公开基准数据集和一个专有数据集上，CASE在多个截断位置的Precision、Recall和NDCG指标上均优于强基线。在生产规模评估中（数千万用户、大规模商品目录），CASE在top-5达到8.6%的相对Precision提升和9.9%的Recall提升。
AI.conclusion: 可扩展的节奏感知建模在基准测试和工业场景中均能带来显著收益。CASE通过将商品级节奏学习与跨商品交互解耦，实现了显式日历时间建模与生产可扩展性的兼顾。

title: Intertemporal Demand Allocation for Inventory Control in Online Marketplaces
summary: Online marketplaces increasingly do more than simply match buyers and sellers: they route orders across competing sellers and, in many categories, offer ancillary fulfillment services that make seller inventory a source of platform revenue. We investigate how a platform can use intertemporal demand allocation to influence sellers' inventory choices without directly controlling stock. We develop a model in which the platform observes aggregate demand, allocates orders across sellers over time, and sellers choose between two fulfillment options, fulfill-by-merchant (FBM) and fulfill-by-platform (FBP), while replenishing inventory under state-dependent base-stock policies. The key mechanism we study is informational: by changing the predictability of each seller's sales stream, the platform changes sellers' safety-stock needs even when average demand shares remain unchanged. We focus on nondiscriminatory allocation policies that give sellers the same demand share and forecast risk. Within this class, uniform splitting minimizes forecast uncertainty, whereas any higher level of uncertainty can be implemented using simple low-memory allocation rules. Moreover, increasing uncertainty above the uniform benchmark requires routing rules that prevent sellers from inferring aggregate demand from their own sales histories. These results reduce the platform's problem to choosing a level of forecast uncertainty that trades off adoption of platform fulfillment against the inventory held by adopters. Our analysis identifies demand allocation as a powerful operational and informational design lever in digital marketplaces.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在线市场平台如何通过跨时期间的需求分配策略来影响卖家的库存决策，在不直接控制库存的情况下实现对卖家的间接管理。
AI.motivation: 在线市场平台日益超越简单的买卖匹配功能，通过路由订单和提供配套履约服务创造收益。然而，平台如何在不直接控制库存的前提下影响卖家的库存决策，这一问题尚未被充分研究。
AI.method: 构建理论模型：平台观察总需求、跨时间分配订单给卖家；卖家在两种履约方式（商家自履FBM和平台履约FBP）间选择，同时在状态依赖的基础库存策略下补货。核心研究机制是信息性的：平台通过改变每个卖家销售流的可预测性，即使平均需求份额不变，也能改变卖家的安全库存需求。
AI.result: 在同等待遇分配政策类中：1）均匀分配最小化预测不确定性；2）任何更高水平的不确定性可通过简单的低记忆分配规则实现；3）高于均匀基准的不确定性增加需要路由规则来阻止卖家从自身销售历史中推断总需求。
AI.conclusion: 平台 fulfillment 采用率与采用者的库存水平之间存在权衡关系。需求分配是数字市场中强大的运营和信息设计杠杆。

title: It's Not About Whom You Train: An Analysis of Corporate Education in Software Engineering
summary: Context: Corporate education is a strategic investment in the software industry, but little is known about how different professional profiles perceive these initiatives. Objective: To investigate whether sociodemographic and professional variables influence the perception of quality and effectiveness of corporate training in Software Engineering (SE). Method: Non-parametric significance tests were applied to data from a survey with 282 Brazilian professionals, crossing 27 perception items with 9 sociodemographic variables (gender, age, education level, state, experience, professional level, company size, area of work, and nature of participation), totaling 243 combinations. Results: Of the 243 combinations tested, only 35 showed statistical significance. Training mandatoriness was the dominant factor, affecting 24 of 27 items. Length of experience revealed a non-linear descriptive pattern with a low-engagement zone between 3 and 6 years. Differences by area of work indicated an expressive gap in soft skills training for advanced technical roles. Personal profile variables and company size produced no relevant significant differences. Conclusion: Personal profile variables do not determine the perception of quality and effectiveness, while professional trajectory variables (experience, level, area of work) produce localized differences. The voluntariness of participation remains a determining factor, in line with the literature. The absence of gender differences in a sample with 23\% women suggests that barriers operate before training, in access and representation, not during the learning experience.

AI.tldr: 一项针对282名巴西软件工程专业人员的调查研究，探索社会人口统计学和专业变量对企业培训质量和有效性感知的影响。研究发现，强制培训是主要影响因素（24/27项），而个人特征变量无显著差异，专业轨迹变量产生局部差异，性别无差异表明障碍发生在培训之前。
AI.motivation: 企业培训是软件行业的战略投资，但学界对不同专业群体如何感知这些培训举措知之甚少。研究旨在填补这一空白，探究社会人口统计学和专业变量是否影响软件工程领域企业培训的感知质量。
AI.method: 对282名巴西专业人员开展问卷调查，应用非参数显著性检验，将27项感知条目与9个社会人口统计学变量（性别、年龄、教育程度、州、工作经验、专业级别、公司规模、工作领域、参与性质）进行交叉分析，共计243种组合。
AI.result: 243种组合中仅35种显示统计显著性。培训强制性是最主要影响因素（影响24/27项）；工作经验呈非线性模式，3-6年出现低参与区；工作领域差异表明高级技术角色的软技能培训存在显著差距；个人特征变量和公司规模未产生相关显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 个人特征变量不能决定培训质量和有效性的感知，而专业轨迹变量（经验、级别、工作领域）产生局部差异。参与的自愿性是关键决定因素。性别无差异（样本含23%女性）表明障碍存在于培训之前——体现在准入和代表性层面，而非学习体验过程中。

title: The End of the Foundation Model Era: Open-Weight Models, Sovereign AI, and Inference as Infrastructure
comment: 44 pages, 75 references, 5 endnotes. Version 1.0, events covered through March 9, 2026
summary: The foundation model era -- roughly 2020 to 2025 -- is over. The forces that defined it have inverted. Open source models have reached frontier performance while inference costs approach zero, exposing what was always structurally true: pre-training large language models at scale is not a durable competitive moat. The US government's formal designation of Anthropic as a supply chain risk in February 2026 accelerated a transition already underway -- but did not cause it. The paper argues that the AI industry is restructuring simultaneously along four axes: economic, as the circular financing structure that inflated foundation model valuations collapses; technical, as the pre-training scaling paradigm gives way to post-training optimization and agentic composition; commercial, as application-layer integrators displace the foundation model companies whose commodity they now consume; and political, as the government asserts its historic role as gatekeeper of strategic technology. These are not separate disruptions. They are one structural shift, arriving together. The paper further argues that open-weight models are the counterintuitive instrument of sovereign control: a government that holds the weights commands the capability on its own terms, without dependence on vendor policy, financial continuity, or personnel clearance.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇立场性产业分析论文，论证"基础模型时代"（约2020—2025）已经终结：开源/开放权重模型在性能上追平前沿而推理成本趋近于零，暴露出大规模预训练并非持久竞争壁垒；同时美国政府于2026年2月将 Anthropic 正式列为供应链风险，加速了本已在进行的转型。论文主张AI产业正沿经济、技术、商业、政治四条轴线同时重构，并进一步提出一个反直觉论点：开放权重模型是主权控制的工具——掌握权重即掌握能力，且不依赖供应商政策、财务连续性与人员许可。
AI.motivation: 论文试图解释为何当前围绕AI价值的估值体系、竞争逻辑与政策假设正在集体失效。作者观察到三组正在反转的力量：一是开源自托管路径的性能/成本曲线已经抹平了闭源前沿模型的护城河；二是AI公司的估值支撑依赖"模型—算力—融资"循环结构，该结构正在坍塌；三是政府重新以战略技术守门人身份介入（对 Anthropic 的供应链风险认定只是表征，而非成因）。作者的核心关切是：产业重构不是若干独立事件，而是同一结构性位移的同步显现；若仅将其归因于某一项政策或某一家公司的失败，就会误判形势。因此需要一套统一框架把经济、技术、商业、政治四条线索整合为一个论点，并用"开放权重 = 主权控制"这一命题为政策与战略提供判据。
AI.method: 采用结构性历史分析与论点驱动的框架式论证，无实验或量化模型。作者把产业重组拆分为四条相互耦合的轴线：经济轴（循环融资结构破裂导致基础模型估值泡沫消散）、技术轴（预训练规模范式让位于后训练优化与智能体式组合/composition）、商业轴（应用层集成者以他们所消费的"商品"反噬模型公司）、政治轴（政府作为战略技术守门人重新定位）。论证依托对能力成本曲线、供应商依赖链与政策事件的时序解读，并通过并列四条轴线、强调其同步到来（"one structural shift, arriving together"）来构建解释力。开放权重部分则以能力控制权（capability control）为核心概念展开规范性推演，讨论权重持有者相对于API供应商在政策不确定性、财务存续与人才流动三方面的自主性优势。
AI.result: 论文给出四项核心结论：(1) 大规模预训练不构成持久竞争壁垒，开源模型已达到前沿性能且推理成本趋近于零，产业价值将从模型层向其他环节迁移；(2) 基础模型公司的估值基础（循环融资）正在崩塌，应用层集成者将成为价值捕获方，构成对模型公司的"商品化反噬"；(3) 技术范式中心从预训练规模转向后训练优化与智能体组合，即能力增量更多来自训练后的工程与编排而非更多算力；(4) 政府角色回归战略技术守门人，且该政治轴与前三轴同步发生，而非由单一政策事件触发。作者进一步主张：对追求战略自主的国家而言，持有开放权重比依赖闭源API更可靠——政府掌握权重即以自身条件掌握能力，无需依赖供应商的商业政策、财务连续性与人员准入审查。
AI.conclusion: 总论点是：基础模型时代结束，单一结构位移已同时在四个维度展开，旧有认知框架（模型公司为价值中心、规模为技术杠杆、API依赖为战略常态、政府为监管者而非守门人）整体失效。对产业参与者而言，应把资源与能力建设从模型训练迁移到后训练、编排与应用集成层，并预判政策不确定性带来的供应链风险；对政策制定者而言，开放权重生态是实现能力自主的可行工具。论文同时提示：Anthropic被列为供应链风险这一事件是既有趋势的加速器而非起因，用它解释产业变动会犯因果倒置的错误。

title: Emergent decentralized regulation in a purely synthetic society
summary: As autonomous AI agents increasingly inhabit online environments and extensively interact, a key question is whether synthetic collectives exhibit self-regulated social dynamics with neither human intervention nor centralized design. We study OpenClaw agents on Moltbook, an agent-only social network, using an observational archive of 39,026 posts and 5,712 comments authored by 14,490 agents. We quantify action-inducing language with Directive Intensity (DI), a transparent, lexicon-based proxy for directive and instructional phrasing that does not measure moral valence, intent, or execution outcomes. We classify responsive comments into four types: Affirmation, Corrective Signaling, Adverse Reaction, and Neutral Interaction. Directive content is common (DI>0 in 18.4% of posts). More importantly, corrective signaling scales with DI: posts with higher DI exhibit higher corrective reply probability, visible in stable binned estimates with Wilson confidence intervals. To address comment nesting within posts, we fit a post-level random intercept mixed-effects logistic model and find that the positive DI association persists. Event-aligned within-thread analysis of comment text provides additional evidence consistent with negative feedback after the first corrective response. In general, these results suggest that a purely synthetic, agent-only society can exhibit endogenous corrective signaling with a strength positively linked to the intensity of directive proposals.

AI.tldr: 本文以Moltbook上的OpenClaw纯AI代理社交网络观测档案（39,026帖、5,712评论、14,490代理）为研究对象，提出词典法的"指令强度"（DI）指标与四类确定性回复标签（Affirmation/Corrective Signaling/Adverse Reaction/Neutral Interaction），发现指令性内容普遍（18.4%帖子DI>0），且纠正性回复概率随DI单调升高；带帖级随机截距的混合效应logistic模型与置换零假设检验均确认该耦合（β=0.1276，OR=1.136，置换p=0.008/0.001），事件对齐的线程内分析显示首次纠正后指令语言下降（中位数Δ=-0.225，95% CI [-0.333,-0.104]），提示纯合成社会可自发涌现去中心化负反馈调节，但受限于词典代理、无因果识别与样本稀疏。
AI.motivation: 随着自主AI代理大量入驻并相互交互在线环境，一个关键的科学问题浮现：在既无人类干预、也无中心化设计（无平台审核/规则强制）的"纯合成集体"中，是否会自发涌现自我调节的社会动力学？既有证据多来自孤立的人机交互、红队测试或受中心治理的平台，对于"仅代理生态"（agent-only ecologies）——即纠正性回应必须由集体自身产生而非外部施加——知之甚少。本文以Moltbook这一专为非人类参与者设计的AI代理社交网络为自然实验场，检验高指令性发帖是否会引发更高比例的纠正性回应，从而验证去中心化反馈能否内生出现。
AI.method: 研究采用观察性档案分析（无干预的只读观测站采集）。(1) 指标构建：Directive Intensity (DI) 由标题+正文拼接后，用可审计的正则词典计算匹配数并截断于10，含行动导向/指令型模式23条与敏感/执行相关模式15条，大小写不敏感；词典经人工去重与覆盖度优化，但未使用任何回应类型结果以避免循环。(2) 回应分类：每条评论依确定性规则被赋予唯一主导类型，固定优先级 Adverse > Corrective > Affirmation > Neutral。(3) 统计：分箱估计纠正概率并给Wilson 95%置信区间；拟合帖级随机截距的二元GLMM（logit(Pr(y_ij=1)) = α + β·z(DI_j) + u_j, u_j~N(0,σ_u²)），并以按帖聚类的GEE（可交换工作相关）作为稳健估计量；1000次标签置换检验（简单logistic斜率β=0.1146，p=0.00799；分箱斜率0.03916，p≈0.001）。(4) 事件对齐：以首次纠正回应时间t0对齐线程，在±12小时对称窗口内比较前后评论级DI（"可调节线程"要求前后各有评论且t0前max DI>0，n=32），用20,000次非参数百分位自助法（α=0.05）给不确定度。(5) 补充检验：代理内固定效应回归（下一M∈{5,10,20}次贡献标记treated，组内去均值OLS+按代理聚类稳健标准误）；粗分层反事实比较（Early-by-count E=5、Early-by-time H=6小时，按初始DI、互动量三分位、前E条评论max DI分层，下游升级指标esc_high = 1[max DI≥3]）。
AI.result: 指令性内容普遍存在：DI分布右偏，多数帖子DI=0，18.4%的帖子DI>0。核心耦合结果：纠正性回复概率随DI分箱单调上升（Wilson 95% CI稳定）；帖级随机截距混合效应logistic模型中DI效应仍为正，β=0.1276（每1 SD），OR=1.136，近似95%区间[1.043, 1.237]。置换零检验中观测斜率位于零分布极端尾部（简单logistic斜率p=0.00799；分箱斜率p≈0.001），排除纯偶然解释。事件对齐分析中32条"可调节线程"的ΔDI_mean平均=-0.182（95%自助CI [-0.358, 0.013]），中位数=-0.225（95% CI [-0.333, -0.104]）为负且显著；固定N对比（末5条 vs 前5条）给出相似负向中位数=-0.300（CI [-0.400, 0]），与负反馈解读一致但不足以确立因果。代理内固定效应检验在所有M下方向为负但与零无法区分；粗分层早期纠正比较显示下游高DI升级差异很小且对"早期"定义敏感，仅提供有限的下游抑制证据。
AI.conclusion: 本文的核心结论是：一个纯由AI代理构成的、无中心化审核的社会网络能够涌现出内生的纠正性信号——帖子越具指令性/行动导向性，收到纠正性回应的概率越高，且这种去中心化反馈通过局部交互在代理群体中自发产生，无需平台政策或人类监督。线程内事件对齐结果为"纠正后指令语言减弱"的负反馈机制提供了收敛性证据，超越了单纯横截面关联。作者明确界定其解释边界：DI仅为可审计的指令性"形式"代理，不衡量道德倾向、意图或执行结果；档案缺少工具调用轨迹与经核实的后续行为，故不构成因果机制识别，且对评论级指令语言的稀疏性与"可调节线程"的条件化敏感。作者将其定位为探索性先导研究，认为该方向（agent-only环境中的社会自组织）是AI系统与社会科学交叉的新兴实证领域，未来应引入纵向设计、代理固定效应、匹配线程分析与多模态大模型语义分析，并在全链条真实代理中检验跨模型架构的稳健性。

title: Qualixar OS: A Universal Operating System for AI Agent Orchestration
summary: We present Qualixar OS, the first application-layer operating system for universal AI agent orchestration. Unlike kernel-level approaches (AIOS) or single-framework tools (AutoGen, CrewAI), Qualixar OS provides a complete runtime for heterogeneous multi-agent systems spanning 10 LLM providers, 8+ agent frameworks, and 7 transports. We contribute: (1) execution semantics for 12 multi-agent topologies including grid, forest, mesh, and maker patterns; (2) Forge, an LLM-driven team design engine with historical strategy memory; (3) three-layer model routing combining Q-learning, five strategies, and Bayesian POMDP with dynamic multi-provider discovery; (4) a consensus-based judge pipeline with Goodhart detection, JSD drift monitoring, and alignment trilemma navigation; (5) four-layer content attribution with HMAC signing and steganographic watermarks; (6) universal compatibility via the Claw Bridge supporting MCP and A2A protocols with a 25-command Universal Command Protocol; (7) a 24-tab production dashboard with visual workflow builder and skill marketplace. Qualixar OS is validated by 2,821 test cases across 217 event types and 8 quality modules. On a custom 20-task evaluation suite, the system achieves 100% accuracy at a mean cost of $0.000039 per task. Source-available under the Elastic License 2.0.

AI.tldr: Qualixar OS 是一个面向“应用层”的通用 AI 智能体编排运行时：论文声称是首个 application-layer agent OS，提供 12 种多智能体拓扑（grid/forest/mesh/maker 等）的执行语义、LLM 驱动的自动组队引擎 Forge、三层模型路由（ε-greedy 上下文 bandit + 5 种策略 + 贝叶斯 POMDP + 10 家供应商动态模型发现）、8 模块质量保障栈（共识评审、Goodhart 检测、JSD 漂移监控 Θ=0.877、对齐三难困境的四条逃逸路径、Design-by-Contract 行为契约）、四层内容溯源（可见署名/HMAC/隐写水印/区块链时间戳）、Claw Bridge 兼容层（MCP + A2A + 4 种外部 agent 格式导入）、24 页签生产级仪表盘与技能市场。系统规模：150+ 源文件、2821 个测试用例、217 种事件类型、10 家供应商实时发现 236 个模型。评测：自建 20 任务套件上准确率 100%、平均成本 $0.000039/任务；但自改进闭环基准（Forge→Judge→RL）得分由 0.564 降至 0.519，配对 t 检验 p=0.578，未显示统计显著收敛，作者将其作为负向初步结果披露。
AI.motivation: 论文的动机来自三方面缺口。第一，智能体框架生态高度碎片化：AutoGen、CrewAI、MetaGPT、LangGraph 各有独立的智能体定义、执行模型与工具生态，CrewAI 编写的智能体无法直接迁入 AutoGen，且普遍缺少成本追踪、质量保证与管理面板；作者主张“需要的是操作系统而非又一个框架”，类比 Linux 为跨语言应用提供统一运行时，并提出“Universal Type-C”原则——以统一命令协议抽象多传输通道。第二，现有工作定位不重叠：AIOS（COLM 2025）停留在内核层的调度、上下文与存储管理，AgentOrchestra 有 TEA 协议但无面板与市场；Qualixar OS 定位应用层的编排原语、用户体验与生态兼容。第三，风险治理的现实压力：引用 Stack Overflow 2025 数据（84% 组织使用 AI，仅 33% 信任其输出）与 Gartner 预测（2027 年前 40%+ agentic AI 项目因治理与质量控制不足被取消）；同时 Goodhart 定律直接威胁 LLM-as-judge 体系（优化评审通过率可能偏离真实质量），Chen et al. 的对齐三难困境（强优化、完美价值捕获、稳健泛化不可兼得）则从理论上限制了任何宣称自主自改进的系统。这使得“编排 + 质量 + 溯源 + 治理”的一体化运行时成为需求。
AI.method:
系统按六层组织：展示层（React 19 + Zustand 的 24 页签仪表盘，WebSocket 实时推送与 REST 轮询兜底）、传输层（HTTP/REST、MCP 双向、CLI、Discord、Telegram、Webhook、Slack 共 7 通道）、编排层（12 步确定性流水线）、执行层（SwarmEngine + 5 状态智能体注册表）、基础设施层（SLM-Lite 记忆、工具注册表、AES-256 凭据库、Claw Bridge）、持久层（SQLite 49 表 + FTS5 + 事件溯源 + 检查点恢复）。12 步流水线为：初始化预算校验 → SLM-Lite 记忆注入 → Forge 组队 → 可选模拟 → 安全策略校验 → 按拓扑分发执行 → 共识评审 → 拒绝则回到第 3 步（最多 5 次、3× 预算上限，超限转人工）→ RL 奖励记录 → 行为模式捕获 → 输出格式化 → 收尾。每步间检查转向状态以支持中途暂停/恢复/重定向/取消。
核心机制：(1) 拓扑执行语义——12 种拓扑（Sequential、Parallel、Hierarchical、DAG、Mixture、Debate、Mesh、Star、Circular、Grid、Forest、Maker）各有形式化终止条件、基于集中式 MsgHub 的消息传递协议与显式聚合策略；其中 Grid 为 2D 矩阵四邻域迭代精修（元胞自动机式），Forest 为多树并行层次结构避免单根瓶颈，Maker 为提案者+投票者多数票（默认 66%）。(2) Forge（528 行）——LLM 驱动的元认知组队器，将任务 T 与预算 B 映射为设计 D=(𝒜, τ, 𝒯, ℳ)，算法流程为：LLM 分类任务类型 → RL Trainer 推荐历史最优拓扑 → DesignStore 按 θ=0.7 检索成功设计库 → 有则适配、无则生成 → 工具与结构校验；拒绝后按 <3 次精炼、≥3 次强制换拓扑并查库避免重复失败模式、5 次或超 3× 预算则升级人工。(3) 三层模型路由——元层为 ε-greedy 上下文 bandit（γ=0，状态编码 taskTypeHash_modelCountBucket_budgetClass，Q 表每 10 episode 持久化到 SQLite）；策略层为 AI.result: 系统规模与工程质量：150+ TypeScript 源文件、2821 个测试用例全部通过、0 个 TSC 错误、49 张数据库表（含 1 个 FTS5 与 meta 表）、60+ API 端点、12 种拓扑、10 家供应商、7 个通信通道、217 种事件类型、8 个质量模块、25 条 UCP 命令、18 个迁移阶段。四级 UAT 最终识别 22 个缺陷并全部修复，质量评分 100/100；Pivot 2 审计又发现 36 项（3 Critical、14 High、13 Medium、6 Low），全部 Critical/High 立即修复，Medium/Low 留待后续。动态模型发现已在 Azure AI Foundry 企业订阅上实测：返回 236 个模型（含 GPT-5.4-mini、GPT-5.3-chat、DeepSeek-V3.2-Speciale、Grok-4.1-fast-reasoning、Kimi-K2.5、Mistral-Large-3、Claude Opus 4.6/Sonnet 4.6/Haiku 4.5、FLUX.2-pro），并通过发现到的 GPT-5.4-mini 端点完成 “Hello” 往返调用验证端到端可用。20 任务评测套件（Level-1 事实/算术 7 题、Level-2 多步推理 7 题、Level-3 概率/复杂 6 题）在 GPT-5.4-mini 上取得 100% 正确率（7/7、7/7、6/6），平均每任务成本 $0.000039（20 任务共 $0.00078），平均耗时 3,996 ms，19 题精确匹配、1 题（G18 “About 50%”）模糊匹配。相较 AIOS/AutoGen/CrewAI/LangGraph 的八维度定性对比表显示其在拓扑数、自动组队、成本路由、模型发现、共识评审、Goodhart 检测、JSD 漂移监控、行为契约、三难处理、面板、市场、框架导入、四层溯源、本地优先、工作流编辑器等维度均领先，但承认在边缘部署与通道广度上存在短板。需要审慎看待的是：100% 准确率来自作者自建的 20 题套件，任务不含网页浏览、文件操作或多工具编排，难度偏事实回忆与算术，成绩更多反映底层模型能力而非编排增益；自改进闭环基准中平均评审分从 0.564 降至 0.534 再降至 0.519，10 题中仅 3 题分数上升、6 题收敛（≥0.8），配对 t 检验 p=0.578，作者明确将下降趋势判为统计不显著并作为负向初步结果披露，指出需以完整编排器在线运行复核该“自改进”主张。
AI.conclusion: 论文主张 Qualixar OS 通过 12 种拓扑执行语义、自动组队、三层成本感知路由、共识式质量保障、四层溯源与完整面板/市场，弥合了智能体框架与生产系统之间的鸿沟，使编排对开发者与非技术用户 alike 可用；其应用层定位与内核层的 AIOS 互补而非竞争，通用兼容层确保任何主要框架构建的智能体都能被导入编排。系统以 2821 个测试与 25 条预置市场条目为基础，声称已具备社区采用与扩展条件，并开放于 Elastic License 2.0。诚实的自我限定与后续工作包括：自建评测套件缺乏外部效度（SWE-Bench、HumanEval、MINT 待测）；闭环自改进未获统计显著支持；当前为单节点 SQLite 架构，分布式执行与 PostgreSQL/CockroachDB 迁移在计划中；拓扑选择可引入以评审裁决为奖励的 RL；启动时 10 家供应商目录查询带来 2–8 秒初始化延迟（拟用后台刷新）；Goodhart 检测需至少 50 次评估才能给出可靠信号，低频部署场景窗口过大；JSD 漂移监控隐含参考分布平稳性假设，初始校准期若含异常将造成漏检；企业 SSO 目前产生合成令牌，完整 OAuth2 交换待实现；拓扑语义与行为契约尚未做 TLA+ 等形式化验证。总体而言，该工作是一份工程量巨大、功能覆盖广、以作者自建评测与自动化测试为主的系统论文，其“首个通用智能体 OS”与各项量化指标的普适性仍需第三方在标准基准与真实生产负载上的独立验证。

title: MO-RiskVAE: A Multi-Omics Variational Autoencoder for Survival Risk Modeling in Multiple MyelomaMO-RiskVAE
summary: Multimodal variational autoencoders (VAEs) have emerged as a powerful framework for survival risk modeling in multiple myeloma by integrating heterogeneous omics and clinical data. However, when trained under survival supervision, standard latent regularization strategies often fail to preserve prognostically relevant variation, leading to unstable or overly constrained representations. Despite numerous proposed variants, it remains unclear which aspects of latent design fundamentally govern performance in this setting. In this work, we conduct a controlled investigation of latent modeling choices for multimodal survival prediction within a unified extension of the MyeVAE framework. By systematically isolating regularization scale, posterior geometry, and latent space structure under identical architectures and optimization protocols, we show that survival-driven training is primarily sensitive to the magnitude and structure of latent regularization rather than the specific divergence formulation. In particular, moderate relaxation of KL regularization consistently improves survival discrimination, while alternative divergence mechanisms such as MMD and HSIC provide limited benefit without appropriate scaling. We further demonstrate that structuring the latent space can improve alignment between learned representations and survival risk gradients. A hybrid continuous--discrete formulation based on Gumbel--Softmax enhances global risk ordering in the continuous latent subspace, even though stable discrete subtype discovery does not emerge under survival supervision. Guided by these findings, we instantiate a robust multimodal survival model, termed MO-RiskVAE, which consistently improves risk stratification over the original MyeVAE without introducing additional supervision or complex training heuristics.

AI.tldr: 本文针对多模态变分自编码器(VAE)在多发性骨髓瘤生存风险预测中的潜在空间设计进行了系统性消融研究，发现KL正则化的强度和结构是关键因素，并提出了改进模型MO-RiskVAE。
AI.motivation: 多发性骨髓瘤生存风险建模中，现有多模态VAE框架在生存监督训练下，标准潜在正则化策略常无法保留预后相关信息，导致表示不稳定或过度约束。此外，现有研究缺乏对潜在设计各要素对性能影响的系统比较。
AI.method: 在统一扩展的MyeVAE框架下，系统性地隔离正则化尺度、 posterior几何和潜在空间结构，在相同架构和优化协议下进行对照实验。采用Gumbel-Softmax的混合连续-离散公式。
AI.result: 生存驱动训练主要对潜在正则化的强度和结构敏感，而非特定散度公式。适度放松KL正则化持续改善生存区分度；MMD和HSIC等替代散度机制在无适当 scaling 时效果有限。结构化潜在空间可改善学习表示与生存风险梯度的对齐；混合连续-离散 formulation 增强了连续潜在子空间的全局风险排序。
AI.conclusion: MO-RiskVAE 在不引入额外监督或复杂训练启发式的情况下， consistently 改善了相对于原始 MyeVAE 的风险分层。生存监督下未出现稳定的离散亚型发现。

title: Scheduling the Unschedulable: Taming Black-Box LLM Inference at Scale
comment: 10 pages, 8 figures. Code and reproduction artifacts available upon request
summary: When output token counts can be predicted at submission time (Gan et al., 2026), client-side scheduling against a black-box LLM API becomes semi-clairvoyant: decisions condition on coarse token priors even though the provider's internals remain hidden. We decompose this boundary problem into three separable concerns: allocation (inter-class share via adaptive DRR), ordering (intra-class sequencing with feasible-set scoring), and overload control (explicit admit/defer/reject on a cost ladder). An information ladder experiment shows that coarse magnitude priors -- not class labels alone -- are the practical threshold for useful client control; removing magnitude inflates short-request P95 by up to $5.8\times$ and degrades deadline satisfaction. Under balanced / high congestion the full stack achieves 100% completion, 100% deadline satisfaction, and useful goodput of $4.2 \pm 1.6$ SLO-meeting requests/s with short P95 within tens of milliseconds of quota-tiered isolation. A predictor-noise sweep confirms graceful degradation under up to 60% multiplicative error. Heavy-dominated regimes separate policies on completion, tail, and interpretable shedding. We further compare short-priority allocation (biased toward interactive traffic) with Fair Queuing (round-robin across classes): Fair Queuing achieves +32% short-request P90 improvement over FIFO with only +17% long-request overhead, versus Short-Priority's +27% / +116% trade-off -- demonstrating that the allocation layer accommodates different fairness objectives without changing the remaining stack. We contribute the three-layer client-side decomposition, controlled evaluation of joint metrics across regimes, allocation-policy alternatives, and overload-policy evidence linking cost-ladder shedding to the stated service objective.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了客户端如何利用输出token计数的先验知识来调度对黑盒LLM API的请求，提出allocation-ordering-overload control三层分解框架。实验表明，粗粒度幅度先验是实现有效客户端控制的关键阈值，在高拥塞下可实现100%完成率和100%截止期限满足率，且在高达60%乘法预测误差下仍能优雅降级。
AI.motivation: 当客户端可在提交时预测输出token数量时，对黑盒LLM API的调度变为"半先知"问题——决策可基于粗粒度token先验，但提供商内部仍不可见。如何在黑盒约束下实现有效调度控制成为关键挑战。
AI.method: 提出三层分解框架：(1) Allocation层 - 通过自适应DRR实现类间份额分配；(2) Ordering层 - 基于可行集评分的类内排序；(3) Overload Control层 - 基于成本阶梯的显式 admit/defer/reject 控制。信息阶梯实验评估幅度先验的价值。
AI.result: 粗粒度幅度先验（非仅类标签）是实现有效客户端控制的关键阈值；移除幅度信息使短请求P95延迟增加高达5.8倍。平衡/高拥塞下实现100%完成率、100%截止期限满足率，有效goodput达4.2±1.6 SLO达标请求/秒；在高达60%乘法预测误差下仍可优雅降级。Fair Queuing相比FIFO使短请求P90改善+32%（仅增加长请求开销+17%），优于Short-Priority的+27%/+116%权衡。
AI.conclusion: 三层客户端分解框架有效支持不同公平性目标（无需更改剩余栈）；成本阶梯丢弃策略与服务质量目标可解释地关联；在重请求主导场景下策略在完成率、尾延迟和可解释丢弃上表现差异明显。

title: LASER: A Data-Centric Method for Low-Cost and Efficient SQL Rewriting based on SQL-GRPO
summary: Query rewriting, the process of transforming queries into semantically equivalent yet more efficient variants, is crucial for database optimization. Existing solutions predominantly rely on either rule-based heuristics or Large Language Models (LLMs). However, traditional rule-based methods lack adaptability, while LLM-based approaches incur prohibitive inference costs and privacy risks. In contrast, Small Language Models (SLMs) present a compelling middle ground, potentially offering both flexibility and efficiency. However, the development of such compact models is severely bottlenecked by the scarcity of high-quality, domain-specific training data. To bridge this gap, we introduce LASER, a data-centric framework designed to empower small models for robust SQL optimization. First, to address the scarcity of existing benchmarks and the limited optimization headroom of generic synthetic queries, we construct SQL-MCTS, a large-scale corpus of complex slow queries. We employ an MCTS-based hybrid expansion strategy that combines rule-guided anti-patterns with LLM mutations to evolve structurally expressive seeds into execution-verified slow variants. Second, to enable the model to autonomously discover latency-aware rewriting patterns, we propose SQL-GRPO, a specialized alignment strategy adapted from Group Relative Policy Optimization. By integrating Anchored Group Advantage to refine advantage estimation and Complexity-Adaptive Dynamic Rollout to efficiently allocate exploration budgets, this approach effectively empowers compact models to master execution-based optimization logic. Implemented on Qwen3 models, LASER significantly outperforms rule-based systems and LLMs in execution efficiency, while exhibiting robust zero-shot transferability with minimal overhead.

AI.tldr: LASER是一个数据为中心的框架，利用小语言模型（SLM）进行SQL查询重写优化。通过SQL-MCTS生成大规模复杂慢查询数据集，并采用SQL-GRPO对齐策略训练Qwen3模型，在保持低开销的同时超越了基于规则和LLM方法的执行效率。
AI.motivation: 现有SQL优化方案存在根本性矛盾：基于规则的方法缺乏适应性，而LLM方法虽有灵活性但推理成本高昂且存在隐私风险。小语言模型虽处于"甜蜜点"，但高质量领域特定训练数据的稀缺严重制约了其发展。
AI.method: 提出两个核心组件：1) SQL-MCTS：基于MCTS的混合扩展策略，融合规则引导的反模式与LLM突变，将表达性种子演化为经执行验证的慢查询变体；2) SQL-GRPO：专为此任务改编的群组相对策略优化对齐方法，通过锚定群组优势（Anchored Group Advantage）改进优势估计，并采用复杂度自适应动态 rollout 高效分配探索预算。
AI.result: 在Qwen3模型上实现，LASER在执行效率上显著优于基于规则的系统和大语言模型，同时展现出强大的零样本迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: LASER成功证明了小语言模型在SQL优化任务上的可行性，通过数据合成与对齐策略的协同设计，为构建高效、可部署的数据库优化器提供了新范式。

title: Leveraging LLMs and Heterogeneous Knowledge Graphs for Persona-Driven Session-Based Recommendation
summary: Session-based recommendation systems (SBRS) aim to capture user's short-term intent from interaction sequences. However, the common assumption of anonymous sessions limits personalization, particularly under sparse or cold-start conditions. Recent advances in LLM-augmented recommendation have shown that LLMs can generate rich item representations, but modeling user personas with LLMs remains challenging due to anonymous sessions. In this work, we propose a persona-driven SBRS framework that explicitly models latent user personas inferred from a heterogeneous knowledge graph (KG) and integrates them into a data-driven recommendation pipeline.Our framework adopts a two-stage architecture consisting of personalized information extraction and personalized information utilization, inspired by recent chain-of-thought recommendation approaches. In the personalized information extraction stage, we construct a heterogeneous KG that integrates time-independent user-item, item-item, item-feature association, and metadata from DBpedia. We then learn latent user personas in an unsupervised manner using a Heterogeneous Deep Graph Infomax (HDGI) objective over a KG initialized with LLM-derived item embeddings. In the personalized information utilization stage, the learned persona representations together with LLM-derived item embeddings are incorporated into a modified architecture of data-driven SBRS to generate a candidate set of relevant items, followed by reranking using the base sequential model to emphasize short-term session intent. Unlike prior approaches that rely solely on sequence modeling or text-based user representations, our method grounds user persona modeling in structured relational signals derived from a KG. Experiments on Amazon Books and Amazon Movies & TV demonstrate that our approach consistently improves over sequential models with user embeddings derived using session history.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于人格驱动的会话推荐系统(SBRS)框架，通过从不完整会话中推断潜在用户人格，并将其整合到数据驱动的推荐流程中，以解决匿名会话场景下个性化不足的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有会话推荐系统假设会话是匿名的，限制了个性化能力，尤其在数据稀疏或冷启动场景下表现不佳。LLM虽能生成丰富的物品表示，但因匿名会话限制，难以建模用户人格。用户人格的显式建模对于提升推荐准确性至关重要。
AI.method: 框架采用两阶段架构：1) 个性化信息提取阶段：构建融合DBpedia元数据的异构图谱(HetKG)，利用LLM派生的物品嵌入初始化图谱，通过异构图谱自监督学习(HDGI)无监督地学习潜在用户人格表示；2) 个性化信息利用阶段：将人格表示与LLM物品嵌入整合到修改后的序列推荐模型中生成候选集，再通过基础序列模型重排序以强调短期会话意图。
AI.result: 在Amazon Books和Amazon Movies & TV两个数据集上的实验表明，相比基于会话历史的用户嵌入的序列模型，该方法持续提升推荐性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过将用户人格建模扎根于KG衍生的结构化关系信号，而非仅依赖序列建模或文本用户表示，有效提升了匿名会话场景下的个性化推荐效果。该方法为LLM增强的会话推荐提供了新的思路。

title: CODE-GEN: A Human-in-the-Loop RAG-Based Agentic AI System for Multiple-Choice Question Generation
comment: Full version of the paper accepted as a short paper at the 27th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education (AIED 2026)
summary: We present CODE-GEN, a human-in-the-Loop, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)-based agentic AI system for generating context-aligned multiple-choice questions to develop student code reasoning and comprehension abilities. CODE-GEN employs an agentic AI architecture in which a Generator agent produces multiple-choice coding comprehension questions aligned with course-specific learning objectives, while a Validator agent independently assesses content quality across seven pedagogical dimensions. Both agents are augmented with specialized tools that enhance computational accuracy and verify code outputs. To evaluate the effectiveness of CODE-GEN, we conducted an evaluation study involving six human subject-matter experts (SMEs) who judged 288 AI-generated questions. The SMEs produced a total of 2,016 human-AI rating pairs, indicating agreement or disagreement with the assessments of Validator, along with 131 instances of qualitative feedback. Analyses of SME judgments show strong system performance, with human-validated success rates ranging from 79.9% to 98.6% across the seven pedagogical dimensions. The analysis of qualitative feedback reveals that CODE-GEN achieves high reliability on dimensions well suited to computational verification and explicit criteria matching, including question clarity, code validity, concept alignment, and correct answer validity. In contrast, human expertise remains essential for dimensions requiring deeper instructional judgment, such as designing pedagogically meaningful distractors and providing high-quality feedback that reinforces understanding. These findings inform the strategic allocation of human and AI effort in AI-assisted educational content generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CODE-GEN：一个"人在回路"（human-in-the-loop）的、基于检索增强生成（RAG）的双智能体（Agentic AI）系统，用于生成与课程学习目标对齐的编程理解多选题。Generator 智能体出题，Validator 智能体按七个教学维度独立评估质量，并由 6 位专家（SMEs）对 288 道题给出 2,016 组人机评分对与 131 条质性反馈。人工验证的成功率在 79.9%–98.6% 之间，结论是：可计算验证/显式标准匹配的维度可放心交给 AI，而干扰项设计与高质量反馈仍需人类教学判断。
AI.motivation: 通用 LLM 生成的题目过于泛化、与课程特定学习目标对齐不足，削弱教学有效性与教师信任；同时，多智能体研究常假定自动化 critique 智能体的评审可靠，但 LLM 评估器存在幻觉、偏见与判断不一致，若不加人类校验，评估阶段的错误会在迭代中被放大而非纠正。缺乏针对智能体式教育内容生成系统的系统性人机对比评估，因此需要明确"AI 能可靠自动化什么、哪些必须保留人类专家"这一分工边界。
AI.method: 1) RAG 管线：教师上传学习目标、示例题与示例代码，采用按行解析+docstring 识别的领域特定分块，用 OpenAI text-embedding-3-small 嵌入并索引至 FAISS（L2 距离、IndexFlatL2）向量库，按主题做最近邻检索后注入 Generator 提示词。2) 双智能体架构：Generator（GPT-4.1）生成题干、可执行代码、四个选项及正确/错误选项的反馈；Validator（GPT-5-mini）按七个维度（题干清晰度、代码有效性、概念对齐、正确答案有效性、干扰项质量、正确答案反馈质量、干扰项反馈质量）输出 Yes/No 或 Good/Poor 分类与理由，均遵循预定义 JSON schema。3) 工具增强：Arithmetic Expression Evaluator 确定性计算多步算术表达式（规避 LLM 运算错误），Sandboxed Python Runner 在受限环境执行代码以核验输出与变量状态。4) 人类评估：6 位有入门编程教学经验的 SMEs（3男3女）经统一培训后，对 288 道不同题目（每人题集不同，故不适用 Cohen's kappa）逐维度与 Validator 判断做"同意/不同意"评分并撰写理由，形成 2,016 组配对与 131 条质性反馈；将 SME 视为 ground truth、Validator 视为预测，按 TP/FP/TN/FN 分类计算成功率、失败率（错误接受）、保护率（正确拒绝）、低效率（错误拒绝），并分析 FP/FN 案例的质性原因。
AI.result: 七个维度的人工验证成功率为 79.9%–98.6%。概念对齐最高（98.6% 成功、0.3% 失败、1.0% 低效），题干清晰度 97.9%（失败 2.1%、无低效），代码有效性 95.5%（失败 3.1%、低效 1.4%），正确答案反馈质量 92.4%、正确答案有效性 92.0%（失败均为 1.4%、2.1%，保护率约 2.8%–3.1%）。需深度教学判断的维度表现较弱：干扰项质量成功 79.9%、失败 15.6%（最低），干扰项反馈质量成功 86.1%、失败 9.4%。SME–Validator 同意率均值 82.5%–98.4%，七个维度中五个标准差 ≤3.8%。质性分析：FP 多源于干扰项"语法正确但浅薄"、未针对新手常见误解，Validator 误批"仅描述表层机制、缺乏概念阐述"的反馈；FN 多源于 Validator 混淆答案值与选项序号，以及文字分析肯定但最终二元分类相反的内部不一致。
AI.conclusion: CODE-GEN 证明 RAG + 双智能体 + 工具增强可对"显式标准匹配、可计算验证"的维度提供可规模化的第一线质量控制（成功率 79.9%–98.6%），且系统级失败率低（≤3.1%）；但"教学深度"维度（干扰项的迷思针对性、反馈的概念阐述）必须保留人类专家监督。论文由此提出 AI 与人类在教育内容生成中的分工原则：AI 负责可验证的规模化质控，人类负责教学洞察与学生迷思预判。局限与展望：研究限于入门 Python；未来将扩展到其他学科，并把结构化人类反馈作为教育 LLM 的 RLHF 对齐数据集，同时推广其人机对比评估框架以研究"AI 评估自身质量"的可信度边界。

title: Benchmarking Requirement-to-Architecture Generation with Hybrid Evaluation
summary: Recently, Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated significant potential in automating software engineering tasks. Generating software architecture designs from requirement documents is a crucial step in software development. However, there is currently a lack of functional datasets tailored for this task. To bridge this gap, we introduce R2ABench (Requirement-To-Architecture Benchmark), a novel benchmark comprising diverse real-world software projects paired with comprehensive Product Requirements Documents (PRDs) and expert-curated PlantUML reference diagrams. Furthermore, we propose a multi-dimensional, hybrid evaluation framework that assesses generated diagrams across three complementary layers: Structural Graph Metrics, Multi-dimensional Scoring, and Architecture Anti-pattern Detection. Using this framework, we conducted a comprehensive empirical study evaluating state-of-the-art models and agentic workflows. Our study shows that LLMs show strong syntactic validity and robust entity extraction but fundamentally struggle with relational reasoning, leading to structurally fragmented architectures. Code-specialized models partially alleviate this limitation, while agent frameworks introduce significant instability rather than consistent improvements. R2ABench provides a robust and standardized foundation for advancing LLM-driven software architecture generation.

AI.tldr: R2ABench是一个用于评估LLM从需求文档生成软件架构图能力的新型基准测试，配套多维度混合评估框架，并揭示了当前模型在关系推理方面的核心缺陷。
AI.motivation: 当前缺乏针对从需求文档生成软件架构设计这一任务的功能性数据集，制约了该领域的研究与发展。
AI.method: 提出R2ABench基准（含真实软件项目、PRD文档及专家标注的PlantUML图表）和三层评估框架（结构图指标、多维度评分、架构反模式检测），对主流模型和Agent工作流进行实证评估。
AI.result: LLM在句法有效性和实体提取方面表现强健，但在关系推理上存在根本性缺陷，导致架构结构碎片化；代码专用模型部分缓解该问题；Agent框架引入显著不稳定性而非稳定提升。
AI.conclusion: R2ABench为推进LLM驱动的软件架构生成研究提供了稳健且标准化的评估基础。

title: From experimentation to engagement: on the paradox of participatory AI and power in contexts of forced displacement and humanitarian crises
comment: This paper was submitted to the ACM FAccT conference in 2025 and is published here as a preprint in March 2026. The research was conducted in December 2024. Since submission, AI deployment across the humanitarian sector has accelerated without commensurate development of independent accountability
summary: Across the Global North, calls for participatory artificial intelligence (AI) to improve the responsible, safe, and ethical use of AI have increased, particularly efforts that engage citizens and communities whose well-being and safety may be directly impacted by AI and other algorithmic tools. These initiatives include surveys, community consultations, citizens' councils and assemblies, and co-designing AI models and projects. Far fewer efforts, however, have been made in the Global South, particularly in contexts related to humanitarian crises and forced displacement, where the deployment of AI and algorithmic tools is accelerating. In this paper, we critically examine participatory AI methods and their limitations in these contexts and explore the opinions and perceptions of AI held by displaced and crisis-affected communities. Based on a pilot exercise with communities living in Kakuma Refugee Camp in northwestern Kenya, we find important limitations in some participatory AI approaches which, if used in humanitarian contexts, could increase risks of so-called 'participation washing' and algorithmic harm. We argue that these risks are not predominantly driven by varying levels of understanding and awareness of AI but more closely linked to the fundamental power dynamics embedded within the humanitarian sector: between humanitarian aid recipients, service providers, donor governments, and host nations, as well as the power differentials and incentives that exist between AI companies and humanitarian actors. These structural conditions make the case not only for more rigorous participatory methods, but for independent governance architecture capable of holding humanitarian AI to account.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性审视了在人道主义危机和流离失所背景下参与式AI方法的局限性。基于肯尼亚卡库马难民营的试点研究，发现参与式AI方法存在"参与漂洗"和算法伤害的风险，这些风险主要源于人道主义部门内部根深蒂固的权力不对等，而非社区对AI认知不足。
AI.motivation: 当前参与式AI研究主要集中于全球北方，在全球南方尤其是人道主义危机和被迫流离失所情境中的探索极为有限，但AI和算法工具在此类场景中的应用却在加速。作者试图填补这一研究空白，并质疑现有参与式AI方法在脆弱人群中的适用性。
AI.method: 在肯尼亚西北部卡库马难民营与受影响社区开展试点调研，收集并分析流离失所和危机影响社区对AI的看法与态度数据。
AI.result: 研究发现部分参与式AI方法存在重要局限，在人道主义情境中使用可能增加"参与漂洗"和算法伤害风险。这些风险并非主要由不同水平的AI理解程度驱动，而更与嵌入人道主义部门的根本权力结构密切相关。
AI.conclusion: 作者主张需要更严格的参与式方法以及能够问责人道主义AI的独立治理架构。核心论点是将责任归结为个人认知差异具有误导性——结构性权力失衡（援助接受者与服务提供者、捐赠国与东道国、AI公司与人道主义行动者之间的权力差异）才是根本症结所在。

title: Beyond Facts: Benchmarking Distributional Reading Comprehension in Large Language Models
summary: While most reading comprehension benchmarks for LLMs focus on factual information that can be answered by localizing specific textual evidence, many real-world tasks require understanding distributional information, such as population-level trends and preferences expressed across collections of text. We introduce Text2DistBench, a reading comprehension benchmark for evaluating LLMs' ability to infer distributional knowledge from natural language. Built from real-world YouTube comments about movie and music entities, the benchmark provides models with entity metadata and associated comments, and requires them to answer distributional questions, such as estimating the proportions of positive and negative comments, or identifying the most and second most frequent topics discussed among viewers. To support reliable and long-term evaluation, the construction pipeline of Text2DistBench is fully automated and continuously updated to incorporate newly emerging entities over time. Experiments across multiple LLMs show that while models substantially outperform random baselines, performance varies widely across different distribution types and characteristics. These findings highlight both the capabilities and limitations of current LLMs in distributional reading comprehension and demonstrate the value of Text2DistBench as a practical and scalable testbed for future research.

AI.tldr: Text2DistBench是一个用于评估LLM从自然语言中推断分布知识能力的阅读理解基准测试，基于YouTube电影和音乐评论构建，特点是全自动化和可持续更新。实验表明模型优于随机基线，但不同分布类型间性能差异显著。
AI.motivation: 现有阅读理解基准测试主要关注可从局部文本证据回答的事实信息，而现实任务需要理解分布信息（如群体趋势、跨文本集合的偏好表达）。现有基准缺乏对此类能力的评估。
AI.method: 构建Text2DistBench基准：从YouTube电影和音乐评论中提取实体元数据和关联评论，要求模型回答分布性问题（如正负评论比例、最常讨论话题）。pipeline全自动化并持续纳入新实体以支持长期评估。
AI.result: 多LLM实验中，模型显著优于随机基线，但不同分布类型和特征间性能差异明显。
AI.conclusion: 该研究揭示了当前LLM在分布阅读理解方面的能力与局限，Text2DistBench可作为未来研究的实用、可扩展测试平台。

title: ProofSketcher: Hybrid LLM + Lightweight Proof Checker for Reliable Math/Logic Reasoning
summary: The large language models (LLMs) might produce a persuasive argument within mathematical and logical fields, although such argument often includes some minor missteps, including the entire omission of side conditions, invalid inference patterns, or appeals to a lemma that cannot be derived logically out of the context being discussed. These omissions are infamously hard to notice solely out of the text, as even the misconstrued construction still may seem mostly accurate. Conversely, interactive theorem provers like Lean and Coq have rigorous reliability by ensuring that syntactic and semantic statements only accept statements that can pass all the syntactic and semantic steps in the program which is a small trusted kernel of the language type-checks with. Despite the fact that this technique provides strong guarantees, it comes at quite a heavy price: the evidence must be completely formalized, and the evidence user or a auxiliary search program must provide an avalanche of low-level information. This paper presents a hybrid pipeline where an LLM generates a typed proof sketch in a compact DSL and a lightweight trusted kernel expands the sketch into explicit proof obligations.

AI.tldr: ProofSketcher 提出一种"LLM 写证明草图、内核做形式检查"的混合流水线：LLM 不直接输出完整 Lean/Coq 战术脚本，而是在一种紧凑的类型化证明草图 DSL（ProofSketch DSL）中给出带有方法标签（rewrite/split/induction/contradiction）、引用事实和类型化空洞（typed holes）的结构化证明计划；轻量级可信内核将每个草图节点确定性地展开成显式的证明义务（Γ⊢φ 序列），义务要么由内核内置的可信推理规则证明，要么由外部 SMT/ATP 求解器（不可信）返回证明证书并经可信证书检查器验证；失败时内核返回节点级结构化反馈（缺失引理、实例化失败、无效重写、前置条件不满足），LLM 只重写失败节点，系统通过节点内容哈希缓存实现增量重检，从而在小可信计算基（TCB）与可靠接受之间取得平衡。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在数学与逻辑推理中常能生成"看起来正确"的论证，但会遗漏边条件、使用无效推理模式，或调用在当前上下文中无法推出的引理，这类缺陷仅凭文本极难察觉。而 Lean、Coq 等交互式定理证明器具有严格可靠性（仅依赖小型可信内核的类型检查），代价是必须完全形式化、用户或搜索程序需提供大量底层细节：LLM 一次性生成完整证明脚本时，编译失败反馈往往过细（战术状态）或过粗（超时），只能靠昂贵的整体重生成来补救；同时外部求解器的可靠性只有在其输出附带可验证证书时才成立。据此作者主张重新划分形式验证引擎与语言模型的分工：让模型负责高层结构，让小型可信内核负责正确性判定，以获得"快速修复 + 小 TCB + 接受即可靠"的系统。
AI.method: 系统为闭环流水线，可信边界仅含内核、证书检查器与证明对象存储/重放；检索、LLM、外部求解器均在 TCB 之外。流程分四阶段：(1) 类型化草图生成——LLM 针对定理 T 与上下文 Γ（逻辑 L 为带等式的一阶逻辑，算术义务扩展线性整数算术 LIA）产出 ProofSketch DSL 草图，节点含目标公式、方法标签、引用事实与类型化子目标，未证子目标以声明所需公式类型的 typed hole 表示；(2) 义务抽取——可信内核依据节点标签与类型字段做确定性展开，生成有限义务集 O={(Γ_i⊢φ_i)}，如 split 节点产生 Γ∪{c} 与 Γ∪{¬c} 两个义务，rewrite 节点产生等式成立性与在指定项位置应用重写两个义务；(3) 证书门控的义务消解——义务可由内核可信规则（命题逻辑、等式推理、显式实例化的量词规则）证明，或调用外部求解器翻译后的形式并要求其返回证明证书，由可信检查器验证后才被记为派生步骤，证书验证失败则义务标记失败；(4) 局部修复与增量重检——失败时内核返回记录 (node_id, cause, Γ_i, φ_i)，cause 分四类，LLM 仅编辑失败节点及其直接子目标生成 S′，内核用节点哈希复用未变节点的缓存证明做增量重检，循环最多 R 轮，仍未通过则以最终失败报告拒证。此外包含有界前提检索（参照 LeanDojo/ReProver）作为非可信提示，产出可重放的证明对象。
AI.result: 在 miniF2F(test, Lean4)、LeanDojo benchmark(mathlib)、ProofNet 三个设置上评测，仅当内核接受可重放证明才计为解决。与 ReProver、DeepSeek-Prover、DeepSeek-Prover-V2 对比的内核接受通过率为：miniF2F 上 92.21%（对比 ReProver 26.64%、DeepSeek-Prover 50.00%、DeepSeek-Prover-V2 88.93%）；LeanDojo 上 58.25%（对比 ReProver 51.20%）；ProofNet 上 44.62%（对比 ReProver 13.98%、DeepSeek-Prover-V2 37.10%）。论文还报告了按基准统计的通过率、平均每题 LLM 调用次数（反映修复频率）与平均运行时间在内核/求解器之间的划分，并对首个失败节点的失败类型（缺失引理、实例化失败、无效重写、前置条件不满足）与接受前平均修复次数做了失败分析。作者同时指明结论具有多处限定：证书体积大时证书检查会主导运行时间，故建议仅在良定义片段上使用认证求解器、小步骤优先用内核原生推理；库依赖问题（缺引理/缺边条件）只能被"缺失引理"信号缓解而未被消除；跨域鲁棒性不足，需按基准调节草图粒度；翻译层（义务→求解器格式）虽在 TCB 内但必须最小化并充分测试，因其为微妙不健全的常见来源。
AI.conclusion: 论文提出 ProofSketcher，将 LLM 的非形式推理与形式可靠性桥接起来：LLM 只负责提出高层结构（类型化草图、显式步骤标签、类型化空洞），正确性由可信内核与证书检查器判定，定理仅在全部义务被内核规则或经可信验证的外部证明证书消解时才被接受；失败可定位到单个节点并支持基于缓存的快速局部修复。主要贡献为：类型化草图 DSL、义务抽取器、证书门控的求解器接口、节点级缓存与定向修复的增量编辑-检查循环。讨论部分指出核心权衡在于草图粒度与义务消解负担之间（过抽象则义务庞大、求解器调用多；过细则退化为战术脚本、LLM 承担底层工程），最佳折中是显式记录步骤为何应当成立（方法标签）并把引理交给可信内核与认证自动化。未来工作方向：更好的义务整形以减小证书体积、与库检索更紧密集成以减少缺失引理失败、在保持小 TCB 的前提下向更多证明领域与理论片段扩展评测。

title: RAGEN-2: Reasoning Collapse in Agentic RL
summary: RL training of multi-turn LLM agents is inherently unstable, and reasoning quality directly determines task performance. Entropy is widely used to track reasoning stability. However, entropy only measures diversity within the same input, and cannot tell whether reasoning actually responds to different inputs. In RAGEN-2, we find that even with stable entropy, models can rely on fixed templates that look diverse but are input-agnostic. We call this template collapse, a failure mode invisible to entropy and all existing metrics. To diagnose this failure, we decompose reasoning quality into within-input diversity (Entropy) and cross-input distinguishability (Mutual Information, MI), and introduce a family of mutual information proxies for online diagnosis. Across diverse tasks, mutual information correlates with final performance much more strongly than entropy, making it a more reliable proxy for reasoning quality. We further explain template collapse with a signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) mechanism. Low reward variance weakens task gradients, letting regularization terms dominate and erase cross-input reasoning differences. To address this, we propose SNR-Aware Filtering to select high-signal prompts per iteration using reward variance as a lightweight proxy. Across planning, math reasoning, web navigation, and code execution, the method consistently improves both input dependence and task performance.

AI.tldr: RAGEN-2 指出多轮 LLM 智能体 RL 中存在一种"模板坍缩"（template collapse）失效模式：推理在单个输入内看似多样，但跨输入完全无差别，熵等既有指标对此完全盲视。作者用信息论把推理质量分解为"输入内多样性 H(Z|X)"与"跨输入可区分性 I(X;Z)"，提出可在线计算的互信息（MI）代理族（Retrieval-Acc、MI-ZScore-EMA 等）用于诊断；并用信噪比（SNR）视角解释成因——低奖励方差削弱任务梯度，使 KL/熵正则项主导更新、抹平跨输入差异；进而提出 SNR-Aware Filtering，按 prompt 奖励方差做 top-p 过滤以保留高信号更新，在多任务、多算法、多尺度、多模态上一致提升输入依赖性与任务性能。
AI.motivation: 多轮 LLM 智能体 RL 训练天然不稳定，现有监控范式把奖励（结果稳定性）与熵（推理过程稳定性）当作训练健康的证据。但熵只刻画给定输入下的行为多样性，无法判断推理是否真正响应输入差异：即便熵稳定乃至升高，模型仍可能收敛到跨输入近乎一致的固定"推理模板"——表面多样、实则 input-agnostic 的样板文字，作者称之为 template collapse。该失效在多轮稀疏奖励设定下尤其隐蔽：奖励无法区分"输入驱动的推理"与"恰好成功的模板化推理"，且推理链难以直接监督，导致坍缩在训练中被静默忽视并持续损害智能体可靠性。因此论文提出两个问题：(Q1) 如何在线诊断这种熵与所有既有指标都看不到的坍缩？(Q2) 它为何在 RL 中发生、能否被缓解？
AI.method:
**诊断（§2）**：以 Shannon 恒等式 H(Z)=I(X;Z)+H(Z|X) 为框架，将推理质量分解为输入内多样性（条件熵）与输入依赖性（互信息），据此给出四种推理状态象限（多样推理 / 模板坍缩 / 压缩推理 / 低熵坍缩），其中模板坍缩是唯一"熵高但 MI 低"的盲区。构造 **MI 代理族（Table 1）**：在同一 batch 内做 teacher-forced 交叉打分，计算打分矩阵 L_{i,k,j}=log p_θ(Z_{i,k}|X_j)，得到 matched（真实 prompt 下的逐 token 对数似然）与 marginal（批内均匀混合下的对数似然）两个长度归一化量，进而导出离散型 Retrieval-Acc（坍缩时退化至随机水平 1/P）、Recall@k 与连续型 MI-Est、MI-Seq-Est、MI-ZScore、MI-ZScore-EMA（z-score 归一化 + EMA 稳定，ε=1e-3、α=0.9）。全部代理复用训练 rollout 中已有的 (X, Z) 对，无需外部模型或额外推理。

**机制（§3）**：提出三噪声梯度分解 g_total = g_signal + g_task-noise + g_reg，并给出理论刻画：Theorem H.2（Cauchy-Schwarz）证明 ‖g_task(x)‖ ≤ √RV(x)·√E‖s‖²，即任务梯度幅度由 prompt 内奖励方差控制；Theorem H.3 给出 SNR ≤ √G·√RV(x)/σ(x)；Theorem H.4 说明零均值噪声下参数以 √T 速度漂移；Lemma I.1 给出模板混合使 I(X;Z) 至多收缩 (1−α) 倍；Theorem L.1 表明 KL 约束只"保住"而非提升输入依赖性；Theorem M.2 给出 ΔI = Δ_marg − Δ_in，说明熵奖励常使输入依赖下降；Proposition N.1 指出 GRPO 的 √RV 归一化引入 RV^{-1} 的噪声放大，使低 RV prompt 的更新噪声地板更高。梯度范数按奖励方差分桶的实证（Figure 3）显示：任务梯度范数随 RV 单调上升、正则梯度跨桶持平，低 RV 桶的更新几乎完全由输入无关的正则项驱动。

**方法（§3.3）**：**SNR-Aware Filtering**——每轮 rollout 后按 prompt 计算 Var(R|X)，按降序排名，取累计方差质量达到 ρ·ΣVar 的最小前缀 S（top-p，类比 nucleus sampling），仅在该子集上计算参数更新，并按 ρ 缩放损失以保持步长可比；配套 top-k、min-p、reverse-top-p 等对照变体。训练设置沿用 RAGEN/veRL，Qwen2.5-3B 为主干，PPO/DAPO/GRPO/Dr.GRPO，每轮 K=P×G=128 条轨迹，7 个环境（Sokoban、FrozenLake、MetaMathQA、Countdown、SearchQA、WebShop、DeepCoder）。
AI.result: **诊断有效性**：MI 家族与最终性能的 Spearman 相关为正（Trajectory MI-ZScore 达 +0.39），而推理熵与条件熵为近零或负（−0.11 至 −0.14），即熵的指示方向是错的；MI 下降先于任务性能退化，可作为早期预警。**坍缩普遍存在**：所有训练配置下 I(X;Z) 持续下滑而 H(Z|X) 居高不下；八个环境中推理长度单调缩短，构成行为层面的模板化签名；格式有效性（format validity）与 MI 解耦，不能替代 MI 诊断。**因果验证**：按 RV 四分位分桶单独训练，性能与 MI 从 Q1 到 Q4 单调退化（21.1%→11.0%，MI 0.95→0.73）；环境随机性从 0% 增至 100% 时 MI 单调下降、熵上升。**方法效果**：Top-p 一致优于 Top-k 与不过滤；在四任务四算法（PPO/DAPO/GRPO/Dr.GRPO）、多尺度（Qwen2.5 0.5B–7B、Llama3.2-3B）、多模态（Qwen2.5-VL-3B 文本/图像）矩阵上，过滤在多数设置提升峰值成功率（如 Sokoban PPO 12.9→+16.0，VL-3B 图像 FrozenLake 19.5→+59.5），平均分普遍上升。**边界条件**：高环境噪声（80–100%）下 RV 失去区分力、优势消失；RV 的 Std/Mean 比值低（如 FrozenLake GRPO 的 0.33）时过滤近似随机丢弃、可能反而变差；prompt 级过滤优于轨迹级过滤，说明收益来自信号质量而非 prompt 分布偏置。**开销**：RV 计算本身 <0.1% 迭代时间，过滤使每步耗时降低 26–41%，G≥4 时与 128×1 基线持平或更好，实现零额外 rollout 成本；训练中保留比例 ρ_eff 会随零方差 prompt 增多而自动收紧。
AI.conclusion: 多轮智能体 RL 存在一种"静默失败"：推理漂移为流畅但与输入无关的样板文字，而条件熵保持稳定。作者由此提出 template collapse 概念、基于互信息的可扩展在线诊断框架（MI 代理族，优于熵类指标），以及 SNR 机制解释（低奖励方差→任务梯度弱→正则主导→输入依赖被抹平），并给出 SNR-Aware Filtering 这一轻量、无额外监督的干预手段，可在现有训练管线中即插即用地同时改善输入依赖性与任务性能，从而把熵从"过程稳定性"指标纠偏为"输入依赖性"指标。局限包括：SNR 分解假设信号与正则噪声可干净分离（实际可能经梯度累积耦合）；仅单智能体实验，多智能体下坍缩的传播机制未知；强模型可能通过人为膨胀奖励方差来"钻"过滤标准的空子；方法依赖奖励方差作为可靠代理，在稀疏或高噪声奖励环境下退化；激进的过滤可能收窄探索覆盖，保留质量 ρ 需按任务调参。

title: Autopoiesis: A Self-Evolving System Paradigm for LLM Serving Under Runtime Dynamics
summary: Modern Large Language Model (LLM) serving operates in highly volatile environments characterized by severe runtime dynamics, such as workload fluctuations and elastic cluster autoscaling. Traditional serving systems rely on static, human-engineered serving policies (e.g., scheduling algorithms and rescheduling strategies) to manage these dynamics. However, these policies must navigate deeply intertwined runtime trade-offs (e.g., scheduling overhead vs. execution efficiency, rescheduling frequency vs. reconfiguration overhead), whose optimal balance is workload-specific and shifts continuously as runtime conditions evolve, rendering any fixed policy fundamentally unable to adapt. We propose Autopoiesis, a novel online self-evolving system that shifts LLM serving from static policy deployment to continuous online policy evolution. First, Autopoiesis introduces an LLM-driven program synthesis workflow to evolve serving policies with respect to real-time observed dynamics, where the evolved policies reflect the optimal decision in navigating the complex, multi-dimensional trade-off space. Second, Autopoiesis enables this synthesis process to operate continuously during serving, observing real-world system behavior, and rewriting the policy code as runtime trade-offs shift, thereby transforming policy design from a one-time offline endeavor into an ongoing system component, enabling autonomous adaptation to evolving runtime conditions. Together, we establish a new paradigm: Serving policies are no longer static artifacts designed by humans before deployment, but living code that LLMs continuously evolve throughout deployment to navigate runtime trade-offs beyond human design. We evaluate Autopoiesis across diverse runtime dynamics and show up to 53% and on average 34% improvements over state-of-the-art LLM serving systems.

AI.tldr: Autopoiesis是一个新型的在线自进化LLM服务系统，将LLM服务从静态策略部署转变为持续在线策略演化。该系统通过LLM驱动的程序合成工作流，根据实时观测的运行时动态演化服务策略，使策略能够持续观察真实系统行为并在运行时条件变化时重写策略代码，实现对动态运行时条件的自主适应。实验表明该系统相比现有最优LLM服务系统可提升性能最高达53%，平均提升34%。
AI.motivation: 传统LLM服务系统依赖静态、人工设计的策略（如调度算法和重调度策略）来应对运行时动态（如工作负载波动和弹性集群自动扩缩容）。然而，这些策略面临复杂的权衡取舍（如调度开销vs执行效率、重调度频率vs重配置开销），最优平衡点随工作负载和运行时条件持续变化，固定策略无法自适应。
AI.method: 1. LLM驱动的程序合成工作流：根据实时观测的动态演化服务策略，策略能够反映在复杂多维权衡空间中的最优决策；2. 持续运行时合成：系统在服务过程中持续运行，观察真实系统行为并重写策略代码，使策略设计从一次性离线工作转变为持续运行的系统组件。
AI.result: 实验评估涵盖多种运行时动态场景，相比现有最优LLM服务系统实现最高53%、平均34%的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 提出了LLM服务的新范式：服务策略不再是部署前由人类设计的静态产物，而是LLM在部署过程中持续演化的"活代码"，用于导航超出人类设计能力的运行时权衡。

title: AV-SQL: Decomposing Complex Text-to-SQL Queries with Agentic Views
summary: Text-to-SQL is the task of translating natural language queries into executable SQL for a given database, enabling non-expert users to access structured data without writing SQL manually. Despite rapid advances driven by large language models (LLMs), existing approaches still struggle with complex queries in real-world settings, where database schemas are large and questions require multi-step reasoning over many interrelated tables. In such cases, providing the full schema often exceeds the context window, while one-shot generation frequently produces non-executable SQL due to syntax errors and incorrect schema linking. To address these challenges, we introduce AV-SQL, a framework that decomposes complex Text-to-SQL into a pipeline of specialized LLM agents. Central to AV-SQL is the concept of agentic views: agent-generated Common Table Expressions (CTEs) that encapsulate intermediate query logic and filter relevant schema elements from large schemas. AV-SQL operates in three stages: (1) a rewriter agent compresses and clarifies the input query; (2) a view generator agent processes schema chunks to produce agentic views; and (3) a planner, generator, and revisor agent collaboratively compose these views into the final SQL query. Extensive experiments show that AV-SQL achieves 70.38% execution accuracy on the challenging Spider 2.0 benchmark, outperforming state-of-the-art baselines, while remaining competitive on standard datasets with 85.59% on Spider, 72.16% on BIRD and 63.78% on KaggleDBQA. Our source code is available at https://github.com/pminhtam/AV-SQL.

AI.tldr: AV-SQL是一个基于LLM智能体框架的Text-to-SQL系统，通过将复杂SQL生成分解为重写、视图生成和组合三个阶段，并引入"智能体视图"概念来处理大规模数据库schema，在Spider 2.0上达到70.38%的执行准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在处理复杂查询时面临挑战：大规模数据库schema超出上下文窗口限制，一次性生成容易产生语法错误和错误的schema关联。
AI.method: 提出AV-SQL框架，包含三个阶段：(1) 重写智能体压缩澄清输入查询；(2) 视图生成智能体处理schema分块生成智能体视图(CTEs)；(3) 规划器、生成器和修订器智能体协作将视图组合为最终SQL。
AI.result: 在Spider 2.0上达到70.38%的执行准确率，超越现有最优方法；在Spider上85.59%、BIRD上72.16%、KaggleDBQA上63.78%。
AI.conclusion: 通过智能体协作和中间CTE表示，有效解决了复杂Text-to-SQL任务中的schema过大和多步推理问题，验证了多智能体架构在该领域的有效性。

title: MARVEL: Multimodal Adaptive Reasoning-intensiVe Expand-rerank and retrievaL
summary: Multimodal retrieval over text corpora remains a fundamental challenge: the best vision-language encoder achieves only 27.6 nDCG@10 on MM-BRIGHT, a reasoning-intensive multimodal retrieval benchmark, underperforming strong text-only systems. We argue that effective multimodal retrieval requires three tightly integrated capabilities that existing approaches address only in isolation: expanding the query's latent intent, retrieving with a model trained for complex reasoning, and reranking via explicit step-by-step reasoning over candidates. We introduce \textbf{MARVEL} (\textbf{M}ultimodal \textbf{A}daptive \textbf{R}easoning-intensi\textbf{V}e \textbf{E}xpand-rerank and retrieva\textbf{L}), a unified pipeline that combines LLM-driven query expansion, \textbf{MARVEL-Retriever} -- a reasoning-enhanced dense retriever fine-tuned for complex multimodal queries -- and GPT-4o-based chain-of-thought reranking with optional multi-pass reciprocal rank fusion. Evaluated on MM-BRIGHT across 29 technical domains, MARVEL achieves \textbf{37.9} nDCG@10, surpassing the best multimodal encoder by \textbf{+10.3 points} and outperforming all single-stage baselines in 27 of 29 domains and matching or approaching the best baseline in the remaining two highly-specialized domains (Crypto, Quantum Computing), demonstrating that reasoning-intensive multimodal retrieval is best addressed through a unified expand-retrieve-rerank framework. https://github.com/mm-bright/multimodal-reasoning-retrieval

AI.tldr: MARVEL是一个统一的多模态检索框架，通过结合LLM驱动的查询扩展、推理增强的密集检索器(MARVEL-Retriever)和基于GPT-4o的思维链重排序，在MM-BRIGHT基准上达到37.9 nDCG@10，较最佳多模态编码器提升10.3个百分点。
AI.motivation: 当前多模态检索存在三个核心问题：现有方法仅单独解决查询意图扩展、复杂推理检索或重排序中的某一个，而非联合优化；最佳视觉-语言编码器在MM-BRIGHT推理密集型基准上仅达到27.6 nDCG@10，落后于纯文本系统；实际场景需要跨29个技术领域的复杂多模态推理能力。
AI.method: MARVEL采用三阶段统一流程：(1) LLM驱动查询扩展以捕获潜在意图；(2) MARVEL-Retriever微调密集检索器处理复杂多模态查询；(3) GPT-4o链式思维重排序结合可选多轮 reciprocal rank fusion。在MM-BRIGHT的29个技术领域评估。
AI.result: MARVEL达到37.9 nDCG@10，较最佳多模态编码器提升+10.3点；在29个领域中的27个领域超越所有单阶段基线方法；在Crypto和Quantum Computing两个高度专业化领域达到匹配或接近最佳基线水平。
AI.conclusion: 推理密集型多模态检索应通过统一的扩展-检索-重排序框架解决；三个核心能力需要紧密集成而非孤立优化；该工作为复杂多模态推理检索确立了新的性能边界。

title: Stabilization Without Simplification: A Two-Dimensional Model of Software Evolution
comment: 18 pages. Theoretical paper. Introduces a graph-based, discrete-time probabilistic framework for software evolution, separating structural burden and uncertainty
summary: Software systems are widely observed to grow in size, complexity, and interdependence over time, yet many large-scale systems remain stable despite persistent structural burden. This apparent tension suggests a limitation in one-dimensional views of software evolution. This paper introduces a graph-based, discrete-time probabilistic framework that separates structural burden from uncertainty. Change effort is modeled as a stochastic variable determined by the dependency neighborhood of the changed entity and by residual variability. Within this framework, burden is defined as expected effort and uncertainty as variance of effort. We show that, under explicit assumptions on non-decreasing average structural load, structural regularization, process stabilization, and covariance control, there exists a regime in which uncertainty decreases while structural burden does not. This regime formalizes the phenomenon of stabilization without simplification. The proposed framework provides a minimal theoretical explanation for how software systems can become more predictable over time without necessarily becoming structurally simpler, and offers a foundation for further theoretical and empirical studies of software evolution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于图论的离散时间概率框架，将软件演化中的结构性负担与不确定性分离。该框架证明，在特定假设下，存在一种"稳定化而不简化"的 regime，即系统的可预测性提高而结构性负担不降低。
AI.motivation: 软件系统规模、复杂度和相互依赖性持续增长，但许多大型系统仍保持稳定。传统的一维演化视角无法解释这一现象——系统如何在负担增加时仍保持稳定？这表明需要新的理论框架来理解软件演化。
AI.method: 提出了基于图的离散时间概率框架，将变更工作建模为随机变量，由依赖邻域和残余变异性决定。框架中：负担(burden)定义为工作量的期望值，不确定性(uncertainty)定义为工作量的方差。在非递减平均结构负载、结构正则化、过程稳定化和协方差控制等显式假设下进行分析。
AI.result: 证明了在上述假设条件下，存在一个 regime 使得不确定性降低而结构性负担不降低。这一结果形式化地描述了"稳定化而不简化"(stabilization without simplification)现象。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为理解软件系统如何随时间变得更加可预测而无需结构简化提供了最小化理论解释，并为软件演化的进一步理论和实证研究奠定了基础。

title: The End of Human Judgment in the Kill Chain? Relocating Initiative and Interpretation with Agentic AI
summary: Large language model-based agents are increasingly being integrated into core battlefield functions, including intelligence analysis, data fusion, and battlefield management. This paper argues that the very features that make such agents operationally attractive, namely their capacity for initiative, interpretation, their goal-directedness, and dynamic memory, are the same features that render context-appropriate human judgment and control substantively ineffectual in those parts of the kill chain where agents operate. Drawing on specific use cases, the paper argues that by relocating initiative and interpretation, LLM-based agents displace human decision-making in ways that makes their use incompatible with the requirement of human judgment and control which is central to existing governance frameworks, like those proposed by the GGE-CCW and REAIM. The paper concludes that a subset of agentic AI applications, particularly those deployed for data fusion and battle management in lethal contexts, cannot be used justifiably on the battlefield under current and foreseeable conditions, and proposes two ways for the international governance community to respond to this challenge.

AI.tldr: 本文论证了大型语言模型（LLM）智能体在战场上的核心功能（如情报分析、数据融合、战场管理）应用中，其固有的主动性、解释能力、目标导向性和动态记忆特性，与人类判断与控制的有效性存在根本矛盾，从而使其与现行国际治理框架（如GGE-CCW和REAIM）的要求不相容。作者认为，在当前及可预见的条件下，用于致命场景中数据融合和战斗管理的自主性AI应用无法在战场上被合理使用，并就此提出了两项国际治理建议。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM智能体正被整合到战场核心功能中，而现有的国际治理框架（如GGE-CCW和REAIM）建立在"人类判断与控制"这一核心原则之上。作者认为现有框架未能充分审视LLM智能体所带来的结构性挑战——即其运作特征本身可能使人类控制变得实质上无效，而非仅仅是形式上存在。
AI.method: 本文采用案例分析方法（use cases），具体分析LLM智能体在情报分析、数据融合和战场管理等任务中的运作机制，揭示其"主动性、解释能力、目标导向性和动态记忆"四大特征如何系统性地削弱人类决策者在杀伤链（kill chain）中的实质性控制能力。
AI.result: 研究结果表明：（1）LLM智能体因重新配置了主动性和解释权，实质性地排斥了人类决策者；（2）这种排斥使得其在致命场景中的应用与现有治理框架的要求不相容；（3）在数据融合和战斗管理等特定应用场景下，当前和可预见的条件下无法实现合理的战场部署。
AI.conclusion: 作者得出结论：应用于致命场景中数据融合和战斗管理的一类自主性AI应用，在现有及可预见的治理条件下，无法在战场上获得正当性使用依据。论文最后就国际治理社区如何应对这一挑战提出了两项具体建议。

title: Cross-Lingual Transfer and Parameter-Efficient Adaptation in the Turkic Language Family: A Theoretical Framework for Low-Resource Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have transformed natural language processing, yet their capabilities remain uneven across languages. Most multilingual models are trained primarily on high-resource languages, leaving many languages with large speaker populations underrepresented in both training data and evaluation benchmarks. This imbalance is particularly visible in the Turkic language family. This paper proposes a theoretical framework for studying cross-lingual transfer and parameter-efficient adaptation of multilingual LLMs within the Turkic language family, focusing on Azerbaijani, Kazakh, Uzbek, Turkmen, and Gagauz. These languages share substantial typological and morphological similarity while differing greatly in available digital resources, making them a natural setting for analyzing multilingual adaptation strategies. We integrate insights from multilingual representation learning and parameter-efficient fine-tuning techniques such as Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) to develop a conceptual scaling model describing how adaptation performance depends on model capacity, adaptation data size, and the expressivity of adaptation modules. To formalize transfer potential between related languages, we introduce the Turkic Transfer Coefficient (TTC), a theoretical measure incorporating morphological similarity, lexical overlap, syntactic structure, and script compatibility across Turkic languages. The framework highlights how typological similarity can enable efficient multilingual transfer while also identifying structural limits of parameter-efficient adaptation in extremely low-resource scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个理论框架，研究多语言LLM在突厥语族内的跨语言迁移和参数高效微调，通过分析阿塞拜疆语、哈萨克语、乌兹别克语、土库曼语和加告兹语这五种具有相似类型学特征但数字资源差异显著的语言，建立概念扩展模型描述适应性能与模型容量、适配数据规模和适配模块表达力之间的关系，并引入突厥迁移系数(TTC)来量化语言间的迁移潜力。
AI.motivation: 当前多语言LLM在不同语言间的能力分布极不均衡，突厥语族作为拥有大量使用人口但数字资源极度匮乏的语言家族，在训练数据和评估基准方面均严重不足，亟需理论框架指导跨语言迁移策略的设计。
AI.method: 整合多语言表示学习与参数高效微调技术（如LoRA），构建概念扩展模型量化模型容量、数据规模和适配模块表达力对适应性能的影响；提出突厥迁移系数(TTC)综合形态相似性、词汇重叠度、句法结构和文字兼容性四个维度量化语言间迁移潜力。
AI.result: 框架明确了类型学相似性如何实现高效多语言迁移，同时识别出极低资源场景下参数高效适配的结构性限制，为突厥语族语言的LLM适应提供了系统性指导。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用突厥语族内的高度类型学相似性，可设计高效的跨语言迁移策略；TTC系数为预测迁移效果提供了可量化的评估工具；但在极低资源条件下，参数高效适配仍面临不可逾越的性能边界。

title: BDI-Kit Demo: A Toolkit for Programmable and Conversational Data Harmonization
summary: Data harmonization remains a major bottleneck for integrative analysis due to heterogeneity in schemas, value representations, and domain-specific conventions. BDI-Kit provides an extensible toolkit for schema and value matching. It exposes two complementary interfaces tailored to different user needs: a Python API enabling developers to construct harmonization pipelines programmatically, and an AI-assisted chat interface allowing domain experts to harmonize data through natural language dialogue. This demonstration showcases how users interact with BDI-Kit to iteratively explore, validate, and refine schema and value matches through a combination of automated matching, AI-assisted reasoning, and user-driven refinement. We present two scenarios: (i) using the Python API to programmatically compose primitives, examine intermediate outputs, and reuse transformations; and (ii) conversing with the AI assistant in natural language to access BDI-Kit's capabilities and iteratively refine outputs based on the assistant's suggestions.

AI.tldr: BDI-Kit是一个用于模式和值匹配的可扩展工具包，提供Python API和AI辅助聊天界面两种接口，支持用户通过自动化匹配、AI辅助推理和用户驱动的改进来迭代探索、验证和优化数据协调结果。
AI.motivation: 数据协调是集成分析的主要瓶颈，因为不同数据源在模式、值表示和领域特定约定方面存在异构性，现有的数据协调方法缺乏灵活性和用户交互性。
AI.method: BDI-Kit采用双接口架构：(1) Python API允许开发者程序化构建协调流程；(2) AI聊天界面让领域专家通过自然语言对话进行数据协调。
AI.result: 演示展示了两个场景：(i) 使用Python API程序化组合基元、检查中间输出和复用转换；(ii) 通过AI助手进行自然语言对话，迭代改进输出。
AI.conclusion: BDI-Kit通过结合自动化匹配、AI辅助推理和用户驱动的验证，为异构数据的协调提供了灵活、可扩展的解决方案。

title: Asymptotic-Preserving Neural Networks for Viscoelastic Parameter Identification in Multiscale Blood Flow Modeling
summary: Mathematical models and numerical simulations offer a non-invasive way to explore cardiovascular phenomena, providing access to quantities that cannot be measured directly. In this study, we start with a one-dimensional multiscale blood flow model that describes the viscoelastic properties of arterial walls, and we focus on improving its practical applicability by addressing a major challenge: determining, in a reliable way, the viscoelastic parameters that control how arteries deform under pulsatile pressure. To achieve this, we employ Asymptotic-Preserving Neural Networks that embed the governing physical principles of the multiscale viscoelastic blood flow model within the learning procedure. This framework allows us to infer the viscoelastic parameters while simultaneously reconstructing the time-dependent evolution of the state variables of blood vessels. With this approach, pressure waveforms are estimated from readily accessible patient-specific data, i.e., cross-sectional area and velocity measurements from Doppler ultrasound, in vascular segments where direct pressure measurements are not available. Different numerical simulations, conducted in both synthetic and patient-specific scenarios, show the effectiveness of the proposed methodology.

AI.tldr: 本文将渐近保持神经网络（APNN）嵌入一维多尺度黏弹性血流模型，在训练中同时反演血管壁黏弹性参数（瞬时杨氏模量 E₀、弛豫时间 τ_r）并重建压力波形；仅用多普勒超声可测的血管截面积与轴向速度数据，即可推断不可直接测量的血管内压力波形。合成数据（主动脉弓）与三名健康志愿者颈总动脉在体数据均验证了该方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 1D 血流模型是计算效率与物理保真度之间的有效折中，但传统公式采用纯弹性管壁关系（tube law），忽略真实血管壁的黏弹性（滞回与耗散），会高估压力峰值。SLS（标准线性固体）黏弹性模型虽更真实，但其参数 E₀、E_∞、τ_r 无法在体直接测量，且该模型具有多尺度特性：随 τ_r→0 并按不同标度（η→0 的双曲标度、E₀→∞ 的扩散标度）分别退化为纯弹性双曲模型与 Kelvin–Voigt 抛物模型，这给传统数值方法与常规 PINN 带来困难（常规 PINN 在多尺度下可能无法恢复正确的渐近极限行为）。此外，非浅表血管的压力测量需有创手段，因此需要一种非侵入式手段从易测的截面积与速度数据反推压力。
AI.method: 1) 物理模型：轴对称截面积分三维不可压 Navier–Stokes 得守恒方程组（质量、动量）+ SLS 黏弹性本构方程；管壁函数 G(A)、F(A) 分别对动脉/静脉取不同形式；系统可写成拟线性形式，扩展 Jacobian 特征值为 u−c, 0, u+c，属双曲弛豫系统；E_∞ 由参考波速 c 反演校准（动脉/静脉不同公式），E₀ 与 τ_r 留作反演未知参数。2) 渐近极限分析：τ_r→0, η→0 得弹性双曲模型；τ_r→0, E₀→∞ 且 η∼τ_r E₀ 得 Kelvin–Voigt 抛物模型（动量方程附加粘性耗散项）。3) APNN 框架：将黏弹性本构方程残差乘以弛豫时间 τ_r 写成 R₃ = τ_r(∂p/∂t + E₀G(A)∂(Au)/∂x) + (p − F(A))，从而当 ε→0 时物理残差自动收敛到约化模型的残差，保证 AP 性质；所有方程无量纲化以保证梯度稳定。4) 网络与训练：全连接前馈网络，1 输入层 + 3 个 32 神经元隐藏层（tanh）+ 输出层；截面积输出经 softplus 保证 Â>0，速度与压力线性输出；ξ=(τ_r, E₀) 经指数变换保证严格为正并与网络权重 θ 用 Adam 联合优化（lr=1e-3，12×10⁶ epoch）；损失 L = ω_d^T L_d + ω_r^T L_r + ω_b^T L_b，权重 10/1/1；L_d 仅含测点的截面积与速度误差（无压力），L_r 在时空网格配点上用自动微分计算质量、动量、本构三个残差，L_b 含压力正性惩罚（|p̂|−p̂）与 t=0 处初始条件 A₀、p₀；不施加显式空间边界条件；配点采样经比较（均匀网格/固定随机/逐轮重采样/RAD）后选均匀网格以提高效率。5) 数据：合成数据集用三阶 AP IMEX Runge–Kutta + 有限体积 + 三阶 WENO + Dumbser–Osher-Toro 保路径守恒 Riemann 求解器求解上胸主动脉模型（入口时变流量 + 三元 Windkessel RCR 出口）；在体数据为 3 名健康志愿者右颈总动脉，B 模式超声（Chan–Vese 分割、形态学细化、中轴变换、欧氏距离变换求半径）测截面积，脉冲多普勒测速度（抛物线剖面 0.5 缩放系数），应用式压力计测压力（去趋势、ECG 对齐多周期平均、袖带血压标定），全部重采样至统一时间网格并归一化周期为 T=1 s。
AI.result: 合成主动脉弓测试：测点处平均百分比相对误差（PRE）面积 0.038%、速度 0.71%、压力 0.28%；全空间域 PRE 为面积 0.19%、速度 1.1%、压力 0.26%，速度误差在收缩期峰值附近及近端（近 17%）最大，远端降至约 5%；反演参数收敛但偏差中等（E₀ 12.73%、τ_r 20.84%），仍给出临床上最关心的压力曲线高精度结果。在体 CCA-A/B/C：测点面积 PRE 0.031%/0.031%/0.030%，速度 0.34%/0.60%/0.49%，压力（完全由物理项推断）3.5%/6.5%/5.7%，误差主要出现在收缩峰前的陡峭梯度与重搏切迹处；网络虽仅用单一测点的面积与速度训练，仍能重建沿全血管长度的时空分布（面积沿轴向递减、速度递增），物理上合理；E₀ 与 τ_r 收敛到与独立校准参考值同量级的稳定估计（参考值本身仅为生理近似，故差异不宜解读为严格识别误差）。
AI.conclusion: APNN 框架将多尺度黏弹性血流模型的物理规律与渐近一致性嵌入学习过程，可在不提供压力数据的情况下，从易获取的患者特异性截面积与速度数据非侵入式重建压力波形，并同时识别血管壁黏弹性参数；在合成与在体实验中均表现出高精度与物理自洽性，可作为非侵入式血流动力学评估的可靠、可解释工具。局限与展望：参数估计存在不可辨识性/偏差（E₀、τ_r 误差达 10–20%），压力在收缩陡峭段与重搏切迹处误差较大；未来将结合 MRI 等其他影像模态、拓展至不同血管段，并引入多保真框架与不确定性量化以处理生物医学数据固有的测量不确定性。

title: InfiniLoRA: Disaggregated Multi-LoRA Serving for Large Language Models
summary: LoRA enables efficient customization of LLMs and is widely used in multi-tenant and multi-task serving. However, emerging model architectures such as MoE significantly increase LoRA memory cost, making existing coupled LoRA serving designs poorly scalable and prone to tail-latency inflation. We present InfiniLoRA, a disaggregated LoRA serving system that decouples LoRA execution from base-model inference. InfiniLoRA introduces a shared LoRA Server with parallelism-aware execution, SLO-driven provisioning, and critical-path optimizations, including GPU-initiated communication and hardware-specialized LoRA kernels.
