Inspired by documentation-driven development, our strategy evaluates documentation quality by assessing an LLM's ability to understand and implement functionalities using the documentation, rather than by directly scoring it. This is measured through function-driven Question Answering (QA) tasks. SWD-Bench comprises three interconnected QA tasks: (1) Functionality Detection, to determine if a functionality is described; (2) Functionality Localization, to evaluate the accuracy of locating related files; and (3) Functionality Completion, to measure the comprehensiveness of implementation details. We construct the benchmark, containing 4,170 entries, by mining high-quality Pull Requests and enriching them with repository-level context. Experiments reveal limitations in current documentation generation methods and show that source code provides complementary value. Notably, documentation from the best-performing method improves the issue-solving rate of SWE-Agent by 20.00%, which demonstrates the practical value of high-quality documentation in supporting documentation-driven development.

AI.tldr: SWD-Bench是一个用于评估仓库级软件文档质量的新基准测试。它创新性地通过功能驱动的问答任务来评估文档质量，而非直接打分。基准包含4,170条数据，通过挖掘高质量Pull Requests并补充仓库级上下文构建。最佳文档生成方法能使SWE-Agent的问题解决率提升20%，证明了高质量文档在支持文档驱动开发方面的实用价值。
AI.motivation: 现有软件文档基准测试存在两大局限：(1)缺乏整体性的仓库级评估；(2)依赖不可靠的评估策略（如LLM-as-a-judge），该方法存在评判标准模糊、仓库级知识不足等问题。
AI.method: 受文档驱动开发启发，提出通过评估LLM能否利用文档理解和实现功能来间接衡量文档质量。构建包含三个关联QA任务的SWD-Bench：(1)功能检测——判断功能是否被描述；(2)功能定位——评估定位相关文件的准确性；(3)功能补全——衡量实现细节的完整性。基准通过挖掘高质量Pull Requests并补充仓库级上下文构建。
AI.result: 基准包含4,170条数据。实验揭示现有文档生成方法的局限性，并发现源代码具有互补价值。最佳文档方法使SWE-Agent的问题解决率提升20%。
AI.conclusion: SWD-Bench通过功能驱动的QA任务提供了新颖的仓库级文档评估范式，验证了高质量文档在支持文档驱动开发中的实际应用价值。

title: Better Balance in Informatics 2.0: The First-Year Students
summary: Diversity among computer scientists and technologists is necessary for the sustainable development of society through technological innovation. At UiT The Arctic University of Norway, only 13% of computer science students are women. Many find the learning curve in introductory computer science courses to be very steep, and thus, they drop out. Female students tend to be overrepresented in this group. The goal of this project was to improve the gender balance among computer science students at UiT by focusing on female first-year students and ensuring that they do not drop out of the study programs in the first year of study. The project established a seminar series for strengthening the basic programming-technical skills that many first-year students lack, and exposing them to different aspects and career paths within the computer science subject beyond the focus area of the study program. Results show positive developments, particularly related to the students' perceived introduction to basic technical topics. A comparison between 2024 and 2025 shows improvements in several of the areas addressed in the technical workshops, including use of file systems, terminals, debugging and the code development process. However, effects on dropout and study experience require more long-term measures.

AI.tldr: 本研究旨在通过为挪威北极大学（UiT）的计算机科学专业大一女生提供技术研讨会系列，提升该专业性别平衡并降低女生辍学率。研究表明，研讨会对学生掌握文件系统、终端、调试等基础技能有积极影响，但降低辍学率和改善学习体验需要更长期的措施。
AI.motivation: 挪威北极大学计算机科学专业女生仅占13%，且一年级课程的陡峭学习曲线导致较高的辍学率，女生在这一群体中占比过高。因此需要专门针对大一女生采取干预措施，帮助她们掌握基础知识并了解专业多元职业路径，从而提高留校率。
AI.method: 项目为大一女生建立了专题研讨会系列，重点加强编程技术基础技能培训，并展示计算机科学专业除主修方向外的多元面向与职业发展路径。通过对比2024年与2025年的数据进行效果评估。
AI.result: 研究结果显示积极进展，尤其是学生对基础技术主题的认知方面有明显改善。2024至2025年对比表明，文件系统、终端操作、调试及代码开发流程等方面的能力均有提升。然而，辍学率和整体学习体验的改善效果仍需更长期观察。
AI.conclusion: 短期技术研讨会能有效提升学生的基础技术能力，但在降低辍学率和改善学习体验方面需要建立长期综合干预机制。

title: TelcoAgent-Bench: A Multilingual Benchmark for Telecom AI Agents
summary: The integration of large language model (LLM) agents into telecom networks introduces new challenges, related to intent recognition, tool execution, and resolution generation, while taking into consideration different operational constraints. In this paper, we introduce TelcoAgent-Bench and TelcoAgent-Metrics, a Telecom-specific benchmarking framework for evaluating multilingual telecom LLM agents. The proposed framework assesses the semantic understanding as well as process-level alignment with structured troubleshooting flows and stability across repeated scenario variations. Our contribution includes a structured suite of metrics that assess intent recognition, ordered tool execution, resolution correctness, and stability across scenario variations, with the aim of quantifying the reliability and operational consistency of LLM agents in telecom environments. The framework is designed to operate in both English and Arabic, to address the need for multilingual agent deployment in operational network environments. Our experimental results show that although recent instruct-tuned models can understand telecom problems in a reasonable way, they usually struggle to consistently follow the required troubleshooting steps and to maintain stable behavior when exposed to different variations of the same scenario. This performance gap becomes more pronounced in unconstrained and bilingual settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向电信运维场景的多语言（英/阿）LLM智能体评测框架 TelcoAgent-Bench 与 TelcoAgent-Metrics：数据集含15个意图、49个蓝图、约1470条双语多轮对话与工具调用标注；评测指标包含意图识别准确率IRA、序列对齐分SAS（MSC×EAP）、解析准确率RA与蓝图可靠性BRS（GPC-0/GPC-1/SD加权）。在8个3–8B级SLM上的实验显示：语义理解与最终解决方案生成能力较好（IRA 0.66–0.93，RA 0.73–0.89），但严格遵循黄金排障流程的能力很弱（GPC-0几乎接近0，最高仅0.303），且阿拉伯语表现普遍低于英语、无候选标签与双语设定下差距进一步扩大。
AI.motivation: 电信网络运维正引入agentic AI，需要智能体理解复杂技术意图、推理网络状态、调用正确工具并生成可审计的解决方案，任何识别或执行失误都会带来直接运维后果。现有的AgentBench、GAIA、WebArena等通用智能体基准主要关注任务成功率、工具调用准确率与推理效率，属于领域无关型，无法刻画电信网络特有的要求：排障流程路径的一致性、与最优排障流的对齐度、以及在操作约束下的解决时效等。更重要的是，已有电信相关评测只问“能否回答电信问题”，而非“能否真正解决网络故障”。此外，电信网络普遍存在英/阿双语运维环境，需要能同时评估两种语言下智能体的意图理解、多轮对话一致性与结论可靠性的框架。
AI.method: （1）数据集TelcoAgent-Bench：构建模拟网络工程师与LLM智能体交互的蓝图驱动、双语、工具增强数据集。定义7大类共15个意图，每个意图绑定一条黄金排障流（如beam misalignment需coverage_map→recommend_param_change→create_ticket），并展开为3–5个带参数区间与约束的蓝图（如下行吞吐下降蓝图定义PRB利用率0.75–0.95、DL吞吐4–15 Mbps、BLER 0.02–0.07）；由蓝图采样生成N条对话实例（每个蓝图30条），总计49个蓝图、约1470条对话。每条样本含双语问题陈述、多轮双语对话、显式工具调用序列、对话轮到黄金步骤的flow alignment映射、以及含根因/纠正措施/工单的双语黄金摘要。护栏：KPI值严格落在蓝图区间内；工具调用必须遵循黄金顺序，偏离即标记剔除；仅允许预定义黄金函数，拒绝幻觉或越界工具。（2）工具环境：7个核心工具（oss_query、kpi_timeseries、recommend_param_change、create_ticket、push_config、neighbor_audit、coverage_map）与6个干扰工具（subscriber_insight、device_cap_lookup、sla_policy_fetch、traffic_forecast、complaint_trend_analy、spectrum_license_info）混合。（3）指标TelcoAgent-Metrics：IRA用句嵌入余弦相似度对自由文本意图描述与蓝图意图标签打分（非固定标签分类）；SAS=MSC×EAP，其中MSC为智能体工具序列与黄金路径的最长公共子序列长度对黄金路径长度归一化，EAP=1−max(0,n−m)/n惩罚冗余工具；RA为智能体摘要与黄金摘要的余弦相似度；BRS为蓝图级可靠性，由GPC-0（精确一致比例）、GPC-1（Levenshtein距离≤1的比例）、SD（样本对之间平均归一化Levenshtein距离，越低越稳定）加权组合，且α1>α2>α3以强调严格遵循黄金路径。评测从工程师的首条问题陈述出发，不回放合成对话，要求模型自主生成工具调用序列与最终解决方案。（4）实验：8个指令微调SLM（Llama-3-8B、Qwen-2.5-7B、Granite-3.1-MoE-3B、Granite-3.3-8B、Gemma-3-4B、Qwen-3-8B、Qwen-7B、Mistral-7B），在英语/阿拉伯语、有无候选意图列表（W/ List、W/o List）两种设定下测试。
AI.result: IRA方面，W/ List设定下所有模型均优于W/o List，说明显式意图分类体系能显著提升对齐；英语普遍优于阿拉伯语，差距在小型模型与MoE架构上更明显（如Granite-3.1-MoE-3B：En 0.812/Ar 0.669），反映模型在电信专业术语上的多语能力不足。SAS方面存在明显权衡：Qwen-7B的MSC最高（En 0.799、Ar 0.835）但EAP极低（0.367/0.361），说明大量冗余/无关工具调用；Qwen-2.5-7B（EAP 0.959）与Gemma-3-4B（0.959/0.958）严格约束工具、几乎不碰干扰项，但MSC偏低而漏掉必要步骤；Granite-3.3-8B取得最高综合SAS（En 0.644、Ar 0.623），在覆盖必要步骤与避免多余调用间最均衡。BRS方面，多数模型GPC-0几乎为0（Granite-3.3-8B最高，En 0.303/Ar 0.301；其余多在0.00–0.15），表明现有模型难以严格遵循预定义工具流；Granite-3.3-8B的GPC-1（0.451/0.444）与BRS（0.468/0.462）同样最优；SD高者（如Granite-3.1-MoE-3B，SD 0.644/0.544）BRS显著更低，体现动作序列不稳定。RA方面所有模型均较高（En 0.823–0.886，Ar 0.733–0.847），Granite-3.3-8B英语最佳（0.886），Gemma-3-4B阿拉伯语最佳（0.847）；这说明即使中间工具选择或执行顺序出错，模型仍能产出结构良好的最终摘要，即高RA并不等价于流程正确。总体：语义理解与结论生成尚可，流程遵从性与跨情景重复一致性是主要短板，在无候选标签与双语设定下差距更明显。
AI.conclusion: TelcoAgent-Bench与TelcoAgent-Metrics提供了一个电信专用、多语言的智能体评测套件，把评测重点从“能否回答问题”转向“能否真正解决网络故障”，同时考察语义理解、排障流程对齐与蓝图级稳定性，填补了通用智能体基准在电信领域的过程可靠性与一致性度量空白。实验表明先进指令微调模型具备较强的语义理解能力并能部分逼近黄金排障流，但仍难以严格遵守结构化执行路径、在场景变体下保持稳定行为，且阿拉伯语与无约束设定下性能进一步下滑，因此需要面向电信领域适配的双语智能体。作者指出当前评测尚未建模完整闭环运维推理（智能体解释工具输出、实施配置变更并重新评估网络行为再给出最终结论），该局限留作未来工作。

title: AgentGate: A Lightweight Structured Routing Engine for the Internet of Agents
summary: The rapid development of AI agent systems is leading to an emerging Internet of Agents, where specialized agents operate across local devices, edge nodes, private services, and cloud platforms. Although recent efforts have improved agent naming, discovery, and interaction, efficient request dispatch remains an open systems problem under latency, privacy, and cost constraints. In this paper, we present AgentGate, a lightweight structured routing engine for candidate-aware agent dispatch. Instead of treating routing as unrestricted text generation, AgentGate formulates it as a constrained decision problem and decomposes it into two stages: action decision and structural grounding. The first stage determines whether a query should trigger single-agent invocation, multi-agent planning, direct response, or safe escalation, while the second stage instantiates the selected action into executable outputs such as target agents, structured arguments, or multi-step plans. To adapt compact models to this setting, we further develop a routing-oriented fine-tuning scheme with candidate-aware supervision and hard negative examples. Experiments on a curated routing benchmark with several 3B--7B open-weight models show that compact models can provide competitive routing performance in constrained settings, and that model differences are mainly reflected in action prediction, candidate selection, and structured grounding quality. These results indicate that structured routing is a feasible design point for efficient and privacy-aware agent systems, especially when routing decisions must be made under resource-constrained deployment conditions.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 AgentGate：一个面向"智能体互联网"（AgentDNS/A2H 生态）的轻量级结构化路由引擎。它把代理请求分发从"自由文本生成"重新定义为"候选感知的受约束决策问题"，并分解为两阶段——Stage I 动作决策（在单代理调用 CALL_AGENT、多代理规划 MULTI_AGENT_PLAN、直接回复 DIRECT_ANSWER、安全升级 ESCALATE 四类动作中择一）与 Stage II 结构化落地（生成目标代理、符合 schema 的参数集或有序多步计划），配合以置信度 γ_eff=min(γ_act,γ_str) 为依据的边缘—云自适应后端选择、动作侧安全/词法启发式、候选元数据匹配恢复与槽位补全，以及带硬负例的候选感知 LoRA 微调。在 3,200 条自建 AgentDNS 运行时基准（2400/400/400）上，用 Qwen2.5-3B/7B、Mistral-7B、Llama2-7B、Phi-3.5-mini 等 3B–7B 开源权重模型、单张 RTX 5090 微调评测：Qwen2.5-7B 取得最均衡结果（动作 0.9425、参数 EM 0.9325、升级 P/R 均为 1.0），优于规则基线、检索排序基线与通用工具调用基线；消融显示微调收益主要体现在参数精确匹配而非粗粒度动作判断；系统侧第二阶段结构化落地是主要延迟来源，混合边缘—云策略目前因回退过于激进而近似退化为纯云。结论是：在资源受限的边缘部署条件下，带显式输出约束与硬负例设计的结构化路由是可行且有前景的工程落点。
AI.motivation: AI 智能体系统快速发展，正形成跨本地设备、边缘节点、私有服务与云平台的"智能体互联网"。已有的 AgentDNS 解决了智能体命名/注册/发现，A2H 等协议规范了人机交互，但"请求该由谁处理"这一中间层路由问题仍被忽视：在边缘侧部署路由时，若以强云端 LLM 作为默认路由器，会把每个请求都置于远程模型关键路径，带来额外延迟、重复 API 成本与更广的数据暴露；若只用紧凑本地模型，则在歧义/长尾路由上能力不足。同时，现有多智能体框架普遍假设强中心模型编排全部过程，把路由当作无约束文本生成，而实际部署中许多请求只需在候选代理集合上做一次受约束决策（调用单个代理、生成多步计划、直接回复、或因安全/授权而中止）。因此需要一个可本地运行、具备可执行输出与边界感知能力的结构化路由引擎，并支持对难例的"有原则的升级"。
AI.method: 问题形式化：边缘侧可访问注册表 C（每个代理 c_i = ⟨n_i, d_i, A_i⟩，含名称、能力描述、调用参数 schema），轻量检索给出候选子集 C_sub；路由输入 x = ⟨q, C_sub, s⟩（s 为可选上下文），输出 o = ⟨y, ĉ, Ω, Π, r, γ⟩，其中 y∈{y_call, y_plan, y_direct, y_escalate}、ĉ 为目标代理、Ω 为参数集、Π 为有序多步计划、r 为可选理由/直接回复、γ 为置信度；并给出动作依赖的可执行部分 Exec(o) 与训练目标（最大化结构化输出的条件似然，分解为 p(y|x)·p(ĉ,Ω,Π,r,γ|x,y)）。架构上，AgentGate 采用边缘优先（edge-first）与置信度感知（confidence-aware）的两阶段流水线：Stage I 用模板 Φ_act 预测动作、理由与 γ_act，若为 direct/escalate 则直接短路终止；Stage II 以动作 y* 为条件，用 Φ_str 生成 ĉ/Ω/Π 与 γ_str，并受"候选一致性与 schema 合法性"约束（等价于 argmax p(ĉ,Ω,Π|x,y*)）。有效置信度 γ_eff = min(γ_act, γ_str)（direct/escalate 时取 γ_act），阈值 τ 决定使用边缘模型 b_edge 还是回退到更强的远端云模型 b_cloud；论文明确区分"任务级安全升级"与"推理级后端回退"。启发式兜底：(1) 动作侧保护——敏感/未授权词触发 escalate，顺序性词（first/then/after that）且 |C_sub|≥2 触发 plan，Stage I 失败时按候选非空触发 call、否则 direct；(2) 候选恢复——基于代理元数据 token 的启发式相关性 S(c_i,q)（含人工语义提示权重 λ）取 argmax；(3) 槽位补全——用正则/轻量规则从查询中抽取 time/location/entity/numeric 等槽位填补 Ω。训练方面构建路由导向 SFT 数据集 D_route，四类样本（单代理调用、多代理规划、直接回退、安全升级）并加入难负例（误导性顺序措辞、语义重叠候选、似可执行但应回退/升级的歧义请求）；损失仅在目标输出 token 上计算（不监督 prompt），采用 LoRA 参数高效微调以保持边缘可部署性。实验：自建 3,200 条 AgentDNS 运行时基准（2,400 训练/400 验证/400 测试），覆盖外卖、打车、住宿、天气、餐厅预订、 grocery、电影票、快递、机票、日历等域且含部分重叠候选；指标为动作准确率、代理准确率、参数精确匹配、计划精确匹配、JSON 有效性与升级的精确率/召回率；对比规则基线、检索-排序基线、通用 LLM 工具调用基线，并比较 5 个 3B–7B 开源骨干；另做微调消融、系统延迟/吞吐/显存测量与 50 样本真实混合边缘—云实验。
AI.result: 1) 范式对比（agentdns_runtime）：Rule-based 动作 0.7400/代理 0.7650/参数EM 0.7450/计划EM 0.7800/升级 P=0、R=0；Retrieve-rank 0.9250/0.9225/0.8600/0.8025/1.0/0.8；Tool-Calling(Qwen2.5-7B) 仅 0.2400/0.4600/0.4600/0.8600/0.2400/1.0（JSON 合法但路由质量最差）；AgentGate(Qwen2.5-7B) 0.9425/0.8800/0.9325/0.8075/1.0/1.0。2) 骨干对比：Phi-3.5-mini 动作/代理最佳（0.9625/0.9300），Qwen2.5-7B 最均衡且升级 P/R 满分，Qwen2.5-3B 明显偏弱（代理 0.7025、升级召回 0.4800），Mistral-7B（代理 0.2425）与 Llama2-7B（动作 0.4500、升级精确率 0.2475）在运行环境下最不可靠。3) 微调消融（两阶段探针）：微调并不一致提升动作/代理准确率，多个强骨干基座已达 0.9844；增益主要体现在参数精确匹配与输出格式规整性（schema 对齐）。4) 系统性能（20 样本探针，单卡离线推理）：Qwen2.5-7B 路线延迟 3159.5 ms、QPS 0.317、显存 14.56 GiB，综合最优；Qwen2.5-3B 延迟 3531.5 ms、显存最小 5.99 GiB；Llama2-7B 延迟 8329.8 ms、QPS 0.120，明显不适合部署；第二阶段选择/落地模块占延迟主开销。5) 混合边缘—云（50 样本，云端后端为 MiniMax M2.5）：edge-only Qwen2.5-7B 动作 1.0/代理 0.94/参数EM 0.94/计划EM 0.86/升级 1.0/1.0；hybrid 模式下 7B、3B、Mistral 结果几乎一致（0.98/0.94/0.90/0.86/1.0/0.9167），说明强制回退设置下混合策略几乎退化为纯云后端。
AI.conclusion: 论文结论：把智能体路由形式化为带显式输出约束的结构化决策问题，并分解为"动作决策 + 结构化落地"两阶段，可行且可解释；在候选感知监督与严格输出约束下，3B–7B 级小模型能胜任边缘侧结构化路由，各模型差异主要体现在动作预测、候选选择与结构化落地质量三方面；严格的输出约束与硬负例设计是提升路由可靠性的关键。实验同时暴露两个待改进点：混合边缘—云策略的瓶颈已不在"能否接入云回退"，而在回退触发条件与置信度校准（当前过于激进导致退化为云-only）；第二阶段结构化落地是系统延迟与吞吐的主要开销来源。后续工作方向包括扩展到更动态、更广泛的智能体环境，评估端到端执行性能与真实边缘部署下的系统级效率，并对 confidence-aware 回退策略做 Pareto 优化。需要注意的表述瑕疵：正文以 "Manuscript received April 19, 2021" 的模板信息标注了时间，正文中式编号等明显为模板残留；另外表 IV 中"路线延迟"与"动作延迟 + 选择延迟"之和在数值上不自洽，Plan EM 在多个基线间取值高度雷同（0.80–0.86），部分指标与样本规模（如 400 条测试集上的 0.9231 精确率、400 样本 vs 20/50 样本探针混用）也提示评测口径需谨慎解读。

title: BiScale-GTR: Fragment-Aware Graph Transformers for Multi-Scale Molecular Representation Learning
summary: Graph Transformers have recently attracted attention for molecular property prediction by combining the inductive biases of graph neural networks (GNNs) with the global receptive field of Transformers. However, many existing hybrid architectures remain GNN-dominated, causing the resulting representations to remain heavily shaped by local message passing. Moreover, most existing methods operate at only a single structural granularity, limiting their ability to capture molecular patterns that span multiple molecular scales. We introduce BiScale-GTR, a unified framework for self-supervised molecular representation learning that combines chemically grounded fragment tokenization with adaptive multi-scale reasoning. Our method improves graph Byte Pair Encoding (BPE) tokenization to produce consistent, chemically valid, and high-coverage fragment tokens, which are used as fragment-level inputs to a parallel GNN-Transformer architecture. Architecturally, atom-level representations learned by a GNN are pooled into fragment-level embeddings and fused with fragment token embeddings before Transformer reasoning, enabling the model to jointly capture local chemical environments, substructure-level motifs, and long-range molecular dependencies. Experiments on MoleculeNet, PharmaBench, and the Long Range Graph Benchmark (LRGB) demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across both classification and regression tasks. Attribution analysis further shows that BiScale-GTR highlights chemically meaningful functional motifs, providing interpretable links between molecular structure and predicted properties. Code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: BiScale-GTR是一个用于自监督分子表示学习的统一框架，结合了化学启发的片段分词和自适应多尺度推理，通过并行GNN-Transformer架构在分子性质预测任务上取得了最先进的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有图Transformer混合架构仍以GNN为主导，导致表示受限于局部消息传递；同时大多数方法仅在单一结构粒度上操作，难以捕获跨越多个分子尺度的分子模式。
AI.method: 改进图BPE分词生成一致、化学有效、高覆盖率的片段标记；采用并行GNN-Transformer架构，将原子级表示池化为片段级嵌入后与片段标记嵌入融合，经Transformer推理，实现局部化学环境、子结构级基序和长程分子依赖的联合捕获。
AI.result: 在MoleculeNet、PharmaBench和LRGB数据集上的分类和回归任务均达到最优性能。归因分析表明BiScale-GTR能突出化学有意义的官能团基序，提供分子结构与预测性质之间的可解释链接。
AI.conclusion: BiScale-GTR通过化学启发的片段分词与自适应多尺度推理的结合，有效解决了现有方法在分子表示学习中的粒度局限性问题，显著提升了分子性质预测的准确性和可解释性。

title: REAgent: Requirement-Driven LLM Agents for Software Issue Resolution
summary: Issue resolution aims to automatically generate patches from given issue descriptions and has attracted significant attention with the rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs). However, due to the complexity of software issues and codebases, LLM-generated patches often fail to resolve corresponding issues. Although various advanced techniques have been proposed with carefully designed tools and workflows, they typically treat issue descriptions as direct inputs and largely overlook their quality (e.g., missing critical context or containing ambiguous information), which hinders LLMs from accurate understanding and resolution. To address this limitation, we draw on principles from software requirements engineering and propose REAgent, a requirement-driven LLM agent framework that introduces issue-oriented requirements as structured task specifications to better guide patch generation. Specifically, REAgent automatically constructs structured and information-rich issue-oriented requirements, identifies low-quality requirements, and iteratively refines them to improve patch correctness. We conduct comprehensive experiments on three widely used benchmarks using two advanced LLMs, comparing against five representative or state-of-the-art baselines. The results demonstrate that REAgent consistently outperforms all baselines, achieving an average improvement of 17.40% in terms of the number of successfully-resolved issues (% Resolved).

AI.tldr: REAgent 是一个"需求驱动"的LLM智能体框架：借鉴软件需求工程思想，把原始issue描述自动加工成结构化、信息丰富的"面向issue的需求（issue-oriented requirements）"，并通过测试执行间接评估需求质量（RAS分数）、对低质量需求做分类（冲突/遗漏/歧义）迭代精化，从而显著提升仓库级issue修复的成功率——在3个SWE-bench基准、2个LLM上共6种设置下均优于5个代表性/SOTA基线，% Resolved平均提升17.40%。
AI.motivation: 仓库级issue修复的瓶颈不仅在模型能力与推理流程，更在"被解决对象"本身的质量：现有方法（Agentless、SWE-agent、Trae-agent等）直接把issue描述当作精确实现规格使用，隐含假设其准确反映编程需求。实际上issue多由用户/开发者用自然语言写成，用于人际沟通而非精确实现规范，常缺失关键上下文且表述含糊（例如超过70%的issue缺少复现步骤或验证标准），非结构化自然语言也导致解释主观不一致；而LLM对输入质量高度敏感，从而妨碍其准确理解与修复。论文以django__django-16642为动机示例：issue未说明.Z文件在mimetypes.guess_type()中对应的编码，模型误将编码名当作"Z"而生成错误补丁；而结构化需求补全出"'application/x-compress' for .Z files"后即得到正确补丁。因此作者提出以需求工程的原则（多视角结构化要素：背景、功能目标、环境、行为约束、可验证成功准则）构造面向issue的结构化需求作为任务规格。同时该方向面临三大挑战：(1)散落在多文件多模块中的issue相关信息难以收集与组织；(2)自然语言结构化需求缺乏形式语义，质量难以自动评估；(3)需求语义空间巨大且缺乏可执行反馈，缺陷根因难以定位与修复。
AI.method: REAgent包含三个组件。(1)需求生成（Requirement Generation）：需求生成智能体在Docker容器中借助文件检索/浏览/代码分析等工具模拟程序理解过程，沿程序依赖迭代检索issue相关上下文，并依据预定义的9个一级需求属性与17个二级属性（Background：Main Functionality/Main Modules；Problem Overview：Core Description/Problem Coverage；Steps to Reproduce：Preconditions/Key Conditions/Reproduction Commands；Actual Behavior：Erroneous/Correct Behavior；Expected Behavior：Ideal Behavior/Success Criteria；Environment：Dependencies and Imports；Root Cause Analysis：Error Cause/Code Paths；Solution：Modification Location/Modification Content/Impact Scope；Additional Notes）输出结构化需求。(2)需求评估（Requirement Assessment）：需求评估智能体基于需求生成初始补丁，并独立生成10个测试脚本（基于Reproduction Commands与Success Criteria的复现测试、结合Correct Behavior与既有回归测试精化的回归测试），采用高温采样与多数投票；以补丁通过测试脚本的比例定义需求评估分数RAS∈[0,1]，RAS=1.0即严格接受并输出该补丁，否则转入精化。(3)需求精化（Requirement Refinement）：需求分析智能体借鉴IEEE 830把需求缺陷归为Conflict（与issue描述不一致）、Omission（缺失issue中的关键信息）、Ambiguity（表述含糊）三类，可多标签，针对每类设计定制化精化策略并生成可执行反馈；迭代采用贪心优化策略，按RAS选取最优候选需求并将反馈回灌需求生成智能体，未改进的反馈被记录为反例以引导后续调整；迭代上限N达到时输出RAS最高需求对应的补丁。实验设置：DeepSeek-V3.2与Qwen-Plus，patch生成温度0.1、需求/精化/测试生成温度0.5，最大迭代数N=4，最大交互轮数50；基准为SWE-bench Lite、Verified、Pro各采样100实例（Pro排除Python相关问题），指标为% Applied、% Resolved、输入/输出token与$ Cost。基线含BM25 Retrieval、Agentless、Trae-agent（关闭test-time scaling）以及改造到仓库级的函数级需求方法ArchCode、Specine（均结合BM25检索）。
AI.result: RQ1：在全部6种设置（2 LLM × 3基准）下REAgent均最优。DeepSeek-V3.2上：SWE-Lite 75%/37%、SWE-Verified 83%/46%、SWE-Pro 75%/21%（% Applied/% Resolved），最佳基线为Trae-agent的28%、Agentless/Trae-agent的35%与Trae-agent的11%；Qwen-Plus上：85%/24%、80%/32%、70%/15%。相对基线% Resolved提升9.17%~24.83%（平均17.40%），% Applied提升22.17%~49.50%；Wilcoxon符号秩检验p<2.5×10⁻⁴。REAgent还取得最多的"唯一解决"实例（Venn图），互补性强；数据泄漏排查显示仅2个补丁与黄金补丁文本完全相同，且人工核查确认无reward hacking。效率上REAgent开销最高（DeepSeek输入5.13M token、$1.474；Qwen 3.21M、$0.386），与ArchCode相当但优于Trae-agent的性价比。RQ2：N从1增至10时所有方法均提升，REAgent各设置下均领先（% Resolved平均领先6.33%~26.00%），且从N=1到N=10自身% Resolved平均提升10.67%（基线仅4.00%~6.33%）；极端对比中REAgent(N=1，$0.510，25.67%)仍优于所有基线N=10（Agentless 24.00%/$0.577、Specine 10.67%/$1.029、ArchCode 13.00%/$1.503）。RQ3消融：REAgent全面优于woRM（用BM25替代需求建模策略，% Resolved平均-9.50%）、woRA（去除结构化属性，-3.33%）、woA（用LLM-as-a-judge替代测试执行评估，-7.67%，表现最差）、woR（用测试执行反馈替代需求精化，-2.33%），p<2.5×10⁻⁴。测试质量分析：REAgent生成的测试脚本正确率23.44%~46.41%（Base仅12.97%），且随N增加持续提升（N=4比N=1平均高22.98%）。
AI.conclusion: 论文的结论是：任务输入（issue规格）的质量是仓库级issue修复的关键瓶颈，通过引入结构化、信息丰富的"面向issue的需求"作为中间任务规格，可以系统性提升补丁正确性。REAgent以需求生成—评估（RAS）—精化（冲突/遗漏/歧义三类缺陷）的闭环，在三个主流基准、两个先进LLM上稳定超越五个代表性/SOTA基线，且与现有agent式/工作流式方法在方法论上正交，可作为前置预处理模块与之结合。作者同时承认局限：LLM生成测试仍不够可靠（约一半测试不完美）、token与成本开销偏高、迭代次数固定。后续方向包括覆盖引导与类型检查增强的测试生成、上下文压缩等高效上下文管理、以及基于反馈的自适应迭代策略。

title: Are LLMs Ready for Computer Science Education? A Cross-Domain, Cross-Lingual and Cognitive-Level Evaluation Using Professional Certification Exams
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly applied in computer science education for tasks such as tutoring, content generation, and code assessment. However, systematic evaluations aligned with formal curricula and certification standards remain limited. This study benchmarked four recent models, including GPT-5, DeepSeek-R1, Qwen-Plus, and Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct, using a dataset of 1,068 questions derived from six certification exams covering networking, office applications, and Java programming.
  We evaluated performance across language (Chinese vs. English), cognitive levels based on Bloom's Taxonomy, domain knowledge, confidence-accuracy alignment, and robustness to input masking. Results showed that GPT-5 performed best on English-language certifications, while Qwen-Plus performed better in Chinese contexts. DeepSeek-R1 achieved the most balanced cross-lingual performance, whereas Llama-3.3 showed clear limitations in higher-order reasoning and robustness. All models performed worse on more complex tasks.
  These findings provide empirical support for the integration of LLMs into computer science education and offer practical implications for curriculum design and assessment.

AI.tldr: 本文以六项国际与国内计算机职业资格考试（CCNA、ICDL、OCJP、NCRE Office/Java、中国网络工程师）的 1,068 道纯文本选择题为基准，测评 GPT-5、DeepSeek-R1、Qwen-Plus、Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct 四个 2025 年末主流 LLM 在计算机网络、办公软件与 Java 编程三大领域的表现，覆盖中英双语对比（用 DeepSeek-V3 双向翻译构建平行语料）、基于 Bloom 修订版_taxonomy 的高阶/低阶认知分层、领域与子主题细分、置信度—准确率校准以及输入掩蔽扰动鲁棒性五个维度，并用 Bootstrap(1,000 次)给出 95% 置信区间。结论：GPT-5 在英文/国际认证上最强且抗扰动与高阶推理表现最佳；Qwen-Plus 在中文本土考试上领先并具明显中文偏好；DeepSeek-R1 跨语言/跨域最均衡稳定；Llama-3.3 在高阶推理与鲁棒性上存在明显短板（高阶题掉 28.7 分、60% 掩蔽掉 31.4 分）。所有模型在高阶认知任务上普遍退化。
AI.motivation: LLM 已被大量用于计算机科学教育（自动辅导、题目生成、代码评改），但既有评测多依赖 MMLU、GSM8K、HumanEval 等通用基准，或只报告编程题通过率，缺乏与正式课程体系、技能层级和标准化职业认证考试对齐的系统性评估，指标也往往单一。作者希望用真实的高利害认证考试作为测试床，检验这些模型是否真正"准备好"承担 CS 教学任务，并回答两个研究问题：RQ1——不同类型 CS 教育测评（语言、领域、认知层级）下模型表现是否存在系统性差异；RQ2——模型输出的鲁棒性与可靠性如何（置信度校准与对输入扰动的敏感性）。
AI.method: 构建 1,068 道纯文本多选题库（源自 CCNA、ICDL、OCJP、NCRE MS Office、NCRE Java 二级、中国网络工程师六项认证的官方考纲与能力标准，剔除图片题）；通过官方 API 以零样本、无微调方式调用四个模型，施加与题型匹配的"领域专家角色"系统提示并强制 JSON 结构化输出（答案字母、≤100 词解释、1–5 置信度、高/低阶分类、分类置信度），多选题按与官方答案完全匹配计分、不给部分分。跨语言部分用 DeepSeek-V3 以专业翻译提示词双向（中→英、英→中）构建平行语料并人工校验。认知分层由四个模型独立按 Bloom 修订版_taxonomy 判定，取至少 3 票一致，剔除 2:2 平票（剔除率约 19.5%，保留 860 题，其中高阶 36、低阶 824）；另用 5 点 Likert 让四模型评估难度主观量。扰动实验对题干做轻量分词（中文按字、英文按词）后按比例 r∈{0.0,0.2,0.4,0.6} 均匀随机无放回掩蔽为 "[MASK]"，选项不变。统计采用 Bootstrap(1,000 次重采样) 的 95% 百分位置信区间，模型间难度评分一致性用 Krippendorff's α（含缺失处理）。
AI.result: 1) 六项考试总体：GPT-5 在 CCNA 93.2%、ICDL 94.5%、中国网络工程师 90.3%、OCJP 77.8% 居首；Qwen-Plus 在 NCRE Java 96.5% 最高、NCRE Office 92.6% 与 DeepSeek-R1 并列；DeepSeek-R1 六项均排前二（89.5%–94.0%）；Llama-3.3 在五项垫底，与最优差距 5.5–16.0 个百分点（OCJP 仅 61.8%）。OCJP 难度最高（平均 71.5%），各模型相对 NCRE Java 下滑 15.7–24.3 分，说明难度差异非纯语言因素。2) 跨语言：GPT-5 最稳健（原文→译文仅降 0.6 分，平均绝对波动约 0.6 分），DeepSeek-R1 降 1.3 分，Llama-3.3 降 1.1 分，Qwen-Plus 反而提升 2.3 分，因其英→中方向大幅提升 5.0 分（83.0%→88.0%）且中→英方向近乎不变（92.6%→92.4%），呈显著中文偏好；中→英方向所有模型下降幅度均很小（0.2–1.3 分）。3) 领域/子主题：Java OOP 上 Qwen-Plus 在 NCRE 题集 96.3% 而 OCJP 题集仅 GPT-5 84.6% vs Llama-3.3 59.0%；Office OS 子主题 Qwen-Plus 在 MS Office 题集 95.5% 但 ICDL 题集仅 79.0%，Llama-3.3 呈反向模式（ICDL 89.5% vs MS Office 79.6%），提示训练数据与优化偏好的领域偏置；网络工程中 Llama-3.3 在 CCNA IP 连通性仅 71.4%，其余三者 85.7%–95.2%。4) 认知层级：全部模型高阶显著劣于低阶——GPT-5 86.1% vs 91.9%（差 5.8 分），DeepSeek-R1 72.2% vs 90.0%，Qwen-Plus 75.0% vs 90.0%，Llama-3.3 55.6% vs 84.3%（差 28.7 分，最大）。5) 置信度校准：置信度与准确率正相关，GPT-5 L5 达 94.2%、Qwen-Plus 92.4%、DeepSeek-R1 92.0%、Llama-3.3 87.5%；Llama-3.3 过度保守，绝大多数答案落在 L3（1008 条，80.9%），仅 56 条给 L5，妨碍高利害场景的阈值筛选。6) 掩蔽鲁棒性：GPT-5 从 90.4% 降至 74.8%（-15.6 分）最佳，DeepSeek-R1 -21.9 分，Qwen-Plus -24.0 分，Llama-3.3 -31.4 分（20% 掩蔽即降 11.0 分）最脆弱。7) 主观难度评分一致性低：总体 Krippendorff's α=0.13（各类 -0.16 至 0.17），但四模型对题库相对难度排序一致（OCJP 最难、办公最易）。
AI.conclusion: 四个 2025 年末 LLM 在标准化认证考题上整体已具较高准确率，但能力高度异质：GPT-5 跨条件最稳健（英文域、校准、掩蔽韧性、高阶推理均为最优），Qwen-Plus 是中文教学场景的优选，DeepSeek-R1 是跨语言/跨域最均衡的"安全"选项，Llama-3.3 存在持续的"推理鸿沟"与输入碎片敏感，不宜承担高阶与高利害任务。因此将 LLM 引入 CS 教育应采取上下文依赖的谨慎策略：以域匹配和语言匹配选型，用置信度阈值过滤与人工监督兜底，避免在 Bloom 高阶（分析、评价、创造）目标上过度依赖模型，并优先部署抗扰动模型于真实课堂噪声环境。作者同时指出局限：仅覆盖三域、仅多选题、缺少人类基准对照、单轮静态交互、平行语料依赖自动翻译；未来应扩展域覆盖、引入开放题与生成式/交互式评测、引入人类参照、开展纵向课堂研究，并通过 CoT 提示工程与领域自适应预训练弥合开源与闭源差距。

title: Distributional Open-Ended Evaluation of LLM Cultural Value Alignment Based on Value Codebook
summary: As LLMs are globally deployed, aligning their cultural value orientations is critical for safety and user engagement. However, existing benchmarks face the Construct-Composition-Context ($C^3$) challenge: relying on discriminative, multiple-choice formats that probe value knowledge rather than true orientations, overlook subcultural heterogeneity, and mismatch with real-world open-ended generation. We introduce DOVE, a distributional evaluation framework that directly compares human-written text distributions with LLM-generated outputs. DOVE utilizes a rate-distortion variational optimization objective to construct a compact value-codebook from 10K documents, mapping text into a structured value space to filter semantic noise. Alignment is measured using unbalanced optimal transport, capturing intra-cultural distributional structures and sub-group diversity. Experiments across 12 LLMs show that DOVE achieves superior predictive validity, attaining a 31.56% correlation with downstream tasks, while maintaining high reliability with as few as 500 samples per culture.

AI.tldr: DOVE是一个分布评估框架，通过比较人类写作文本分布与LLM生成输出来评估LLM的文化价值观对齐程度，解决了现有基准测试在构造-组合-上下文方面的挑战。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM在全球范围内的部署，文化价值观对齐对安全性和用户参与度至关重要。然而现有基准测试面临C³挑战：依赖辨别性多项选择格式（只能探测知识而非真正取向）、忽视亚文化异质性、以及与现实世界开放式生成任务不匹配。
AI.method: DOVE采用率-失真变分优化目标，从10K文档构建紧凑的价值码本，将文本映射到结构化价值空间以过滤语义噪声。使用非平衡最优传输测量对齐度，捕捉文化内部分布结构和亚群体多样性。
AI.result: 在12个LLM上的实验表明，DOVE实现优越的预测有效性，与下游任务达到31.56%的相关性，同时仅需每种文化500个样本即可保持高可靠性。
AI.conclusion: DOVE框架为LLM文化价值观对齐评估提供了更准确、更高效的方法，能够捕捉文化内部异质性并与真实世界场景更好对齐。

title: ATANT: An Evaluation Framework for AI Continuity
comment: 7 pages, 8 tables. Framework and evaluation protocol available at https://github.com/Kenotic-Labs/ATANT
summary: We present ATANT (Automated Test for Acceptance of Narrative Truth), an open evaluation framework for measuring continuity in AI systems: the ability to persist, update, disambiguate, and reconstruct meaningful context across time. While the AI industry has produced memory components (RAG pipelines, vector databases, long context windows, profile layers), no published framework formally defines or measures whether these components produce genuine continuity. We define continuity as a system property with 7 required properties, introduce a 10-checkpoint evaluation methodology that operates without an LLM in the evaluation loop, and present a narrative test corpus of 250 stories comprising 1,835 verification questions across 6 life domains. We evaluate a reference implementation across 5 test suite iterations, progressing from 58% (legacy architecture) to 100% in isolated mode (250 stories) and 100% in 50-story cumulative mode, with 96% at 250-story cumulative scale. The cumulative result is the primary measure: when 250 distinct life narratives coexist in the same database, the system must retrieve the correct fact for the correct context without cross-contamination. ATANT is system-agnostic, model-independent, and designed as a sequenced methodology for building and validating continuity systems. The framework specification, example stories, and evaluation protocol are available at https://github.com/Kenotic-Labs/ATANT. The full 250-story corpus will be released incrementally.

AI.tldr: ATANT是一个用于评估AI系统上下文连续性能力的开放框架，定义了连续性为7个必需属性的系统属性，并提出10个检查点评估方法，250个故事组成的叙事测试语料库，最终在250个故事累积模式下达到96%的准确率。
AI.motivation: 当前AI行业虽已产生多种记忆组件（RAG管道、向量数据库、长上下文窗口、配置文件层），但缺乏正式框架来定义和衡量这些组件是否产生真正的连续性（跨时间持久化、更新、消歧和重建有意义上下文的能力）。
AI.method: 1) 将连续性定义为具有7个必需属性的系统属性；2) 引入10个检查点评估方法，评估过程不使用LLM；3) 构建包含250个故事、1835个验证问题、覆盖6个生活领域的叙事测试语料库；4) 在5次测试套件迭代中评估参考实现。
AI.result: 从58%（传统架构）逐步提升到隔离模式100%（250个故事）、50个故事累积模式100%，以及250个故事累积模式96%。累积模式是主要衡量指标：250个不同的生活叙事共存于同一数据库时，系统必须为正确上下文检索正确事实而不产生交叉污染。
AI.conclusion: ATANT是系统无关、模型无关的框架，设计为构建和验证连续性系统的序列方法论。框架规范、示例故事和评估协议已在GitHub开源，完整250故事语料库将逐步发布。

title: Bi-Level Optimization for Single Domain Generalization
summary: Generalizing from a single labeled source domain to unseen target domains, without access to any target data during training, remains a fundamental challenge in robust machine learning. We address this underexplored setting, known as Single Domain Generalization (SDG), by proposing BiSDG, a bi-level optimization framework that explicitly decouples task learning from domain modeling. BiSDG simulates distribution shifts through surrogate domains constructed via label-preserving transformations of the source data. To capture domain-specific context, we propose a domain prompt encoder that generates lightweight modulation signals to produce augmenting features via feature-wise linear modulation. The learning process is formulated as a bi-level optimization problem: the inner objective optimizes task performance under fixed prompts, while the outer objective maximizes generalization across the surrogate domains by updating the domain prompt encoder. We further develop a practical gradient approximation scheme that enables efficient bi-level training without second-order derivatives. Extensive experiments on various SGD benchmarks demonstrate that BiSDG consistently outperforms prior methods, setting new state-of-the-art performance in the SDG setting.

AI.tldr: BiSDG是一种针对单域泛化（SDG）问题的新型双层优化框架，通过将任务学习与领域建模解耦来提升模型在未见目标域上的泛化能力。该方法利用标签保持变换构建替代域，并引入领域提示编码器生成轻量级调制信号。
AI.motivation: 单域泛化（SDG）是当前机器学习中尚未充分探索的难题：仅从单一标注源域进行学习，在训练时无法访问任何目标数据的情况下，如何泛化到完全未见的目标域。这比传统的多源域泛化更具挑战性，因为缺乏跨域多样性信息。
AI.method: BiSDG采用双层优化框架：1）通过标签保持变换构建替代域以模拟分布偏移；2）提出领域提示编码器生成轻量级调制信号；3）使用特征级线性调制（FiLM）生成增强特征；4）内层优化固定提示下的任务性能，外层通过更新领域提示编码器最大化替代域间的泛化能力；5）开发了避免二阶导数的实用梯度近似方案以实现高效训练。
AI.result: 在多个SDG基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，BiSDG始终优于先前方法，在单域泛化设定下达到新的最优性能。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出了一种有效的双层优化框架，通过显式解耦任务学习与领域建模，结合领域提示编码器和替代域策略，成功解决了单域泛化难题。无需二阶导数的梯度近似方案使该方法具有实际应用价值，为鲁棒机器学习提供了新思路。

title: LLM-based Schema-Guided Extraction and Validation of Missing-Person Intelligence from Heterogeneous Data Sources
comment: 9 pages, 6 figures. Accepted at International Conference on Intelligent Digitization of Systems and Services (IDSS 2026)
summary: Missing-person and child-safety investigations rely on heterogeneous case documents, including structured forms, bulletin-style posters, and narrative web profiles. Variations in layout, terminology, and data quality impede rapid triage, large-scale analysis, and search-planning workflows. This paper introduces the Guardian Parser Pack, an AI-driven parsing and normalization pipeline that transforms multi-source investigative documents into a unified, schema-compliant representation suitable for operational review and downstream spatial modeling. The proposed system integrates (i) multi-engine PDF text extraction with Optical Character Recognition (OCR) fallback, (ii) rule-based source identification with source-specific parsers, (iii) schema-first harmonization and validation, and (iv) an optional Large Language Model (LLM)-assisted extraction pathway incorporating validator-guided repair and shared geocoding services. We present the system architecture, key implementation decisions, and output design, and evaluate performance using both gold-aligned extraction metrics and corpus-level operational indicators. On a manually aligned subset of 75 cases, the LLM-assisted pathway achieved substantially higher extraction quality than the deterministic comparator (F1 = 0.8664 vs. 0.2578), while across 517 parsed records per pathway it also improved aggregate key-field completeness (96.97\% vs. 93.23\%). The deterministic pathway remained much faster (mean runtime 0.03 s/record vs. 3.95 s/record for the LLM pathway). In the evaluated run, all LLM outputs passed initial schema validation, so validator-guided repair functioned as a built-in safeguard rather than a contributor to the observed gains. These results support controlled use of probabilistic AI within a schema-first, auditable pipeline for high-stakes investigative settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"Guardian Parser Pack"——一个面向失踪人口/儿童安全案件文档的LLM辅助模式引导抽取与校验流水线，将多源异构PDF（结构化表单、公告海报、叙事型OSINT档案）统一为符合Guardian模式的机器可读记录。核心设计是双通道抽取（确定性规则解析 + 受约束的LLM模式引导抽取），共享下游的规范化、地理编码与JSON Schema校验服务，并配以校验器引导的最小化修复回路与溯源元数据。在75例人工对齐的gold子集上，LLM通道F1=0.8664（P=R=0.8664），显著优于确定性对照的0.2578；在每通道517条记录上关键字段完整率96.97% vs 93.23%；代价是延迟3.95 s/记录 vs 0.03 s/记录。所有LLM输出初次即通过模式校验（修复率0%），说明修复机制仅是安全兜底而非增益来源。
AI.motivation: 失踪人口与儿童安全调查高度依赖异构案件文档：结构化登记表导出、公报式海报、叙事型OSINT案件页面在版式、术语、字段覆盖与可靠性上差异巨大。这直接阻碍了三类操作需求：(1) 快速分诊(triage)——调查员与搜救协调员需在有限时间内整合人口学描述、最后出现时空信号与叙事情节，形成一致的"案件视图"以支撑优先级排序与搜索规划；(2) 规模化分析——下游热点聚类、流动性预测、空间建模要求字段具备一致的语义与坐标基准，而隐式缺失的字段、混用的命名/类型会使模型放大上游噪声；(3) 现有研究多侧重数据融合、地理画像、基于马尔可夫/agent的搜索规划，缺少将这些模型所需的标准化结构化输入，而从警情叙事中抽取实体又长期缺乏稳定的工程化流水线。此外，作者也指出当前LLM在高风险文档工作流中常被过度信任，多项研究主张应把LLM限制在"辅助抽取/校验修复"等窄角色而非端到端自由推理；且失踪人口领域标注语料稀缺，无法支撑端到端训练的监督学习范式。
AI.method: Guardian Parser Pack 采用双通道（确定性 vs 概率性）文档到模式的流水线，架构分层如下：(1) 文本抽取层采用多引擎级联——先布局感知PDF抽取器，失败后切换次级抽取器，图像型PDF回退OCR；抽取后再做预归一化（合并重复空白、统一换行、去除控制字符），并支持将多案件公报PDF切分为案件段。(2) 源检测层基于规则匹配组织标识、表单标题与样板文字等相对稳定标记，判定文档来源族（NamUs、NCMEC、VSP、FBI海报、The Charley Project等），并将该标签写入溯源元数据，用于决定解析器路由、字段预期与归一化规则。(3) 确定性路径：源特定解析器，以正则/模式匹配与结构化区块抽取获取显式标注字段（人口学、最后已知地点、叙事情节）。(4) LLM路径：schema-guided抽取器，提示约束模型输出对齐Guardian模式的JSON而非自由散文，必要时截断文本以适配上下文窗口；采用Gemini-2.5-flash作为抽取器、Gemini-2.5-pro作为修复器，后端通过抽象层支持本地或托管推理端点，必要时可结合检索增强提示（RAG）以稳定提示格式、抑制参数化记忆的"死记硬背"倾向。(5) 共享后处理：Harmonization将来源约定映射为标准键、归一化单位与枚举、确保必需区块存在（缺值以空值或安全默认显式表达缺失）；Geocoding在缺少显式经纬度时从地点文本解析坐标，带缓存与偏置策略，两路径共享同一服务以消除评估混淆；Validation使用JSON Schema检查结构、类型与必需区块，并对空间字段做数值类型与合理范围（空间可信性）检查。(6) 差异化策略：确定性路径的校验违规仅记警告日志以保吞吐与可复现性；LLM路径以"必须通过校验才写入"作为更严格的接受准则，失败则触发Repair——将校验器错误消息与当前JSON一并交回模型，要求仅做满足模式的最小编辑（修复类型错误、缺失必需字段），明确不得推断或"改进"案情。(7) 输出：同步生成JSONL（每案一条嵌套模式记录，区块含demographic/spatial/temporal/narrative_osint/outcome/provenance；时间统一为带显式时区的ISO 8601；空间区块含可读地点与坐标，坐标可来自地理编码；narrative_summary 仅供分诊、不视为事实）与扁平CSV（点号展开嵌套键）以供人工快速审查过滤；全程保留来源、文档内位置与时间戳等溯源信息以便审计重建字段产生过程。评估采用gold对齐抽取指标（75例人工对齐子集上的P/R/F1与结构化字段准确率）与语料级运营指标（每通道517条记录的模式通过率、关键字段完整率、地理编码成功率与可信率、修复率、平均运行时）。
AI.result: 75例人工对齐子集：LLM辅助通道precision=0.8664、recall=0.8664、F1=0.8664，确定性对照precision=0.2593、recall=0.2641、F1=0.2578；结构化字段准确率0.8810 vs 0.3090。517条记录/通道的批次上：关键字段完整率96.97% (LLM) vs 93.23% (确定性)；地理编码成功率两条路径均100.00%，地理编码可信率95.36% vs 94.78%（因共享同一地理编码与规范化服务，差异相对较小）。校验结果：LLM路径初次模式通过率100.00%、修复后通过率100.00%、修复率0.00%，故校验器引导修复在本次运行中仅起安全兜底作用，而非性能增益来源，也不承担完整性恢复功能。运行时：确定性路径平均0.03 s/记录，LLM路径平均3.95 s/记录。定性结论包括：多引擎抽取级联+OCR回退显著降低图像型输入的整体失败；模式优先设计使两条路径共享同一模式与校验，消除静默不一致；LLM输出被严格定位为"候选记录"，须经受规范化与校验闸门。
AI.conclusion: 结论与定位：Guardian Parser Pack 支持在高风险调查场景中"受控地"使用概率性AI——以模式优先、可审计的流水线约束LLM角色，规则路径提供可复现与高吞吐（稳定显式标注版式），LLM路径在叙事主导或版式漂移的文档上显著提升抽取质量与字段覆盖（约0.61 F1绝对增益、3.74个百分点完整率增益），代价是约130倍的延迟。局限：文档漂移会使源特定解析器失效；从残缺地点文本地理编码引入不确定性（LLM路径可信率仅95.36%）；LLM过度泛化残余风险。缓解手段为模式校验、溯源保留与"候选而非权威事实"的定位；修复机制当前仅由模式校验驱动，故模式合法但内容不完整的记录不会被自动修复。后续工作：加强地理编码与叙事派生字段的不确定性量化；建设失踪人口抽取的基准数据集与评估协议；构建受控弱监督流水线以生成标注数据；与地理空间SAR建模（马尔可夫移动性传播、热点/围合圈预测）更紧密集成并将不确定性向下游传播；扩展检索增强以利用相似历史案件稳定抽取与规范化；明确本文不涉及热点分析与移动性预测的下游用法。

title: An empirical study of LoRA-based fine-tuning of large language models for automated test case generation
summary: Automated test case generation from natural language requirements remains a challenging problem in software engineering due to the ambiguity of requirements and the need to produce structured, executable test artifacts. Recent advances in LLMs have shown promise in addressing this task; however, their effectiveness depends on task-specific adaptation and efficient fine-tuning strategies. In this paper, we present a comprehensive empirical study on the use of parameter-efficient fine-tuning, specifically LoRA, for requirement-based test case generation. We evaluate multiple LLM families, including open-source and proprietary models, under a unified experimental pipeline. The study systematically explores the impact of key LoRA hyperparameters, including rank, scaling factor, and dropout, on downstream performance. We propose an automated evaluation framework based on GPT-4o, which assesses generated test cases across nine quality dimensions. Experimental results demonstrate that LoRA-based fine-tuning significantly improves the performance of all open-source models, with Ministral-8B achieving the best results among them. Furthermore, we show that a fine-tuned 8B open-source model can achieve performance comparable to pre-fine-tuned GPT-4.1 models, highlighting the effectiveness of parameter-efficient adaptation. While GPT-4.1 models achieve the highest overall performance, the performance gap between proprietary and open-source models is substantially reduced after fine-tuning. These findings provide important insights into model selection, fine-tuning strategies, and evaluation methods for automated test generation. In particular, they demonstrate that cost-efficient, locally deployable open-source models can serve as viable alternatives to proprietary systems when combined with well-designed fine-tuning approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文是一项关于使用参数高效微调方法（LoRA）从自然语言需求自动生成测试用例的实证研究。实验表明，LoRA微调能显著提升开源模型性能，其中Ministral-8B表现最佳，且微调后的8B开源模型可媲美未微调的GPT-4.1模型。
AI.motivation: 自然语言需求的歧义性以及生成结构化、可执行测试工件的需求，使得自动化测试用例生成成为软件工程中的挑战性问题。虽然LLM在此任务上展现出潜力，但其有效性依赖于任务特定的适配和高效的微调策略。
AI.method: 采用统一实验流程，评估多个LLM家族（包括开源和专有模型）；系统探索LoRA超参数（rank、scaling factor、dropout）的影响；提出基于GPT-4o的九维质量评估框架。
AI.result: LoRA微调显著提升所有开源模型性能；Ministral-8B在开源模型中表现最佳；微调后的8B开源模型性能可与未微调的GPT-4.1模型相当；GPT-4.1整体性能最高，但微调后开源与专有模型的性能差距大幅缩小。
AI.conclusion: 经过精心设计的微调方法，成本高效、可本地部署的开源模型可作为专有系统的可行替代方案。研究为自动化测试生成的模型选择、微调策略和评估方法提供了重要参考。

title: The ATOM Report: Measuring the Open Language Model Ecosystem
summary: We present a comprehensive adoption snapshot of the leading open language models and who is building them, focusing on the ~1.5K mainline open models from the likes of Alibaba's Qwen, DeepSeek, Meta's Llama, that are the foundation of an ecosystem crucial to researchers, entrepreneurs, and policy advisors. We document a clear trend where Chinese models overtook their counterparts built in the U.S. in the summer of 2025 and subsequently widened the gap over their western counterparts. We study a mix of Hugging Face downloads and model derivatives, inference market share, performance metrics and more to make a comprehensive picture of the ecosystem.

AI.tldr: 本文提供了2025年主要开源语言模型（Qwen、DeepSeek、Llama等约1500个主流通用模型）的生态系统和应用情况快照。研究表明，中国模型在2025年夏季超越了美国同类模型并持续扩大差距，基于Hugging Face下载量、模型衍生数量、推理市场份额和性能指标等多个维度进行分析。
AI.motivation: 理解开源语言模型生态系统的发展趋势，特别是中美两国在该领域的竞争态势，为研究人员、创业者和政策制定者提供关键参考。
AI.method: 综合分析Hugging Face下载量、模型衍生数量、推理市场份额和性能指标等多维度数据。
AI.result: 发现中国模型在2025年夏季超越美国模型后，差距持续扩大，成为开源模型生态的主导力量。
AI.conclusion: 开源语言模型领域呈现明显的地缘政治竞争格局，中国模型已建立显著优势。

title: Illocutionary Explanation Planning for Source-Faithful Explanations in Retrieval-Augmented Language Models
comment: 24 pages; Accepted for publication at XAI'2026
summary: Natural language explanations produced by large language models (LLMs) are often persuasive, but not necessarily scrutable: users cannot easily verify whether the claims in an explanation are supported by evidence. In XAI, this motivates a focus on faithfulness and traceability, i.e., the extent to which an explanation's claims can be grounded in, and traced back to, an explicit source. We study these desiderata in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for programming education, where textbooks provide authoritative evidence. We benchmark six LLMs on 90 Stack Overflow questions grounded in three programming textbooks and quantify source faithfulness via source adherence metrics. We find that non Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) models have median source adherence of 0%, while baseline RAG systems still exhibit low median adherence (22-40%, depending on the model). Motivated by Achinstein's illocutionary theory of explanation, we introduce illocutionary macro-planning as a descriptive design principle for source-faithful explanations and instantiate it with chain-of-illocution prompting (CoI), which expands a query into implicit explanatory questions that drive retrieval. Across models, CoI yields statistically significant gains (up to 63%) in source adherence, although absolute adherence remains moderate and the gains are weak or non-significant for some models. A user study with 165 retained participants (220 recruited) indicates that these gains do not harm satisfaction, relevance, or perceived correctness.

AI.tldr: 本文研究检索增强生成（RAG）系统在编程教育中的可解释性问题，发现现有LLM的源忠诚度（source adherence）极低（0-40%），并提出基于言语行为理论的"言语行为宏规划"设计原则，通过链式言语行为提示（CoI）方法将查询扩展为隐式解释性问题来驱动检索，最终使源忠诚度提升至63%，且不影响用户满意度。
AI.motivation: LLM生成的自然语言解释虽然具有说服力，但缺乏可追溯性（scrutability），用户难以验证解释中的claims是否有证据支持。在RAG系统中，可信的解释应该能够追溯到明确的证据源，但现有系统在这一 faithfulness 维度上表现不佳。
AI.method: 使用6个LLM模型，在90道Stack Overflow问题（以3本编程教科书作为权威证据源）上进行基准测试；引入Achinstein的言外行为（illocutionary）解释理论，提出illocutionary macro-planning作为设计原则；设计chain-of-illocution prompting (CoI)方法，将用户查询展开为隐式的解释性问题以驱动检索；招募165名参与者进行用户研究。
AI.result: 非RAG模型的源忠诚度中位数为0%；基线RAG系统源忠诚度为22-40%；CoI方法使各模型的源忠诚度获得统计显著提升（最高达63%），但部分模型的提升效果较弱或统计不显著。用户研究显示，这些提升不会损害用户满意度、相关性和感知正确性。
AI.conclusion: 通过将查询扩展为解释性问题的CoI方法能有效提升RAG系统的源忠诚度，但绝对忠诚度仍为中等水平，说明提升忠实可解释性仍有较大空间。该研究为XAI领域的faithfulness评估和解释设计提供了新的理论框架和实践方法。

title: Steering the Verifiability of Multimodal AI Hallucinations
summary: AI applications driven by multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are prone to hallucinations and pose considerable risks to human users. Crucially, such hallucinations are not equally problematic: some hallucination contents could be detected by human users(i.e., obvious hallucinations), while others are often missed or require more verification effort(i.e., elusive hallucinations). This indicates that multimodal AI hallucinations vary significantly in their verifiability. Yet, little research has explored how to control this property for AI applications with diverse security and usability demands. To address this gap, we construct a dataset from 4,470 human responses to AI-generated hallucinations and categorize these hallucinations into obvious and elusive types based on their verifiability by human users. Further, we propose an activation-space intervention method that learns separate probes for obvious and elusive hallucinations. We reveal that obvious and elusive hallucinations elicit different intervention probes, allowing for fine-grained control over the model's verifiability. Empirical results demonstrate the efficacy of this approach and show that targeted interventions yield superior performance in regulating corresponding verifiability. Moreover, simply mixing these interventions enables flexible control over the verifiability required for different scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文针对多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）产生的幻觉问题，区分了"明显幻觉"和"隐性幻觉"两种类型，提出了基于激活空间干预的方法，通过学习不同的探针实现对幻觉可验证性的细粒度控制。
AI.motivation: AI应用中的幻觉问题并非同等严重：有些幻觉容易被人类察觉（明显幻觉），而有些则难以发现或需要更多验证努力（隐性幻觉）。然而，现有研究缺乏对这种可验证性差异的有效控制方法，无法满足不同安全性和可用性需求的场景。
AI.method: 1) 构建数据集：从4,470个人类对AI生成幻觉的响应中收集数据；2) 将幻觉分为明显型和隐匿型两类；3) 提出激活空间干预方法，学习针对两种不同类型幻觉的独立探针。
AI.result: 明显幻觉和隐性幻觉会触发不同的干预探针，实现了模型可验证性的细粒度控制；针对性干预在调节相应可验证性方面表现优异；混合使用这些干预方法可灵活适应不同场景的可验证性需求。
AI.conclusion: 通过激活空间干预方法成功实现了对多模态AI幻觉可验证性的细粒度控制，为不同安全等级和可用性需求的AI应用场景提供了灵活的解决方案。

title: Stochastic Gradient Descent in the Saddle-to-Saddle Regime of Deep Linear Networks
summary: Deep linear networks (DLNs) are used as an analytically tractable model of the training dynamics of deep neural networks. While gradient descent in DLNs is known to exhibit saddle-to-saddle dynamics, the impact of stochastic gradient descent (SGD) noise on this regime remains poorly understood. We investigate the dynamics of SGD during training of DLNs in the saddle-to-saddle regime. We model the training dynamics as stochastic Langevin dynamics with anisotropic, state-dependent noise. Under the assumption of aligned and balanced weights, we derive an exact decomposition of the dynamics into a system of one-dimensional per-mode stochastic differential equations. This establishes that the maximal diffusion along a mode precedes the corresponding feature being completely learned. We also derive the stationary distribution of SGD for each mode: in the absence of label noise, its marginal distribution along specific features coincides with the stationary distribution of gradient flow, while in the presence of label noise it approximates a Boltzmann distribution. Finally, we confirm experimentally that the theoretical results hold qualitatively even without aligned or balanced weights. These results establish that SGD noise encodes information about the progression of feature learning but does not fundamentally alter the saddle-to-saddle dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文研究全连接深度线性网络（DLN）在"鞍点到鞍点"（rich regime）特征学习阶段中 SGD 噪声的作用。作者将 SGD 的连续极限建模为带各向异性、状态依赖噪声的 Itô 随机微分方程，推导了精确的梯度噪声协方差（分解为数据失配项与标签噪声项），并在权重平衡、模态对齐假设下将动力学精确分解为逐模态的一维 SDE。主要结论：模态扩散系数在特征被完全学会之前达到峰值（无标签噪声时学完后扩散归零），因而噪声本身"编码"了特征学习的进度；但 SGD 噪声并不改变鞍点到鞍点的本质结构——模态仍按奇异值递减顺序学习，SGD 主要只是拉长各阶段的时间尺度。稳态方面：无标签噪声时逐模态分布退化为 Dirac 质量（与梯度流一致），有标签噪声时近似 Boltzmann 分布。
AI.motivation: DLN（仅含矩阵乘法的网络）虽是线性模型，却复现了非线性网络中的特征学习、分阶段动力学与高度退化的损失流形，因而是可解析的理想实验台。已有工作精确刻画了 DLN 上梯度流（GF）在小初始化下的鞍点到鞍点动力学（按奇异值从大到小逐个学习），但对 SGD 噪声在该阶段的影响缺乏分析：已有随机化结果仅限于对角线性网络（Pesme et al. 2021，稀疏化隐式偏置）与秩一线性网络（Lyu & Zhu 2023），全连接 DLN 仍属空白。此外，学界对 SGD 噪声是否真正影响泛化存在分歧（Paquette et al. 2022 的 Golden Path 假设 vs. Pesme et al. 2021 的稀疏偏置），而文献已表明 SGD 噪声是状态依赖、各向异性的，常见的各向同性 Langevin 假设可能失真。因此本文要回答：在鞍点到鞍点阶段，SGD 噪声是仅改变时间尺度，还是会改变特征学习的结构与顺序、以及训练结束时的稳态分布。
AI.method:
1) 建模：将常数步长在线 SGD 在 martingale 泛函 CLT（Lindeberg 条件与条件二次变差一致收敛）下取连续极限，得 Itô SDE dθ = -g(θ)dt + sqrt(η Σ_b(θ)) dW，即"各向异性 Langevin 动力学"。设白化高斯输入 X~N(0,I)、teacher 矩阵 M=USVᵀ、可选标签噪声 ξ_q~N(0,σ_q²I)。
2) 精确噪声协方差（Prop 3.2）：以 vec/Kronecker 运算推导逐层块协方差 Σ_lm，明确分解为"数据失配项" J_lᵀ(I⊗Δ)(I_{d0²}+C)(I⊗Δ)ᵀJ_m（用 Wick/Isserlis 定理得 E[vec(XXᵀ-I)vec(XXᵀ-I)ᵀ]=I+C）与"标签噪声项" (W_<l W_<mᵀ)⊗(W_>lᵀΣ_q W_>m)。
3) 模态分解：定义 w_α=u_αᵀ W v_α 与交叉模态 w_αβ；用多元 Itô 公式得模态幅度的一维 SDE（Prop 3.4）：漂移 = NTK 型梯度漂移 + 噪声诱导的 Itô 修正项 (η/2)tr(Σ∇²w_α)，扩散 D_α=η a_αᵀΣa_α，且 D_α 与各层 NTK K_l 显式相关。
4) 精确解耦：在 (A1) 权重平衡、(A2) 模态对齐假设下（Prop 3.5）得到逐模态闭式一维 SDE：漂移 (s_α-w_α)L w_α^{2(L-1)/L} + Itô 项，扩散 D_α(w_α)=βL²(2(s_α-w_α)²+σ_q²)w_α^{4(L-1)/L}，β=η/b。
5) 特征学习时间预测：对 D_α 求极大，得 w_α^⋆=((a+1)s_α-√(s_α²-(a(a+2)/2)σ_q²))/(a+2)，a=4(L-1)/L；存在条件 σ_q²≤s_α²L²/[4(L-1)(3L-2)]，且总有 w_α^⋆<s_α（峰值先于学完）。
6) 稳态分布：由 Fokker–Planck 方程与详细平衡得 p* ∝ D⁻¹exp(∫2μ/D dz)；无标签噪声时密度在 w→s_α 处不可积，塌缩为 δ(w-s_α)；有标签噪声时用 OU 线性化得均值偏移 (η/2B)(L-1)s_α^{-2/L}σ_q、方差 (ηL/2B)σ_q²s_α^{2(L-1)/L}，即近似 Boltzmann/Gaussian。
7) 实验：深度 2/4/6、d=12、teacher 奇异值 {1.0,0.7,0.4}、初始化方差 min{d}^{-γ}(γ=3, rich regime)、在线 SGD；对比 GD、离散 SGD、各向同性 Langevin、状态依赖各向异性 Langevin；检验平衡/对齐假设的成立程度、学习率与批量大小的标度、有限数据集修正（附录 G）、Euler–Maruyama 离散步长误差（附录 K）。
AI.result:
•  Prop 3.2：给出 DLN 中 SGD 单样本梯度噪声协方差的闭式分解，数据失配项在全局极小点（Δ=0）及 Jacobian 零点处消失，说明噪声随损失几何退化而自动衰减；该协方差状态依赖且各向异性。
•  Prop 3.3–3.5：模态扩散 D_α=η a_αᵀΣa_α 与 NTK K_l 直接挂钩（lazy 阶段 NTK 冻结时只依赖 Δ；feature learning 阶段则由 NTK 结构化）；在平衡+对齐下精确解耦为独立的一维 Itô SDE（数据失配部分贡献 2ηL²(s_α-w_α)²w_α^{4(L-1)/L}，标签噪声部分贡献 ηL²σ_q²w_α^{4(L-1)/L}）。
•  核心预测（Prop 3.4 推论 + Eq.9）：扩散系数在 w_α^⋆<s_α 处取极大，即"模态的最大扩散先于该特征被完全学会"；无标签噪声时 w_α→s_α 后扩散归零，有标签噪声时则退化为各向异性但状态无关的 Langevin 噪声。实验（4 层网络）中扩散峰与各模态学会的时刻、以及 Fig.1/Fig.3 中理论曲线与实测 D_α=ηa_αᵀΣa_α 高度吻合；扩散峰值与学习率成正比、与批量大小成反比，符合 Eq.7。
•  动力学结构保持：SGD 下模态仍按奇异值递减顺序逐个学习、损失呈平台—跃迁的阶梯状（鞍点到鞍点），但各模态学习时间显著变长（离散 SGD 全部学完约需 200 时间单位，而连续极限模拟约 30），即噪声主要影响时间尺度。
•  稳态（Prop 5.2 + Fig.4/5）：无标签噪声时逐模态分布退化为 w_α=s_α 处的 Dirac，与梯度流一致（离散 SGD 直方图尖锐集中于 teacher 奇异值 1.0）；Euler–Maruyama 模拟分布较宽，作者归因于离散化误差（附录 K 显示步长变细时方差下降）。有标签噪声（σ_q²=0.1）时分布由点变为近似高斯、方差 O(η)，符合 Boltzmann 近似。
•  建模精度：状态依赖各向异性噪声比各向同性均匀噪声更贴近真实 SGD——各向同性噪声在无标签噪声时不产生集中于 s_α 的分布，而各向异性版本方差更小、行为更接近 SGD。
•  假设检验（附录 I）：交叉模态在训练大部分时间可忽略，仅在相应模态学习期间少数交叉模态出现峰值；由不平衡初始化出发，训练过程中平衡度会自发改善（但主要是权重范数增长所致，绝对不平衡量并未下降），强制平衡初始化可较好保持平衡。放宽 (A1)(A2) 后理论预测定性仍成立。
AI.conclusion: SGD 噪声在鞍点到鞍点阶段的作用是"提供信息而非改变结构"：各向异性、状态依赖的噪声沿各模态的扩散曲线峰值明确标记出该特征即将被完全学会的时刻，因此噪声强度/方差可作为特征学习进度的可观测信号；但 SGD 并不破坏 rich regime 的分阶段时间尺度分离，模态仍按 teacher 奇异值递减顺序被学习，噪声主要改变每个阶段的过渡时间尺度与训练末期的展宽行为。在稳态上，无标签噪声时 SGD 与 GD 的模态分布一致（Dirac），有标签噪声时 SGD 有限时间行为近似 Boltzmann 分布（作者推测长时间仍会回到 Dirac）。方法论上，状态依赖噪声模型比文献常用的各向同性 Langevin 假设更准确，尤其在 feature learning 阶段与训练末期分布上。局限：仅用连续极限（忽略有限学习率带来的 GD 振荡/中心流）、假设 i.i.d. 数据与轻尾噪声、依赖平衡与对齐假设（需推广以处理交叉模态耦合）。未来方向：推广到非线性架构（如两层 ReLU）以追踪分阶段特征学习，并澄清 Golden Path 假设成立的条件——若噪声不影响所选特征与学习顺序，则可将理论分析简化为只研究梯度流。

title: Assessing REST API Test Generation Strategies with Log Coverage
summary: Assessing the effectiveness of REST API tests in black-box settings can be challenging due to the lack of access to source code coverage metrics and polyglot tech stack. We propose three metrics for capturing average, minimum, and maximum log coverage to handle the diverse test generation results and runtime behaviors over multiple runs. Using log coverage, we empirically evaluate three REST API test generation strategies, Evolutionary computing (EvoMaster v5.0.2), LLMs (Claude Opus 4.6 and GPT-5.2-Codex), and human-written Locust load tests, on Light-OAuth2 authorization microservice system. On average, Claude Opus 4.6 tests uncover 28.4% more unique log templates than human-written tests, whereas EvoMaster and GPT-5.2-Codex find 26.1% and 38.6% fewer, respectively. Next, we analyze combined log coverage to assess complementarity between strategies. Combining human-written tests with Claude Opus 4.6 tests increases total observed log coverage by 78.4% and 38.9% in human-written and Claude tests respectively. When combining Locust tests with EvoMaster the same increases are 30.7% and 76.9% and when using GPT-5.2-Codex 26.1% and 105.6%. This means that the generation strategies exercise largely distinct runtime behaviors. Our future work includes extending our study to multiple systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于日志覆盖率的三个指标来评估黑盒环境下REST API测试的有效性，并对比了进化计算(EvoMaster)、大语言模型(Claude Opus 4.6和GPT-5.2-Codex)及人工编写的Locust负载测试三种策略。实验表明Claude Opus 4.6表现最优，各策略间具有显著互补性。
AI.motivation: 黑盒环境下REST API测试有效性评估面临挑战：缺乏源代码覆盖率指标的访问权限，且技术栈多语言化（polyglot）增加了评估难度。现有方法难以全面衡量不同测试生成策略的效果。
AI.method: 提出三种日志覆盖率指标（平均值、最小值、最大值）来处理多次运行的多样化测试生成结果和运行时行为。在Light-OAuth2授权微服务系统上，对三种REST API测试生成策略进行实证评估：(1)进化计算(EvoMaster v5.0.2)；(2)大语言模型(Claude Opus 4.6和GPT-5.2-Codex)；(3)人工编写的Locust负载测试。
AI.result: Claude Opus 4.6测试比人工测试多发现28.4%的唯一日志模板，而EvoMaster和GPT-5.2-Codex分别少发现26.1%和38.6%。组合覆盖分析显示：人工测试+Claude Opus 4.6组合使总日志覆盖率提升78.4%和38.9%；Locust+EvoMaster组合提升30.7%和76.9%；Locust+GPT-5.2-Codex组合提升26.1%和105.6%。
AI.conclusion: 测试生成策略在运行时行为上表现出显著差异和互补性。单一策略无法覆盖所有测试场景，组合使用不同策略可大幅提升总体测试覆盖率。未来工作将扩展至多个系统进行验证。

title: Designing Safe and Accountable GenAI as a Learning Companion with Women Banned from Formal Education
comment: This work has been accepted at ACM Conference on Fairness, Accountability, and Transparency 2026 as a full paper. Please cite the peer-reviewed version
summary: In gender-restrictive and surveilled contexts, where access to formal education may be restricted for women, pursuing education involves safety and privacy risks. When women are excluded from schools and universities, they often turn to online self-learning and generative AI (GenAI) to pursue their educational and career aspirations. However, we know little about what safe and accountable GenAI support is required in the context of surveillance, household responsibilities, and the absence of learning communities. We present a remote participatory design study with 20 women in Afghanistan, informed by a recruitment survey (n = 140), examining how participants envision GenAI for learning and employability. Participants describe using GenAI less as an information source and more as an always-available peer, mentor, and source of career guidance that helps compensate for the absence of learning communities. At the same time, they emphasize that this companionship is constrained by privacy and surveillance risks, contextually unrealistic and culturally unsafe support, and direct-answer interactions that can undermine learning by creating an illusion of progress. Beyond eliciting requirements, envisioning the future with GenAI through participatory design was positively associated with significant increases in participants' aspirations (p=.01), perceived agency (p=.01), and perceived avenues (p=.03). These outcomes show that accountable and safe GenAI is not only about harm reduction but can also actively enable women to imagine and pursue viable learning and employment futures. Building on this, we translate participants' proposals into accountability-focused design directions that center on safety-first interaction and user control, context-grounded support under constrained resources, and offer pedagogically aligned assistance that supports genuine learning rather than quick answers.

AI.tldr: 一项关于阿富汗女性在教育受限环境中如何使用生成式AI进行学习和职业发展的参与式设计研究。研究表明，女性将AI视为同伴和导师而非单纯的信息来源，但同时面临隐私监控风险、文化不适配和学习幻觉等问题。通过参与式设计，参与者的职业愿望、感知能动性和感知途径显著增加。
AI.motivation: 在性别限制和监控严格的背景下，女性被排斥于正规教育之外，常转向在线自学和生成式AI追求教育和职业目标。然而，学界对在监控、家庭责任和缺乏学习社区的条件下，女性需要何种安全可靠的AI支持知之甚少。
AI.method: 研究采用远程参与式设计方法，对20名阿富汗女性进行研究（前期招募问卷n=140），探讨参与者如何设想AI在学习中的应用。研究还通过参与式设计让参与者与AI未来愿景进行互动。
AI.result:
1. 女性将AI更多视为随时可用的同伴、导师和职业指导来源，而非单纯的信息源，以弥补学习社区缺失
2. AI使用受限于隐私监控风险、文化上不安全且不符合语境的支持
3. 直接给出答案的交互方式可能造成学习进步假象，削弱实际学习效果
4. 参与式设计显著提升了参与者的职业愿望(p=.01)、感知能动性(p=.01)和感知途径(p=.03)
AI.conclusion: 安全可靠的AI不仅是减少伤害，更能积极赋能女性想象和追求可行的学习与就业未来。研究提出以安全优先、用户控制、语境适配和教学对齐为核心的设计方向。

title: Invisible Influences: Investigating Implicit Intersectional Biases through Persona Engineering in Large Language Models
comment: 11 pages, 5 figures, ACM WebScience Conference, 6 Tables
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at human-like language generation but often embed and amplify implicit, intersectional biases, especially under persona-driven contexts. Existing bias audits rely on static, embedding-based tests (CEAT, I-WEAT, I-SEAT) that quantify absolute association strengths. We show that they have limitations in capturing dynamic shifts when models adopt social roles. We address this gap by introducing the Bias Amplification Differential and Explainability Score (BADx): a novel, scalable metric that measures persona-induced bias amplification and integrates local explainability insights. BADx comprises three components - differential bias scores (BAD, based on CEAT, I-WEAT, I-SEAT),Persona Sensitivity Index (PSI), and Volatility (Standard Deviation), augmented by LIME-based analysis for emphasizing explainability. This study is divided and performed as two different tasks. Task 1 establishes static bias baselines, and Task 2 applies six persona frames (marginalized and structurally advantaged) to measure BADx, PSI, and volatility. This is studied across five state-of-the-art LLMs (GPT-4o, DeepSeek-R1, LLaMA-4, Claude 4.0 Sonnet and Gemma-3n E4B). Results show persona context significantly modulates bias. GPT-4o exhibits high sensitivity and volatility; DeepSeek-R1 suppresses bias but with erratic volatility; LLaMA-4 maintains low volatility and a stable bias profile with limited amplification; Claude 4.0 Sonnet achieves balanced modulation; and Gemma-3n E4B attains the lowest volatility with moderate amplification. BADx performs better than static methods by revealing context-sensitive biases overlooked in static methods. Our unified method offers a systematic way to detect dynamic implicit intersectional bias in five popular LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BADx指标，用于衡量LLM在人格角色（persona）驱动下的偏见放大效应，通过结合差分偏差评分、角色敏感度指数和波动性三个维度，并借助LIME可解释性分析，实现对动态隐式交叉偏见的系统性检测。
AI.motivation: 现有偏见审计方法（CEAT、I-WEAT、I-SEAT）依赖静态嵌入测试，仅能量化绝对关联强度，无法捕捉模型在采用社会角色时的动态偏见变化。
AI.method: 提出BADx指标，包含三个组件：(1) 差分偏差评分（Differential Bias Scores，基于CEAT/I-WEAT/I-SEAT）；(2) 角色敏感度指数（PSI）；(3) 波动性（标准差）。通过LIME增强可解释性。实验分为两个任务：Task 1建立静态偏见基线，Task 2应用六种角色框架（边缘化和结构性优势群体）测量BADx。
AI.result: 对5个主流LLM（GPT-4o、DeepSeek-R1、LLaMA-4、Claude 4.0 Sonnet、Gemma-3n E4B）的测试表明：GPT-4o表现出高敏感性和波动性；DeepSeek-R1抑制偏见但波动不稳定；LLaMA-4维持低波动性和稳定偏见特征；Claude 4.0 Sonnet实现平衡调制；Gemma-3n E4B波动性最低但存在中等程度放大。BADx优于静态方法，能揭示后者遗漏的上下文敏感偏见。
AI.conclusion: BADx提供了一种统一方法来检测5个主流LLM中的动态隐式交叉偏见，为评估LLM在角色扮演场景下的偏见行为提供了系统性框架。

title: TurboAgent: An LLM-Driven Autonomous Multi-Agent Framework for Turbomachinery Aerodynamic Design
summary:
The aerodynamic design of turbomachinery is a complex and tightly coupled multi-stage process involving geometry generation, performance prediction, optimization, and high-fidelity physical validation. Existing intelligent design approaches typically focus on individual stages or rely on loosely coupled pipelines, making fully autonomous end-to-end design challenging.To address this issue, this study proposes TurboAgent, a large language model (LLM)-driven autonomous multi-agent framework for turbomachinery aerodynamic design and optimization. The LLM serves as the core for task planning and coordination, while specialized agents handle generative design, rapid performance prediction, multi-objective optimization, and physics-based validation. The framework transforms traditional trial-and-error design into a data-driven collaborative workflow, with high-fidelity simulations retained for final verification.A transonic single-rotor compressor is used for validation. The results show strong agreement between target performance, generated designs, and CFD simulations. The coefficients of determination (R2) for mass flow rate, total pressure ratio, and isentropic efficiency all exceed 0.91, with normalized RMSE values below 8%. The optimization agent further improves isentropic efficiency by 1.61% and total pressure ratio by 3.02%. The complete workflow can be executed within approximately 30 minutes under parallel computing.
  These results demonstrate that TurboAgent enables an autonomous closed-loop design process from natural language requirements to final design generation, providing an efficient and scalable paradigm for turbomachinery aerodynamic design

AI.tldr: TurboAgent是一个基于大语言模型(LLM)的自主多智能体框架,用于叶轮机械气动设计优化。该框架将传统试错式设计转变为数据驱动的协作工作流,实现了从自然语言需求到最终设计生成的自主闭环流程。
AI.motivation: 现有叶轮机械智能设计方法通常聚焦于单一环节或依赖松耦合流程,难以实现完全自主的端到端设计。设计过程涉及几何生成、性能预测、优化和高保真物理验证等多个紧密耦合的环节,亟需一个能够协调各环节的统一框架。
AI.method: TurboAgent框架以LLM为核心进行任务规划与协调,部署专业化智能体分别处理:生成式设计、快速性能预测、多目标优化和基于物理的验证。针对跨音单转子压气机进行验证。
AI.result: 质量流量、总压比和等熵效率的决定系数R²均超过0.91,归一化RMSE低于8%。优化智能体进一步将等熵效率提升1.61%,总压比提升3.02%。完整工作流在并行计算下约30分钟完成。
AI.conclusion: TurboAgent成功实现了从自然语言需求到最终设计生成的自主闭环设计流程,为叶轮机械气动设计提供了高效且可扩展的新范式。

title: The Master Key Hypothesis: Unlocking Cross-Model Capability Transfer via Linear Subspace Alignment
summary: We investigate whether post-trained capabilities can be transferred across models without retraining, with a focus on transfer across different model scales. We propose the Master Key Hypothesis, which states that model capabilities correspond to directions in a low-dimensional latent subspace that induce specific behaviors and are transferable across models through linear alignment. Based on this hypothesis, we introduce UNLOCK, a training-free and label-free framework that extracts a capability direction by contrasting activations between capability-present and capability-absent Source variants, aligns it with a Target model through a low-rank linear transformation, and applies it at inference time to elicit the behavior. Experiments on reasoning behaviors, including Chain-of-Thought (CoT) and mathematical reasoning, demonstrate substantial improvements across model scales without training. For example, transferring CoT reasoning from Qwen1.5-14B to Qwen1.5-7B yields an accuracy gain of 12.1% on MATH, and transferring a mathematical reasoning direction from Qwen3-4B-Base to Qwen3-14B-Base improves AGIEval Math accuracy from 61.1% to 71.3%, surpassing the 67.8% achieved by the 14B post-trained model. Our analysis shows that the success of transfer depends on the capabilities learned during pre-training, and that our intervention amplifies latent capabilities by sharpening the output distribution toward successful reasoning trajectories.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"主密钥假设"(Master Key Hypothesis)，认为模型能力对应于低维潜在子空间中的方向，可通过线性对齐跨模型迁移。提出UNLOCK框架，无需训练即可通过对比激活差异提取能力方向并迁移到目标模型，在数学推理等任务上取得显著效果。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型的后训练能力（如推理能力）通常需要针对特定模型规模进行训练，成本高昂。本文旨在探索跨模型规模迁移后训练能力而无需重新训练的可能性。
AI.method: 基于主密钥假设，提出UNLOCK框架：1)通过对比有/无特定能力的源模型变体的激活差异提取能力方向；2)通过低秩线性变换将能力方向与目标模型对齐；3)推理时应用该方向以激发目标模型的能力。
AI.result: 实验表明：Qwen1.5-14B到Qwen1.5-7B的CoT推理迁移在MATH上获得12.1%的精度提升；Qwen3-4B-Base到Qwen3-14B-Base的数学推理方向迁移使AGIEval Math精度从61.1%提升至71.3%，超越14B后训练模型达到的67.8%。
AI.conclusion: 能力迁移成功与否取决于预训练阶段学习到的能力，干预通过锐化输出分布向成功推理轨迹倾斜来放大潜在能力。

title: Compact Constraint Encoding for LLM Code Generation: An Empirical Study of Token Economics and Constraint Compliance
summary:
LLMs used for code generation are typically guided by engineering constraints--technology choices, dependency restrictions, and architectural patterns--expressed in verbose natural language. We investigate whether compact, structured constraint headers can reduce prompt token consumption without degrading constraint compliance.
  Across six experimental rounds spanning 11 models, 16 benchmark tasks, and over 830 LLM invocations, we find that compact headers reduce constraint-portion tokens by approximately 71% and full-prompt tokens by 25--30%, replicated across three independent rounds. However, we detect no statistically significant differences in constraint satisfaction rate (CSR) across three encoding forms or four propagation modes; observed effect sizes are negligible (Cliff's $δ$ < 0.01, 95% CI spanning $\pm$2.6 percentage points). This null pattern holds across two models from different capability tiers. A supplementary experiment with four non-CSS tasks provides additional cross-domain support for the encoding null result.
  The largest observed sources of compliance variance are constraint type ($Δ$ = 9 percentage points between normal and counter-intuitive constraints) and task domain: counter-intuitive constraints opposing model defaults fail at 10--100%, while conventional constraints achieve 99%+ compliance regardless of encoding. Model self-assessments systematically overestimate compliance relative to rule-based scoring, revealing a gap between constraint understanding and execution. Under the tested conditions, the primary benefit of compact constraint encoding is token reduction rather than compliance improvement, and engineering effort toward compliance is better directed at constraint design than prompt formatting.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了代码生成任务中紧凑结构化约束头是否能减少提示词令牌消耗，同时不降低约束合规率。实验覆盖11个模型、16个基准任务和830余次LLM调用，结果表明紧凑编码可减少约71%的约束相关令牌和25-30%的完整提示令牌，但未发现编码形式或传播模式对约束满足率(CSR)有显著影响。合规率的主要差异来源于约束类型（常规vs反直觉）和任务领域，而非编码格式。因此，紧凑约束编码的主要收益在于令牌节省而非合规提升，工程优化应聚焦于约束设计而非提示格式。
AI.motivation: 代码生成任务中，工程约束通常以冗长自然语言形式表达，导致大量令牌消耗。研究者希望探究是否可以用紧凑结构化形式替代，从而节省令牌而不影响约束遵守效果。
AI.method: 进行了六轮实验，涵盖11个模型、16个基准任务和830+次LLM调用，测试三种编码形式和四种传播模式，采用规则基评分和模型自评估进行约束满足率对比，并通过Cliff's δ效应量分析统计显著性。
AI.result: 紧凑头可减少约束部分令牌约71%、完整提示令牌25-30%；编码形式和传播模式对CSR无显著影响(Cliff's δ < 0.01)；最大合规差异来源于约束类型（常规vs反直觉）和任务领域；模型自评估系统性高估合规率。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑约束编码的主要价值在于令牌节省而非合规改善；合规优化应优先关注约束设计本身而非提示格式；反直觉约束与模型默认的冲突是合规失败的主因，常规约束可达99%+合规率。

title: Unsupervised Neural Network for Automated Classification of Surgical Urgency Levels in Medical Transcriptions
comment: 7 pages. Published in Proceedings of the IISE Annual Conference & Expo 2025. DOI: 10.21872/2025IISE_6828
summary: Efficient classification of surgical procedures by urgency is paramount to optimize patient care and resource allocation within healthcare systems. This study introduces an unsupervised neural network approach to automatically categorize surgical transcriptions into three urgency levels: immediate, urgent, and elective. Leveraging BioClinicalBERT, a domain-specific language model, surgical transcripts are transformed into high-dimensional embeddings that capture their semantic nuances. These embeddings are subsequently clustered using both K-means and Deep Embedding Clustering (DEC) algorithms, in which DEC demonstrates superior performance in the formation of cohesive and well-separated clusters. To ensure clinical relevance and accuracy, the clustering results undergo validation through the Modified Delphi Method, which involves expert review and refinement. Following validation, a neural network that integrates Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) layers with BioClinicalBERT embeddings is developed for classification tasks. The model is rigorously evaluated using cross-validation and metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score, which achieve robust performance and demonstrate strong generalization capabilities on unseen data. This unsupervised framework not only addresses the challenge of limited labeled data but also provides a scalable and reliable solution for real-time surgical prioritization, which ultimately enhances operational efficiency and patient outcomes in dynamic medical environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于无监督神经网络的手术转录文本紧急程度自动分类方法：先用 BioClinicalBERT 提取高维语义嵌入，再经 K-means 与深度嵌入聚类（DEC）聚类为“立即/紧急/择期”三级，其中 DEC 簇更紧致分离；结果经改良德尔菲法专家验证后，训练 BiLSTM + BioClinicalBERT 融合的有监督分类器，并以交叉验证、准确率/精确率/召回率/F1 评估，取得稳健表现。该框架可缓解标注数据稀缺问题，适用于实时手术优先级排序。
AI.motivation: 手术台次与资源的实时调度依赖于对手术紧急度的快速、准确判别，但人工标注成本高、可扩展性差，且存在标注数据稀缺的问题；同时手术转录文本为临床自然语言，缺乏结构化字段，需要语义层面的表示学习。作者因此引入无监督聚类方法作为冷启动与预标注手段，以在无标签条件下自动生成紧急度分层结果，并借助专家验证保证临床相关性。
AI.method: 1) 领域语言模型编码：以 BioClinicalBERT（临床领域预训练 BERT）对手术转录文本进行编码，得到高维语义嵌入；2) 无监督聚类：并行采用 K-means 与深度嵌入聚类（DEC，深度自编码器 + KL 散度软分配）划分簇，比较其簇内凝聚度与簇间分离度，DEC 表现更优；3) 临床验证：借助改良德尔菲法（多轮专家评审与意见收敛修订）对聚类结果进行语义标签映射与确认；4) 有监督分类：以验证后的标签构建训练集，构建融合 BioClinicalBERT 嵌入与双向长短期记忆（BiLSTM）层的神经网络完成三级分类；5) 评估：采用 k 折交叉验证，计算准确率、精确率、召回率、F1 分数，检验对未见数据的泛化能力。
AI.result: DEC 聚类在簇的凝聚性与分离度上优于 K-means；经德尔菲法专家验证后的聚类标签具备临床合理性；以 BioClinicalBERT 嵌入 + BiLSTM 的分类模型在交叉验证下取得稳健的准确率、精确率、召回率与 F1 分数，显示出对未见样本的良好泛化性能。该无监督框架成功克服标注数据有限的问题，验证了自动化手术优先级分层的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 将无监督深度嵌入聚类与专家德尔菲验证相结合，可从无标签手术转录中自动、可扩展地提取三级紧急度分层，并借助经验证标签训练的高性能分类器支持实时手术优先级排序，从而提升医疗系统的运营效率与患者结局；但论文未报告具体数值与外部数据集验证，其临床部署仍需多中心验证与偏倚评估。

title: FVD: Inference-Time Alignment of Diffusion Models via Fleming-Viot Resampling
summary: We introduce Fleming-Viot Diffusion (FVD), an inference-time alignment method that resolves the diversity collapse commonly observed in Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) based diffusion samplers. Existing SMC-based diffusion samplers often rely on multinomial resampling or closely related resampling schemes, which can still reduce diversity and lead to lineage collapse under strong selection pressure. Inspired by Fleming-Viot population dynamics, FVD replaces multinomial resampling with a specialized birth-death mechanism designed for diffusion alignment. To handle cases where rewards are only approximately available and naive rebirth would collapse deterministic trajectories, FVD integrates independent reward-based survival decisions with stochastic rebirth noise. This yields flexible population dynamics that preserve broader trajectory support while effectively exploring reward-tilted distributions, all without requiring value function approximation or costly rollouts. FVD is fully parallelizable and scales efficiently with inference compute. Empirically, it achieves substantial gains across settings: on DrawBench it outperforms prior methods by 7% in ImageReward, while on class-conditional tasks it improves FID by roughly 14-20% over strong baselines and is up to 66 times faster than value-based approaches.

AI.tldr: arXiv 正文实际为《VASR: Variance-Aware Systematic Resampling for Reward-Guided Diffusion》（与给定的 FVD 摘要并非同一篇：FVD 摘要讲 Fleming-Viot 出生-死亡重采样，正文讲"方差分解 + 系统重采样"，两者都针对 SMC 扩散采样器的多样性坍塌问题）。核心思想：把奖励引导扩散 SMC 每步的估计方差分解为"续传方差 V_t^cont"与"残差方差 V_t^res"，前者用方差最优质量分配 m_t^(i) ∝ w_t^(i)·e^{r̃} 最小化，后者用系统重采样（|N−m|≤1、Var≤1/4）替代多项式重采样（O(K) 方差）；另在潜空间高噪声场景提出有意偏置的 VASR-Max（全部后代集中到 argmax 粒子）。结果：MNIST/CIFAR-10 类条件后验采样 FID 优于 FKD/DTS/DAS/TDS，匹配 NFE 下比 DTS 快约 66×；Stable Diffusion 文本到图像上 VASR-Max 在 DrawBench 上全面超过 FKD 与 DTS*，奖励最高可达 FKD 的 1.6×，且比 DTS* 快约 4×。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型的推理时对齐（inference-time alignment）希望从 p*(x) ∝ p_θ(x)·exp(λr(x)) 采样，从而无需针对每个新奖励函数重训模型。现有路线各有缺陷：RL 微调（策略梯度/DPO/直接奖励优化）代价高、换奖励就要重训；基于梯度的方法需要可微奖励，且易把轨迹拉离数据流形；搜索/基于价值函数的方法（DTS、MCTS）依赖串行树展开、算力昂贵且难并行。粒子/SMC 方法（如 FKD、TDS、DAS）可扩展、无需可微奖励，但存在严重的"多样性坍塌/血缘坍塌"：强奖励倾斜下少数高奖励粒子迅速占据种群，破坏分布覆盖、降低样本质量。作者把根因定位在常用的多项式重采样上——它对重质量粒子的后代数量带来 O(K) 级波动。作者希望用一套原则化的方差控制机制（而非启发式调参）来同时改善质量与多样性。
AI.method: 1) 方差分解框架（Proposition 1/7）：对条件于 F_t 的终端估计量做全方差分解，Var(Ẑ_T|F_t)=V_t^cont+V_t^res，其中 E[V_t^cont|F_t]=Σ_i (w_t^(i))²/m_t^(i)·σ_t²(x_t^(i))，V_t^res 为后代数随机性引起的二次型（含协方差项）。2) 方差最优质量分配（Proposition 6）：以 σ_t ∝ e^{r̃} 为 plug-in 代理，通过拉格朗日/严格凸最小化 Σ b_i²/m_i（b_i=w_t·a_i）得到 m_t^(i) ∝ w_t^(i)·e^{r̃_t^(i)}，即在先前 SMC 常用的 m ∝ e^r 基础上显式乘上当前权重。3) 系统重采样（Proposition 4，Douc et al.）：单个共享随机偏移 U 决定全部后代数，保证无偏（E[N]=m、ΣN=K 几乎必然），|N^(k)−m^(k)|≤1、Var(N^(k))={m^(k)}(1−{m^(k)})≤1/4，把每粒子波动从 O(K) 降到 O(1)，且恰好在强倾斜（重质量）区间收益最大。4) 排序启发式：重采样前按 w·e^{r̃}/m 降序排列（确定性置换，不破坏无偏性），使累积质量网格上相邻格对应相近分数，进一步压低残差方差。5) 无偏性保证（Proposition 5）：后代权重取 w̃=w/m 时，加权经验测度在期望上保持不变。6) VASR-Max：针对潜空间 SD 中 Tweedie 中间奖励噪声大的情况，用尖峰分配把全部 K 个后代给 argmax 粒子（牺牲无偏性换鲁棒性）；附录 A 验证中间奖励的粒子内方差恒为 0.02–0.04、与奖励排名无关，故软比例分配不可靠。7) 实现：K 个粒子按 DDIM(η=1) 演化，在预设调度 T 上重采样（MNIST/CIFAR-10：每 5 步、t=10→40；SD DrawBench 同；aesthetic 任务 t=20→45），重采样仅 O(K) 且单次均匀抽样，完全并行、无需价值函数或 rollout 训练。
AI.result: 类条件后验采样（10^6 NFE、5 种子、5000 样本）：VASR 在 MNIST 上 FID 0.015 / MMD 0.087，MNIST 偶奇多模态 0.014 / 0.084，CIFAR-10 0.132 / 0.598，优于 DPS、FKD、TDS、DAS，与最强的 DTS 相当或更好（MNIST 偶奇与 DTS 同为 0.014）；Figure 1 显示其在各 NFE 预算下 FID 均优于 FKD/DTS，缩放平滑稳定，并在匹配 NFE 下比 DTS 快约 66×，且 DTS 即使用尽运行时也达不到 VASR 的最好 FID。消融：方差最优分配相对 m ∝ e^r 使续传方差代理降低约 8×、终端 MMD 改善近 2×；系统性重采样相对多项式重采样显著保留更多血缘（λ=1 时约多 1.5× 祖先谱系）， offspring 方差稳定在 1/4 量级；温度消融显示 λ 从 1 升到 15 时血缘多样性由约 1500 降到约 1000、FID 由约 0.40 恶化到约 1.65，且当系统性重采样的血缘多样性退化到与多项式相当时 FID 也退化到相近水平，证明增益主要来自"保留血缘多样性"这一机制；排序启发式使 offspring 方差下降并把终端 FID 从 0.27 改善到 0.24。文本到图像（SD v1.5）：aesthetic 基准上 FKD 原始奖励更高但明显过拟合（视觉失真），VASR-Max 奖励略低但保真度与奖励缩放更好；DrawBench 上 VASR-Max 在所有算力预算下超过 FKD 与 DTS*，最高可达 FKD 的 1.6×，与基于 MCTS 的 DTS* 差距在 2.5–3% 奖励以内，且约快 4×；定性结果显示 FKD/TDS 在 CIFAR-10 上模式坍塌、DPS 产生分布外样本，VASR 与 DTS 保持多样性。
AI.conclusion: 结论是"原则化的方差控制"（方差最优质量分配 + 有界系统重采样）是改进扩散推理时对齐的关键机制：它以线性开销、免训练、完全并行的方式缓解了 SMC 采样器的多样性坍塌，兼顾分布质量、血缘多样性与推理效率，并在像素空间类条件任务与潜空间文本到图像任务上均取得可比或更优结果且比树搜索方法快 4–66×。作者同时给出清晰的机制性验证（逐项方差/血缘消融）与理论支撑（无偏性、方差界、严格凸最小化）。局限与展望：VASR-Max 是有意偏置的估计量，牺牲了无偏性与理论保证（其合理性依赖未来能更好地去噪中间奖励）；未在流匹配与一致性模型上验证；仅限单目标对齐，缺少多目标/多模态奖励的分析；未来方向包括寻找完全无偏的方差最优分配、更精细的奖励去噪以及多目标扩展。

title: Toward a universal foundation model for graph-structured data
summary: Graphs are a central representation in biomedical research, capturing molecular interaction networks, gene regulatory circuits, cell--cell communication maps, and knowledge graphs. Despite their importance, currently there is not a broadly reusable foundation model available for graph analysis comparable to those that have transformed language and vision. Existing graph neural networks are typically trained on a single dataset and learn representations specific only to that graph's node features, topology, and label space, limiting their ability to transfer across domains. This lack of generalization is particularly problematic in biology and medicine, where networks vary substantially across cohorts, assays, and institutions. Here we introduce a graph foundation model designed to learn transferable structural representations that are not specific to specific node identities or feature schemes. Our approach leverages feature-agnostic graph properties, including degree statistics, centrality measures, community structure indicators, and diffusion-based signatures, and encodes them as structural prompts. These prompts are integrated with a message-passing backbone to embed diverse graphs into a shared representation space. The model is pretrained once on heterogeneous graphs and subsequently reused on unseen datasets with minimal adaptation. Across multiple benchmarks, our pretrained model matches or exceeds strong supervised baselines while demonstrating superior zero-shot and few-shot generalization on held-out graphs. On the SagePPI benchmark, supervised fine-tuning of the pretrained backbone achieves a mean ROC-AUC of 95.5%, a gain of 21.8% over the best supervised message-passing baseline. The proposed technique thus provides a unique approach toward reusable, foundation-scale models for graph-structured data in biomedical and network science applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向图结构数据的通用基础模型（GFM）：将与特征无关的拓扑属性（度、聚类系数、k-core、ego 网络统计、PageRank、Label Propagation 与 SCoDA 社区指标、扩散/多尺度社区签名）组装成自然语言"节点画像"，经 MiniLM 编码为结构提示，与两层 GraphSAGE 消息传递骨干输出做 InfoNCE 对比对齐。在 9 张非生物异质图（Cora、CiteSeer、DBLP、ogbn-arxiv、CoauthorCS/Physics、AmazonComputers/Photo、WikiCS）上一次性预训练后，冻结骨干可零样本或少样本迁移到 4 个从未见过的生物 PPI 基准（SagePPI、ogbn-proteins、StringGO、Fold-PPI），全面超过从头训练的 GCN/GraphSAGE/GAT/GIN；SagePPI 全监督微调后平均 ROC-AUC 达 95.5%，较最佳监督消息传递基线提升 21.8 个百分点。
AI.motivation: 图的表示学习仍缺少类似语言/视觉的可复用基础模型：现有 GNN（GCN、GIN、GAT、GraphSAGE）以及 DGI/GRACE/BGRL 等自监督方法几乎都在单一图上定义目标，其参数只反映该数据集的节点特征、拓扑与标签语义，迁移到另一张图需从头重训；而生物医学网络在队列、检测手段、机构之间差异极大，标注又昂贵稀缺，使这一局限尤为突出。根因在于图缺少规范输入空间：节点特征可以是词袋、分子指纹、连续属性或学习嵌入，边语义（物理相互作用、调控、引用、交易）各不相同，无法定义跨数据集的共享表示；同时局部消息传递在加深后会出现过平滑、压缩远距离结构信息的问题。已有的结构提示/子图预训练思路依赖特定领域词汇或图类型匹配，无法直接跨域。因此需要一个仅依赖图组织本身（度、中心性、社区结构、扩散统计等内在且普适的拓扑量）、不绑定节点身份、特征模式与标签集的可迁移表示学习接口，并验证其在标签稀疏与跨类别场景下的可用性。
AI.method: GFM 分三部分。(1) 结构提示构造：对每个节点计算局部描述符（度数 d、聚类系数 c、k-core 数、1/2 阶 ego 网络的顶点数/边数/密度、PageRank（阻尼 0.85，40 次幂迭代））与全局描述符（Label Propagation 运行 20 次、SCoDA 流式社区检测，各自记录社区 ID、规模、内部边密度），再拼接图级统计（N、E、平均度、传递性、度数四分位、谱间隙），组装为自然语言"节点画像"，由 all-MiniLM-L6-v2 Sentence Transformer 编码为 384 维文本向量 z_text。(2) 图特征嵌入与骨干：每图一个线性适配器 A 将 [原始特征 ‖ z_text] 映射到 1024 维，两层 GraphSAGE（隐层 512、输出 256、dropout 0.6）产出图结构嵌入 g，文本投影头产出 z，最终节点嵌入 e = [0.7·g ‖ 0.3·z]（512 维）。(3) 多图对比预raining：以 Personalized PageRank（重启 0.15，100 次迭代）为每个锚点取 top-96 正样本，用对称 InfoNCE（温度 τ=0.1，大图用 1024 批内负样本，小图用全节点库）并叠加拉普拉斯平滑正则（λ=5e-3），在 9 张异质非生物图上按每步均匀采样单图、1024 锚点、250 epoch×128 step、Adam lr 1e-5、weight decay 5e-4、混合精度训练。下游适配：为目标图新建适配器（用预训练适配器权重均值初始化），冻结骨干，仅用目标图拓扑上的同一对比目标无标签调参（SagePPI 2000 步，其余 5000 步）；零样本＝冻结骨干＋逻辑回归线性探针；全监督微调分两阶段（先只训适配器与任务头，再全参联合训练，骨干/投影 lr 1e-5、适配器 1e-4、头 1e-3），BCE 损失、按验证集 mean ROC-AUC 选模型；少样本探针每类用 K 个标注样本（GO 任务 K∈{1,5,10,20}，Fold-PPI K∈{3,5,7,10,15,20}）。基线为两层、隐层 256 的 GCN/GraphSAGE/GAT/GIN，在目标图上用原始特征从头训练，超参统一不做数据集特定调优；指标为 mean ROC-AUC（Fold-PPI 以 accuracy 为主）与验证集阈值下的 accuracy，随机种子 42。
AI.result: SagePPI（121 个 GO-BP 多标签，预训练未见过该图）：零样本冻结骨干＋线性探针 mean ROC-AUC 76.1%、accuracy 72.2%，超过最强监督基线 GIN 73.7%（GraphSAGE 69.7%、GAT 67.1%、GCN 57.1%）；全监督微调后 ROC-AUC 95.5%、accuracy 84.1%，较最佳基线 +21.8 个百分点；K=1 少样本时零样本 GFM 达 0.567，而所有监督基线在 0.505–0.515，K=20 时 GFM 零样本 0.690 已超过监督基线最佳 0.583（等于监督模型需 20 个样本才接近的水平）；6 个 GO 过程在 k=5…100 的同标签近邻纯度上 GFM 全面占优，跨功能共富集矩阵自发呈现转录模块与免疫/细胞因子模块；多功能性与嵌入密度的 Spearman 相关 GFM 零样本 +0.263，而 GIN 为 −0.290。ogbn-proteins（STRING v11，132,534 节点、39.56M 边，112 GO 标签，物种分层划分）：零样本 71.0%（GCN 56.5%、GraphSAGE 50.9%、GAT 47.0%、GIN 64.6%），微调 77.5%、accuracy 81.1%，超 GIN 12.9 个百分点；K=1 时零样本 0.620 vs 基线 0.495–0.540；GO 层级分层显示 GFM Trained 随深度单调提升（浅 75.4%→中 76.7%→深 80.5%），GIN 无一致趋势（61.7/61.4/67.5%），优势恰好出现在最难任务上；多功能性相关 +0.105，基线多为负。StringGO（18k 蛋白、约 8M 相互作用、20 维氨基酸组成特征）：MF 零样本 81.4%（GIN 74.7%）、CC 81.1%（GIN 74.9%），微调分别 86.3%、87.4%，较 GIN +11.6/+12.5，较 GCN/GraphSAGE/GAT 差距超 30 个百分点；BP 零样本 80.5% 仍超全部基线，但 GFM Trained 仅 68.7%、未超过零样本，构成明确的失效边界；50% 特征噪声下 MF/CC 仍保持 0.791（仅降 2.3/2.0 个百分点）；CC 共富集自发解析出线粒体、核对质与膜三个空间模块。Fold-PPI（144 组织特异 PPI 网，SCOP 折叠类，训练 19 类/测试 5 类完全不相交）：K=20 时零样本 accuracy 83.4%、ROC-AUC 95.5%，GFM Trained 82.1%/95.8%，均超 GAT 74.8%/94.1%、GraphSAGE 60.6%、GCN 60.5%、GIN 53.1%；K=5 起差距即显现并随 K 单调扩大；此处零样本略优于微调，源于微调引入训练类特定几何偏置；组织流行度中心化强度 GFM Trained 0.296 对 GAT 0.126；t-SNE 显示折叠类簇紧凑可分。整体上，预训练图全部为非生物图（引用/合著/商品共购），未含任何蛋白或功能注释。
AI.conclusion: 以纯拓扑导出的结构提示作为跨域接口是可行的：把局部连通性、全局社区归属与扩散位置写成文本化"结构 token"，可与图消息传递表示对齐，从而让在非生物图上一次性预训练的单一模型直接迁移到生物网络，无需目标图训练即可超过从头训练的监督 GNN，并在标签极端稀缺（每类 1 个标注）与测试类别完全未见（Fold-PPI）的极端设定下保持优势，说明其学到的是可跨域、跨标签边界的拓扑角色表征而非数据集特异语义。机制证据包括：优势随 GO 注释特异性上升（长程与跨社区信号被 diffusion 与多尺度社区指标编码）、多功能性与嵌入密度正相关、跨功能共富集自发恢复转录/免疫/细胞因子/线粒体-核质-膜等已知生物学模块。实践含义：当测试标签词表与训练标签词表不一致时，拓扑预训练表征是更安全的初始化。边界与局限：StringGO 的 BP 大而异质标签空间下两阶段微调不稳定（GFM Trained 低于零样本），提示需标签均衡采样、本体感知课程调度或分头适配；结构提示依赖可靠的社区检测与扩散统计，在边稀疏或含噪时可靠性下降；需在适配期获得完整拓扑，尚缺流式/隐私约束下的归纳式结构提示；向基因调控网络、细胞通信图、药物靶点图与临床知识图谱的迁移仍是待验证的开放问题。

title: Chatbot-Based Assessment of Code Understanding in Automated Programming Assessment Systems
comment: 12 pages, accepted for publication at CSEDU 2026
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) challenge conventional automated programming assessment because students can now produce functionally correct code without demonstrating corresponding understanding. This paper makes two contributions. First, it reports a saturation-based scoping review of conversational assessment approaches in programming education. The review identifies three dominant architectural families: rule-based or template-driven systems, LLM-based systems, and hybrid systems. Across the literature, conversational agents appear promising for scalable feedback and deeper probing of code understanding, but important limitations remain around hallucinations, over-reliance, privacy, integrity, and deployment constraints. Second, the paper synthesizes these findings into a Hybrid Socratic Framework for integrating conversational verification into Automated Programming Assessment Systems (APASs). The framework combines deterministic code analysis with a dual-agent conversational layer, knowledge tracking, scaffolded questioning, and guardrails that tie prompts to runtime facts. The paper also discusses practical safeguards against LLM-generated explanations, including proctored deployment modes, randomized trace questions, stepwise reasoning tied to concrete execution states, and local-model deployment options for privacy-sensitive settings. Rather than replacing conventional testing, the framework is intended as a complementary layer for verifying whether students understand the code they submit.

AI.tldr: 本文针对LLM时代传统自动编程评估面临的挑战，提出了一套混合苏格拉底式验证框架。论文首先对编程教育中的会话式评估方法进行了饱和式范围审查，识别出三类主流架构（规则/模板驱动、LLM驱动、混合系统），并指出幻觉、过度依赖、隐私和诚信等问题。随后，该研究将这些发现综合为一种混合框架，结合确定性代码分析与双智能体会话层、知识追踪、支架式提问等技术，用于验证学生是否真正理解所提交的代码。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型使学生能够生成功能正确的代码而不必真正理解代码，导致传统的自动编程评估系统无法有效区分"真理解"与"假成果"。因此需要开发新的验证机制来判断学生是否真正掌握所提交的代码。
AI.method: 采用饱和式范围审查（saturation-based scoping review）方法，对编程教育中的会话式评估文献进行系统性梳理；随后基于综述发现，综合构建了混合苏格拉底式框架，整合确定性代码分析、双智能体对话层、知识追踪、支架式提问及防护栏等技术组件。
AI.result: 识别出三类主流架构体系：基于规则/模板的系统、基于LLM的系统、以及混合系统；提出了包含确定性代码分析、双智能体对话层、知识追踪、代码执行状态关联的推理验证、随机化追踪问题等组件的混合苏格拉底式框架；讨论了防范LLM生成解释的实践策略，包括监考式部署、随机追踪问题、本地模型部署等隐私保护方案。
AI.conclusion: 该框架并非替代传统测试，而是作为补充层用于验证学生是否真正理解所提交的代码；强调需要结合多种技术手段和制度设计来应对LLM在教育评估中带来的诚信与隐私挑战。

title: The Rhetoric of Machine Learning
comment: 25 pages. Text of a talk given at AlphaPersuade 2.0, 26 March 2026
summary: I examine the technology of machine learning from the perspective of rhetoric, which is simply the art of persuasion. Rather than being a neutral and "objective" way to build "world models" from data, machine learning is (I argue) inherently rhetorical. I explore some of its rhetorical features, and examine one pervasive business model where machine learning is widely used, "manipulation as a service."

AI.tldr: 本文从修辞学视角重新审视机器学习技术，认为其本质上是修辞性的而非中立的"客观"工具，并探讨了机器学习在"操控即服务"这一商业模式中的应用。
AI.motivation: 传统观点将机器学习视为从数据中构建"世界模型"的中立、客观方法，但作者认为这种观点掩盖了机器学习技术本质上的修辞特性，需要从修辞学（说服艺术）的角度重新理解这一技术。
