CMRM measures the confidence margin between the observed label and competing labels, and thresholds it with a conformal quantile estimated per batch to focus training on high-margin samples while suppressing likely mislabeled ones. We derive a learning bound for CMRM under arbitrary label noise requiring only mild regularity of the margin distribution. Across five base methods and six benchmarks with synthetic and real-world noise, CMRM consistently improves accuracy (up to +3.39%), reduces conformal prediction set size (up to -20.44%) and does not hurt under 0% noise, showing that CMRM captures a method-agnostic uncertainty signal that existing mechanisms did not exploit.

AI.tldr: CMRM是一种即插即用的封套框架，通过添加单个分位数校准的正则化项来改进任意分类损失在标签噪声下的性能，无需特权知识或训练管道修改。该方法测量观察标签与竞争标签之间的置信度边界，并用共形分位数阈值化，在训练中聚焦高边界样本、抑制可能的错误标注样本。
AI.motivation: 现有噪声标签学习方法通常需要特权知识（如噪声转移矩阵、干净子集或预训练特征提取器），而这些资源在最需要鲁棒性时往往不可用。因此需要一种无需特权知识、即插即用的方法来处理标签噪声问题。
AI.method: CMRM通过以下步骤工作：（1）测量观察标签与竞争标签之间的置信度边界；（2）使用逐批次估计的共形分位数对边界进行阈值化；（3）聚焦高边界样本的同时抑制可能的错误标注样本。该方法作为封套框架可与任意基础分类损失结合使用，无需修改训练流程。
AI.result: 在五个基础方法和六个基准数据集上（含合成噪声和真实世界噪声），CMRM一致提升准确率（最高+3.39%）、缩减共形预测集大小（最高-20.44%），且在0%噪声下无性能损害。
AI.conclusion: CMRM捕捉到了现有机制未利用的方法无关的不确定性信号，证明了置信度边界是一种有效的、与具体方法无关的噪声检测和利用机制。

title: FMI@SU ToxHabits: Evaluating LLMs Performance on Toxic Habit Extraction in Spanish Clinical Texts
comment: 8 pages, 1 figure, 6 tables, Challenge and Workshop BC9 Large Language Models for Clinical and Biomedical NLP, International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence IJCAI 2025
summary: The paper presents an approach for the recognition of toxic habits named entities in Spanish clinical texts. The approach was developed for the ToxHabits Shared Task. Our team participated in subtask 1, which aims to detect substance use and abuse mentions in clinical case reports and classify them in four categories (Tobacco, Alcohol, Cannabis, and Drug). We explored various methods of utilizing LLMs for the task, including zero-shot, few-shot, and prompt optimization, and found that GPT-4.1's few-shot prompting performed the best in our experiments. Our method achieved an F1 score of 0.65 on the test set, demonstrating a promising result for recognizing named entities in languages other than English.

AI.tldr: 本研究针对西班牙语临床文本中的有毒习惯命名实体识别任务，探索了GPT-4.1等大语言模型在零样本、小样本和提示优化等策略下的表现，其中小样本提示策略表现最佳，F1分数达0.65。
AI.motivation: 临床文本中物质使用和滥用信息的自动识别对于公共卫生监测和医学研究具有重要意义，但非英语语言（如西班牙语）的相关研究相对匮乏。
AI.method: 采用大语言模型（GPT-4.1），通过零样本、小样本和提示优化等不同策略进行有毒习惯命名实体识别，并将实体分为烟草、酒精、大麻和药物四类。
AI.result: GPT-4.1结合小样本提示策略在测试集上取得最佳性能，F1分数为0.65。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明大语言模型在非英语语言的命名实体识别任务中具有应用潜力和可行性。

title: EVGeoQA: Benchmarking LLMs on Dynamic, Multi-Objective Geo-Spatial Exploration
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate remarkable reasoning capabilities, their potential for purpose-driven exploration in dynamic geo-spatial environments remains under-investigated. Existing Geo-Spatial Question Answering (GSQA) benchmarks predominantly focus on static retrieval, failing to capture the complexity of real-world planning that involves dynamic user locations and compound constraints. To bridge this gap, we introduce EVGeoQA, a novel benchmark built upon Electric Vehicle (EV) charging scenarios that features a distinct location-anchored and dual-objective design. Specifically, each query in EVGeoQA is explicitly bound to a user's real-time coordinate and integrates the dual objectives of a charging necessity and a co-located activity preference. To systematically assess models in such complex settings, we further propose GeoRover, a general evaluation framework based on a tool-augmented agent architecture to evaluate the LLMs' capacity for dynamic, multi-objective exploration. Our experiments reveal that while LLMs successfully utilize tools to address sub-tasks, they struggle with long-range spatial exploration. Notably, we observe an emergent capability: LLMs can summarize historical exploration trajectories to enhance exploration efficiency. These findings establish EVGeoQA as a challenging testbed for future geo-spatial intelligence. The dataset and prompts are available at https://github.com/Hapluckyy/EVGeoQA/.

AI.tldr: EVGeoQA是一个基于电动汽车充电场景的新型地理空间问答基准测试，采用位置锚定和双目标设计，评估大语言模型在动态多目标探索任务中的表现。实验表明LLM能够利用工具完成子任务，但在长距离空间探索方面存在困难，同时展现出从历史轨迹中学习以提高探索效率的新兴能力。
AI.motivation: 现有地理空间问答基准主要关注静态检索，无法反映现实世界中涉及动态用户位置和复合约束的复杂规划场景，LLMs在动态地理空间环境中的目的驱动探索能力尚未得到充分研究。
AI.method: 1) 构建EVGeoQA基准测试，以电动汽车充电场景为核心，每个查询绑定用户实时坐标并整合充电必要性和同位活动偏好双目标；2) 提出GeoRover评估框架，基于工具增强的智能体架构评估LLMs的动态多目标探索能力。
AI.result: 实验发现：LLMs能成功利用工具解决子任务，但在长距离空间探索方面表现困难；同时观察到新兴能力——LLMs能够总结历史探索轨迹以提高探索效率。
AI.conclusion: EVGeoQA作为一个具有挑战性的测试平台，可用于评估和发展未来的地理空间智能研究。

title: MICA: Multivariate Infini Compressive Attention for Time Series Forecasting
summary: Multivariate forecasting with Transformers faces a core scalability challenge: modeling cross-channel dependencies via attention compounds attention's quadratic sequence complexity with quadratic channel scaling, making full cross-channel attention impractical for high-dimensional time series. We propose Multivariate Infini Compressive Attention (MICA), an architectural design to extend channel-independent Transformers to channel-dependent forecasting. By adapting efficient attention techniques from the sequence dimension to the channel dimension, MICA adds a cross-channel attention mechanism to channel-independent backbones that scales linearly with channel count and context length. We evaluate channel-independent Transformer architectures with and without MICA across multiple forecasting benchmarks. MICA reduces forecast error over its channel-independent counterparts by 5.4% on average and up to 25.4% on individual datasets, highlighting the importance of explicit cross-channel modeling. Moreover, models with MICA rank first among deep multivariate Transformer and MLP baselines. MICA models also scale more efficiently with respect to both channel count and context length than Transformer baselines that compute attention across both the temporal and channel dimensions, establishing compressive attention as a practical solution for scalable multivariate forecasting.

AI.tldr: MICA（Multivariate Infini Compressive Attention）是一种把 Infini-Attention 的线性注意力/压缩记忆技术从"序列维度"迁移到"通道维度"的架构设计：它在通道独立（channel-independent）骨干（如 PatchTST）上叠加一个跨通道的全局线性注意力模块，并与原有的局部时间注意力通过可学习门控融合，使总体复杂度为 O(P²C + PC)，对通道数与上下文长度均为线性扩展。实验显示 MICA 相对通道独立版本平均降低预测误差 5.4%（最高 25.4%），在深度多变量 Transformer/MLP 基线中排名第一，且在通道数与上下文长度的扩展效率上优于在时间与通道两个维度同时做注意力的 Transformer（如 Moirai、Timer-XL、Chronos-2）。
AI.motivation: 多变量时间序列预测中，跨通道依赖（cross-channel dependency）已被证明能显著提升精度（天气、能源、交通、医疗、金融等场景）。但现有通道独立模型（PatchTST、DLinear/TSMixer 类）高效且对伪跨通道相关鲁棒，而要在 Transformer 中显式建模跨通道关系，若直接做全跨通道注意力，其代价是"注意力的二次序列复杂度 × 二次通道扩展"，即 O(P²C²)，在高维时序中不可行；即便 iTransformer 的通道注意力也需 O(PC²)。作者观察到这与 LLM 长上下文问题同构——需要借用 Infini-Attention（Munkhdalai et al., 2024）的压缩记忆与线性注意力思想。因此动机是：设计一个既保留通道独立骨干效率、又能以线性代价引入通道依赖的通用可插拔架构，并厘清各类跨通道处理机制的复杂度权衡。
AI.method:
**任务设定**：给定 Y∈R^{B×C×T}，用长度 L 的上下文预测 H 步；单变量设定把通道折入 batch（BC 个独立序列），多变量设定保留通道维并由模型内部组件显式建模跨通道依赖。损失采用 MAE（对离群点更鲁棒、单位可解释），在 B、C、H 上平均。

**MICA 三组件**（加在通道独立骨干上）：
1. **局部注意力（Local Attention）**：保留骨干（如 PatchTST）的多头缩放点积注意力，逐通道独立建模局部时序关系，A_local = softmax(QKᵀ/√d_k)V，形状 R^{B×C×N×P×d_v}；复杂度 O(P²C)，兼容 FlashAttention。
2. **全局注意力（Global Attention）**：把 Infini-Attention 的线性注意力改造到通道维。通过避免 QKᵀ 矩阵乘，改为跨通道累积 KᵀV 得到全局上下文记忆 M=Σ_c φ(K^{(c)})ᵀV^{(c)} 与归一化项 z=Σ_cΣ_p φ(K_p^{(c)})，再由 φ(Q) 查询，得 A_global = φ(Q)M / (φ(Q)z + ε)，其中 φ(x)=ELU(x)+1，ε 为数值稳定常数；复杂度 O(PC)。与 Infini-Attention 不同，MICA **不保留/更新跨前向传播的记忆状态**（因预测训练常用窗口采样，无法保证时间上下文连续）；记忆矩阵每次前向独立重算。
3. **全局-局部混合门（Mixing Gate）**：线性门 A_mixed = σ(β)⊙A_global + (1−σ(β))⊙A_local，β 为每头一个可学习参数，从 U(0,1e-2) 初始化并在头维度上中心化（β̂_k = β_k − E_k[β_k]）以获得平衡的初始混合偏好；另提出**非线性 MLP 门**：A_mixed = MLP(A_global, A_local)，以及引入查询信息的上下文引导变体 MLP(A_global, A_local, Q)。最后一层混合输出经 Decoder（可以是 PatchTST/MOMENT 式轻量线性投影）得到预测。

**总体复杂度**：O(P²C + PC)，对通道数 C 与上下文/序列长度 P 线性；顺序处理通道可将全局注意力内存降至 O(P²C + P)。附录给出更省内存的全局注意力算法草图。

**配套贡献**：跨通道处理技术分类表（按机制与复杂度对比 PCA/FastICA、TSMixer、TimeMixer、SOFTS、ModernTCN、TimesNet、UP2ME、StemGNN、TimeFilter、TimePro、Moirai、Timer-XL、iTransformer、Crossformer、Chronos-2 等）；覆盖气候、能源、交通、医疗的多领域基准，并贡献两个来自 Earth Observing Laboratory Field Data Archive 的高频分布式气象站数据集；以及设计消融（全局线性注意力的通道排除与通道加权策略、门控形式）。
AI.result: 1. **精度**：在多个预测基准上，MICA 相对其通道独立对应模型平均降低误差 5.4%，单数据集最高降低 25.4%，说明显式跨通道建模的必要性。2. **排名**：带 MICA 的模型在深度多变量 Transformer 与 MLP 基线中排名第一。3. **可扩展性**：MICA 在通道数与上下文长度上的扩展效率优于在时间与通道双维做注意力的 Transformer 基线；分类表显示 MICA 是唯一对通道数线性扩展的多变量 Transformer（Crossformer 仅在可学习向量数 R ≪ C 时才线性）。4. **消融**：全局线性注意力的通道排除/加权策略与非线性门控设计对性能有显著影响（详见附录 D.1）。
AI.conclusion: 跨通道建模对多变量预测是有价值的，但必须配合线性级复杂度才具备实用性。MICA 通过把 Infini-Attention 的压缩/线性注意力从上下文维迁移到通道维，在保留通道独立骨干局部时间建模能力的同时，以 O(P²C + PC) 的代价引入跨通道依赖，并以可学习门控自适应融合局部与全局信息；结合面向跨通道机制的复杂度分类学与多领域（含自建高频气象数据）基准，实验证明其在精度和扩展性两方面均优于现有深度多变量 Transformer/MLP 基线，确立了"压缩式注意力"作为可扩展多变量预测的可行方案。局限在于其局部时间注意力仍为二次复杂度 O(P²C)，全局注意力每前向重算记忆（放弃 Infini-Attention 的持久压缩记忆），且混合权重以头级参数或浅层 MLP 形式实现，可能限制细粒度的通道级自适应。

title: Attention Flows: Tracing LLM Conceptual Engagement via Story Summaries
summary: Although LLM context lengths have grown, there is evidence that their ability to integrate information across long-form texts has not kept pace. We evaluate one such understanding task: generating summaries of novels. When human authors of summaries compress a story, they reveal what they consider narratively important. Therefore, by comparing human and LLM-authored summaries, we can assess whether models mirror human patterns of conceptual engagement with texts. To measure conceptual engagement, we align sentences from 150 human-written novel summaries with the specific chapters they reference. We demonstrate the difficulty of this alignment task, which indicates the complexity of summarization as a task. We then generate and align additional summaries by nine state-of-the-art LLMs for each of the 150 reference texts. Comparing the human and model-authored summaries, we find both stylistic differences between the texts and differences in how humans and LLMs distribute their focus throughout a narrative, with models emphasizing the ends of texts. Comparing human narrative engagement with model attention mechanisms suggests explanations for degraded narrative comprehension and targets for future development. We release our dataset to support future research.

AI.tldr: 研究评估了LLM在长篇小说摘要生成任务中的表现，发现模型与人类作者在叙事焦点分布上存在显著差异：人类摘要反映其认为的叙事重点，而模型摘要则倾向于强调文本结尾部分。
AI.motivation: 虽然LLM的上下文长度已大幅增长，但其在长文本中整合信息的能力可能未同步提升。研究者试图通过比较人类与LLM生成的摘要，评估模型是否表现出与人类相似的概念性参与模式。
AI.method: 1) 收集150部小说的150篇人类-written摘要，将摘要句子与具体章节进行对齐；2) 使用9个SOTA LLM为每部小说生成摘要并进行相同对齐；3) 比较人类与模型摘要的文体差异及叙事焦点分布；4) 将人类叙事参与模式与模型注意力机制进行对比分析。
AI.result: 1) 人类与模型摘要存在明显文体差异；2) 叙事焦点分布不同：模型更强调文本结尾；3) 章节对齐任务本身具有相当难度，表明摘要任务的复杂性；4) 模型注意力机制与人类叙事参与模式的差异可解释其叙事理解能力的退化。
AI.conclusion: LLM在长文本叙事理解方面与人类存在系统性偏差，模型对文本结尾的过度强调可能是其叙事整合能力不足的原因之一。该数据集可用于未来LLM长文本理解能力的改进研究。

title: Reason in Chains, Learn in Trees: Self-Rectification and Grafting for Multi-turn Agent Policy Optimization
summary: Reinforcement learning for Large Language Model agents is often hindered by sparse rewards in multi-step reasoning tasks. Existing approaches like Group Relative Policy Optimization treat sampled trajectories as independent chains, assigning uniform credit to all steps in each chain and ignoring the existence of critical steps that may disproportionally impact reasoning outcome. In this paper, we propose T-STAR(Tree-structured Self-Taught Agent Rectification), a framework that recovers the latent correlated reward structure across seemingly independent trajectories. Specifically, we consolidate trajectories into a unified Cognitive Tree by identifying and merging functionally similar steps/nodes. It enables an Introspective Valuation mechanism that back-propagates trajectory-level rewards through the tree to obtain a new notion of variance-reduced relative advantage at step-level. Using the Cognitive Tree, we also develop In-Context Thought Grafting to synthesize corrective reasoning by contrasting successful and failed branches at critical divergence points/steps. Our proposed Surgical Policy Optimization then capitalizes on the rich policy gradient information concentrated at these critical points/steps through a Bradley-Terry type of surgical loss. Extensive experiments across embodied, interactive, reasoning, and planning benchmarks demonstrate that T-STAR achieves consistent improvements over strong baselines, with gains most pronounced on tasks requiring extended reasoning chains.

AI.tldr: T-STAR通过构建认知树(Cognitive Tree)整合独立轨迹，识别关键决策点，结合回顾性估值机制和情境思维嫁接技术，在长推理链任务中显著提升LLM Agent的强化学习效果。
AI.motivation: 现有方法如GRPO将采样轨迹视为独立链，统一分配信用给所有步骤，忽视了关键步骤对推理结果的非对称影响，导致在稀疏奖励的多步推理任务中学习效率低下。
AI.method: 1) 构建认知树：识别并合并功能相似的步骤/节点，将轨迹整合为统一结构；2) 回顾性估值机制(Introspective Valuation)：通过树结构反向传播轨迹级奖励，获得步级方差缩减的相对优势估计；3) 情境思维嫁接(In-Context Thought Grafting)：在关键分歧点对比成功与失败分支，合成修正推理；4) 外科策略优化(Surgical Policy Optimization)：采用Bradley-Terry型损失，聚焦关键决策点的策略梯度信息。
AI.result: 在具身、交互、推理和规划基准测试中，T-STAR相比强基线方法取得一致改进，在需要长推理链的任务上提升尤为显著。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模轨迹间的潜在关联结构，识别关键决策点并针对性地传递梯度信息，可以有效解决LLM Agent在多步推理任务中的稀疏奖励难题。

title: AE-ViT: Stable Long-Horizon Parametric Partial Differential Equations Modeling
summary: Deep Learning Reduced Order Models (ROMs) are becoming increasingly popular as surrogate models for parametric partial differential equations (PDEs) due to their ability to handle high-dimensional data, approximate highly nonlinear mappings, and utilize GPUs. Existing approaches typically learn evolution either on the full solution field, which requires capturing long-range spatial interactions at high computational cost, or on compressed latent representations obtained from autoencoders, which reduces the cost but often yields latent vectors that are difficult to evolve, since they primarily encode spatial information. Moreover, in parametric PDEs, the initial condition alone is not sufficient to determine the trajectory, and most current approaches are not evaluated on jointly predicting multiple solution components with differing magnitudes and parameter sensitivities. To address these challenges, we propose a joint model consisting of a convolutional encoder, a transformer operating on latent representations, and a decoder for reconstruction. The main novelties are joint training with multi-stage parameter injection and coordinate channel injection. Parameters are injected at multiple stages to improve conditioning. Physical coordinates are encoded to provide spatial information. This allows the model to dynamically adapt its computations to the specific PDE parameters governing each system, rather than learning a single fixed response. Experiments on the Advection-Diffusion-Reaction equation and Navier-Stokes flow around the cylinder wake demonstrate that our approach combines the efficiency of latent evolution with the fidelity of full-field models, outperforming DL-ROMs, latent transformers, and plain ViTs in multi-field prediction, reducing the relative rollout error by approximately $5$ times.

AI.tldr: AE-ViT 是一种用于参数化偏微分方程长期自回归代理建模的联合学习架构：由全卷积编码器（带 FiLM 参数注入）降分辨率、视觉 Transformer（带参数 token 与注意力 FiLM 调制）在隐空间演化、解码器重建。辅以坐标傅里叶特征通道与长度仅 4 步的 scheduled sampling，即可在 Advection-Diffusion-Reaction 与圆柱绕流 Navier-Stokes 两个算例上取得远低于 DL-ROM、隐空间 Transformer 和朴素 ViT 的相对 rollout 误差（约 5 倍提升），且参数量更少（≈6M vs 38–52M），误差随时间近似线性累积，数百步内保持稳定。
AI.motivation: 参数化时变 PDE 的代理模型（深度学习降阶模型 ROM）在血流动力学、空气动力学等场景中有替代昂贵数值求解的价值，但现有路线各有缺陷：(1) 在全解场上演化需捕获长程空间交互，计算代价高；(2) 在自编码器压缩的隐空间演化虽便宜，但隐向量主要编码空间信息、难以演化；(3) DeepONet/FNO 等算子学习框架通常只把物理参数作为输入函数的常数场或拼接向量，未做显式参数条件化，当各算例共享同一初始条件时网络无法区分轨迹；(4) 多数方法未在"多分量、量级与参数敏感度差异大"的联合预测场景下评估；(5) 分阶段训练（先训 AE 再训演化器）会使隐空间偏向重建精度而牺牲预测鲁棒性。作者的目标是在训练参数范围内的分布内（in-distribution）未见参数上实现稳定的长时程 rollout。
AI.method: 整体为编码器—Transformer—解码器联合训练，端到端以 MSE 最小化 4 步展开窗口内的平均误差。编码器：全卷积 ResNet 块（GroupNorm，组数 min(32, n_c/4)），后接 FiLM 参数注入 h←α(λ)⊙h⊕β(λ)；输出保留空间结构的张量隐表示（如 16×16×256）。坐标编码：将归一化物理坐标 x,y 以频率 f=2,4,…,2^k 的 sin/cos 特征编码为 4k 个通道，与原特征拼接。Transformer：ViT 编码器，切 2×2 patch 得 64 个 token，可学习位置编码，参数经 MLP 作为额外 token；每个注意力头在 Q/K/V 上施加参数化 FiLM（V←V⊙(1+ηα_V(λ))+ηβ_V(λ)，η 为带上限的可学习标量），LayerNorm 后再施加 λ 条件调制（θ=1e-3，调制网络近零初始化以稳定训练）；参数注入覆盖编码器、Transformer、解码器三层。解码器镜像编码器，输出 t+Δt 的原分辨率多分量解。训练：scheduled sampling，窗口长度 4，逆 sigmoid 衰减 p_i=k/(k+exp(i/k))；不注入时间以保外推；全局梯度范数裁剪 c=1；三阶段学习率（10% warm-up、20% 恒定、其余 cosine 衰减）；逐通道 z-score 归一化。理论解释：以核回归/算子学习视角把注意力权重 a_ij^t(λ) 视为隐 token 上的"状态相关有效核"，并区分特征条件化、注意力条件化、全条件化三种参数注入范式。基线：ViT、DL-ROM、AE+1D Transformer（均做超参网格搜索，多随机种子）。算例：ADR 方程（32×32 网格 FEM P1，800/200/200 训练/验证/测试）与圆柱绕流 Navier-Stokes（64×320 网格，u_x、u_y、p 联合预测，800 训练模拟）。
AI.result: ADR 算例：AE-ViT 在 T=0.4 时相对 rollout 误差 0.0029、T=1.0 时 0.0059，远优于 ViT（0.0997/0.2366）、DL-ROM（0.0123/0.6473）、AE+1D Transformer（0.0117/0.0229）；参数量约 6M，低于 ViT 的 4M 之上的其他基线（38M、52M）。消融显示单项增强均显著降错：坐标编码 0.0575、编码器/解码器 FiLM 0.005207、LayerNorm FiLM 0.15602、注意力 FiLM 0.005188、参数 token 0.008613（基线 0.4274），注意力 FiLM 与特征 FiLM 单独效果相当但需同时使用。Navier-Stokes 算例（u_x/u_y/p 联合）：AE-ViT 在 T=2.7 分别为 0.01725/0.0724/0.0999，T=6.75 为 0.0276/0.1271/0.1861，全面优于 ViT（0.3876/1.0225/1.6385 起）、DL-ROM 与 AE+1D Transformer，相对最优基线约低 5 倍误差。误差随时间近似线性增长（压力因全局泊松方程与相位漂移呈周期性尖峰），训练仅用 4 步 scheduled sampling 却能稳定外推至数百步（约窗口长度 250 倍）。作者还报告分开训练 AE 与 ViT 失败（固定隐表示上 ViT 不收敛）。
AI.conclusion: AE-ViT 证明联合的、参数感知的算子学习可以同时具备隐空间演化的效率与全解场模型的精度：多阶段参数注入 + 坐标通道 + 短窗 scheduled sampling 使模型在长时程 rollout 中保持稳定，显著降低训练成本，并在多分量（量级不平衡）参数化 PDE 上领先现有 DL-ROM、隐空间 Transformer 与朴素 ViT。局限：依赖将解插值到矩形域，不适用于非矩形/复杂几何；自注意力的二次复杂度限制了 token 数（可用相对位置偏置或稀疏/线性注意力缓解）。未来工作为借助神经网络逼近理论给出误差与复杂度界，并面向流体—结构耦合等几何非线性问题扩展。

title: State-of-the-Art Arabic Language Modeling with Sparse MoE Fine-Tuning and Chain-of-Thought Distillation
summary: This paper introduces Arabic-DeepSeek-R1, an application-driven open-source Arabic LLM that leverages a sparse MoE backbone to address the digital equity gap for under-represented languages, and establishes a new SOTA across the entire Open Arabic LLM Leaderboard (OALL). Our four-phase CoT distillation scheme integrates Arabic-specific linguistic verification and regional ethical norms into a 372M-token, contamination-controlled 80/20 Arabic-English training mixture. Arabic-DeepSeek-R1 achieves the highest average score across the seven-benchmark OALL suite while establishing SOTA or near-SOTA, including dominant results on grammar-focused MadinahQA (surpassing both GPT-5.1 and the OALL leader by substantial margins), safety-oriented AraTrust, multi-ability AlGhafa, and retrieval-augmented ALRAGE. Our results indicate that the combination of sparse MoE architecture, culturally-informed CoT distillation with explicit Arabic linguistic checks, and strategic bilingual data curation enables an open-source adapted model to systematically outperform the proprietary frontier system GPT-5.1 on the majority of benchmarks evaluating comprehensive language-specific tasks: the first such demonstration for Arabic LLMs. These findings indicate that much of Arabic's performance deficit in current LLM ecosystems stems from under-specialization rather than architectural limitations, and that parameter-efficient adaptation of open reasoning models can yield breakthrough SOTA performance without industrial-scale pretraining costs. Arabic-DeepSeek-R1 establishes a validated and replicable framework for sovereign and domain-specific language technologies, demonstrating that strategic, culturally-grounded adaptation of sparse MoE backbones offers a viable and cost-effective pathway to achieving record-breaking performance across standardized benchmarks for low-resource languages.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Arabic-DeepSeek-R1：以开源推理型稀疏 MoE 模型 DeepSeek-R1 为基座，通过 LoRA 参数高效微调 + 四阶段「文化嵌入式」思维链（CoT）蒸馏 + 372M token 无污染的 80/20 阿英混合语料，在 Open Arabic LLM Leaderboard（OALL v2）七个基准上取得最高平均分 80.18%，超过此前开源平均榜首 D2IL-Arabic-Qwen2.5-72B（+4.32）与闭源前沿模型 GPT-5.1（+2.31），并在 5/7 个单项基准上达到 SOTA 或接近 SOTA（MadinahQA 86.43%，较类别榜首 +8.43 为最大增益）。
AI.motivation: 阿拉伯语拥有 3 亿+母语者，是教育、外交与文化的重要载体，但其数字存在度与高资源语言严重脱节，形成"数字公平"问题：现有阿拉伯语模型（Jais、ALLaM）在复杂推理与生成任务上仍明显落后，且闭源模型（GPT-4/Gemini/GPT-5.1）不可参数级微调，无法满足教育、医疗、公共服务、安全关键场景对数据主权、透明度、可审计与文化对齐的要求；闭源模型主要在英语中心语料上训练，对阿语方言、形态句法与文化规范处理脆弱。作者的核心论点是：阿语性能差距主要源于"专门化不足"而非"架构局限"，因此无需工业级预训练算力，通过参数高效的针对性适配即可突破。此外，社区长期存在开源 vs. 闭源的权衡：闭源强但不可研究与适配，开源可权重级适配但需高质量阿语语料与专门训练配方，而现有工作缺乏系统、可复现的阿拉伯语适配与评测流程。
AI.method: 1) 基座模型：以 DeepSeek-R1（RL 训练的推理型稀疏 MoE，权重开放）为基座，激活部分专家降低算力开销并减少阿/英语 token 流相互干扰；冻结基座、仅训练 LoRA 适配器，推理时合并。2) 数据：构建 372M token 监督数据集，阿语:英语 ≈ 80:20，阿语以原生长文本、教育/宗教材料、法律政策文本及海湾/黎凡特/埃及等方言对话为主，偏好原生创作而非机器翻译；英语部分锚定预训练分布以防止灾难性遗忘并保留跨语言推理迁移。分布为文献批评 103.2M、STEM/数学/逻辑 90M、创意写作与开放对话 70M、消费评论与客服反馈 60.2M、法律与文化对齐 40M、社会与方言 8.6M。使用专门分类器与精确/模糊匹配剔除与 OALL v2 七个基准的重叠，并做低质、近重复、有害内容过滤。3) 四阶段 CoT 蒸馏：用 GPT-5.1（batch API，比 Claude 4.5 更经济）在复杂度分层子集上生成推理链，四段格式为 analysis（识别核心冲突/适用规则，纳入文化化两难如 amanah 与 sila 的原则冲突）→ elimination（显式排除貌似合理但错误的选项并给出理由）→ linguistic check（对最终选项做阿拉伯语形态句法与文体约束的显式校验）→ synthesis（简洁标准化作答）；该格式与 DeepSeek-R1 的 RL 推理风格对齐，第 3 阶段语言校验是区别于标准 CoT 蒸馏（Wei et al., 2022）的关键创新。4) 训练流程：SFT + CoT 蒸馏联合训练，混合精度、多 GPU、梯度累积处理长 CoT 序列，余弦学习率 + warmup，小规模消融选择 LoRA rank/缩放、学习率与最大序列长度，训练仅数个 epoch。5) 评测协议：采用 OALL v2 协议与 lighteval；对直答模型用归一化 log-likelihood 准确率；对推理型模型改为解析模型输出中 `</think>` 之后的显式答案字母计算准确率（作者论证默认 log-prob 打分与推理型模型实际产出方式不符，会低估其性能），并声明所有评测实例在训练时均不可见。
AI.result: 表 1 显示 Arabic-DeepSeek-R1 平均 80.18%，为全场最高：较平均榜首 D2IL-Arabic-Qwen2.5-72B +4.32，较 GPT-5.1 +2.31，较 Falcon-H1-Arabic-34B-Instruct +5.28，较 Jais-family-30B-16k-chat +14.75，较未适配的 DeepSeek-R1 基线 +6.56（榜首前五名模型通常相差不足 0.5 分）。单项上 5/7 达到 SOTA 或近 SOTA：MadinahQA 86.43%（超类别榜首 AIC-1 的 78.00% 达 +8.43、超 GPT-5.1 达 +7.21，为全部评测最大增益），AraTrust 90.22%（较基线 +6.73、超 GPT-5.1 +2.10，距榜首 91.40% 仅 1.18），AlGhafa 81.88%（超类别榜首 Llama-3.3-70B +1.52、超 GPT-5.1 +7.66），ALRAGE 81.88% 级别上的显著领先（超类别榜首 Qwen3-32B +5.84、超 GPT-5.1 +4.52），ArabicMMLU 77.14%（超类别榜首 +1.82，距 GPT-5.1 的 78.09% 差 0.95），ArbMMLU-HT 78.84%（超类别榜首 +4.55、较基线 +15.54，但低于 GPT-5.1 的 83.30%）。该模型同时超越训练自基的专用阿语系统 Jais 与 Falcon-H1-Arabic-34B（后者本身在 ArbMMLU-HT、AlGhafa 上超过类别榜首），是首个同时做到（a）平均分最高、（b）多数单项 SOTA、（c）语法任务大幅领先的模型。作者也承认局限：Arabic EXAMS（60.26%）落后类别榜首 Llama-3.3-70B（66.67%），说明考试型课程监督不足；ALRAGE 仅与基线持平（+0.16），反映训练偏重结构化推理而缺少检索感知监督。
AI.conclusion: 论文结论是：阿语在现有 LLM 生态中的性能差距主要源于语言/文化专门化不足，而非架构性限制；对开放推理型稀疏 MoE 基座做参数高效适配（LoRA）、配合带显式形态句法校验的文化嵌入式四阶段 CoT 蒸馏、以及去污染的阿英混合数据配方，可在不付出工业级预训练算力与环保成本的前提下取得破纪录的标准化基准表现，为主权与领域专用语言技术提供了可验证、可复现的模板（可服务教育、医疗、公共服务与安全关键场景的数字公平与本地可控部署）。局限与未来工作包括：为 ALRAGE 引入检索感知/RAG 训练目标、针对考试课程与 RAG 语料的轻量域自适应阶段、以及跨方言、跨领域、跨安全类别的错误模式分析以细化数据与 CoT 设计。需注意评测采用解析式答案抽取而非官方 log-prob 打分，且缺少与闭源模型的统一协议对照，结论的可比性与归因（架构 vs. 训练配方 vs. 评测协议）仍需进一步验证。

title: How Much LLM Does a Self-Revising Agent Actually Need?
summary:
Recent LLM-based agents often place world modeling, planning, and reflection inside a single language model loop. This can produce capable behavior, but it makes a basic scientific question difficult to answer: which part of the agent's competence actually comes from the LLM, and which part comes from explicit structure around it?
  We study this question not by claiming a general answer, but by making it empirically tractable. We introduce a declared reflective runtime protocol that externalizes agent state, confidence signals, guarded actions, and hypothetical transitions into inspectable runtime structure. We instantiate this protocol in a declarative runtime and evaluate it on noisy Collaborative Battleship [4] using four progressively structured agents over 54 games (18 boards $\times$ 3 seeds).
  The resulting decomposition isolates four components: posterior belief tracking, explicit world-model planning, symbolic in-episode reflection, and sparse LLM-based revision. Across this decomposition, explicit world-model planning improves substantially over a greedy posterior-following baseline (+24.1pp win rate, +0.017 F1). Symbolic reflection operates as a real runtime mechanism -- with prediction tracking, confidence gating, and guarded revision actions -- even though its current revision presets are not yet net-positive in aggregate. Adding conditional LLM revision at about 4.3\% of turns yields only a small and non-monotonic change: average F1 rises slightly (+0.005) while win rate drops (31$\rightarrow$29 out of 54).
  These results suggest a methodological contribution rather than a leaderboard claim: externalizing reflection turns otherwise latent agent behavior into inspectable runtime structure, allowing the marginal role of LLM intervention to be studied directly.

AI.tldr: 本文研究LLM智能体中各组件的贡献度分解问题，提出一种反射性运行时协议，将智能体状态外化为可检查的运行时结构。通过在Collaborative Battleship环境中对四种渐进结构化智能体进行评估，发现显式世界模型规划比贪心后验跟随基线显著提升（+24.1pp胜率），而条件性LLM修订仅在约4.3%的回合中触发，对性能影响较小且非单调。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体通常将世界建模、规划和反思整合在单一语言模型循环中，这使得难以区分智能体能力究竟是来自LLM本身还是外部结构。本文旨在通过实证方法将这一科学问题变得可研究。
AI.method: 1) 设计声明式反射运行时协议，将智能体状态、后验置信度、守卫动作和假设性转换外化为可检查结构；2) 在Collaborative Battleship环境中实例化该协议；3) 评估四种渐进结构化智能体（54场游戏：18个棋盘×3个随机种子）。
AI.result: 世界模型规划比基线提升+24.1pp胜率和+0.017 F1分数；符号反思作为真实运行时机制运作（预测跟踪、置信度门控、守卫修订），但当前修订预设总体非正向；条件LLM修订仅在约4.3%回合触发，F1略升(+0.005)但胜率下降(31→29)。
AI.conclusion: 本文的主要贡献是方法论层面的：外部化反思机制将原本隐含的智能体行为转化为可检查的运行时结构，使得LLM干预的边际作用能够被直接研究。性能提升主要来自结构化规划而非LLM本身。

title: Distributed Interpretability and Control for Large Language Models
summary: Large language models that require multiple GPU cards to host are usually the most capable models. It is necessary to understand and steer these models, but the current technologies do not support the interpretability and steering of these models in the multi-GPU setting as well as the single-GPU setting. We present a practical implementation of activation-level interpretability (logit lens) and steering (steering vector) that scales up to multi-GPU language models. Our system implements design choices that reduce the activation memory by up to 7x and increase the throughput by up to 41x compared to a baseline on identical hardware. We demonstrate the method across LLaMA-3.1 (8B, 70B) and Qwen-3 (4B, 14B, 32B), sustaining 20-100 tokens/s while collecting full layer-wise activation trajectories for sequences of 1,500 tokens. Using label-position steering vectors injected post-LayerNorm, we show controllable, monotonic shifts in model outputs with a mean steerability slope of 0.702 across evaluated datasets, without fine-tuning or additional forward passes. We release detailed benchmarks, ablations, and a reproducible instrumentation recipe to enable practical interpretability and real-time behavioral control for frontier LLMs at https://github.com/Devdesai1901/LogitLense.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了可在多GPU环境下对大规模语言模型进行激活级可解释性分析（logit lens）和行为 steering 的实用实现方案，通过内存优化和吞吐量提升，在LLaMA-3.1和Qwen-3等多种模型上验证了post-LayerNorm steering vector的有效性。
AI.motivation: 当前需要多GPU才能运行的大型语言模型往往是最强大的模型，但现有技术无法在多GPU环境下实现与单GPU环境同等水平的模型可解释性和行为控制能力，这限制了对这些前沿模型的理解与操控。
AI.method: 采用激活级可解释性（logit lens）和 steering（steering vector）技术，通过创新的工程设计实现多GPU扩展。关键优化包括：1）激活内存降低7倍；2）吞吐量提升41倍；3）使用post-LayerNorm注入的label-position steering vectors，无需微调或额外前向传播。
AI.result: 在LLaMA-3.1（8B、70B）和Qwen-3（4B、14B、32B）上验证了该方法，支持20-100 tokens/s的实时处理，可处理1500 tokens序列的完整层间激活轨迹。实验显示模型输出产生可控的、单调的行为偏移，跨数据集平均steerability slope达0.702。
AI.conclusion: 本研究首次实现了大规模多GPU语言模型的实用化激活级可解释性和实时行为控制，提供了详细的基准测试、消融实验和可复现的 instrumentation 方案，为前沿LLM的可解释性研究提供了重要工具基础。

title: When to Call an Apple Red: Humans Follow Introspective Rules, VLMs Don't
summary: Understanding when Vision-Language Models (VLMs) will behave unexpectedly, whether models can reliably predict their own behavior, and if models adhere to their introspective reasoning are central challenges for trustworthy deployment. To study this, we introduce the Graded Color Attribution (GCA) dataset, a controlled benchmark designed to elicit decision rules and evaluate participant faithfulness to these rules. GCA consists of line drawings that vary pixel-level color coverage across three conditions: world-knowledge recolorings, counterfactual recolorings, and shapes with no color priors. Using GCA, both VLMs and human participants establish a threshold: the minimum percentage of pixels of a given color an object must have to receive that color label. We then compare these rules with their subsequent color attribution decisions. Our findings reveal that models systematically violate their own introspective rules. For example, GPT-5-mini violates its stated introspection rules in nearly 60\% of cases on objects with strong color priors. Human participants remain faithful to their stated rules, with any apparent violations being explained by a well-documented tendency to overestimate color coverage. In contrast, we find that VLMs are excellent estimators of color coverage, yet blatantly contradict their own reasoning in their final responses. Across all models and strategies for eliciting introspective rules, world-knowledge priors systematically degrade faithfulness in ways that do not mirror human cognition. Our findings challenge the view that VLM reasoning failures are difficulty-driven and suggest that VLM introspective self-knowledge is miscalibrated, with direct implications for high-stakes deployment.

AI.tldr: 论文引入GCA数据集研究VLMs是否能可靠预测自身行为及遵守自省推理规则。研究发现VLMs系统性地违反自身规则（如GPT-5-mini在强颜色先验物体上违反率达60%），而人类受试者则遵守规则。VLMs虽能准确估计颜色覆盖率，却在最终决策中公然矛盾。研究表明VLM自省式自我知识存在校准错误，对高风险应用部署具有直接启示。
AI.motivation: 理解VLMs何时会产生意外行为、模型能否可靠预测自身行为、以及模型是否遵守其自省推理，是实现可信部署的核心挑战。
AI.method: 引入Graded Color Attribution (GCA)数据集——一个用于引出决策规则并评估规则忠实度的受控基准。GCA包含线条图，通过三种条件变化像素级颜色覆盖率：世界知识重着色、反事实重着色、无颜色先验的形状。在GCA上测试VLMs和人类受试者，比较其建立的规则与后续颜色归因决策。
AI.result: 1. VLMs系统性地违反自身自省规则：GPT-5-mini在强颜色先验物体上违反率近60%。2. 人类受试者遵守规则，表面违规可由高估颜色覆盖率的认知偏差解释。3. VLMs是优秀的颜色覆盖率估计者，但公然矛盾自身推理。4. 世界知识先验系统性地损害忠实度，且方式与人类认知不同。
AI.conclusion: VLM推理失败并非源于困难驱动，而是VLM自省自我知识存在校准错误。直接挑战"推理失败由难度驱动"的观点，对高风险部署具有直接启示。

title: Inference-Time Code Selection via Symbolic Equivalence Partitioning
summary: "Best-of-N" selection is a popular inference-time scaling method for code generation using Large Language Models (LLMs). However, to reliably identify correct solutions, existing methods often depend on expensive or stochastic external verifiers. In this paper, we propose Symbolic Equivalence Partitioning, a selection framework that uses symbolic execution to group candidate programs by semantic behavior and select a representative from the dominant functional partition. To improve grouping and selection, we encode domain-specific constraints as Satisfiability Modulo Theories (SMT) assumptions during symbolic execution to reduce path explosion and prevent invalid input searches outside the problem domain. At N=10, our method improves average accuracy over Pass@1 from 0.728 to 0.803 on HumanEval+ and from 0.516 to 0.604 on LiveCodeBench, without requiring any additional LLM inference beyond the initial N candidate generations.

AI.tldr: SEP 用符号执行把 LLM 生成的 N 个候选程序按"在合法输入上的语义行为"划分为等价类，选最大等价类的代表作为最终答案；配合公共样例过滤与 SMT 约束注入，在 HumanEval+ 与 LiveCodeBench 上稳定优于 Pass@1 及多数重排基线，且不需要额外 LLM 推理。
AI.motivation: Best-of-N 代码生成的收益几乎完全取决于选择机制。理想做法是用完整隐藏测试判定正确性，但这类测试在推理时不可得；现有方法依赖代理信号（LLM 生成测试、学习式奖励模型/验证器、文本一致性），成本高、引入额外推理或验证器误差。更关键的是，作者指出选择问题具有特殊的语义结构：正确解在语法、实现与算法策略各异的情况下往往在合法输入上收敛到同一功能行为；而"一致性"本身不保证正确性——模型可能产生"相关的错误解"（correlated wrong solutions），共同实现同一错误理解，此时多数投票会稳定地选出错误行为。因此需要一个既不依赖昂贵外部验证器、又能直接刻画功能语义的信号。
AI.method: 框架包含四个组件：(1) 公共样例过滤器：执行题目自带的输入输出样例，剔除运行报错或输出不符的候选，得到规模 N' ≤ N 的候选池；(2) 有界符号等价判定：把 p_i ≡_C p_j 归约为"分歧公式"的存在性查询 ∃x. C(x) ∧ PC(x) ∧ (EO_i(x) ≠ EO_j(x))，其中 PC 为符号路径条件，EO 涵盖返回值、异常终止及可达输入对象的改动；求解器可满足即得反例证其不等价，预算内找不到反例则视为等价（由已探索路径与资源限制定义的有界近似）；实例化用 Python 差分符号执行引擎 CrossHair + Z3，固定 per-condition 15s、per-path 15√15≈3.87s 超时；(3) SMT-Constrained Pruning：不做 assert 注入（断言会引入额外失败分支、浪费求解预算），而是从题面显式约束块抽取约束、解析为 Python AST 并归一化（如链式比较），再作为 Z3 求解器级假设注入到符号前置代码中，使违反约束的路径不可行而被剪枝，从而把搜索限制在有效输入域内；(4) 贪心代表元划分：候选按序与已有划分的代表元比较（按规模从大到小），等价则并入，否则新建划分；利用等价关系在有界分析下的近似传递性把 O((N')²) 降为 O(N'·M)，最终输出最大划分的代表元。实现上对 HumanEval+ 统一注入 EvalPlus 的类型化函数签名，以消除 CrossHair 依赖类型提示构造符号输入所带来的提示格式混淆。
AI.result: 在 7 个模型（Phi-4 mini/reasoning、Qwen3 4B/4B-Instruct-2507/14B、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct、gpt-oss-20b，4B–20B）× 3 个采样预算（N=5/10/20）× 2 个基准上评估：N=10 时，HumanEval+ 平均准确率 0.754→0.826，LiveCodeBench 0.565→0.647；相对扩展基线在 42 个"模型×预算"设置中 40 个最优或并列最优（LiveCodeBench 上 gpt-oss-20b 的 0.881 略低于 SRank 0.885）。相对提升在 LiveCodeBench 上更大（+8.2 点/+14.5% vs HumanEval+ 的 +7.2 点/+9.5%），说明在语法相似度不可靠的竞赛题上功能语义信号更有价值；N 从 5 增至 20 持续改善未饱和。消融与诊断：约束注入（仅 LiveCodeBench）几乎不改变代表元准确率（0.647 vs 0.646），但成对等价准确率从 0.721 提升到 0.866、符号分析工作量减少 17.4%；去掉公共样例过滤后 HumanEval+/LiveCodeBench 分别下降 4.4/4.0 点，"主划分多数错误"案例从 35→64 与 78→151。成对等价准确率均值 0.884（HE+ 0.900、LCB 0.868）；8,969 个"存在≥2 个正确解"的一致性可用实例中仅 505 个（5.63%）被标记为主划分多数错误或代表元错误。成本方面：SEP 后处理为 CPU 符号分析（AMD Ryzen 7 7700X），HumanEval+ 平均 539/1271/2723 秒（N=5/10/20），LiveCodeBench 1103/2584/5292 秒，且不含候选执行与排序时间；而 CodeT 的辅助测试生成成本固定为 11192 秒（HE+）与 40986 秒（LCB），且需额外 H100 推理。
AI.conclusion: SEP 表明形式化语义分析可作为推理时代码选择的实用信号：仅依靠符号执行的功能一致性，无需辅助测试生成、训练验证器或额外 LLM 推理，即可把 Best-of-N 的候选池转化为更高的选择准确率，尤其在竞赛型难题上收益更大，且后处理成本低于基线的辅助测试生成阶段。其有效性以有界符号分析的近似性为前提：语义差异若超出搜索视野则可能被误判为等价；贪心划分只与当前代表元比较，带来顺序依赖；公共样例缺失时更易被"相关的错误解"主导；隐式写在自然语言中的约束无法恢复，可能造成等价解被错误分离。此外实现依赖 Python 专属符号执行后端，推广到 C++/Java/Rust 需 KLEE/CBMC 等工具链，验证成本 O(N'·M) 在大候选池下仍可能不可行。文中摘要所报数字（HumanEval+ 0.728→0.803、LiveCodeBench 0.516→0.604）与正文/表格（0.754→0.826、0.565→0.647）不一致，应以正文表格为准。

title: Team Fusion@ SU@ BC8 SympTEMIST track: transformer-based approach for symptom recognition and linking
comment: 6 pages, 3 tables, Proceedings of the BioCreative VIII Challenge and Workshop: Curation and Evaluation in the era of Generative Models, American Medical Informatics Association 2023 Annual Symposium
summary: This paper presents a transformer-based approach to solving the SympTEMIST named entity recognition (NER) and entity linking (EL) tasks. For NER, we fine-tune a RoBERTa-based (1) token-level classifier with BiLSTM and CRF layers on an augmented train set. Entity linking is performed by generating candidates using the cross-lingual SapBERT XLMR-Large (2), and calculating cosine similarity against a knowledge base. The choice of knowledge base proves to have the highest impact on model accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于Transformer的方法解决SympTEMIST命名实体识别（NER）和实体链接（EL）任务。NER采用RoBERTa + BiLSTM + CRF架构，EL使用SapBERT XLMR-Large生成候选并计算余弦相似度。
AI.motivation: 解决医学临床文本中的命名实体识别和实体链接问题，提升SympTEMIST任务性能
AI.method: NER模块：微调RoBERTa作为token级分类器，叠加BiLSTM和CRF层，并在增强训练集上训练。EL模块：利用跨语言SapBERT XLMR-Large生成候选实体，通过余弦相似度与知识库进行匹配
AI.result: 知识库的选择对模型准确率影响最大
AI.conclusion: 在实体链接任务中，知识库的选择是决定模型性能的关键因素

title: Discrete Flow Matching Policy Optimization
summary: We introduce Discrete flow Matching policy Optimization (DoMinO), a unified framework for Reinforcement Learning (RL) fine-tuning Discrete Flow Matching (DFM) models under a broad class of policy gradient methods. Our key idea is to view the DFM sampling procedure as a multi-step Markov Decision Process. This perspective provides a simple and transparent reformulation of fine-tuning reward maximization as a robust RL objective. Consequently, it not only preserves the original DFM samplers but also avoids biased auxiliary estimators and likelihood surrogates used by many prior RL fine-tuning methods. To prevent policy collapse, we also introduce new total-variation regularizers to keep the fine-tuned distribution close to the pretrained one. Theoretically, we establish an upper bound on the discretization error of DoMinO and tractable upper bounds for the regularizers. Experimentally, we evaluate DoMinO on regulatory DNA sequence design. DoMinO achieves stronger predicted enhancer activity and better sequence naturalness than the previous best reward-driven baselines. The regularization further improves alignment with the natural sequence distribution while preserving strong functional performance. These results establish DoMinO as an useful framework for controllable discrete sequence generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DoMinO（Discrete Flow Matching policy Optimization）：一个把离散流匹配（DFM）的采样过程重写为"内部多步 MDP"的强化学习微调框架。其关键洞察是，DFM 的一步跳转分布恰好就是 MDP 的策略 π_t^θ(x_{t+Δt}|x_t)=u_t^θ(x_{t+Δt},x_t)Δt，其对数似然是闭式可解的，从而可以在不使用似然代理、不依赖可微奖励、不引入有偏辅助估计器的前提下，直接套用 REINFORCE / PPO / GRPO 等策略梯度算法。作者进一步提出两种基于总变差（TV）距离的正则项（后验交叉熵、广义 KL），并给出 Euler 离散化误差 O(Δt) 与终端 TV 距离的可处理上界。在 HepG2 增强子设计任务上，DoMinO 将预测增强子活性从 SEPO 的 7.55 提升到 8.35，并显著改善序列自然性。
AI.motivation: 离散流匹配（DFM）在语音、图、视频、生物序列等预训练生成任务上表现强劲，但其"奖励驱动的后训练/微调"仍处于探索不足的状态（现有 RL 微调工作主要针对离散扩散模型）。在 DFM 设定下直接最大化终端期望奖励 J(θ)=E_{X_T~p_T^θ}[r(X_T)] 面临三重障碍：(1) DFM 参数化的是底层 CTMC 的转移速率（velocity）而非策略本身，边缘分布与精确似然不可 tractable，直接优化需反传采样过程或估计似然比，方差高、成本大；(2) 大量奖励（尤其是生物学设计中的功能预测器）不可微，无法直接梯度优化；(3) 纯奖励优化易过度优化（over-optimization），产出"钻奖励模型空子"的样本并偏离预训练分布，破坏序列自然度（naturalness）。已有缓解手段如路径级 KL 正则需要沿整条轨迹、对所有下一状态积分，计算代价高且约束的是整条轨迹而非终端分布；同时 DRAKES 依赖 Gumbel-Softmax 直通反传（只支持连续奖励），SEPO 依赖自归一化重要性采样做额外估计，另一些离散扩散 RL 方法使用有偏估计器。因此需要一个直接、无偏、可支持非可微奖励、且保留原 DFM 采样器的通用 RL 微调框架。
AI.method:
【1】内部 MDP 重构（Sec 4.2）：受 DDPO (Black et al., 2023) 启发，把一次 DFM 推理视为"内部多步 MDP" M=(S,A,P,R,1)。状态 s_t=(t,x_t)，动作 a_t=x_{t+Δt}，转移为确定性 P(s_{t+Δt}|s_t,a_t)=(δ_{t+Δt},δ_{x_{t+Δt}})，初始 P_0=(δ_0,p_0)，奖励仅在最后一步给 R(s_{T-Δt},a)=r(x_T)，其余为 0（无折扣）。策略恰为 DFM 的一步跳转分布：π_t^θ(a_t|s_t)=p_t^θ(x_{t+Δt}|x_t)=u_t^θ(x_{t+Δt},x_t)·Δt（当 x_{t+Δt}≠x_t），保持不动时为 1−Σ_{y≠x_t}u_t^θ(y,x_t)Δt。Proposition 4.1 证明该内部 MDP 上的 RL 目标与原目标等价：J_RL(θ)=J(θ)。因此 log π 可解析获得，无需似然代理或额外估计量。条件生成只需在所有量上条件化于 c，框架可自然延伸（适合 GRPO）。

【2】算法实例化（Sec 4.3）：DoMinO-REINFORCE（Alg. 1）用 log-likelihood 策略梯度，∇J=E[Σ_t ∇_θ log p_t^θ(x_{t+Δt}|x_t)·Â(x_T)]，以优势替代原始奖励降方差；DoMinO-PPO（Alg. 2）用裁剪代理目标 J_PPO=E[Σ_t min{r_t(θ)A_t, Clip(r_t(θ),1±ε)A_t}]，似然比 r_t(θ)=p_t^θ/p_t^{θ_old} 可 tractable 计算，终端奖励下采用轨迹级优势共享到各时间步。

【3】TV 距离正则化（Sec 5）：目标是控制终端分布 p_T^θ 与参考 p_T^ref 的 TV 距离而非路径级 KL。在混合路径+后验参数化 p_{1|t}^θ(·|x) 下给出两个正则：(a) 交叉熵正则 L_reg^CE = E_{t,X_t~p_t^{θref}}[−Σ_y p_{1|t}^{θref}(y|X_t) log p_{1|t}^θ(y|X_t)]；(b) 广义 KL 正则 L_reg^gKL = E[D_gKL(u_t^{θref}(·,X_t), u_t^θ(·,X_t))]，其中 D_gKL(u,v)=Σ u_j log(u_j/v_j)−Σu_j+Σv_j。二者复用 RL rollout 已存储的状态，仅需对参考模型再做一次前向。总目标 J_total = J_RL − λ·L_reg。

【4】理论（Sec 6）：Theorem 6.1：在奖励有界、θ 位于紧集、速度场 u_t^θ(·,·)∈C² 的条件下，Euler 采样器给出的奖励及其梯度相对连续时间精确值的误差均为 O(Δt)，即一阶一致。Theorem 6.2：TV(p^θ,p^{θref}) ≲ √(L_reg^CE(θ,θref) − L_reg^CE(θref;θref))。Theorem 6.3：TV(p^θ,p^{θref}) ≲ √L_reg^gKL(θ,θref)。二者说明正则项确实控制了对参考模型的分布漂移。

【5】实验设置（Sec 7）：HepG2 细胞系增强子设计，200bp 序列，约 70 万条带活性测量的大规模数据集 (Gosai et al., 2024)；在全集上预训练 DFM，数据划分为两个 Enformer 奖励 oracle（一个微调用、一个评估用）。指标：评估 oracle 的 Pred-Activity、独立染色质可及性分类器的 ATAC-Acc、以及与 HepG2 全体序列 3-mer 频率谱的 Pearson 相关（3-mer Corr-All，模型无关的自然度度量）。基线含预训练扩散/流匹配、DRAKES（去 KL）、DRAKES+KL、SEPO、SEPO+GF。
AI.result:
表1（无正则）：DoMinO-REINFORCE 的 Pred-Activity 8.32、ATAC-Acc 99.2%、3-mer Corr-All −0.285；DoMinO-PPO 为 8.35 / 99.2% / −0.331。相比 SEPO（7.55 / 99.5% / −0.537），功能活性从 7.55 提升到 8.35 且自然性大幅改善（−0.537 → −0.285/−0.331）；相比 DRAKES（6.37 / 96.1% / −0.379），活性与可及性同步提升。SEPO 的 ATAC-Acc 略高（99.5% vs 99.2%），但整体权衡更优。预训练层面，预训练流匹配（0.64）已优于预训练扩散（0.17），表明 DFM 骨干更适合奖励优化。

表2（正则效果）：DoMinO-REINFORCE + GKL 把 3-mer Corr-All 从 −0.285 提升到 0.013（唯一为正者），Pred-Activity 保持 8.24；+ CE 为 8.22 / 94.1% / −0.347。DoMinO-PPO + CE 为 7.98 / 97.5% / −0.152，+ GKL 为 7.78 / 95.8% / −0.167。相比之下基线的正则收益有限：DRAKES+KL 3-mer 从 −0.379 到 −0.302，SEPO+GF 从 −0.537 到 −0.496。结论是 DoMinO 框架中的正则化带来更大幅度的自然度改善，同时基本保持功能性能，形成"功能优化—序列自然度"更优的折中；REINFORCE+GKL 综合表现最强。

需注意的实验局限：仅在单一任务（DNA 增强子）与单一奖励模型族上验证；TV 上界的证明细节与常数在附录（正文未展开）；表中"自然度"提升伴随 ATAC-Acc 一定下降（如 REINFORCE+GKL 降至 90.2%），说明正则强度与功能保持之间仍存在明显权衡。
AI.conclusion: DoMinO 将 DFM 采样解释为内部 MDP，使得终端奖励最大化被重写为标准、无偏、无需似然代理的 RL 目标，从而把 REINFORCE/PPO/GRPO 等主流策略梯度方法直接迁移到离散流匹配的奖励微调上，同时支持非可微奖励与条件生成，并保留原始 DFM 采样器。理论层面证明 Euler 离散化仅引入一阶 O(Δt) 的目标与梯度误差，且所提出的交叉熵与广义 KL 正则分别为终端 TV 距离提供可处理上界，支撑了"用 TV 而非路径级 KL 做自然度约束"的设计动机。实验在 HepG2 增强子设计上取得 SOTA 的预测增强子活性并优于扩散类基线（DRAKES、SEPO），正则化进一步改善与自然序列分布的对齐。总体而言，该工作确立了策略梯度微调 DFM 作为可控离散序列生成的一条有效范式，同时在"功能强度—自然度"权衡上优于扩散型或既有奖励驱动方法。

title: Learning to Interrupt in Language-based Multi-agent Communication
summary: Multi-agent systems using large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities across various domains. However, current agent communication suffers from verbose output that overload context and increase computational costs. Although existing approaches focus on compressing the message from the speaker side, they struggle to adapt to different listeners and identify relevant information. An effective way in human communication is to allow the listener to interrupt and express their opinion or ask for clarification. Motivated by this, we propose an interruptible communication framework that allows the agent who is listening to interrupt the current speaker. Through prompting experiments, we find that current LLMs are often overconfident and interrupt before receiving enough information. Therefore, we propose a learning method that predicts the appropriate interruption points based on the estimated future reward and cost. We evaluate our framework across various multi-agent scenarios, including 2-agent text pictionary games, 3-agent meeting scheduling, and 3-agent debate. The results of the experiment show that our HANDRAISER can reduce the communication cost by 32.2% compared to the baseline with comparable or superior task performance. This learned interruption behavior can also be generalized to different agents and tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HANDRAISER框架，允许LLM多智能体系统中的倾听者主动打断说话者，通过学习预测最佳打断点来实现通信压缩。实验表明该方法可降低32.2%通信成本，同时保持或提升任务性能。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM多智能体通信存在冗长输出过载上下文、增加计算成本的问题。现有方法仅从说话者侧压缩消息，难以适应不同倾听者并识别相关信息。人类通信中倾听者可主动打断的机制提供了启发。
AI.method: 提出可打断通信框架HANDRAISER，通过提示工程实验发现当前LLM过于自信、过早打断。基于此，设计学习方法根据估计的未来奖励和成本预测最佳打断时机。评估场景包括：双人文本猜词游戏、三人会议调度、三人辩论。
AI.result: 相比基线方法，HANDRAISER降低32.2%通信成本，同时任务性能相当或更优。学习到的打断行为可泛化至不同智能体和任务。
AI.conclusion: 赋予倾听者主动打断能力是实现高效多智能体通信的有效途径，通过学习预测打断点可显著降低通信开销且保持任务效果。

title: Optimal Rates for Pure {\varepsilon}-Differentially Private Stochastic Convex Optimization with Heavy Tails
summary: We study stochastic convex optimization (SCO) with heavy-tailed gradients under pure epsilon-differential privacy (DP). Instead of assuming a bound on the worst-case Lipschitz parameter of the loss, we assume only a bounded k-th moment. This assumption allows for unbounded, heavy-tailed stochastic gradient distributions, and can yield sharper excess risk bounds. The minimax optimal rate for approximate (epsilon, delta)-DP SCO is known in this setting, but the pure epsilon-DP case has remained open. We characterize the minimax optimal excess-risk rate for pure epsilon-DP heavy-tailed SCO up to logarithmic factors. Our algorithm achieves this rate in polynomial time with high probability. Moreover, it runs in polynomial time with probability 1 when the worst-case Lipschitz parameter is polynomially bounded. For important structured problem classes - including hinge/ReLU-type and absolute-value losses on Euclidean balls, ellipsoids, and polytopes - we achieve the same excess-risk guarantee in polynomial time with probability 1 even when the worst-case Lipschitz parameter is infinite. Our approach is based on a novel framework for privately optimizing Lipschitz extensions of the empirical loss. We complement our excess risk upper bound with a novel high probability lower bound.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了重尾梯度下的纯ε-差分隐私随机凸优化问题。在仅假设梯度存在有界k阶矩的条件下（无需最坏情况Lipschitz参数有界），提出了多项式时间算法，实现了接近最优的 excess risk 界限，并针对特定结构化问题类（铰链/ReLU型损失、绝对值损失在欧式球、椭球和多面体上）即使在最坏Lipschitz参数无穷时也能以概率1在多项式时间内达到同样保证。
AI.motivation: 纯ε-差分隐私（pure ε-DP）下的重尾随机凸优化的极小极大最优速率此前是开放的。现有工作已知近似(ε,δ)-DP情况下的最优率，但纯ε-DP情况缺乏完整刻画。此外，传统方法依赖Lipschitz参数有界假设，无法处理梯度无界、分布重尾的更一般场景。
AI.method: 提出了一个私有优化经验损失Lipschitz扩展的新框架。通过对经验损失构建适当的Lipschitz延拓，然后应用私有优化算法，在仅依赖k阶矩有界的假设下获得 excess risk 上界。利用问题结构（如欧式球、椭球、多面体上的特定损失函数）设计定制化算法实现概率1的多项式时间保证。
AI.result: 刻画了纯ε-DP重尾SCO的极小极大最优 excess risk 速率（至对数因子），给出了相应的高概率下界，并提出多项式时间算法以高概率达到该速率。对于结构化问题类，算法以概率1在多项式时间内达到最优 excess risk 界限，即使最坏情况Lipschitz参数无穷。
AI.conclusion: 纯ε-DP重尾SCO的极小极大问题已得到完整刻画，通过Lipschitz扩展框架为重尾、无界梯度的私有优化提供了理论与算法基础。

title: Context-Aware Dialectal Arabic Machine Translation with Interactive Region and Register Selection
comment: 14 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables. Preprint under review
summary:
Current Machine Translation (MT) systems for Arabic often struggle to account for dialectal diversity, frequently homogenizing dialectal inputs into Modern Standard Arabic (MSA) and offering limited user control over the target vernacular. In this work, we propose a context-aware and steerable framework for dialectal Arabic MT that explicitly models regional and sociolinguistic variation. Our primary technical contribution is a Rule-Based Data Augmentation (RBDA) pipeline that expands a 3,000-sentence seed corpus into a balanced 57,000-sentence parallel dataset, covering eight regional varieties eg., Egyptian, Levantine, Gulf, etc. By fine-tuning an mT5-base model conditioned on lightweight metadata tags, our approach enables controllable generation across dialects and social registers in the translation output.
  Through a combination of automatic evaluation and qualitative analysis, we observe an apparent accuracy-fidelity trade-off: high-resource baselines such as NLLB (No Language Left Behind) achieve higher aggregate BLEU scores (13.75) by defaulting toward the MSA mean, while exhibiting limited dialectal specificity. In contrast, our model achieves lower BLEU scores (8.19) but produces outputs that align more closely with the intended regional varieties. Supporting qualitative evaluation, including an LLM-assisted cultural authenticity analysis, suggests improved dialectal alignment compared to baseline systems (4.80/5 vs. 1.0/5). These findings highlight the limitations of standard MT metrics for dialect-sensitive tasks and motivate the need for evaluation practices that better reflect linguistic diversity in Arabic MT.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于规则的数据增强（RBDA）管道，将3,000句种子语料扩展为57,000句平行语料，覆盖8种阿拉伯语方言变体。通过对mT5-base模型进行轻量级元数据标签条件微调，实现方言和社交语域的可控翻译生成。研究揭示了准确性与忠实性之间的权衡：NLLB基线虽BLEU分数更高（13.75），但倾向于向MSA靠拢；本文模型BLEU较低（8.19），却实现更好的方言对齐（文化真实性评分4.80/5 vs 1.0/5）。研究表明标准MT评估指标不适用于方言敏感任务。
AI.motivation: 当前阿拉伯语机器翻译系统难以处理方言多样性，通常将方言输入统一转换为现代标准阿拉伯语（MSA），且对目标方言缺乏用户控制能力。这导致翻译输出无法反映阿拉伯语丰富的区域和社会语言变异性。
AI.method: （1）提出基于规则的数据增强（RBDA）管道，将3,000句种子语料扩展为57,000句平衡平行数据集，覆盖8种地区变体（埃及、黎凡特、海湾等）；（2）使用轻量级元数据标签对mT5-base模型进行条件微调，实现跨方言和社交语域的可控生成；（3）结合自动评估与定性分析（含LLM辅助的文化真实性分析）进行综合评估。
AI.result: 实验揭示了准确性与忠实性的权衡：NLLB基线虽获得更高BLEU分数（13.75），但默认向MSA靠拢，方言特异性有限；本文模型BLEU较低（8.19），但输出更贴近目标地区方言。LLM辅助文化真实性评估显示显著优势（4.80/5 vs 1.0/5）。
AI.conclusion: 标准MT评估指标（如BLEU）不适用于方言敏感任务，亟需更反映阿拉伯语MT语言多样性的评估实践。本研究为可控制的方言翻译提供了可行框架，但需开发专门的方言评估基准。

title: Improving Robustness In Sparse Autoencoders via Masked Regularization
summary: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are widely used in mechanistic interpretability to project LLM activations onto sparse latent spaces. However, sparsity alone is an imperfect proxy for interpretability, and current training objectives often result in brittle latent representations. SAEs are known to be prone to feature absorption, where general features are subsumed by more specific ones due to co-occurrence, degrading interpretability despite high reconstruction fidelity. Recent negative results on Out-of-Distribution (OOD) performance further underscore broader robustness related failures tied to under-specified training objectives. We address this by proposing a masking-based regularization that randomly replaces tokens during training to disrupt co-occurrence patterns. This improves robustness across SAE architectures and sparsity levels reducing absorption, enhancing probing performance, and narrowing the OOD gap. Our results point toward a practical path for more reliable interpretability tools.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种掩码正则化（masked regularization）训练策略：在训练SAE时以概率p随机将输入序列中的token替换为掩码字符串"..."，以打断特征共现模式，从而缓解特征吸收（feature absorption）、提升探针性能并缩小OOD泛化差距。在Pythia-160M-deduped与Gemma-2-2B的MatryoshkaBatchTopK SAE上，跨多种稀疏度（ℓ₀=20/40/80/160）一致改善吸收、稀疏探针、TPP、SCR等指标，OOD探针AUC分别提升1.48%和2.4%。
AI.motivation: 稀疏自编码器（SAE）被广泛用于LLM的机制可解释性分析，但其稀疏性目标只是可解释性的不完美代理，导致学到的潜表示脆弱、易产生捷径（shortcut）结构。具体表现为两类失败模式：(1) 特征吸收（feature absorption）——由于共现模式，通用特征被更具体的特征吞并，例如本应表示"以S开头的词"的潜变量坍缩为"短的以S开头的词"，虽保持高重建保真度但可解释性下降；(2) 基于SAE潜变量训练的探针在分布外（OOD）任务上泛化性能远低于直接在原始激活上训练的oracle探针。作者认为二者根源相同：当前训练目标约束不足（under-specified），既未阻止共现驱动的捷径，也未鼓励可泛化的结构。仅靠MatryoshkaBatchTopK等架构改进并不足够，需要更强的训练目标。
AI.method: 设LLM为G，token序列t分词后在第l层产生token级激活X^(l)∈R^{n×D}，作为SAE训练数据。SAE包含编码器e(x)=σ(W_e x+b_e)∈R^m（m≫D，σ为BatchTopK等稀疏诱导非线性）与解码器x̂=W_d e(x)+b_d，目标为L(x)=‖x−x̂‖²₂+λ‖e(x)‖₁。掩码正则化：对输入序列采样二值掩码ω~Bernoulli(p)，将选中token替换为固定掩码字符串"..."得到t′，再送入LLM产生掩码后的激活x′，使用同一目标L_mask(x′)=‖x′−x̂′‖²₂+λ‖e(x′)‖₁训练。其机理在于掩码改变了周边token的上下文嵌入，从而去相关特征共现，迫使潜变量捕获更一般的结构而非捷径，降低吸收风险。实验：Pythia-160M-deduped（layer 8）与Gemma-2-2B（layer 12），残差流激活，字典大小4096，Pile-CC-deduplicated上训练500M tokens，超参沿用dictionary_learning代码库；ℓ₀∈{20,40,80,160}，默认掩码概率p=0.3。评估含五项指标：Mean Full Absorption、Explained Variance、Sparse Probing（稀疏逻辑回归）、TPP（针对性消融导致的探针精度下降）、SCR（去除虚假相关潜变量并保留任务相关特征的能力）；OOD部分采用Smith等人的协议，在8个OOD数据集上评估ℓ₀=20的平均测试AUC，并与oracle探针比较；另做掩码概率{0.2,0.3,0.5}消融。
AI.result: 表1（Pythia, MatryoshkaBatchTopK, layer 8）：掩码使Mean Full Absorption从86.119/91.646/94.650/97.434提升至88.475/93.450/96.437/98.003（ℓ₀=20处+2.35个百分点）；Sparse Probing在ℓ₀=20与40分别提升2.09和2.01个百分点；TPP在ℓ₀=20提升2.27个百分点；SCR在ℓ₀=80、160分别提升7.5与11.8个百分点；Explained Variance在高稀疏下略降（如ℓ₀=20为71.266 vs 72.172，ℓ₀=160则升至88.823 vs 87.841）。表2（Gemma-2-2B, layer 12）：Mean Full Absorption在ℓ₀=20提升3.75个百分点（90.805→94.559），Explained Variance整体相当或略优，稀疏探针/TPP/SCR在多数稀疏度上持平或更好，ℓ₀=160时SCR提升4.3个百分点，个别设置存在轻微退化（如ℓ₀=80吸收略降、ℓ₀=160 TPP 17.550→15.988）。OOD（图1）：掩码显著提升两个LLM的OOD平均AUC（Pythia +1.48%，Gemma +2.4%），并缩小SAE与oracle探针的差距。消融（表3）：掩码概率越大，吸收指标越高但解释方差越低；p=0.3为最佳折中，p=0.5时吸收升至89.602但解释方差降至69.540。总体趋势是改进在高稀疏（低ℓ₀）时更显著，低稀疏时基线本身已较优、收益递减。
AI.conclusion: 掩码正则化是一种简单、架构无关且可调强度的训练目标改进，通过破坏token共现模式抑制SAE的捷径学习，可在不改动架构的前提下同时缓解特征吸收、提升稀疏探针与TPP/SCR表现、增强OOD鲁棒性，代价是低稀疏下解释方差的小幅损失；最佳掩码概率为0.3。作者认为该策略为更可靠的可解释性工具提供了实用路径，并计划扩展到更大规模LLM、比较其他掩码字符串、以及引入自动可解释性技术来刻画所学特征。局限包括实验仅覆盖Pythia与Gemma两个模型、掩码字符串选择未系统研究、以及部分稀疏度设置下存在小幅性能退化。

title: Multi-objective Evolutionary Merging Enables Efficient Reasoning Models
summary: Reasoning models have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in solving complex problems by leveraging long chains of thought. However, this more deliberate reasoning comes with substantial computational overhead at inference time. The Long-to-Short (L2S) reasoning problem seeks to maintain high accuracy using fewer tokens, but current training-free model merging approaches rely on scalarized, fixed-hyperparameter arithmetic methods that are highly brittle and force suboptimal compromises. To address this gap, we introduce Evo-L2S, a novel framework that formulates L2S reasoning as a multi-objective optimization challenge. By leveraging evolutionary model merging, Evo-L2S explicitly optimizes the trade-off between accuracy and output length to produce a robust Pareto front of merged models. To make this search computationally tractable for large language models, we propose an entropy-based subset sampling technique that drastically reduces the overhead of fitness estimation. Comprehensive experiments across 1.5B, 7B, and 14B parameter scales on six mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that Evo-L2S can reduce the length of generated reasoning traces by over 50% while preserving, or even improving, the problem-solving accuracy of the original reasoning models.

AI.tldr: Evo-L2S是一个新颖的框架，将长链推理（L2S）问题重新定义为多目标优化挑战，通过进化模型合并技术，在保持或提升准确率的同时，将推理长度减少超过50%。该方法采用基于熵的子集采样技术来降低大规模语言模型的计算开销，并在1.5B、7B和14B参数规模的6个数学推理基准测试中验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 当前推理模型依赖长链思维来解决复杂问题，但这带来了大量计算开销。现有的免训练模型合并方法使用标量化固定超参数的算术方法，存在高度脆弱性且被迫做出次优权衡。
AI.method: Evo-L2S将L2S推理问题形式化为多目标优化挑战，利用进化模型合并显式优化准确率与输出长度之间的权衡，生成鲁棒的Pareto前沿模型。为使搜索对大语言模型计算可行，提出了基于熵的子集采样技术来大幅降低适应度评估的开销。
AI.result: 在1.5B、7B和14B参数规模的6个数学推理基准测试中，Evo-L2S能将生成的推理轨迹长度减少超过50%，同时保持或甚至提升原始推理模型的问题解决准确率。
AI.conclusion: 通过进化多目标优化和创新的采样策略，Evo-L2S成功实现了高效的长链推理压缩，为平衡推理效率与性能提供了新的研究方向。

title: Transformer See, Transformer Do: Copying as an Intermediate Step in Learning Analogical Reasoning
summary: Analogical reasoning is a hallmark of human intelligence, enabling us to solve new problems by transferring knowledge from one situation to another. Yet, developing artificial intelligence systems capable of robust human-like analogical reasoning has proven difficult. In this work, we train transformers using Meta-Learning for Compositionality (MLC) on an analogical reasoning task (letter-string analogies) and assess their generalization capabilities. We find that letter-string analogies become learnable when guiding the models to attend to the most informative problem elements induced by including copying tasks in the training data. Furthermore, generalization to new alphabets becomes better when models are trained with more heterogeneous datasets, where our 3-layer encoder-decoder model outperforms most frontier models. The MLC approach also enables some generalization to compositions of trained transformations, but not to completely novel transformations. To understand how the model operates, we identify an algorithm that approximates the model's computations. We verify this using interpretability analyses and show that the model can be steered precisely according to expectations derived from the algorithm. Finally, we discuss implications of our findings for generalization capabilities of larger models and parallels to human analogical reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文训练使用元学习组合性(MLC)的transformer模型解决字母串类比任务，发现包含复制任务的训练数据能引导模型关注信息量最大的元素，异质性数据集提升跨字母表泛化能力，3层编码器-解码器模型性能超越多数前沿模型，且可识别出近似模型计算的算法并进行精确引导。
AI.motivation: 类比推理是人类智能的标志，使人类能够将一个情境的知识迁移到另一个情境。然而，开发具有稳健类人泛化能力的人工智能系统仍然困难重重。
AI.method: 使用Meta-Learning for Compositionality (MLC)训练transformer模型，在字母串类比任务上进行评估，并通过在训练数据中引入复制任务来引导模型关注最具信息量的元素。
AI.result: 1) 字母串类比在包含复制任务的训练指导下变得可学习；2) 使用更异质的训练数据集能改善跨字母表泛化能力；3) 3层编码器-解码器模型优于大多数前沿模型；4) MLC方法能实现对训练转换组合的泛化，但无法泛化到全新转换；5) 可识别出近似模型计算的算法。
AI.conclusion: MLC方法结合特定训练策略可实现有效的类比推理泛化，模型行为可通过可解释算法精确描述和引导，研究结果对理解更大规模模型的泛化能力及类人推理机制具有参考价值。

title: DataSTORM: Deep Research on Large-Scale Databases using Exploratory Data Analysis and Data Storytelling
summary:
Deep research with Large Language Model (LLM) agents is emerging as a powerful paradigm for multi-step information discovery, synthesis, and analysis. However, existing approaches primarily focus on unstructured web data, while the challenges of conducting deep research over large-scale structured databases remain relatively underexplored. Unlike web-based research, effective data-centric research requires more than retrieval and summarization and demands iterative hypothesis generation, quantitative reasoning over structured schemas, and convergence toward a coherent analytical narrative.
  In this paper, we present DataSTORM, an LLM-based agentic system capable of autonomously conducting research across both large-scale structured databases and internet sources. Grounded in principles from Exploratory Data Analysis and Data Storytelling, DataSTORM reframes deep research over structured data as a thesis-driven analytical process: discovering candidate theses from data, validating them through iterative cross-source investigation, and developing them into coherent analytical narratives. We evaluate DataSTORM on InsightBench, where it achieves a new state-of-the-art result with a 19.4% relative improvement in insight-level recall and 7.2% in summary-level score. We further introduce a new dataset built on ACLED, a real-world complex database, and demonstrate that DataSTORM outperforms proprietary systems such as ChatGPT Deep Research across both automated metrics and human evaluations.

AI.tldr: DataSTORM 是一个面向大规模结构化数据库的 LLM 智能体深度研究系统，借鉴探索性数据分析（EDA）与数据叙事（Data Storytelling），将深度研究重构为「论点驱动（thesis-driven）的分析过程」：从数据中发现候选论点、通过跨来源迭代验证、最终收敛为连贯的叙述性报告。在 InsightBench 上取得 SOTA（insight-level 相对提升 19.4%，summary-level 提升 7.2%），并在基于 ACLED 冲突数据库构建的新基准上全面优于 OpenAI Deep Research。
AI.motivation: 现有「深度研究」类 LLM 智能体几乎都面向非结构化网页文本，隐含假设「知识主要表达为自然语言」。但在金融、政策、冲突分析等高价值领域，关键知识往往编码在结构化数据库中，以数值关系、实体和形式化 schema 存在。作者实测发现即便是 OpenAI Deep Research 这类领先系统，也仅有 23.3% 的洞察来自数据库内容。此外，对结构化数据的研究不能停留在「检索+摘要」，而需要：(1) 迭代式假设生成与检验；(2) 归纳式模式发现与演绎式推理的交织；(3) 向连贯中心叙事的收敛。同时，现有线性的固定流水线/多智能体方案未针对大规模数据库探索的独特挑战（如并行分支在时间窗、过滤条件上悄然漂移，导致结论表面矛盾实则不可比）作设计。
AI.method: 系统分为三阶段。①预热启动（Warm-start）：用 Co-STORM 在互联网语料上做浅层检索式研究，产出初始洞察库 B₀ 与预报告 r₀（起始论点为空）。②多智能体分层探索框架：最多 m=5 层，每层由 Planner 智能体基于当前洞察库与论点生成最多 n 个自然语言探索问题（标注路由到「数据库」或「互联网」），再由独立的 Executor 智能体（ReAct 风格，配备 get_tables / retrieve_tables_details / execute_sql / execute_python_from_sql / stop 五个动作，上下文隔离）把问题翻译为 SQL 并取数。四个关键机制：(a) Planner–Executor 分解，对应 EDA 的「提问—检索」循环；(b) 查询一致性模块，比较同层及与全局洞察库中的 SQL，对不一致的谓词（如 actor1 vs assoc_actor_1、disorder_type vs event_type、COUNT(*) vs SUM(fatalities)）生成 follow-up 修正查询；(c) 自底向上的归纳式统计浮现，在每个回答中嵌入各列摘要统计（唯一值比例、Top-5 值、数值列的 min/max/median/mean）以暴露自顶向下查询难以预料的异常模式；(d) 论点驱动探索，第 p 层后由 thesis 生成模块产出候选论点，此后每 p 层按 sharpen / pivot / confirm 动作精修论点并给出研究策略，后续提问围绕该论点展开。每层结束时合并新证据并按上限裁剪洞察库，低质量洞察可被更强发现替换。③最终报告生成：采用五阶段编辑流水线——大纲规划（分节、分配证据子集）→ 分节撰写 → 句级事实核查（按引用边界切块、标注无支撑论断）→ 据批评修订 → 汇总润色，以抑制幻觉引用与结构松散问题。
AI.result: InsightBench（100 条实例，GPT-4o 与 Qwen3-30B 双评审）：相对 AgentPoirot（gpt-5）在 insight-level 提升 14.8%/19.4%，summary-level 提升 5.9%/7.2%（GPT-4o 评审 61.9/52.5 vs 47.1/46.6；Qwen3-30B 评审 69.3/58.7 vs 49.9/51.5）。作者指出原论文的 Llama-3 评审几乎总给 7/10 的退化打分，故改用 Qwen3-30B 与 GPT-4o。错误分析（20 条低分金标）中 45% 归因于数据集标注错误，55% 为真实模型失败，其中 45% 涉及时间序列趋势分析。新建的 ACLED 基准（2020-01-01 至 2025-01-02，1,630,187 行 31 列，20 个主题，基于 ACLED 专家文章派生中性 prompt）：DataSTORM 参考诱导标准匹配 61.8%（vs 51.2% / 48.5%）、RACE 总分 52.6（vs 49.5 / 49.3）、数据库使用率 66.4%（vs 23.3% / 30.4%）；基线通过 Serper 自建搜索屏蔽 ACLED 域名并限制为文章发表前的网页以防信息泄漏。消融（10 主题）：去掉论点生成下降 13.5 点，去掉归纳统计层下降 5.4 点；查询一致性总分由 0.406 提升至 0.549。人工评测（IRB 批准，10 名有调查报道经验的评审，平均 13.3 年经验，40 次评审-主题评分）：DataSTORM 在 7 项 newsworthiness 中的 6 项领先，原创性显著提升（3.05 vs 2.21，p<0.05）；两两偏好中 57.5% 优于 OpenAI DR，对专家原文报告的偏好率 47.5%（OpenAI DR 仅 30.0%）。数值忠实性人工核验 50 条 SQL 支撑断言：86% 忠实、10% 不忠实、4% 不确定，SQL 检索正确率 94%。论点精修事件分布为 sharpen 34 / pivot 3 / confirm 1 / confirm-and-sharpen 2；342 条证据中 21.9% 对初始论点构成限定、反驳或混合，提示该机制有助于缓解确认偏误与过早锁定。
AI.conclusion: DataSTORM 证明把深度研究智能体重新设想为「数据驱动的分析系统」而非纯检索流水线是可行的：规划者-执行者分解、归纳统计浮现与演绎推理的结合、查询一致性保障的局部连贯、以及论点驱动带来的全局叙事收敛，共同支撑了面向数据库的高质量研究报告，在自动指标、专家评测与人工评测上均优于 AgentPoirot 与 OpenAI Deep Research。局限与未来工作：数据清洗（data wrangling）不在范围内、假定输入已清洗；Planner 继承底层 LLM 的假设生成偏误（选择与框架偏误）；时间序列推理能力弱（占真实失败的 45%）待提升；报告可读性、读者引导偏弱——评审在 27.5% 的反馈中指出其可读性与后续报道方向沟通不足，而基线在背景铺垫与读者上手方面更受好评；如何将论点驱动的研究能力与干净、易读、上下文丰富的报告风格结合是关键后续方向。

title: VLMShield: Efficient and Robust Defense of Vision-Language Models against Malicious Prompts
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) face significant safety vulnerabilities from malicious prompt attacks due to weakened alignment during visual integration. Existing defenses suffer from efficiency and robustness. To address these challenges, we first propose the Multimodal Aggregated Feature Extraction (MAFE) framework that enables CLIP to handle long text and fuse multimodal information into unified representations. Through empirical analysis of MAFE-extracted features, we discover distinct distributional patterns between benign and malicious prompts. Building upon this finding, we develop VLMShield, a lightweight safety detector that efficiently identifies multimodal malicious attacks as a plug-and-play solution. Extensive experiments demonstrate superior performance across multiple dimensions, including robustness, efficiency, and utility. Through our work, we hope to pave the way for more secure multimodal AI deployment. Code is available at [this https URL](https://github.com/pgqihere/VLMShield).

AI.tldr: 本文针对视觉-语言模型(VLMs)在视觉信息集成过程中对齐削弱导致的安全漏洞问题，提出了MAFE框架和VLMShield轻量级安全检测器，通过分析良性与恶意提示的特征分布差异实现高效多模态恶意攻击检测。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言模型(VLMs)面临恶意提示攻击带来的严重安全漏洞，现有防御方法在效率和鲁棒性方面存在不足。
AI.method: 1) 提出MAFE(多模态聚合特征提取)框架，使CLIP能够处理长文本并融合多模态信息；2) 通过分析MAFE提取的特征，发现良性与恶意提示存在明显分布差异；3) 基于此发现开发VLMShield轻量级安全检测器。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法在鲁棒性、效率和实用性方面均表现优异。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为更安全的多模态AI部署提供了新思路，可作为即插即用的解决方案有效识别多模态恶意攻击。

title: ValueGround: Evaluating Culture-Conditioned Visual Value Grounding in MLLMs
summary: Cultural values are expressed not only through language but also through visual scenes and everyday social practices. Yet existing evaluations of cultural values in language models are almost entirely text-only, making it unclear whether models can ground culture-conditioned judgments when response options are visualized. We introduce ValueGround, a benchmark for evaluating culture-conditioned visual value grounding in multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Built from World Values Survey (WVS) questions, ValueGround uses minimally contrastive image pairs to represent opposing response options while controlling irrelevant variation. Given a country, a question, and an image pair, a model must choose the image that best matches the country's value tendency without access to the original response-option texts. Across six MLLMs and 13 countries, average accuracy drops from 72.8% in the text-only setting to 65.8% when options are visualized, despite 92.8% accuracy on option-image alignment. Stronger models are more robust, but all remain prone to prediction reversals. Our benchmark provides a controlled testbed for studying cross-modal transfer of culture-conditioned value judgments.

AI.tldr: ValueGround是一个评估多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)在文化价值观视觉接地能力的新基准。研究发现，从纯文本设置(72.8%准确率)切换到可视化选项时，准确率下降至65.8%，尽管选项-图像对齐准确率达92.8%。所有模型都存在预测反转现象。
AI.motivation: 现有文化价值观评估几乎完全依赖文本，无法判断模型在视觉化选项下是否仍能进行文化条件化的判断。跨模态场景下的文化价值接地能力尚未得到充分研究。
AI.method: 基于世界价值观调查(WVS)问题构建ValueGround基准，采用最小对比度的图像对来表示对立选项并控制无关变量。在无原始选项文本的条件下，给定国家、问题和图像对，要求模型选择最匹配该国价值倾向的图像。评估了6个MLLMs在13个国家的数据。
AI.result: 文本-only设置准确率为72.8%，可视化选项设置下降至65.8%；选项-图像对齐准确率为92.8%；更强的模型更具鲁棒性，但所有模型都存在预测反转现象。
AI.conclusion: ValueGround提供了一个受控的测试平台，可用于研究文化条件化价值判断的跨模态迁移能力，揭示了当前MLLMs在视觉场景中理解和应用文化价值观的局限性。

title: Efficient Quantization of Mixture-of-Experts with Theoretical Generalization Guarantees
summary: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) allows scaling of language and vision models efficiently by activating only a small subset of experts per input. While this reduces computation, the large number of parameters still incurs substantial memory overhead during inference. Post-training quantization has been explored to address this issue. Because uniform quantization suffers from significant accuracy loss at low bit-widths, mixed-precision methods have been recently explored; however, they often require substantial computation for bit-width allocation and overlook the varying sensitivity of model performance to the quantization of different experts. We propose a theoretically grounded expert-wise mixed precision strategy that assigns bit-width to each expert primarily based on their change in routers l2 norm during training. Experts with smaller changes are shown to capture less frequent but critical features, and model performance is more sensitive to the quantization of these experts, thus requiring higher precision. Furthermore, to avoid allocating experts to lower precision that inject high quantization noise, experts with large maximum intra-neuron variance are also allocated higher precision. Experiments on large-scale MoE models, including Switch Transformer and Mixtral, show that our method achieves higher accuracy than existing approaches, while also reducing inference cost and incurring only negligible overhead for bit-width assignment.

AI.tldr: 本文针对稀疏MoE模型的高内存开销问题，提出基于路由器l2范数变化和神经元内方差的专家级混合精度量化策略，无需显式搜索即可高效分配比特宽度，在Switch Transformer和Mixtral等大规模模型上验证有效。
AI.motivation: 稀疏MoE模型虽降低计算量，但大量参数仍造成高内存开销；现有均匀量化在低比特宽度下精度损失严重；现有混合精度方法计算开销大且未考虑不同专家对量化的敏感度差异。
AI.method: 提出理论驱动的专家级混合精度策略：(1)基于训练时路由器l2范数变化分配精度——变化小的专家捕获不频繁但关键特征，对量化更敏感，需更高精度；(2)结合最大神经元内方差——方差大的专家量化噪声高，也分配更高精度。
AI.result: 在Switch Transformer和Mixtral等大规模MoE模型上验证，本文方法相比现有方案获得更高精度，同时降低推理成本，比特宽度分配仅产生可忽略的计算开销。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为MoE模型的高效推理提供了无需显式搜索的混合精度量化方案，通过路由器行为分析和方差度量实现精准的比特宽度分配，兼顾精度与效率。

title: Closing the Speech-Text Gap with Limited Audio for Effective Domain Adaptation in LLM-Based ASR
summary: Conventional end-to-end automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems rely on paired speech-text data for domain adaptation. Recent LLM-based ASR architectures connect a speech encoder to a large language model via a projection module, enabling adaptation with text-only data. However, this introduces a modality gap, as the LLM is not exposed to the noisy representations produced by the speech projector. We investigate whether small amounts of speech can mitigate this mismatch. We compare three strategies: text-only adaptation, paired speech-text adaptation, and mixed batching (MB), which combines both. Experiments in in-domain and out-of-domain settings show that even limited speech consistently improves performance. Notably, MB using only 10% of the target-domain (less than 4 hours) speech achieves word error rates comparable to, or better than, conventional ASR fine-tuning with the full dataset, indicating that small amounts of speech provide a strong modality-alignment signal.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨在LLM-based ASR系统中，少量语音数据是否能弥合语音编码器与大语言模型间的模态差距。通过对比文本仅适配、语音-文本配对适配和混合批处理（MB）三种策略，发现仅使用10%的目标域语音（不到4小时）即可达到与全数据集微调相当或更好的词错误率（WER）。
AI.motivation: 传统端到端ASR系统依赖配对的语音-文本数据进行领域适配，而基于LLM的ASR架构虽可通过投影模块连接语音编码器与LLM并支持文本仅适配，但存在模态差距问题——LLM未接触过语音投影器产生的噪声表示。
AI.method: 对比三种适配策略：1）文本仅适配；2）语音-文本配对适配；3）混合批处理（MB），即融合前两者。实验涵盖域内和域外场景。
AI.result: 少量语音即可持续提升性能；使用仅10%目标域语音（不到4小时）的MB方法，其WER可与使用完整数据集的传统ASR微调相媲美或更优。
AI.conclusion: 少量语音提供了强有力的模态对齐信号，可在大幅降低标注语音需求的同时有效缓解LLM-based ASR的模态差距问题。

title: Time-Series Classification with Multivariate Statistical Dependence Features
summary: In this paper, we propose a novel framework for non-stationary time-series analysis that replaces conventional correlation-based statistics with direct estimation of statistical dependence in the normalized joint density of input and target signals, the cross density ratio (CDR). Unlike windowed correlation estimates, this measure is independent of sample order and robust to regime changes. The method builds on the functional maximal correlation algorithm (FMCA), which constructs a projection space by decomposing the eigenspectrum of the CDR. Multiscale features from this eigenspace are classified using a lightweight single-hidden-layer perceptron. On the TI-46 digit speech corpus, our approach outperforms hidden Markov models (HMMs) and state-of-the-art spiking neural networks, achieving higher accuracy with fewer than 10 layers and a storage footprint under 5 MB.

AI.tldr: 提出一个基于FMCA（函数最大相关算法）的非平稳时间序列分类框架：以交叉密度比（CDR）替代传统相关性统计量，用两个神经网络以最大化相关为目标训练，通过对CDR做谱分解（SVD）得到多变量依赖的投影空间，再提取多时间尺度的投影功率特征，最后由单隐层MLP分类；在TI-46数字语音库上达到99.39%准确率，优于HMM（96.48%）与脉冲神经网络类方法，且模型小于10层、存储占用低于5 MB、单卡10分钟内可训练完成。
AI.motivation: 非平稳随机过程（如语音）的统计估计存在根本困难：Wiener滤波等基于固定窗口的自/互相关估计在长窗下会混合不同"状态/regime"的统计量（统计混合问题），短窗下估计方差大且需要精确的准平稳分段。HMM虽能显式建模状态切换，但结构复杂、需大量训练数据。互信息虽能刻画全依赖但只给出标量、在高维分布下估计缺乏针对性；Pearson相关仅捕捉线性关系；LMS与RNN可改善状态判别但未解决统计混合的根源。作者因此转向直接估计输入与目标信号的联合PDF——它与样本顺序无关、对状态切换鲁棒；再借助可将其投影到希尔伯特空间的FMCA方法，从联合密度中构造能刻画丰富多变量依赖的特征表示，并希望在仅使用TI-46数据集、无预训练的前提下取得优于紧凑型脉冲网络与HMM的精度与效率。
AI.method: 1) 依赖度量的构建：以CDR ρ(x,u)=p(x,u)/(p(x)p(u)) 作为依赖度量，它是半正定的，据Mercer定理可在RKHS中做正交谱展开 ρ=Σλ_k φ̂_k(x)ψ̂_k(u)，λ_k为特征值。2) FMCA网络：用两个结构相同的网络 f_θ: X→R^K 与 g_ω: U→R^K，以最小化代价 r = log det R_FG − log det R_F − log det R_G（其中 R_F、R_G 为输出的自相关矩阵，P_FG 为互相关矩阵，ACF加 εI 正则）来最大化相关；训练时 x、u 从同类但不同说话人随机抽取以保证说话人无关；收敛后按 R^{-1/2} 白化，再用SVD得到前 K 个CDR特征值及归一化特征函数 f̂_θ=Q_F^T f̄_θ、ĝ_ω=Q_G^T ḡ_ω。3) 特征与分类：将信号分帧后投影到 φ̂_i 基上得到随时间变化的特征函数系数，在每个话语内的 T 个等分时间区间上计算投影功率，构成 K×T 特征矩阵（展平为1D向量）表示时域局部化依赖；最终用带 H2 个隐元的单隐层MLP分类，FMCA网络与分类器均用Adam优化（不同学习率），推理阶段仅需 f 网络。4) 输入表示：比较时域波形与FFT幅度谱两种表示，谱表示使"two/three"等易混类别的投影更可分、类内更紧，因此后续均用谱表示。5) 超参（窗长L、步长S、投影维度K、时间区间数T）通过20折交叉验证（4:1划分，说话人与类别平衡）调节：S=1最佳，L≈50最佳，K≈20饱和，T=4饱和。
AI.result: TI-46（4000条、16名说话人、10个数字）：FMCA全数据集准确率99.39%，高于5状态HMM基线96.48%（4:1划分）、Spike-train KAARMA 95.23%（2:1）、Digital LSM 92.30%（1590条子集）、SWAT-SNN 95.25%（400条子集）；在500条子集上98.96%（对比Digital LSM 99.79%但其需针对5名说话人微调、泛化性差），400条子集上97.78%（优于SWAT-SNN 95.25%）。消融显示步长越小越好（S=1）、窗长L≈50最优（过短缺频率信息，过长混合音素，尤其损害"six""eight"）、K增至约20后收益饱和、T增至4后无明显增益，且最优T与多数数字不超过4个音素的语音学结构一致；FFT按频率重排输入简化了时序模式学习。效率方面为纯前馈结构，层数少于10层、存储占用低于5 MB，单张NVIDIA RTX A5000上10分钟内训练完成，远快于Digital LSM的5.16小时。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明：放弃窗化时间相关、直接从概率密度（以CDR刻画统计依赖并做谱分解）出发，可绕开非平稳状态切换带来的统计混合问题；FMCA导出的多尺度依赖特征结合轻量前馈分类器，在TI-46上以极小的存储与算力成本超越了HMM与多种尖峰脉冲神经网络的识别精度，显示出良好的跨说话人泛化与可扩展性，适合端侧/在线设备部署。作者同时指出所有超参（L、S、K、T）需依据具体数据集的统计特性重新适配；未来工作是将框架扩展到复数域以改进频谱信息处理。

title: MedConclusion: A Benchmark for Biomedical Conclusion Generation from Structured Abstracts
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are widely explored for reasoning-intensive research tasks, yet resources for testing whether they can infer scientific conclusions from structured biomedical evidence remain limited. We introduce $\textbf{MedConclusion}$, a large-scale dataset of $\textbf{5.7M}$ PubMed structured abstracts for biomedical conclusion generation. Each instance pairs the non-conclusion sections of an abstract with the original author-written conclusion, providing naturally occurring supervision for evidence-to-conclusion reasoning. MedConclusion also includes journal-level metadata such as biomedical category and SJR, enabling subgroup analysis across biomedical domains. As an initial study, we evaluate diverse LLMs under conclusion and summary prompting settings and score outputs with both reference-based metrics and LLM-as-a-judge. We find that conclusion writing is behaviorally distinct from summary writing, strong models remain closely clustered under current automatic metrics, and judge identity can substantially shift absolute scores. MedConclusion provides a reusable data resource for studying scientific evidence-to-conclusion reasoning. Our code and data are available at: https://github.com/Harvard-AI-and-Robotics-Lab/MedConclusion.

AI.tldr: MedConclusion是一个包含570万条PubMed结构化摘要的大规模数据集，用于评估大语言模型从结构化生物医学证据中推断科学结论的能力。
AI.motivation: 当前用于测试LLM能否从结构化生物医学证据推断科学结论的资源非常有限，需要大规模标准化数据集来推动该领域研究。
AI.method: 构建MedConclusion数据集，将摘要的非结论部分与原始作者结论配对，并包含期刊级元数据（生物医学类别、SJR等）。在结论生成和摘要生成两种提示设置下评估多种LLM，采用参考度量和LLM-as-a-judge两种评分方式。
AI.result: 发现结论写作在行为上与摘要写作存在显著差异；当前强大模型在自动度量下表现接近，难以区分；评判者的身份会显著影响绝对评分。
AI.conclusion: MedConclusion为研究科学证据到结论的推理能力提供了可复用的数据资源。

title: When Does Context Help? A Systematic Study of Target-Conditional Molecular Property Prediction
comment: 9 pages, 5 figures. Accepted at Workshop on AI for Accelerated Materials Design and Foundation Models for Science: Real-World Impact and Science-First Design at ICLR 2026
summary: We present the first systematic study of when target context helps molecular property prediction, evaluating context conditioning across 10 diverse protein families, 4 fusion architectures, data regimes spanning 67-9,409 training compounds, and both temporal and random evaluation splits. Using NestDrug, a FiLM-based architecture that conditions molecular representations on target identity, we characterize both success and failure modes with three principal findings. First, fusion architecture dominates: FiLM outperforms concatenation by 24.2 percentage points and additive conditioning by 8.6 pp; how you incorporate context matters more than whether you include it. Second, context enables otherwise impossible predictions: on data-scarce CYP3A4 (67 training compounds), multi-task transfer achieves 0.686 AUC where per-target Random Forest collapses to 0.238. Third, context can systematically hurt: distribution mismatch causes 10.2 pp degradation on BACE1; few-shot adaptation consistently underperforms zero-shot. Beyond methodology, we expose fundamental flaws in standard benchmarking: 1-nearest-neighbor Tanimoto achieves 0.991 AUC on DUD-E without any learning, and 50% of actives leak from training data, rendering absolute performance metrics meaningless. Our temporal split evaluation (train up to 2020, test 2021-2024) achieves stable 0.843 AUC with no degradation, providing the first rigorous evidence that context-conditional molecular representations generalize to future chemical space.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统研究目标上下文在分子性质预测中的作用，发现融合架构比条件化方式更重要，上下文在数据稀缺场景下可带来显著提升，但在分布不匹配时可能损害性能，同时揭露了DUD-E等标准基准测试的严重缺陷。
AI.motivation: 分子性质预测中，是否利用目标上下文信息（如蛋白质家族身份）仍不明确。现有方法缺乏系统性比较，且标准基准测试（如DUD-E）存在已知的评估缺陷，需要更严谨的评估框架。
AI.method: 使用NestDrug（基于FiLM的条件化架构），在10种蛋白质家族、4种融合架构、不同数据量（67-9,409个化合物）下进行系统评估。采用时间分割（2020年前训练，2021-2024年测试）和随机分割两种评估方式。
AI.result: 主要发现：1）融合架构主导性能：FiLM优于拼接24.2个百分点，优于加性条件化8.6个百分点；2）上下文实现不可能的预测：数据稀缺的CYP3A4（67个训练样本）达0.686 AUC，而单目标Random Forest仅0.238；3）上下文系统性地损害性能：分布不匹配导致BACE1下降10.2个百分点；4）揭露基准缺陷：DUD-E上1-最近邻Tanimoto达0.991 AUC无需学习，50%活性物质从训练数据泄露。
AI.conclusion: 上下文条件化的价值取决于场景：数据稀缺时显著有益，但分布不匹配时有害。融合架构设计比是否使用上下文更重要。时间分割验证显示上下文条件化分子表示可泛化至未来化学空间（AUC 0.843且无衰减），为分子性质预测提供了更可靠的评估范式。

title: Fine-tuning Whisper for Pashto ASR: strategies and scale
summary: Pashto is absent from Whisper's pre-training corpus despite being one of CommonVoice's largest language collections, leaving off-the-shelf models unusable: all Whisper sizes output Arabic, Dari, or Urdu script on Pashto audio, achieving word error rates above 100%. We compare four fine-tuning strategies for whisper-base on CommonVoice Pashto v20: vanilla full fine-tuning, LoRA (rank 64), frozen-encoder (2/6 layers), and multistage Urdu-to-Pashto transfer. We extend vanilla fine-tuning to whisper-small and whisper-large-v3-turbo on CommonVoice Pashto v24 (113 hours). Vanilla fine-tuning achieves WER 21.22% on CV20, outperforming LoRA by 33.36 pp, frozen-encoder by 14.76 pp, and Urdu transfer by 44.56 pp. Frozen-encoder fine-tuning degrades performance on whisper-base (6 encoder layers): layer-function separation does not hold at this depth, and freezing removes a third of trainable capacity. Urdu-to-Pashto transfer fails due to an unverified intermediate checkpoint, phonological mismatch, and insufficient training. On CV24, whisper-small achieves WER 24.89% (2.24 pp over whisper-base at 3.3x parameters); whisper-large-v3-turbo achieves 23.37% (a further 1.52 pp). Diminishing returns indicate whisper-small is the practical optimum at 113 hours. Online augmentation provides 7.25 pp WER benefit over matched training. Error analysis identifies word-final suffix confusion (masculine -ay vs. feminine -a) and retroflex substitutions involving the Pashto-unique consonant /ts/ as dominant failure modes. Fine-tuned checkpoints and evaluation scripts are released on HuggingFace.

AI.tldr: 本文针对Whisper模型在Pashto（普什图语）语音识别中完全失效的问题，系统比较了四种微调策略。研究表明，全量微调最优，whisper-large-v3-turbo在113小时数据上达到23.37% WER，但考虑到收益递减，whisper-small是实际最优选择。
AI.motivation: Pashto语言虽在CommonVoice数据集中规模庞大，但未被纳入Whisper预训练语料库，导致所有现成模型对Pashto音频输出阿拉伯语、达里语或乌尔都语脚本，词错误率（WER）均超过100%，完全无法使用。
AI.method: 在CommonVoice Pashto数据集上对Whisper-base比较四种微调策略：全量微调、LoRA（秩64）、冻结编码器（2/6层）和多阶段乌尔都语-帕什图语迁移学习；扩展至whisper-small和whisper-large-v3-turbo（CV24，113小时）；并测试在线数据增强。
AI.result: 全量微调在CV20上达21.22% WER，优于LoRA 33.36pp、冻结编码器14.76pp、乌尔都语迁移44.56pp。whisper-small达24.89%（参数量3.3x下仅优2.24pp），whisper-large-v3-turbo达23.37%（再优1.52pp）。在线增强额外降低7.25pp WER。主要错误类型：词尾后缀混淆（阳性的-ay与阴性的-a）及涉及Pashto独有音素/ts/的卷舌音替换。
AI.conclusion: 冻结编码器微调在6层编码器深度下失效，因层功能分离假设不成立且冻结损失1/3可训练容量；乌尔都语迁移失败原因包括中间检查点未验证、音系不匹配及训练不足。在113小时规模下，whisper-small是性能与效率的最佳平衡点。模型检查点和评估脚本已发布于HuggingFace。

title: TwinLoop: Simulation-in-the-Loop Digital Twins for Online Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
summary: Decentralised online learning enables runtime adaptation in cyber-physical multi-agent systems, but when operating conditions change, learned policies often require substantial trial-and-error interaction before recovering performance. To address this, we propose TwinLoop, a simulation-in-the-loop digital twin framework for online multi-agent reinforcement learning. When a context shift occurs, the digital twin is triggered to reconstruct the current system state, initialise from the latest agent policies, and perform accelerated policy improvement with simulation what-if analysis before synchronising updated parameters back to the agents in the physical system. We evaluate TwinLoop in a vehicular edge computing task-offloading scenario with changing workload and infrastructure conditions. The results suggest that digital twins can improve post-shift adaptation efficiency and reduce reliance on costly online trial-and-error.

AI.tldr: TwinLoop是一个用于在线多智能体强化学习的仿真在环数字孪生框架，通过在上下文切换时触发数字孪生进行加速策略改进，减少对物理系统上试错的依赖。
AI.motivation: 去中心化在线学习虽能实现运行时自适应，但当运行条件变化时，已学策略需要大量试错交互才能恢复性能，导致高昂的代价和效率低下。
AI.method: 提出TwinLoop框架，包含：1) 上下文切换时触发数字孪生；2) 重构当前系统状态；3) 从最新智能体策略初始化；4) 通过仿真假设分析进行加速策略改进；5) 将更新参数同步回物理系统。
AI.result: 在车载边缘计算任务卸载场景中评估，环境条件动态变化，结果表明数字孪生可提高切换后适应效率，减少对代价高昂的在线试错的依赖。
AI.conclusion: 数字孪生技术能有效提升多智能体系统在条件变化时的适应效率，为运行时自适应学习提供了一条有前景的技术路径。

title: Does a Global Perspective Help Prune Sparse MoEs Elegantly?
summary:
Empirical scaling laws for language models have encouraged the development of ever-larger LLMs, despite their growing computational and memory costs. Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoEs) offer a promising alternative by activating only a subset of experts per forward pass, improving efficiency without sacrificing performance. However, the large number of expert parameters still leads to substantial memory consumption.
  Existing pruning methods typically allocate budgets uniformly across layers, overlooking the heterogeneous redundancy that arises in sparse MoEs. We propose GRAPE (Global Redundancy-Aware Pruning of Experts, a global pruning strategy that dynamically allocates pruning budgets based on cross-layer redundancy. Experiments on Mixtral-8x7B, Mixtral-8x22B, DeepSeek-MoE, Qwen-MoE, and GPT-OSS show that, under the same pruning budget, GRAPE consistently achieves the best average performance. On the three main models reported in the paper, it improves average accuracy over the strongest local baseline by 1.40% on average across pruning settings, with gains of up to 2.45%.

AI.tldr: 稀疏MoE模型虽能降低推理计算量，但专家参数带来的显存占用仍是大问题。现有剪枝方法（如路由引导、访问频次引导、损失搜索、特征相似度）都在每一层均匀分配剪枝预算，忽略了不同MoE层之间冗余程度的显著差异。论文提出GRAPE（Global Redundancy-Aware Pruning of Experts）：先量化每层的专家冗余度，再以全局熵作为均衡约束，在全局预算下贪心地跨层合并冗余专家。实验表明在相同剪枝预算下，GRAPE在Mixtral-8x7B/8x22B、DeepSeek-MoE-16B、Qwen-MoE、GPT-oss上平均准确率最优，相对最强局部基线平均提升1.40%，最高提升2.45%；但在DeepSeek-MoE上也暴露出层间冗余极度失衡时全局剪枝可能导致模型崩溃的局限。
AI.motivation: 稀疏MoE通过每次前向只激活部分专家降低了推理计算量，但专家参数量庞大导致显存开销显著，因此需要压缩专家。已有MoE剪枝方法（访问频次引导、路由引导、搜索/损失引导、特征激活相似度引导）虽能识别行为相似的专家对并将其合并或删除，但它们普遍在各MoE层之间均匀分配剪枝预算（每层剪相同数量的专家）。作者观察到同一模型内不同MoE层的冗余度差异很大（如图1：Mixtral-8x22B、DeepSeek-MoE的跨层冗余曲线起伏明显，一般前层冗余较低、后层偏高但非单调），均匀预算并未把剪枝压力放在真正冗余的层上，因此需要一种跨层全局视角的预算分配机制，以在显存削减与性能保持之间取得更好平衡。
AI.method: 1) 冗余度度量：为每个MoE层构建专家成对相似度矩阵D^l（可用CKA、均方误差等），定义层内平均冗余R^l = (1/N(N-1))Σ_{i≠j}D_ij^l，并做min-max归一化得到相对冗余R̃^l∈[0,1]，用于跨层比较。2) 全局优化目标：把各层相似度矩阵拼成块对角矩阵A∈R^{LN×LN}，形式化为在掩码M（0/1块对角）下最小化 Σ_{i≠j} A_ij·M_ij，即在总保留专家数K的预算下最大化被移除专家对的相似度，从而跨层联合决定合并方案。3) 熵正则/约束：为避免最优解把预算过度集中到少数高冗余层（如DeepSeek-MoE最后一层）造成层失衡甚至模型崩溃，定义各层保留专家占比p_l = |C^l| / Σ|C^{l'}|，并用全局熵 E = -Σ p_l log p_l 度量保留专家在层间的分布均衡度；令初始熵为E、阈值Ê = E(1-γ)（γ为熵容忍度）。4) 一次性贪心算法（Algorithm 1）：初始每个专家为单独簇，每步在未冻结层中选残余冗余R^l最大者，合并该层中最相似的一对专家（并把对应相似度置零、R^l更新为R^l-2D_ij），随后重算全局熵，若E < Ê则冻结该层不再剪；若所有层被冻结而预算未达成，则重置冻结集合并继续（restart机制），直至总簇数达到K。整个流程无需微调（任务无关设置下关闭所有微调阶段）。
AI.result: 在Mixtral-8x22B（56个MoE层，每层8专家激活2个）、DeepSeek-MoE-16B（27层，64私有+2共享专家，激活6+2）、GPT-oss-20b（24层，32专家激活4个）上，与Router-guided、Count-guided、Enumerate、DEK四种均匀层内剪枝基线比较，评测MMLU（含Humanities/Social Science/STEM/Other）、BoolQ、OpenBookQA、RTE。GRAPE在所有剪枝设置下平均准确率均最优：Mixtral-8x22B达68.2(2e)/62.6(4e)，较最强局部基线分别提升1.79%与2.45%；DeepSeek-MoE达49.8(2e)/49.5(4e)，相对提升1.84%与1.43%；GPT-oss达90.3(2e)/89.5(4e)，提升0.44%与0.45%；三模型平均提升1.40%。附录中Mixtral-8x7B与Qwen-MoE的"保留性能"实验也显示Global Greedy（GRAPE）在各任务上保持最优或接近最优，尤其在Mixtral-8x7B四专家剪枝时优势明显；同时DeepSeek-MoE上观察到层间冗余极度失衡时全局剪枝可能造成模型崩溃的失败案例。
AI.conclusion: 跨层冗余感知的全局预算分配能比均匀层内剪枝获得更好的准确率-压缩折中，说明MoE剪枝不应忽视层间异质性。但该方法存在明确局限：当某些层冗余度畸高（如DeepSeek-MoE末层）时，剪枝预算会过度集中导致模型崩溃，熵约束与restart机制只能部分缓解。作者指出未来需设计更合适、鲁棒的MoE层冗余度评估指标，并探索更具自适应性的全局剪枝策略。

title: PD-SOVNet: A Physics-Driven Second-Order Vibration Operator Network for Estimating Wheel Polygonal Roughness from Axle-Box Vibrations
summary: Quantitative estimation of wheel polygonal roughness from axle-box vibration signals is a challenging yet practically relevant problem for rail-vehicle condition monitoring. Existing studies have largely focused on detection, identification, or severity classification, while continuous regression of multi-order roughness spectra remains less explored, especially under real operational data and unseen-wheel conditions.
